am: አባ አጋቶን ዘዓምድ፦ ታላቁ ጻድቅ በትውልድ ግብጻዊ ሲሆን በ5ኛው መቶ ክ/ዘመን የነበረ የበቃ አባት ነው:: በወጣትነቱ ዓለምን ንቆ በበርሃ መንኖ በከፍተኛ ገዳማዊ ተጋድሎ ኖረ:: በኋላም በከፍታ ዓምድ (ስቲሎስ) ላይ ወጥቶ ለ50 ዓመታት በጾምና በጸሎት ተወስኖ ቆየ::
በዚያም በብርድና በሙቀት እየተፈተነ ሌሊትና ቀን ሳይቀመጥ ቆሞ እግዚአብሔርን ያመሰግን ነበር:: ታላላቅ ተአምራትን በማድረግ: ሕሙማንን በመፈወስና አጋንንትን በማውጣት ታውቋል:: በዚህች ዕለት በሰላም ዐርፎ ወደ ዘላለም ክብሩ ተሸጋግሯል::
አቡነ ያሳይ ዘመንዳባ፦ በጣና ሐይቅ ላይ የሚገኘውን ታላቁን የማንዳባ መድኃኔ ዓለም ገዳም የመሠረቱ ታላቅ ኢትዮጵያዊ ጻድቅ ናቸው:: በ13ኛው መቶ ክ/ዘመን ተነስተው በታላቅ ገዳማዊ ትሩፋት: በትሕርምትና በቅድስና ኖረዋል:: ገዳማቸው እስካሁን ድረስ በጥብቅ ሥርዓቱ የሚታወቅ ሲሆን ጻድቁ በዚህች ቀን ዐርፈዋል::
አባ ጴጥሮስ መምሕረ ጣና፦ በጣና ገዳማት ውስጥ ወንጌልንና የቤተ ክርስቲያንን ትምህርት በማስተማር ብዙ አርድእትን ያፈሩ ደግ አባት ናቸው:: ከቀሲስ ዴግና ጋር በዚህች ቀን መታሰቢያቸው ይከበራል::
የቅዱሳኑ አምላክ በጸሎታቸው ይማረን:: በረከታቸውንም ያብዛልን::
en: Abba Agathon the Stylite: A luminous 5th-century Egyptian desert father who renounced the world in his youth. Aspiring to unceasing prayer, he ascended a solitary pillar, dwelling upon it for fifty years in rigorous asceticism, exposed to scorching sun and freezing night winds.
Standing continuously with hands lifted toward heaven, he interceded for the world, healing the afflicted and casting out demons by divine grace, before reposing in peace on this day.

Abune Yasay of Mandaba: Renowned Ethiopian righteous father of the 13th century, founder of the venerable monastery of Mandaba Medhane Alem on Lake Tana. Celebrated for his strict monastic rule, humility, and contemplative prayer, his holy shrine remains an enduring bastion of Ethiopian monasticism.
Abba Peter Teacher of Lake Tana: A revered spiritual director who labored tirelessly instructing disciples throughout the monasteries of Lake Tana, commemorated this day alongside holy Priest Degna.
May the God of the righteous have mercy on us through their prayers and multiply His grace among us.

am.verse: ነቢይን በነቢይ ስም የሚቀበል የነቢይን ዋጋ ይወስዳል፥ ጻድቅንም በጻድቅ ስም የሚቀበል የጻድቁን ዋጋ ይወስዳል፤ ማንም ከእነዚህ ከታናናሾቹ ለአንዱ ቀዝቃዛ ጽዋ ውኃ ብቻ በደቀ መዝሙር ስም የሚያጠጣ፥ እውነት እላችኋለሁ፥ ዋጋው አይጠፋበትም።

en.verse: He who receives a prophet in the name of a prophet will receive a prophet's reward. He who receives a righteous man in the name of a righteous man will receive a righteous man's reward. Whoever gives one of these little ones just a cup of cold water to drink in the name of a disciple, most certainly I tell you he will in no way lose his reward.

title.am: ቅዱስ እስጢፋኖስ ሊቀ ዲያቆናት (ፍልሠቱ) እና አቡነ ገብረ ማርያም ዘሐንታ
title.en: Translation of St. Stephen the Archdeacon and Abune Gebre Maryam of Hanta

am: ቅዱስ እስጢፋኖስ ሊቀ ዲያቆናት ወቀዳሜ ሰማዕት (ፍልሠቱ)
en: Translation of the Relics of St. Stephen the Archdeacon and Protomartyr
Abune Gebre Maryam of Hanta
Abba Peter of Teraw
St. Cyricus (Qirqos) and His Mother Julietta
St. Ephrem the Syrian
St. Menas of Egypt
St. Marina
St. Christina

am: ቅዱስ እስጢፋኖስ ሊቀ ዲያቆናት ወቀዳሜ ሰማዕት፦ በሐዲስ ኪዳን የመጀመሪያው ሊቀ ዲያቆናትና ቀዳሚው ሰማዕት ይህ ቅዱስ ነው:: በኢየሩሳሌም የመጀመሪያይቱ ቤተ ክርስቲያን የማዕድ አገልግሎት ፈተና ሲገጥማት ሐዋርያት በመንፈስ ቅዱስ መሪነት ከመረጧቸው 7 ዲያቆናት ዋነኛው ቅዱስ እስጢፋኖስ ነበር:: (ሐዋ. 6:5)

ቅዱስ እስጢፋኖስ ጸጋንና ኃይልን ተሞልቶ ድንቆችንና ተአምራትን ያደርግ ነበር:: አይሁድ በቅናት ተነስተው በሐሰት ምስክር ወንጅለው በሸንጎ ፊት አቆሙት:: ፊቱ እንደ መልአክ ፊት ያበራ ነበር:: በመጨረሻም 'እነሆ ሰማያት ተከፍተው የሰው ልጅ በእግዚአብሔር ቀኝ ቆሞ አያለሁ' በማለቱ ወደ ከተማ ውጭ አውጥተው በድንጋይ ወገሩት:: እርሱ ግን 'ጌታ ሆይ! ይህን ኃጢአት አትቁጠርባቸው' ብሎ እየጸለየ ነፍሱን ሰጠ:: በዚህች ዕለት የከበረ ሥጋው ፍልሠት ተፈጽሟል::
አቡነ ገብረ ማርያም ዘሐንታ፦ በትግራይ ሐንታ ገዳም በታላቅ መንፈሳዊ ተጋድሎ የኖሩ ኢትዮጵያዊ ጻድቅ ናቸው:: ሌሊትና ቀን በጾምና ጸሎት በመትጋት ብዙ ደቀ መዛሙርትን አፍርተዋል፤ በዚህች ዕለትም ዐርፈዋል::
አባ ጴጥሮስ ዘሃገረ ጠራው፦ በደብረ ጠራው ሰንሰለት ለብሰው: ከእህል ተከልክለው: በጾምና ጸሎት ተወስነው የኖሩ ታላቅ ባሕታዊ አባት ናቸው:: ፈጣሪን ሌሊትና ቀን 'ቅዱስ ቅዱስ ቅዱስ' እያሉ እያመሰገኑ ሲርባቸው ደረቅ ሣር እየነጩ ይመገቡ ነበር:: ከብዙ ተጋድሎ በኋላ ያረፉት በዚህ ቀን ነው::
አምላከ ቅዱስ እስጢፋኖስ በረድኤት ይጐብኘን:: ከወዳጆቹ በረከትም ተካፋዮች ያድርገን::
en: St. Stephen Archdeacon and Protomartyr: The first martyr and chief of the seven deacons of the New Covenant Church. When administrative burdens arose concerning daily sustenance in Jerusalem, the Apostles, guided by the Holy Spirit, ordained seven men of honest report, full of the Holy Spirit and wisdom, chief among whom was St. Stephen (Acts 6:5).

Stephen, full of grace and power, performed great wonders and miracles among the people. Falsely accused by envious leaders, he stood before the Sanhedrin with his countenance radiating like the face of an angel. Declaring, 'Behold, I see the heavens opened and the Son of Man standing at the right hand of God', he was cast outside the city walls and stoned, praying: 'Lord, do not hold this sin against them.' On this day, the translation of his holy relics is joyfully commemorated.

Abune Gebre Maryam of Hanta: An esteemed Ethiopian monastic father who flourished at the historic monastery of Hanta in Tigray, guiding generations of monastics in unceasing prayer and contemplation until his holy repose.

Abba Peter of Teraw: A renowned hermit who lived in ascetic mortification at Debre Teraw, wearing heavy chains, abstaining from grain, and subsisting on dried wild herbs while chanting ceaseless praises to the Holy Trinity.
May the God of St. Stephen visit us with His helping grace and make us partakers in the blessings of His holy saints.

am.verse: ይህም ቃል ሕዝቡን ሁሉ ደስ አሰኛቸው፤ እምነትና መንፈስ ቅዱስም የሞላበትን ሰው እስጢፋኖስን... መረጡ፤ እስጢፋኖስም ጸጋንና ኃይልን ተሞልቶ በሕዝቡ መካከል ድንቅንና ታላቅ ምልክትን ያደርግ ነበር።

en.verse: This saying pleased the whole multitude. They chose Stephen, a man full of faith and of the Holy Spirit... And Stephen, full of grace and power, performed great wonders and signs among the people.

title.am: ሕንጸታ ለኢየሩሳሌም (ቅዳሴ ቤተ መቅደስ) እና ቅዱስ ጦቢት ጻድቅ
title.en: Consecration of the Church of the Resurrection in Jerusalem and Righteous Tobit

en: Consecration of the Holy Sepulchre (Resurrection) in Jerusalem
St. Helena the Empress
Righteous Tobit the Prophet
Saints Tobias and Sarah
Abba Agathon the Anchorite

am: ቅዱስ ገብረ ማርያም ጻድቅ ንጉሠ ኢትዮዽያ
en: Kidane Mehret (Covenant of Mercy)
St. Elizabeth (Mother of John the Baptist)
St. Gebre Maryam the Righteous King of Ethiopia
St. Honorius the Righteous King
Abba Abunafar (Onuphrius) the Anchorite
Abba Daniel the Righteous
Abba John of the Golden Gospel

am: ሕንጸታ ለኢየሩሳሌም (ቅዳሴ ቤተ መቅደስ)፦ ቅድስት ንግሥት እሌኒ የጌታችንን ክቡር መስቀል ካወጣች በኋላ: በጌታችን መቃብር ላይ: በጎልጎታና በቤተ ልሔም ታላላቅና ያማሩ አብያተ ክርስቲያናትን አነጸች:: የኢየሩሳሌም ሊቀ ጳጳሳት ቅዱስ መቃርስና ከዓለም ዙሪያ የተሰበሰቡ በርካታ ጳጳሳት በተገኙበት በዚህች ዕለት በታላቅ ክብር ተቀደሰች:: እግዚአብሔርም በዚያ ታላቅ በረከትንና ተአምራትን አደረገ::
ቅዱስ ጦቢት ጻድቅ፦ በምርኮ ዘመን በነነዌ ምድር ይኖር የነበረ ቅንና ፈሪሃ እግዚአብሔር የነበረው ጻድቅ ሰው ነው:: የተራቡትን በማብላት: የታረዙትን በማልበስ: የወደቁትን የእሥራኤል ሙታን በሌሊት እየተነሳ በድብቅ በመቅበር ይታወቅ ነበር:: በዚህም ምክንያት ሀብቱን ተዘረፈ፤ ዓይኖቹም ታወሩ::
ነገር ግን በእግዚአብሔር ላይ አላጉረመረመም:: ፈጣሪም ቅዱስ ሩፋኤል ሊቀ መላእክትን ልኮ ልጁን ጦብያን መርቶ: ሣራን አጋብቶ: የዓይኑንም ብርሃን በተአምራት መለሰለት:: ቅዱስ ጦቢት በመልካም እርጅና በ158 ዓመቱ በዚህች ቀን ዐርፏል::
አባ አጋቶን ባሕታዊ፦ በምድረ ግብጽ በርሃ ለብዙ ዓመታት በብሕትውናና በትሕርምት ኖሮ የተጋደለ የበቃ አባት ሲሆን: በዚህች ዕለት እግዚአብሔርን እያመሰገነ በሰላም ዐርፏል::
የቅዱሳኑ አምላክ በጸሎታቸው ይማረን:: በረከታቸውንም ያብዛልን::
en: Consecration of the Church of the Holy Sepulchre in Jerusalem: After recovering the True Cross, Empress St. Helena erected majestic basilicas over Golgotha, the Holy Sepulchre of the Resurrection, and the Nativity cave in Bethlehem. On this day, St. Macarius Patriarch of Jerusalem and a great synod of bishops solemnly consecrated the Basilica of the Resurrection with great joy and heavenly miracles.

Righteous Tobit the Prophet: A righteous and God-fearing Hebrew who lived in exile in Nineveh. Renowned for feeding the hungry, clothing the naked, and rising at night to give secret, honorable burials to slain brethren, he lost his earthly wealth and suffered the loss of his eyesight.

Through all his trials, he remained steadfast in faith without murmuring against God. In reward, the Lord sent Archangel Raphael, who guided his son Tobias, delivered Sarah from demonic oppression, and miraculously restored Tobit's eyesight with fish gall. Righteous Tobit reposed in peace at the age of 158 on this day.
Abba Agathon the Anchorite: A holy hermit who spent decades in solitude and rigorous asceticism in the Egyptian wilderness, departing to the heavenly kingdom on this day.
May the God of the holy saints have mercy upon us and grant us their heavenly blessings.

am.verse: ወደ እግዚአብሔር ቤት እንሂድ ባሉኝ ጊዜ ደስ አለኝ። ኢየሩሳሌም ሆይ፥ እግሮቻችን በአደባባይሽ ቆሙ። ኢየሩሳሌምስ እርስ በርሷ እንደ ተገጠመች ከተማ ተሠርታለች... ስለ ወንድሞቼና ስለ ባልንጀሮቼ፦ በውስጥሽ ሰላም ይሁን እላለሁ። ስለ አምላካችን ስለ እግዚአብሔር ቤት ለአንቺ መልካምነትን እሻለሁ።

en.verse: I was glad when they said to me, 'Let us go into the house of the LORD.' Our feet are standing within your gates, Jerusalem; Jerusalem, that is built as a city that is compact together... For my brothers and companions' sakes, I will now say, 'Peace be within you.' For the sake of the house of the LORD our God I will seek your good.

title.am: በዓለ መስቀል (ዕፀ መስቀል) እና ቅድስት እሌኒ ንግሥት
title.en: Feast of the Finding of the Holy Cross (Meskel) and Empress Helena

en: The Holy Wood of the Cross (Finding of the True Cross)
St. Helena the Empress
St. Cyriacus the Elder
St. Macarius Patriarch of Jerusalem
St. Eudoxius the Priest
Blessed Theognosta of Rome
St. Stephen the Archdeacon and Protomartyr
St. James the Apostle (son of Zebedee)
Holy Fathers Maximus and Domatius
Abba Gerima of Medera
Abba Palamon the Anchorite
Abba Letsun the Meek

am: በዓለ መስቀል፦ መድኃኔ ዓለም ክርስቶስ በፈቃዱ ተሰቅሎ ዓለምን ካዳነ በኋላ አይሁድ በመስቀሉና በመቃብሩ ላይ የሚደረገውን ተአምር መግታት አልተቻላቸውም:: ስለዚህ በምቀኝነት የኢየሩሳሌም ነዋሪዎች ቆሻሻቸውን በጎልጎታ ላይ እንዲጥሉ አዘዙ:: ለ300 ዓመታት ቆሻሻው ተከምሮ እንደ ተራራ ሆነ::
በ4ኛው መቶ ክ/ዘመን ቅድስት ንግሥት እሌኒ የልጇን የቆስጠንጢኖስን በራዕይ መስቀል ማየትና ድል መንሳት አስባ: የመስቀሉን መገኛ ለማግኘት ወደ ኢየሩሳሌም ተጓዘች:: በዚያም አረጋዊውን ኪራኮስን አገኘችው:: እርሱም 'ደመራ ደምረሽ ዕጣን አቅርቢ: ጢሱ ወደ ወደቀበት ሥፍራ ቆፍሪ' ብሎ መከራት::

ቅድስት እሌኒ ደመራ አስደምራ: ዕጣን አሳርጋ ጸለየች:: የዕጣኑ ጢስ ወደ ሰማይ ወጥቶ ተመልሶ መሬት ላይ ዘንበል ብሎ በመስቀሉ መገኛ ላይ ወደቀ:: ቆፋሪዎች ተመድበው ቆፍረው መስከረም 17 ቀን ሦስቱን መስቀሎች አወጡ:: የትኛው የጌታ እንደሆነ ለማወቅ በሞተ ሰው ላይ ባስቀመጡት ጊዜ: የጌታችን ቅዱስ መስቀል ሙታንን አስነሣ:: ሕሙማንንም ፈወሰ::
ቅድስት እሌኒ በታላቅ ደስታና እልልታ መስቀሉን አከበረች:: በኢትዮጵያም ይህ ታላቅ በዓል በደመራና በዝማሬ በድምቀት ይከበራል::
የመስቀሉ ኃይል ከክፉ ነገር ሁሉ ይጠብቀን:: በረከቱም ይደርብን::
en: Feast of the Finding of the Holy Cross: Following our Lord's voluntary Crucifixion and Resurrection, miracles performed through the wood of the Cross confounded the hostile authorities. In malice, the elders commanded the inhabitants of Jerusalem to heap all garbage and refuse over Golgotha. For three hundred years, rubbish accumulated until it became a towering hill.

In the 4th century, pious Empress Helena, moved by the celestial vision of the luminous Cross that granted her son Constantine imperial victory, journeyed to Jerusalem to excavate the Life-giving Cross. Guided to the elder Cyriacus, he advised her: 'Build a bonfire, burn holy incense, and where the smoke bows down, there dig.'

Empress Helena assembled the wood of the bonfire (Demera), offered incense, and prayed. The smoke rose to heaven and descended directly upon the mound of Golgotha. Excavating on Meskerem 17, three crosses were unearthed. To identify the Savior's Cross, they laid them upon a dead man being carried to burial: when the True Cross touched him, the deceased immediately rose alive, and sick were healed.
Empress Helena venerated the Holy Cross with overwhelming joy and thanksgiving. In Ethiopia, this feast is celebrated with spectacular torchlight Demera bonfires and sacred hymns.
May the saving power of the Holy Cross preserve us from all evil and shelter us in divine grace.

am.verse: የመስቀሉ ቃል ለሚጠፉት ሞኝነት፥ ለእኛ ለምንድን ግን የእግዚአብሔር ኃይል ነውና... አይሁድ ምልክትን ይለምናሉ፥ የግሪክ ሰዎችም ጥበብን ይሻሉ፤ እኛ ግን የተሰቀለውን ክርስቶስን እንሰብካለን፤ ይህም ለአይሁድ ማሰናከያ ለአሕዛብም ሞኝነት ነው፥ ለተጠሩት ግን... የእግዚአብሔር ኃይልና የእግዚአብሔር ጥበብ የሆነው ክርስቶስ ነው።

en.verse: For the word of the cross is foolishness to those who are dying, but to us who are being saved it is the power of God... For Jews ask for signs, and Greeks seek after wisdom, but we preach Christ crucified; a stumbling block to Jews, and foolishness to Greeks, but to those who are called... Christ, the power of God and the wisdom of God.

title.am: አቡነ ኤዎስጣቴዎስ ረባን፣ አቡነ አኖሬዎስ ዓቢይ እና ማር ያዕቆብ ግብጻዊ
title.en: Abune Ewostatewos, Abune Honorius the Great, and Mar Jacob of Egypt

en: Abune Ewostatewos (Eustathius) the Teacher
Abune Honorius the Great
Mar Jacob of Egypt
The Holy Cross
St. Helena the Empress
St. Thomas the Apostle
St. Philip the Apostle
St. James the Apostle (of the 72 Disciples)

am: አቡነ ኤዎስጣቴዎስ ረባን፦ ሐዋርያዊው ኢትዮጵያዊ ጻድቅ ሲሆኑ በመካከለኛው ዘመን የኢትዮጵያ ታሪክ ስማቸው እጅግ የጎላ አባት ናቸው:: በኤርትራ ምድር ተወልደው በቅድስና አደጉ፤ በደብረ ጽጌ ገዳም ተምረው ገዳማዊ ትሩፋትን ፈጸሙ:: በተለይም የቀደመችውን ሰንበት (ቀዳሚት ሰንበት) በኦርቶዶክሳዊ ሥርዓት እንድትከበር በጽናት በመሟገት ይታወቃሉ::

በዚህም ምክንያት ብዙ ስደት ደረሰባቸው:: ከደቀ መዛሙርቶቻቸው ጋር በግብጽ: በኢየሩሳሌምና በቂጵሮስ በኩል ተጉዘው አርማንያ ደረሱ:: በዚያም ወንጌልን ሰብከው: ተአምራትን አድርገው: ብዙ አብያተ ክርስቲያናትን አንጸው በዚህች ቀን በሰላም ዐረፉ:: ደቀ መዛሙርቶቻቸውም ወደ ኢትዮጵያ ተመልሰው ታላላቅ ገዳማትን መሥርተዋል::
አቡነ አኖሬዎስ ዓቢይ፦ የአቡነ ተክለ ሃይማኖት ደቀ መዝሙር ሲሆኑ በሸዋ ምድር በደብረ ጽጋግ ታላቅ ገዳማዊ ተጋድሎን ያደረጉ: ነገሥታቱን በድፍረት የገሠጹ ታላቅ ኢትዮጵያዊ ጻድቅ ናቸው::
ማር ያዕቆብ ግብጻዊ፦ በግብጽ በርሃ በጽኑ ተጋድሎ የኖረና ብዙ ተአምራትን ያደረገ ጻድቅ አባት ነው::
አምላከ ቅዱሳን በረከታቸውን ያብዛልን:: በቃል ኪዳናቸውም ይጠብቀን::
en: Abune Ewostatewos (Eustathius) the Teacher: A prominent Ethiopian apostolic father of the 14th century, born in modern Eritrea. Renowned for his strict asceticism and unbending defense of the biblical Saturday Sabbath observance alongside the Sunday Resurrection, he faced intense persecution.

Journeying abroad with his devoted disciples, he traveled through Egypt, the Holy Land, and Cyprus unto Armenia, where he preached the Gospel, worked extraordinary miracles, and consecrated churches before reposing in peace on this day. His disciples returned to Ethiopia to establish famous monastic centers across northern Ethiopia.
Abune Honorius the Great: A foremost disciple of Abune Tekle Haymanot, celebrated for establishing the monastery of Debre Tsigag in Shewa and fearlessly rebuking royalty for immorality.
Mar Jacob of Egypt: A venerable Egyptian desert anchorite commemorated for his austere virtues and wonderworking prayer.
May the God of the righteous multiply their blessings upon us and preserve us through their covenant.

am.verse: እናንተ የምድር ጨው ናችሁ... እናንተ የዓለም ብርሃን ናችሁ። በተራራ ላይ ያለች ከተማ ልትሰወር አይቻላትም... መልካሙን ሥራችሁን አይተው በሰማያት ያለውን አባታችሁን እንዲያከብሩ ብርሃናችሁ እንዲሁ በሰው ፊት ይብራ።

en.verse: You are the salt of the earth... You are the light of the world. A city located on a hill can't be hidden... Even so, let your light shine before men, that they may see your good works, and glorify your Father who is in heaven.

title.am: ቅዱስ ጐርጐርዮስ ዘአርማንያ እና ቅድስት ሮማነ ወርቅ
title.en: St. Gregory the Illuminator of Armenia and St. Romane-Werq

en: St. Gregory the Illuminator of Armenia
St. Cyricus the Anchorite
St. Romane-Werq
The Holy Cross
Archangel Gabriel
St. Isidore the Martyr
Abune Abiye Egzi' the Righteous
Abune Sene Eyesus
Abune Joseph Light of the World

am: ቅዱስ ጐርጐርዮስ ዘአርማንያ፦ የአርማንያ ሐዋርያና ብርሃን ሰጪ ተብሎ የሚጠራው ይህ ቅዱስ አባት: ለ15 ዓመታት እባቦችና ጊንጦች በሞሉበት ጥልቅ ጉድጓድ (ኮር ቪራፕ) ውስጥ በግፍ ተጥሎ ቆየ:: ንጉሥ ድርጣድስ ቅድስት አርሴማንና ደናግሉን ከገደለ በኋላ በአእምሮ እብደት ተመትቶ እንደ አውሬ ሆነ::
የንጉሡ እህት በሕልም ታይታ ቅዱስ ጐርጐርዮስን ከጉድጓድ አውጥተው አመጡት:: ቅዱሱም ጸልዮ ንጉሡን ፈወሰው፤ ንጉሡም ተጸጽቶ መላው የአርማንያ ሕዝብ ክርስትናን ተቀበለ:: ቅዱስ ጐርጐርዮስ መላውን አገር አጥምቆ አብያተ ክርስቲያናትን አንጾ በሰላም ዐረፈ::
ቅድስት ሮማነ ወርቅ፦ ደግና ፈሪሃ እግዚአብሔር የነበራት የኢትዮጵያ ንግሥት ስትሆን ከተባረከ ትዳሯ ቅዱስ ላዕከ ማርያምን አፍርታለች:: አብያተ ክርስቲያናትን በማነጽ: ነዳያንን በመርዳትና በጸሎት ተግታ በዚህች ቀን ዐርፋለች::
አምላከ ቅዱሳን ጸጋውን ክብሩን አይንሳን:: ከወዳጆቹ በረከትም ያድለን::
en: St. Gregory the Illuminator of Armenia: Known as the Apostle and Enlightener of Armenia. After refusing pagan idolatry, King Tiridates cast him into a deep, vermin-infested pit (Khor Virap) where he was miraculously preserved for fifteen years. Following the king's execution of St. Hripsime (Arsema) and her companion virgins, Tiridates was struck with madness.

Admonished through a heavenly vision, the king's sister caused Gregory to be brought forth from the pit. Praying over the king, St. Gregory restored his health and mind. Tiridates and the entire Armenian nation embraced Christ, making Armenia the first Christian kingdom. St. Gregory baptized the people, consecrated bishops, and reposed in holiness.
St. Romane-Werq: A devout and pious Ethiopian royal lady, mother of St. La'eka Maryam, remembered for erecting churches, distributing alms to the needy, and reposing in sanctity on this day.
May the God of the holy saints bestow His grace and glory upon us and grant us their everlasting blessings.

am.verse: ጻድቃን ጮኹ፥ እግዚአብሔርም ሰማቸው ከመከራቸውም ሁሉ አዳናቸው። እግዚአብሔር ልባቸው ለተሰበረ ቅርብ ነው፥ መንፈሳቸው የተሰበረውንም ያድናቸዋል። የጻድቃን መከራቸው ብዙ ነው፥ እግዚአብሔርም ከሁሉ ያድናቸዋል፤ እግዚአብሔር አጥንቶቻቸውን ሁሉ ይጠብቃል፥ ከእነርሱም አንዱ አይሰበርም።

en.verse: The righteous cry, and the LORD hears, and delivers them out of all their troubles. The LORD is near to those who have a broken heart, and saves those who have a crushed spirit. Many are the afflictions of the righteous, but the LORD delivers him out of them all. He protects all of his bones. Not one of them is broken.

title.am: አባ አትናቴዎስ ካልዕ (28ኛው ሊቀ ጳጳሳት) እና ቅድስት መሊዳማ
title.en: Abba Athanasius II (28th Patriarch of Alexandria) and St. Melidama

am: አባ አትናቴዎስ ካልዕ ሊቀ ጳጳሳት፦ በግብጽ ምድረ አስቄጥስ በገዳማዊ ተጋድሎና በትሕርምት ሲኖር የነበረ የበቃ አባት ነው:: በ5ኛው መቶ ክ/ዘመን የእስክንድርያ 27ኛው ፓትርያርክ አባ ጴጥሮስ ባረፈ ጊዜ: ሕዝቡና ሊቃውንቱ በአንድነት አባ አትናቴዎስን 28ኛ ፓትርያርክ አድርገው በግድ ሾሙት::
አባ አትናቴዎስ መንጋውን በቅንነትና በትጋት ጠበቀ:: የመናፍቃንን ተንኮል በአስተዋይነት እየመከተ: ለምስኪኖችና ለነዳያን መጠጊያ ሆነ:: ለ7 ዓመታት ቤተ ክርስቲያንን በቅድስና አስተዳድሮ በዚህች ቀን በሰላም ዐርፏል::
ቅድስት መሊዳማ ድንግል፦ ንጽሕናዋን ጠብቃ በጾምና በጸሎት የተጋደለች ድንቅ ቅድስት ናት፤ ከቅድስት አቴና ጋር በዚህች ቀን መታሰቢያዋ ይከበራል::
አምላከ አበው አባቶቻችንን ለመንጋው የሚራሩ ያድርግልን:: ከወዳጆቹ ጸጋ በረከትም ይክፈለን::
en: Abba Athanasius II, 28th Pope of Alexandria: A venerable monk of Scete distinguished for his profound humility and ascetic discipline. Following the repose of Pope Peter III in the late 5th century, the clergy and faithful unanimously compelled him to accept the patriarchal throne.

Pope Athanasius shepherded his flock with fatherly gentleness, shielding the Orthodox faith against heterodox factions and providing shelter to the impoverished. After seven faithful years of patriarchal guidance, he reposed in peace on this day.
St. Melidama the Virgin: A chaste virgin who dedicated her life to ascetic prayer, commemorated on this day with holy Athena.
May the God of our holy fathers grant us compassionate shepherds for His flock and grant us a share in their eternal grace.

am.verse: ኤጲስ ቆጶስ እንደ እግዚአብሔር መጋቢ የማይነቀፍ ሊሆን ይገባዋልና፤ የማይኮራ፥ የማይቆጣ፥ የማይሰክር፥ የማይጨቃጨቅ፥ ነውረኛ ረብ የማይወድ፥ ነገር ግን እንግዳ ተቀባይ፥ በጎ የሆነውን ነገር የሚወድ፥ ጠንቃቃ፥ ጻድቅ፥ ቅዱስ፥ ራሱን የሚገዛ ይሁን።

en.verse: For the overseer must be blameless, as God's steward; not self-pleasing, not easily angered, not given to wine, not violent, not greedy for dishonest gain; but given to hospitality, as a lover of good, sober minded, fair, holy, self-controlled.

title.am: ቅድስት ግሼን ደብረ ከርቤ (ብዙኃን ማርያም) እና 318ቱ ቅዱሳን ሊቃውንት

am: ግሼን ደብረ ከርቤ፦ ሃገራችን ኢትዮጵያ ሃገረ እግዚአብሔር መሆኗን መጽሐፍ ቅዱስ ይመሰክራል:: (መዝ. 68:31, አሞጽ 9:7) የኢትዮጵያውያንን ያህል ድንግል ማርያምን የሚወድ: ለመስቀሉ ክብርን የሚሰጥ ያለ አይመስልም:: ለዓለም እስከ አሁን ድረስ የታቦተ ጽዮንና የቅዱስ መስቀሉ መገኛ እንቆቅልሽ ቢሆንም: ለእኛ ግን ሁለቱም በቤታችን ውስጥ ይገኛሉ::

ደጉ አፄ ዳዊት ግማደ መስቀሉን ወደ ኢትዮጵያ ካመጡ በኋላ: ልጃቸው ደጉ አፄ ዘርዐ ያዕቆብ 'አንብር መስቀልየ በዲበ መስቀል - መስቀሌን በመስቀል ቅርጽ ባለ ተራራ ላይ አስቀምጥ' የሚል ራዕይ አይቶ: መስቀል ቅርጽ ባላት በግሼን አምባ ላይ በደብረ ከርቤ አኖረው:: በዚህች ዕለትም የክብር በዓሉ (ብዙኃን ማርያም) በታላቅ ድምቀት ይከበራል::
318ቱ ቅዱሳን ሊቃውንት፦ በአርዮስ ክህደት ምክንያት በ325 ዓ.ም በኒቅያ የተሰበሰቡ ሐዋርያውያን አበው ናቸው:: አርዮስን አውግዘው 'ዘበአማን አምላክ ዘበአማን - የእውነት አምላክ ከእውነተኛ አምላክ የተገኘ' በማለት ጸሎተ ሃይማኖትን ያረቀቁና የተዋሕዶ እምነትን ያጸኑ አባቶች በዚህች ቀን ይታሰባሉ::
ቅዱስ ቆጵርያኖስና ቅድስት ዮስቴና፦ ቆጵርያኖስ ታላቅ አስማተኛ የነበረ ሲሆን: በቅድስት ዮስቴና ጸሎትና የመስቀል ምልክት አጋንንት ሲሸነፉ አይቶ ክርስቶስን አመነ:: አስማቱን አቃጥሎ ተጠመቀ: በኋላም ኤጲስ ቆጶስ ሆነ:: በመጨረሻም ሁለቱም ስለ ክርስቶስ ፍቅር አንገታቸውን ለሰይፍ ሰጥተው በሰማዕትነት አርፈዋል::
የቅዱሳኑ አምላክ በረከታቸውን ያብዛልን:: እመ ብርሃን በምልጃዋ አትለየን::
en: Holy Gishen Debre Kerbe: Holy Scripture testifies that Ethiopia is a nation of God (Psalm 68:31, Amos 9:7). Her faithful people are renowned for their profound love for the Virgin Mary and the True Cross. While the location of the Ark of the Covenant and the True Cross remains a mystery to the rest of the world, both dwell securely in Ethiopia.

Following Emperor Dawit's reception of the Right Wing of the True Cross, his son Emperor Zera Yaqob was commanded in a divine revelation: 'Enshrine My Cross upon a cross-shaped mountain.' Discerning the cross-shaped mountain fortress of Gishen Debre Kerbe, he solemnly deposited the Holy Cross there. On this day, the feast of Bezuhan Maryam is observed with great solemnity.

The 318 Holy Fathers of Nicaea: In 325 A.D., three hundred and eighteen apostolic bishops convoked at Nicaea against the arch-heretic Arius. Condemning the heresy that denied Christ's eternal divinity, they formulated the Nicene Creed, proclaiming the Son consubstantial with the Father, sealing the Orthodox Tewahedo confession.

St. Cyprian and St. Justina: Cyprian was a famous pagan sorcerer of Antioch. Hired to corrupt the virgin Justina, he sent demons against her, but Justina dispelled them all through prayer and the sign of the Cross. Beholding the supreme power of Christ, Cyprian burned his books of magic, was baptized, and eventually became bishop. Both were martyred together under Diocletian, crowned with eternal glory.
May the God of the holy saints multiply their blessings upon us, and may Our Lady the Virgin Mary shelter us through her maternal intercession.

am.verse: ወዳጄ ሆይ፥ ሁለንተናሽ ውብ ነው፥ ምንም ነውር የለብሽም። ሙሽራዬ ሆይ፥ ከሊባኖስ ከእኔ ጋር ነዪ፤ ከሊባኖስ ከእኔ ጋር ነዪ፤ ከአማና ራስ ከአሚርና ከኤርሞን ራስ ከአንበሶች መኖሪያ ከተርሴሶችም ተራራ ተመልከች።

en.verse: You are all beautiful, my love; there is no spot in you. Come with me from Lebanon, my bride, with me from Lebanon. Look from the top of Amana, from the top of Senir and Hermon, from the lions' dens, from the mountains of the leopards.

title.am: ቅዱስ ዮልዮስ ዘአቅፋሐስ እና ቅዱስ ኮቶሎስ ሰማዕት
title.en: St. Julius of Aqfahas and St. Kotolos the Martyr

en: St. Julius the Martyr (of Aqfahas)

am: ቅዱስ ዮልዮስ ዘአቅፋሐስ፦ በግብጽ ምድር የነበረ ባለጠጋና ቅዱስ ሰው ሲሆን: በዘመነ ሰማዕታት የሰማዕታትን ገድልና ታሪክ በክብር በመጻፍ: የተቆረጡ ሥጋቸውን ሰብስቦ በሽቱ ከፍኖ በመቅበር ይታወቃል:: ጌታችን በራዕይ ተገልጦ 'አንተም ሰማዕት ትሆናለህ' አለው:: በመጨረሻም እርሱና ቤተሰቦቹ እንዲሁም 1,500 አገልጋዮቹ በሰማዕትነት አንገታቸውን ተቆርጠው አርፈዋል::
ቅዱስ ኮቶሎስ ሰማዕት፦ የፋርስ ንጉሥ የሳቦር ልጅ ሲሆን እጅግ የተከበረ ልዑል ነበር:: በአባቱ ቤተ መንግሥት ቅዱስ ጣጦስ የተባለውን ክርስቲያን ወታደር በእሳት ሊያቃጥሉት ሲሉ: ጣጦስ በመስቀል ምልክት እሳቱን አጥፍቶ አሳየው:: ኮቶሎስ በክርስቶስ አምኖ ክብሩን ንቆ ወደ እስር ቤት ገባ::
አባቱ ሳቦር ተቆጥቶ እህቱን አክሱን እንድትመክረው ቢልካት: ቅዱስ ኮቶሎስ እህቱንም አስተምሮ የክርስቶስ ወታደር አደረጋት:: በመጨረሻም ጣጦስና አክሱ ተገደሉ፤ ቅዱስ ኮቶሎስም እግሩን በፈረስ አስረው በየመንገዱ ጎትተውት አካሉ እየተቆራረጠ በሰማዕትነት አረፈ::
አምላከ ቅዱሳን ሰማዕታትን ባጸናበት ጽናት ሁላችንንም ያጽናን:: በረከታቸውንም ያብዛልን::
en: St. Julius of Aqfahas: A wealthy and noble official of Egypt who devoted his life and fortune to recording the hagiographies of the martyrs and providing honorable shrouds and burials for their holy relics. Our Lord appeared to him, promising him the crown of martyrdom. Finally, he boldly confessed Christ and was beheaded alongside fifteen hundred of his faithful companions on this day.

St. Kotolos the Martyr: Crown prince of Persia, son of King Sapor. When Christian soldier St. Tatos was condemned to fire, Tatos extinguished the blaze with the sign of the Cross, inspiring Kotolos to renounce the throne and profess Christ.

When his sister Aksu was sent to persuade him, Kotolos converted her to the faith. Both Tatos and Aksu were executed; Kotolos was bound to horses and dragged through the stone streets until his flesh was torn asunder, completing his heroic martyrdom.
May the God of the holy martyrs establish us in unshakeable faith and multiply His blessings upon us.

am.verse: ሰውን ከአባቱ፥ ሴት ልጅንም ከእናትዋ... እለያይ ዘንድ መጥቻለሁና፤ ለሰውም ቤተሰቦቹ ጠላቶች ይሆኑበታል። ከእኔ ይልቅ አባቱን ወይም እናቱን የሚወድ ለእኔ ሊሆን አይገባውም፤ ከእኔ ይልቅም ወንድ ልጁን ወይም ሴት ልጁን የሚወድ ለእኔ ሊሆን አይገባውም፤ መስቀሉንም የማይዝ በኋላዬም የማይከተለኝ ለእኔ ሊሆን አይገባውም።

en.verse: For I came to set a man at odds against his father, and a daughter against her mother... A man's foes will be those of his own household. He who loves father or mother more than me is not worthy of me; and he who loves son or daughter more than me is not worthy of me. He who doesn't take his cross and follow after me isn't worthy of me.

title.am: ቅዱሳን አውናብዮስና እንድርያስ እና ቅድስት ቴክላ ድንግል
title.en: Saints Eunabius and Andrew, and St. Thecla the Virgin

en: Saints Eunabius and Andrew (Martyrs)
St. Gregory the Wonderworker
St. Thecla the Virgin
St. Eustathius the Martyr

am: ቅዱሳን አውናብዮስና እንድርያስ፦ በገዳማዊ ተጋድሎና በጸሎት ተወስነው ይኖሩ የነበሩ ደጋግ መነኮሳት ናቸው:: በዘመነ ሰማዕታት ክርስቶስን በግልጽ በመመስከራቸው ተይዘው በጽኑ ተገረፉ፤ በመጨረሻም አንገታቸውን በሰይፍ ተቆርጠው የሰማዕትነት ክብርን አገኙ::
ቅድስት ቴክላ ድንግል፦ የሐዋርያው የቅዱስ ጳውሎስ ደቀ መዝሙር ስትሆን: የመጀመሪያዋ ሴት ሰማዕትና ሐዋርያዊት በመባል ትታወቃለች:: ለአንበሶችና ለእሳት ብትጣልም በተአምራት ድና ወንጌልን በስፋት ሰብካለች::
ቅዱስ ጐርጐርዮስ መንክራዊ፦ በብዙ ተአምራቱ የታወቀና ተራራን ያፈለሰ ታላቅ ጻድቅ አባት ሲሆን: በዚህች ቀን መታሰቢያው ይከበራል::
የቅዱሳኑ አምላክ በትዕግሥትና በፍቅር ያጽናን:: ከበረከታቸውም ያድለን::
en: Saints Eunabius and Andrew: Pious monks who spent their lives in desert asceticism and vigils. During the imperial persecutions, they boldly confessed their faith in Jesus Christ, enduring brutal floggings before being crowned with martyrdom by the sword.

St. Thecla the Virgin: Foremost disciple of the Holy Apostle Paul, honored as the Protomartyr among women and Equal-to-the-Apostles. Miraculously preserved unhurt from wild beasts and blazing fires, she converted many to Christ.
St. Gregory the Wonderworker: Famed for shifting a mountain by faith and performing countless miracles, commemorated on this day.
May the God of the saints confirm us in patience and love, and grant us their blessings.

am.verse: በጎንም ለማድረግ ብትቀኑ የሚያስጨንቃችሁ ማን ነው? ነገር ግን ስለ ጽድቅ እንኳ መከራን ብትቀበሉ ብፁዓን ናችሁ። ማስፈራራታቸውንም አትፍሩ አትናወጡም፥ ዳሩ ግን ጌታን እርሱም ክርስቶስን በልባችሁ ቀድሱት።

en.verse: Now who is he who will harm you, if you become imitators of that which is good? But even if you should suffer for righteousness' sake, you are blessed. 'Don't fear what they fear, neither be troubled.' But sanctify the Lord God in your hearts.

title.am: ቅዱስ ጐርጐርዮስ ገዳማዊ፣ ቅድስት ክርስቶስ ሠምራ እና ቅዱስ አድሊጦስ ሐዋርያ
title.en: St. Gregory the Monk, St. Krestos Semra, and St. Adlitus the Apostle

en: St. Gregory the Anchorite

St. Adlitus the Apostle (of the 72 Disciples)

am: ቅዱስ ጐርጐርዮስ ገዳማዊ፦ በግብጽ በርሃ ለብዙ ዓመታት በጾምና በጸሎት ተወስኖ የኖረ: ፈጣሪውን በቅድስና ያገለገለ ታላቅ አባት ነው:: በዚህች ቀን ዐርፎ የዘላለም ክብርን ተቀዳጅቷል::
ቅድስት ክርስቶስ ሠምራ፦ ታላቋ ኢትዮጵያዊት ጻድቅ እናት ስትሆን: በዚህች ዕለት ልጆቿንና ሀብቷን ንቃ: ዓለምን ትታ ወደ ደብረ ሊባኖስ ገዳም የገባችበት በዓል ይታሰባል:: በዚያም በጽኑ ተጋድሎና በጸሎት ተወስና ድንቅ ቃል ኪዳንን ተቀብላለች::
ቅዱስ አድሊጦስ ሐዋርያ፦ ከአቴና ከተማ የተገኘ ሲሆን: ከ72ቱ አርድእት አንዱ ሆኖ መድኃኔ ዓለምን ተከትሏል:: መንፈስ ቅዱስን ተቀብሎ በአቴና ወንጌልን በስፋት ሰብኮ ብዙዎችን ካሳመነ በኋላ: በዚህች ቀን በሰማዕትነት አርፏል::
አምላከ ቅዱሳን በፍቅርና በትሕትና ይሸልመን:: ከበረከታቸውም ያድለን::
en: St. Gregory the Anchorite: A holy monk who lived for decades in the Egyptian desert in ceaseless prayer and contemplative fasting, entering eternal rest on this day.

St. Krestos Semra: Illustrious Ethiopian righteous mother who, on this day, renounced noble wealth and earthly family to enter the monastery of Debre Libanos, where through extraordinary asceticism she was granted a miraculous covenant of mercy.

St. Adlitus the Apostle: Born in Athens, he followed Christ as one of the Seventy-Two Disciples. Receiving the Holy Spirit at Pentecost, he returned to Athens to proclaim the Gospel and was crowned with martyrdom on this day.
May the God of the saints adorn us with love and humility, and grant us their blessings.

am.verse: ፍቅር ያስታግሳል፥ ፍቅር ያስተዛዝናል፥ ፍቅር አያቀናናም፥ ፍቅር አያስመካም፥ ፍቅር አያስታብይም፥ ብቻዬን ይድላኝ አያሰኝም፥ አያበሳጭም፥ ክፉ ነገርን አያሳስብም፤ ከእውነት ጋር ደስ ይለዋል እንጂ ስለ ዓመፃ ደስ አይለውም፤ ሁሉን ይታገሣል፥ ሁሉን ያምናል፥ ሁሉን ተስፋ ያደርጋል፥ በሁሉ ይጸናል።

en.verse: Love is patient and is kind; love doesn't envy. Love doesn't brag, is not proud, doesn't behave itself inappropriately, doesn't seek its own way, is not provoked, takes no account of evil; doesn't rejoice in unrighteousness, but rejoices with the truth; bears all things, believes all things, hopes all things, endures all things.

title.am: ጸአተ ክረምት (የክረምት መውጫ) እና ቅዱስ ዮናስ ነቢይ

am: ጸአተ ክረምት፦ ቤተ ክርስቲያናችን ዓመቱን በ4 ወቅቶች (ክረምት: መጸው: ሐጋይ: ጸደይ) ከፍላ ታስተምራለች:: ይህች ዕለት የክረምት መውጫና የመጸው (የአበባ/የጽጌ) ወቅት መግቢያ ናት:: ምድር በአበባ የምታጌጥበት: ፍሬ የሚሰበሰብበት የምሕረት ወቅት ነው::
ቅዱስ ዮናስ ነቢይ፦ የእግዚአብሔር ቃል ወደ እርሱ መጥቶ 'ወደ ነነዌ ሒደህ ስበክ' ባለው ጊዜ: ዮናስ የአሕዛብን መዳን ሳይፈልግ ወደ ተርሴስ በመርከብ ሸሸ:: በባሕር ላይ ማዕበል በተነሳ ጊዜ በዕጣ ተይዞ ወደ ባሕር ተጣለ:: እግዚአብሔር ታላቅ ዓሣ አንበሪ አዘጋጅቶ ዮናስን ዋጠው::

በዓሣው ሆድ ውስጥ ሦስት ቀንና ሦስት ሌሊት ቆይቶ በጸሎት ተማጸነ፤ ዓሣውም በየብሱ ላይ ተፋው:: ከዚያም ወደ ነነዌ ሄዶ 'በሦስት ቀን ውስጥ ነነዌ ትገለበጣለች' ብሎ ሰበከ:: የነነዌ ሰዎች ከንጉሣቸው ጀምሮ ማቅ ለብሰው: በጾምና በጸሎት ንስሐ ገቡ፤ እግዚአብሔርም ምሕረቱን አወረደላቸው:: የዮናስ በዓሣ ሆድ ሦስት ቀን መቆየት የጌታችን በከርሠ መቃብር ሦስት ቀንና ሦስት ሌሊት የመቆየቱ ምሳሌ ነው:: ቅዱስ ዮናስ በሰላም ዐርፏል::
የቅዱሳኑ አምላክ ንስሐችንን ይቀበለን:: በረከታቸውንም ያብዛልን::
en: End of the Rainy Season (Tse'ate Keremt): The liturgical calendar divides the year into four seasons: Winter/Rains (Keremt), Autumn/Flowers (Metsew/Tsige), Harvest/Dry (Hagay), and Spring (Tsedey). This day marks the conclusion of the rainy season and the threshold of Autumn (Season of Flowers), when the earth is adorned with blossoms and harvest commences.

Holy Prophet Jonah: Commanded by God to preach repentance to Nineveh, Jonah fled toward Tarshish. A great tempest arose at sea, and by lot Jonah was cast overboard, swallowed by a great sea monster. In the belly of the whale he prayed for three days and three nights, prefiguring Christ's three-day burial and resurrection, before being deposited safely upon dry land.

Obeying the divine word, he preached to Nineveh, and from the king unto the beasts, the city put on sackcloth and fasted in deep penance, averting destruction through God's abundant mercy. Holy Jonah reposed in peace on this day.
May the God of the prophets accept our repentance and multiply His blessings upon us.

am.verse: ክፉና አመንዝራ ትውልድ ምልክት ይሻል፤ ከነቢዩም ከዮናስ ምልክት በቀር ምልክት አይሰጠውም። ዮናስ በአሣ አንበሪ ሆድ ሦስት ቀንና ሦስት ሌሊት እንደ ነበረ፥ እንዲሁ የሰው ልጅ በምድር ልብ ሦስት ቀንና ሦስት ሌሊት ይኖራል። የነነዌ ሰዎች በፍርድ ቀን ከዚህ ትውልድ ጋር ተነሥተው ይፈርዱበታል፤ በዮናስ ስብከት ንስሐ ገብተዋልና፥ እነሆም፥ ከዮናስ የሚበልጥ ከዚህ አለ።

en.verse: An evil and adulterous generation seeks after a sign; and no sign will be given to it but the sign of Jonah the prophet. For as Jonah was three days and three nights in the belly of the whale, so will the Son of Man be three days and three nights in the heart of the earth. The men of Nineveh will stand up in the judgment with this generation, and will condemn it: for they repented at the preaching of Jonah; and behold, someone greater than Jonah is here.

am: ጽንሰተ ዮሐንስ መጥምቅ፦ እግዚአብሔር አምላክ የሰውን ልጅ ከወደቀበት የኃጢአት አዘቅት ያድን ዘንድ የመድኃኒታችንን የኢየሱስ ክርስቶስን መንገድ የሚጠርግ ነቢይ ይሰጠን ዘንድ ወደደ:: ካህኑ ቅዱስ ዘካርያስ በመቅደስ ውስጥ ዕጣን ሲያጥን: መልአከ ብሥራት ቅዱስ ገብርኤል በስተቀኝ በኩል ተገለጠለት::

መልአኩም 'ዘካርያስ ሆይ! ጸሎትህ ተሰምቷልና አትፍራ፤ ሚስትህ ኤልሳቤጥ ወንድ ልጅ ትወልድልሃለች: ስሙንም ዮሐንስ ትለዋለህ፤ እርሱም በጌታ ፊት ታላቅ ይሆናል: በእናቱም ማሕፀን ሳለ መንፈስ ቅዱስ ይሞላበታል' አለው:: ዘካርያስም 'እኔ ሸምግያለሁ: ሚስቴም መካን ናትና ይህን በምን አውቃለሁ?' በማለቱ እስኪፈጸም ድረስ ዲዳ ሆነ::
በዚህች ዕለት ቅድስት ኤልሳቤጥ ታላቁን ነቢይ ዮሐንስን በማሕፀኗ ፀነሰች፤ 'ጌታ በእነዚህ ቀናት ስድቤን ከሰው መካከል ያስወግድልኝ ዘንድ እንዲህ አደረገልኝ' እያለች 5 ወራት ራሷን ሠወረች:: በ6ኛው ወር እመቤታችን ሰላምታ ስትሰጣት ጽንሱ በማሕፀኗ ውስጥ በደስታ ዘለለ::
ተአምረ ማርያም፦ ድንግል እመቤታችን ቅድስት ማርያም በየዕለቱ ለሚማጸኗት ምዕመናን ታላቅ ረድኤትና ፈውስን እንደምትሰጥ ቤተ ክርስቲያን ታስተምራለች::
የቅዱስ ዮሐንስ መጥምቅና የእመቤታችን በረከት ከሁላችን ጋር ይሁን:: አሜን::
en: Conception of St. John the Baptist: When the fullness of time arrived for God to redeem humanity, He sent forth His messenger to prepare the way of the Savior. While the righteous priest Zacharias was offering incense in the sanctuary of the Lord, Archangel Gabriel appeared standing on the right side of the altar.

The angel proclaimed: 'Do not be afraid, Zacharias, for your prayer is heard; your wife Elizabeth will bear you a son, and you shall call his name John. He will be great in the sight of the Lord, and will be filled with the Holy Spirit, even from his mother's womb.' Because Zacharias doubted due to their advanced age, he was struck mute until the day of fulfillment.

On this sacred day, St. Elizabeth conceived the great forerunner in her womb, hiding herself for five months, praising God for taking away her reproach. In the sixth month, when the Virgin Mary arrived and greeted her, the babe leaped for joy in her womb.
Miracles of Our Lady Mary: Holy Church commemorates the unending wonders and healing mercies poured forth by Our Lady the Virgin Mary upon all who seek her maternal intercession.
May the blessing of St. John the Baptist and the holy Virgin Mary abide with us all. Amen.

am.verse: ኤልሳቤጥም የማርያምን ሰላምታ በሰማች ጊዜ ጽንሱ በማሕፀኗ ውስጥ ዘለለ፤ በኤልሳቤጥም መንፈስ ቅዱስ ሞላባት፥ በታላቅ ድምፅም ጮኻ እንዲህ አለች፦ አንቺ ከሴቶች መካከል የተባረክሽ ነሽ፥ የማሕፀንሽም ፍሬ የተባረከ ነው።

en.verse: When Elizabeth heard Mary's greeting, the baby leaped in her womb, and Elizabeth was filled with the Holy Spirit. She called out with a loud voice, and said, 'Blessed are you among women, and blessed is the fruit of your womb!'

am: ቅዱስ ኤዎስጣቴዎስና ቤተሰቡ፦ የቀድሞ ስሙ ፕላኪደስ ይባል የነበረ የሮም ታላቅ የጦር አዛዥ ነው:: በአደን ሳለ በቀንዶቹ መካከል የሚያበራ የመስቀል ምልክት ያለውን ዋላ ተመልክቶ ጌታችን በድምፅ ተናገረው:: ፕላኪደስ አምኖ ከነሚስቱና ከሁለቱ ልጆቹ ጋር ተጠመቀ፤ ስሙም ኤዎስጣቴዎስ: የሚስቱ ቴዎብስታ: የልጆቹ አጋፔዎስና ቴዎፒስቶስ ተባለ::

እንደ ኢዮብ በታላቅ ፈተና ተፈተነ:: ሀብቱ ሁሉ ወደመ: አገልጋዮቹ በቸነፈር ሞቱ:: ወደ ግብጽ በመርከብ ሲሰደዱ የመርከቡ አለቃ ሚስቱን ቀማው:: ወንዝ ሲሻገሩም አንበሳ አንዱን ልጁን: ተኩላ ደግሞ ሌላውን ልጁን ነጥቀው ወሰዱባቸው:: ቅዱስ ኤዎስጣቴዎስ ግን ፈጣሪውን ሳያማርር ለ15 ዓመታት በመንደር ውስጥ ተቀጥሮ በጥበቃ ሥራ ኖረ::

ከ15 ዓመታት በኋላ ንጉሡ ፈልጎ የሠራዊት አዛዥ አደረገው:: ሁለቱ ልጆቹና ሚስቱም በተአምራት ተርፈው በሠራዊቱ ውስጥ ተገናኙ:: ንጉሥ ሀድሪያን በጣዖት ፊት እንዲሰግዱ ባዘዘ ጊዜ ግን ሁሉም በአንድነት ክርስቶስን መሰከሩ:: ንጉሡ በናስ በሬ ውስጥ አስገብቶ በእሳት አቃጠላቸው፤ በዚህች ቀን አራቱም ቅዱሳን የሰማዕትነት አክሊል ተቀዳጁ::
አባ ዮሐንስ ዘደብረ ጽጌ፦ ድንቅ የሆነውን የማኅሌተ ጽጌ ድርሰት ከደቀ መዝሙሩ ከአባ ጽጌ ድንግል ጋር በመሆን ያዘጋጀ ታላቅ ኢትዮጵያዊ ሊቅና ጻድቅ አባት ነው::
የቅዱሳኑ አምላክ በትዕግሥት ያጽናን:: በረከታቸውንም ያብዛልን::
en: St. Eustathius and His Family: Formerly named Placidus, a celebrated Roman general. While hunting, he beheld a luminous Cross between the antlers of a stag and heard the voice of Christ. Believing with all his heart, he was baptized with his wife and two sons, receiving the name Eustathius, his wife Theopista, and sons Agapius and Theopistus.

Like the righteous Job, he underwent profound tribulations: his wealth was stripped away and his servants died of plague. Fleeing by ship, the barbaric captain seized his wife; crossing a river, a lion carried off one son and a wolf seized the other. Yet Eustathius never murmured against God, laboring humbly as a village guard for fifteen years.

After fifteen years, the Roman Emperor sought him out to command the imperial army. Miraculously, his two sons had been rescued by shepherds and his wife preserved by God, and the entire family was joyfully reunited in the army camp. When Emperor Hadrian ordered sacrifice to idols, the holy family boldly confessed Christ. Cast into a heated bronze bull, they achieved martyrdom on this day without their bodies being consumed.
Abba John of Debre Tsige: Illustrious Ethiopian saint and hymnographer, co-author of the beloved Mahlete Tsige (Hymn of the Flower) alongside Abba Tsige Dengel.
May the God of the saints grant us patience in trials and multiply His blessings upon us.

am.verse: በፈተና የሚጸና ሰው የተባረከ ነው፤ ከተፈተነ በኋላ ለሚወዱት ተስፋ ስለ እርሱ የሰጣቸውን የሕይወትን አክሊል ይቀበላልና።

en.verse: Blessed is the person who endures temptation, for when he has been approved, he will receive the crown of life, which the Lord promised to those who love him.

am: ቅዱሳን አባዲርና እህቱ ኢራኢ፦ የሮም ንጉሥ የዲዮቅልጥያኖስ የእህት ልጆች ሲሆኑ አባዲር ታላቅ የጦር አዛዥ ነበር:: ክርስቲያኖች በመከራ ውስጥ ሲገቡ አይተው: የዓለምን ክብርና መንግሥት ንቀው በድብቅ ወደ ግብጽ ምድር ተጓዙ:: በዚያም መኮንኑ አርያኖስ ፊት ቀርበው ክርስቲያን መሆናቸውን በድፍረት መሰከሩ::
መኮንኑ እጅግ የበዛ ሥቃይን አደረሰባቸው:: በመንኮራኩር ፈጩዋቸው: በእሳት ውስጥ ጣሏቸው: በፈላ ሰም አቃጠሏቸው፤ ጌታችን ግን ተገልጦ አጽናናቸው:: በመጨረሻም መስከረም 28 ቀን አንገታቸውን በሰይፍ ተቆርጠው የሰማዕትነት ክብርን አገኙ::
ቅድስት ሶስና፦ በባቢሎን ምርኮ ዘመን የነበረች ፈሪሃ እግዚአብሔር ያላት ንጽሕት ሴት ነበረች:: ሁለቱ ረበናት (ዳኞች) በሐሰት ከስሰው በሞት ሊያስቀጧት ሲሉ: እግዚአብሔር በወጣቱ ነቢይ በዳንኤል አማካኝነት ንጽሕናዋን ገለጠ:: ሐሰተኞቹ ዳኞች ተፈረደባቸው፤ እርሷም በክብር ዳነች::
የቅዱሳኑ አምላክ ንጽሕናንና እውነተኛውን እምነት ያድለን:: በረከታቸውም ከሁላችን ጋር ትኑር::
en: Saints Abadir and Irai His Sister: High-ranking Roman nobles, nephew and niece of Diocletian. When the great persecution broke out, Abadir, a chief general, and his sister Irai renounced palace luxury and disguised themselves as common pilgrims, journeying to Egypt to confess Christ before governor Arianus.

They endured brutal torments: they were cast into the fiery furnace, racked on iron wheels, and seared with molten lead, yet Christ appeared and healed them. Finally, on Meskerem 28, they were crowned with martyrdom by the sword.

St. Susanna Our Mother: A chaste and God-fearing Hebrew woman in Babylonian exile. Falsely accused by corrupt elders, she placed her trust in God, who inspired the young prophet Daniel to expose their falsehood and exonerate her completely.
May the God of the saints grant us purity of heart and steadfast faith, and may their blessing abide with us.

am.verse: ሶስናም ቃሏን አሰምታ ጮኸች፦ ዘላለም ጸንተህ የምትኖር፥ የተሠወረውን የምታውቅ፥ የሚደረገውን ሁሉ ሳይደረግ የምታውቅ ፈጣሪ ሆይ! በሐሰት እንደ ጣሉኝ አንተ ታውቃለህ፤ እነዚህ መምህራንም ክፉ ነገርን ባደረጉብኝ ገንዘብ፥ የሠራሁት ኃጢአት ሳይኖር እነሆ እሞታለሁ አለች፤ እግዚአብሔርም ቃሏን ሰማት።

en.verse: Then Susanna cried out with a loud voice, and said, 'O eternal God, who knows the secrets, who knows all things before they be: you know that they have borne false witness against me, and, behold, I must die; whereas I never did such things as these men have maliciously invented against me.' And the Lord heard her voice.

am: ቅድስት አርሴማ ድንግል፦ የሮም ንጉሣዊ ቤተሰብ አባል የነበረችና እጅግ የተዋበች ድንግል ነበረች:: ንጉሥ ዲዮቅልጥያኖስ ሊያገባት በፈለገ ጊዜ: እርሷ ግን ድንግልናዋን ለክርስቶስ ሰጥታ ስለነበር: ከእመ ምኔቷ ከቅድስት አጋታና ከ119 ደናግል ጋር ወደ አርማንያ ሸሸች::

የአርማንያው ንጉሥ ድርጣድስ ሊያገባት ቢሞክርም ቅድስት አርሴማ በኃይለ እግዚአብሔር ንጉሡን መሬት ላይ ጥላ አሸነፈችው:: ንጉሡም ፈጽሞ ተቆጥቶ ምላሷን አወጣ: ጥርሶቿን ነቀለ: ጡቶቿን ቆረጠ፤ በመጨረሻም አንገቷን በሰይፍ አስቆረጣት:: ከእርሷ ጋር 119ኙ ደናግል በሰማዕትነት አርፈዋል:: በኢትዮጵያ ኦርቶዶክስ ተዋሕዶ ቤተ ክርስቲያን ቅድስት አርሴማ በታላቅ ተአምራቷና ፈዋሽነቷ ትታወቃለች::
ቅዱስ ዮሐንስ ወንጌላዊ፦ ነባቤ መለኮት ፍቁረ እግዚእ ቅዱስ ዮሐንስ በዚህች ዕለት በታላቅ ክብር ይታሰባል::
ቅድስት ክርስቶስ ክብራ ኢትዮጵያዊት፦ በጸሎቷና በቅድስናዋ ብዙ ነፍሳትን ያዳነች ታላቅ ኢትዮጵያዊት ጻድቅ እናት ናት::
የሰማዕቷ የቅድስት አርሴማ ጸሎቷና በረከቷ ከሁላችን ጋር ይሁን::
en: St. Arsema (Hripsime) the Virgin Martyr: A maiden of noble Roman birth and striking beauty who dedicated her perpetual virginity to Christ. When Emperor Diocletian sought her as bride, she fled to Armenia alongside her abbess St. Agatha and one hundred and nineteen consecrated virgins.

Armenian King Tiridates attempted to take her by force, but through divine power, Arsema wrestled the monarch to the ground and overcame him. Infuriated, Tiridates ordered her to be brutally tortured: her tongue was severed, her teeth pulled, and she was beheaded with the sword alongside her companion virgins. In the Ethiopian Church, St. Arsema is deeply loved and sought as a swift intercessor and wonderworker.
St. John the Evangelist: The Beloved Disciple and theologian of the Incarnate Word is commemorated with reverence on this day.
St. Krestos Kibra: A righteous Ethiopian holy mother celebrated for her ascetic devotion and powerful prayers.
May the prayers and blessings of St. Arsema protect and preserve us all.

am.verse: በመጀመሪያው ቃል ነበረ፥ ቃልም በእግዚአብሔር ዘንድ ነበረ፥ ቃልም እግዚአብሔር ነበረ። ይህ በመጀመሪያው በእግዚአብሔር ዘንድ ነበረ። ሁሉ በእርሱ ሆነ፥ ከሆነውም አንዳች ስንኳ ያለ እርሱ አልሆነም።

en.verse: In the beginning was the Word, and the Word was with God, and the Word was God. The same was in the beginning with God. All things were made through him. Without him was not anything made that has been made.

am: ቅዱስ አትናቴዎስ ሐዋርያዊ፦ 20ኛው የእስክንድርያ ሊቀ ጳጳሳት ሲሆን: ስለ ቀናች ኦርቶዶክሳዊት ተዋሕዶ ሃይማኖት 5 ጊዜ ከዙፋኑ የተሰደደ ታላቅ ሐዋርያዊ አባት ነው:: በአርዮሳውያን ምክንያት 20 ዓመታት በስደት አሳልፏል:: በስደቱ ሁሉ ክርስቶስ ከእርሱ ጋር ነበረ:: በመጨረሻም በዚህች ዕለት በታላቅ ክብርና ድል ወደ እስክንድርያ መንበረ ስብከቱ ተመልሷል::
አባ ሣሉሲ ጻድቅ፦ በኢትዮጵያ ምድር በታላቅ ገዳማዊ ትሩፋት: ሌሊትና ቀን በጾምና በጸሎት ተወስኖ የኖረ: ብዙ ድንቆችንና ተአምራትን ያደረገ ቅዱስ አባት ሲሆን: በዚህች ቀን ዐርፏል::
ቅዱሳን ያዕቆብና ዮሐንስ፦ የዘብዴዎስ ልጆች የሆኑት ሁለቱ ሐዋርያት መረባቸውንና ጀልባቸውን ትተው ጌታችንን የተከተሉበትና ለወንጌል አገልግሎት የተጠሩበት በዚህች ዕለት ይታሰባል:: (ማር. 1:19)
የአባቶቻችን አምላክ ሃይማኖታችንን ይጠብቅልን:: ከቅዱሳኑ በረከትም ይክፈለን:: አሜን::
en: St. Athanasius the Apostolic: The 20th Pope of Alexandria, champion of the Council of Nicaea, who endured five separate imperial banishments totaling twenty years in exile for his uncompromising defense of Christ's divinity. On this day, holy Church commemorates his final triumphal return from exile back to the See of Alexandria.
Abba Salusi the Righteous: A holy Ethiopian ascetic who flourished in monastic austerity, unceasing prayer, and miracles, departing in holiness on this day.
Holy Apostles James and John: The sons of Zebedee left their fishing nets, boat, and father to heed our Lord's call to become fishers of men, commemorated on this day (Mark 1:19).
May the God of our holy fathers preserve our faith and grant us a share in the eternal blessings of His saints. Amen.

am.verse: ስለ ጽድቅ የሚሰደዱ ብፁዓን ናቸው፥ መንግሥተ ሰማያት የእነርሱ ናትና። ሲነቅፏችሁና ሲያሳድዷችሁ በእኔም ምክንያት ክፉውን ሁሉ በሐሰት ሲናገሩባችሁ ብፁዓን ናችሁ። ዋጋችሁ በሰማያት ታላቅ ነውና ደስ ይበላችሁ፥ ሐሴትም አድርጉ፤ ከእናንተ በፊት የነበሩትን ነቢያትን እንዲሁ አሳድደዋቸዋልና።

en.verse: Blessed are those who have been persecuted for righteousness' sake, for theirs is the Kingdom of Heaven. Blessed are you when people reproach you, persecute you, and say all kinds of evil against you falsely, for my sake. Rejoice, and be exceedingly glad, for great is your reward in heaven. For that is how they persecuted the prophets who were before you.

am: በቀደመው ዘመን በተለይም በሮም አካባቢ አንስጣስያ የሚለው ስም በጣም የተለመደ ነበር:: በዚህ ስም የሚጠሩ ቅዱሳትም ቁጥራቸው ቀላል የሚባል አልነበረም:: የቤተ ክርስቲያን ታሪክ እንደሚነግረን ሃገረ ሮሜ እስከ 5ኛው መቶ ክ/ዘመን ድረስ የብዙ ቅዱሳን መፍሪያ ነበረች:: ደጉም ሆነ ክፉው: ኃጥኡና ጻድቁ: አረማዊና ምዕመኑ በአንድ ላይ ይኖሩባት ነበር:: ከእነዚህ ቅዱሳን አንዷ ደግሞ ሰማዕትነትን ከጽድቅና ከድንግልና ጋር የደረበችው እናታችን ቅድስት አንስጣስያ ናት:: ቅድስቲቱ በ4ኛው መቶ ክ/ዘመን አካባቢ ተወልዳ ያደገችው እዛው ሮም ውስጥ ሲሆን ወላጆቿ ክርስቲያኖች በመሆናቸው ገና በልጅነቷ የክርስትናን ምንነት ጠንቅቃ አውቃለች::

ወጣት በሆነች ጊዜም ይህቺ ዓለም ጠልፋ እንዳትጥላት ትጠነቀቅ ነበር:: ይህቺ ዓለም ወጥመዶቿ ብዙ ናቸውና:: በተለይ ደግሞ መልክ ስለ ነበራትና ወላጆቿም ባለጠጐች ስለ ነበሩ እርሷ ትኅርምትን ታበዛ ነበር:: ድንግልናዋን በንጽሕና ትጠብቀው ዘንድ ጾምንና ጸሎትን ከስግደት ጋር አዘወተረች:: በሒደትም በውስጧ ፍቅረ ክርስቶስ እየተቀጣጠለ በመሔዱ ይህንን ዓለም ልትተወው አሰበች:: ነገር ግን ወላጆቿ "ልጃችን ለአካለ መጠን ደርሰሻልና እንዳርሽ" አሏት::

እርሷም "እኔ ለሰማያዊው ሙሽርነት: ለመንፈሳዊውም ሠርግ ተጠርቻለሁና ተውኝ" ብላቸው ወደ ገዳም ሔደች:: በዘመኑ በሮም ከተማ ዙሪያ ብዙ የደናግል ገዳማት ነበሩና ከእነዚያው ከአንዱ ገባች:: እንደ ገባችም ለሰውነቷ ምክንያትን ልትሠጠው አልፈለገችም:: ራሷን በጾም ትቀጣው ዘንድ በ48 ሰዓት (በ2 ቀን) አንዴ ብቻ ትበላ ነበር:: ምግቧም ቁራሽ ቂጣ በጨው ብቻ ነበር:: ዓቢይ ጾም በደረሰ ጊዜ ግን ከእሑድ በቀር እህልን አትቀምስም ነበር:: የጌታዋ ፍቅር አገብሯታልና ለሳምንት ራሷን ከምግብና ከምቾት ትከለክል ነበር:: ይህም ሲሆን ቁጭ ብላ ሳይሆን በጸሎትና በስግደት እየተጋች: ለደናግሉ በሙሉ እየታዘዘች ነው::

ለጥቂት ዓመታት በእንዲህ ያለ ገድል ቆይታ ከእመ ምኔቷ ጋር በዓል ለማክበር አንድ ቀን ከገዳማቸው ወጡ:: በመንገድ ላይ ሳሉ አረማዊ ንጉሥ ክርስቲያኖችን ሰብስቦ ሲያሰቃይ ደረሱ:: በእርግጥ ዐይተው እያዘኑ ማለፍ ቢችሉም ቅድስት አንስጣስያ ግን አልቻለችም:: የወገኖቿ ስቃይ ቢያንገበግባት በድፍረት ወደ መኮንኑ ቀርባ ዘለፈችው:: "አንተ አዕምሮ የጐደለህ! እንዴት በአምላካቸው ደም የተገዙ ክርስቲያኖችን እንዲህ ያለ በደላቸው ታሰቃያቸዋለህ?" አለችው:: በድፍረቷ የተገረመው መኮንኑም "ማንን ታምኚያለሽ?" አላት:: እርሷም ሰማዩንና ምድሩን የፈጠረውን: ስለ ሰው ፍቅርም የሞተውንና የተነሳውን ዘለዓለማዊ ንጉሥ ኢየሱስ ክርስቶስን አመልካለሁ አለች:: እጅግ ስለ ተበሳጨም በብዙ መክፈልተ ኩነኔ አሰቃይተው በዚህች ቀን ገደሏት:: እናታችን አንስጣስያ የጽድቅን: የድንግልናንና የምስክርነትን አክሊል ተቀበለች::

በዘመነ ሐዋርያት በተመሳሳይ 'እንተ ዕፍረት-ባለ ሽቱ' ተብለው የሚጠሩ ሁለት እናቶች ነበሩ:: ሁለቱም ስማቸው ማርያም ስለ ነበር ለመለየት እንዲያመች አንደኛዋን 'ማርያም ኃጥዕት-ከኃጢአት የተመለሰች': ሁለተኛዋን ደግሞ 'ማርያም እኅተ አልዓዛር-በቢታንያ የነበረችው' ብለው አበው ይጠሯቸዋል:: በሉቃስ ወንጌል ላይ የምትገኘው ከኃጢአት ሕይወት የተመለሰችው ስትሆን በዮሐንስ ወንጌል 12:1 ላይ ያለችው ደግሞ የአልዓዛር እህት ድንግሊቱ ናት:: ዛሬም የምናስባት ይህቺውን እናታችን ማርያም እኅተ አልዓዛርን ነው::

ቅድስት ማርያም መድኃኒታችን ክርስቶስ ወደዚህ ዓለም መጥቶ በሚያስተምርበት ዘመን በቢታንያ አካባቢ ትኖር የነበረች ድንግል ወጣት ናት:: ወላጆች ባልነበሩበት ቤት ውስጥ ታላቆቿ አልዓዛርና ማርታ አሳድገዋታል:: በቤተሰብ ደረጃ እንግዳን ይቀበሉ ነበርና ጌታችን ወደዳቸው:: አልዓዛርን ከ72ቱ አርድእት: ማርያምና ማርታን ደግሞ ከ36ቱ ቅዱሳት አንስት ቆጥሯቸዋል:: ወንድማቸው አልዓዛር በታመመ ጊዜ ወደ ጌታ ልከው ነበር::

ያለ ጊዜው የማይሠራ ጌታ ባይመጣ አልዓዛር ሞተ:: በ4ኛው ቀን አምላክ ሲመጣ ቅድስት ማርያም በጌታ ፊት ሰግዳ "እግዚእየ ሶበሰ ኀሎከ ዝየ እምኢሞተ እኁየ-አንተ በዚህ በኖርክስ ወንድሜ ባልሞተ ነበር" ብላ አለቀሰች:: ጌታም ስታለቅስ ባያት ጊዜ አምላክነቱ አራርቶት አለቀሰ:: ወዲያውም በስልጣነ ቃሉ አዞ አልዓዛርን ከሙታን አስነሳው:: ከፋሲካ በፊትም ቅዱሳኑ ለጌታ ግብር አገቡ:: እርሱም ከደቀ መዛሙርቱ ጋር ታደመላቸው::

በዚያም አልዓዛር ከጌታ ጐን ሲቀመጥ: ቅድስት ማርያም ከጌታ ሥር ተንበርክካ ናርዶስ የሚሉትን የ300 ዲናር የከበረ ሽቱ በጌታ ላይ አፈሰሰች:: መዓዛ መለኮቱና ሽቱው ሲገናኝ ምስጥ የሚያደርግ ሽታ ቤቱን ሞላው:: በወቅቱ ይሁዳ ቢቃወምም ጌታ ምላሹን ሰጥቶታል:: ቅድስት ማርያምንም "ማርያምሰ ኃርየት መክፈልተ ሠናየ ዘኢየኃይድዋ-ማርያም መልካም ዕድልን መርጣለች" ብሎ አመስግኗታል:: ያስመሰገናት ቁጭ ብላ በተመስጦ መማሯ ብቻ እንዳልሆነ ሊቁ አባ ሕርያቆስ መስከሯል::

ሊቁ አባ ሕርያቆስ ሲመክረንም "አርምሞንና ትዕግስትን እንደ ማርያም ገንዘብ እናድርግ" ብሎናል (ቅዳሴ ማርያም):: ቅድስት ማርያም በጌታችን ክርስቶስ በሕማሙ ጊዜና ሲቀብሩት ነበረች፤ ትንሳኤውንም ዐይታለች:: ከጌታ እርገት በኋላም መንፈስ ቅዱስን ተከትላ ለወንጌል አገልግሎት ተግታለች:: ቅድስት እናታችን ማርያም እንተ ዕፍረት ዛሬ እንዳረፈች እናዘክራለን:: የእናቶቻችን ቅዱሳት አምላክ ፍቅራቸውን ያድለን፤ በረከታቸውንም ያብዛልን::
en: In ancient times, particularly around Rome, the name Anastasia was widely revered, and many holy women bore it. Church history records that the city of Rome, up to the 5th century, was a fountainhead of numerous saints. Righteous and wicked, believers and pagans dwelt side by side, and from this soil flourished countless martyrs, doctors, and ascetics. Among them was our holy mother St. Anastasia, who united martyrdom with righteousness and perpetual virginity. Born in Rome during the 4th century to devout Christian parents, she was nurtured from infancy in the depth and truth of the Christian faith.

As she blossomed into youth, she took great heed lest the snares of this fleeting world ensnare her soul. Knowing the multiplicity of worldly temptations, and possessing exceptional physical beauty alongside the wealth of her noble family, she dedicated herself entirely to ascetic discipline. To preserve her virginity in immaculate purity, she devoted herself unceasingly to fasting, vigils, and prostrations. As the divine love of Christ inflamed her heart, she resolved to renounce all worldly pursuits. Her parents urged her, saying, 'Our daughter, you have reached marriageable age; let us give you in marriage.'

She responded, 'Leave me, for I am betrothed to the heavenly Bridegroom and invited to the spiritual wedding feast,' and thereupon departed to a convent. Around Rome were several monasteries for virgins, and she entered one among them. Once cloistered, she offered no indulgence to the flesh; she disciplined her body by eating only once every forty-eight hours (every two days), subsisting solely on dry crusts of bread with salt. During the Great Fast (Lent), she tasted no food except on Sundays, withholding herself from sustenance and comfort throughout the week out of fervent love for her Lord. Nor did she spend her time in idle rest, but labored continuously in prayer, prostrations, and humble obedience to all the sisters.

Having persevered in this ascetical struggle for several years, she went out one day accompanied by the abbess to attend a feast. On their way, they came upon a pagan governor who had assembled Christians to subject them to cruel tortures. Though others might have wept and passed by, St. Anastasia could not bear the sight. Anguished by the torment of her brethren, she boldly stepped forward and rebuked the ruler, saying, 'O senseless man! How can you inflict such cruel torment without cause upon Christians redeemed by the blood of their God?' Astonished at her fearlessness, the governor demanded, 'In whom do you believe?' She replied that she worshiped the eternal King, Jesus Christ, Creator of heaven and earth, who died and rose again for the love of mankind. Enraged, the tyrant ordered excruciating tortures upon her, and having tormented her delicate, ascetic body, they martyred her on this day. Our mother St. Anastasia thus received the threefold crown of righteousness, virginity, and martyrdom.

In the apostolic era, there were two distinct holy women known by the title 'Ente Efrat' (She of the Fragrant Ointment). Both were named Mary, and to distinguish them the Church Fathers designated one as 'Mary the Sinner who Repented' and the other as 'Mary Sister of Lazarus in Bethany.' The former is commemorated in the Gospel of St. Luke, whereas the latter is the virgin sister of Lazarus recorded in the Gospel of St. John (12:1). It is this virgin saint, Mary sister of Lazarus, whom we commemorate on this day.

St. Mary was a devout virgin living in Bethany during the earthly ministry of Our Lord and Savior Jesus Christ. Bereft of parents in their home, she was raised by her elder siblings, Lazarus and Martha. The household was renowned for its hospitality toward strangers, and Our Lord loved them dearly; He numbered Lazarus among the Seventy-Two Disciples, and Martha and Mary among the Thirty-Six Holy Women. When their brother Lazarus fell gravely ill, the sisters sent word to the Lord.

The Lord, who performs all things according to divine fullness of time, delayed His coming until Lazarus died. When the Savior arrived on the fourth day, St. Mary prostrated at His feet, weeping and saying, 'Lord, if you had been here, my brother would not have died' (John 11). Beholding her tears, the divine compassion of Christ was stirred, and He wept. Then, by His sovereign word, He commanded Lazarus to arise from the tomb. Later, before the Passover, the holy siblings prepared a feast for the Lord, and He dined with them alongside His disciples.

At the banquet, while Lazarus reclined beside the Lord, St. Mary knelt at the Savior's feet, broke an alabaster flask of costly genuine nard worth three hundred denarii, and poured it upon Him. When the divine majesty met the aromatic ointment, the fragrance filled the entire house. When Judas murmured against her, the Lord rebuked him and praised St. Mary, saying, 'Mary has chosen that good portion which shall not be taken away from her.' The scholar Abba Heryakos bears witness that she was commended not merely for sitting quietly to listen, but for her profound spiritual devotion.

Abba Heryakos admonishes us in the Liturgy of St. Mary (Qeddase Maryam): 'Let us acquire silence and patience like Mary.' St. Mary was present during the Passion of Our Lord Jesus Christ and at His burial, and she was blessed to behold His glorious Resurrection. Following the Lord's Ascension, she was guided by the Holy Spirit and labored faithfully in the ministry of the Gospel. On this day we commemorate the falling asleep of our holy mother St. Mary of the Fragrant Oil. May the God of the holy mothers grant us their love and multiply His blessings upon us.

en.verse: Now it came to pass, as they went, that he entered into a certain village: and a certain woman named Martha received him into her house. And she had a sister called Mary, which also sat at Jesus' feet, and heard his word. ... And Jesus answered and said unto her, Martha, Martha, thou art careful and troubled about many things: But one thing is needful: and Mary hath chosen that good part, which shall not be taken away from her.

am.verse: ሲሔዱም ወደ አንዲት መንደር ገባ፤ ማርታ የተባለች አንዲት ሴትም በቤቷ ተቀበለችው። ለእርሷም ማርያም የምትባል እኅት ነበረቻት፤ እርሷም ደግሞ ቃሉን ልትሰማ በኢየሱስ እግር አጠገብ ተቀምጣ ነበረች። ... ኢየሱስም መልሶ፦ ማርታ፥ ማርታ፥ በብዙ ነገር ትጨነቂያለሽ ትታወኪያለሽም፥ የሚያስፈልገው ግን ጥቂት ወይም አንድ ነገር ብቻ ነው፤ ማርያምም መልካም ዕድልን መርጣለች ከእርሷም አይወሰድባትም አላት።

title.en: The Scholar Abba Heryakos and St. Severus Patriarch of Antioch
title.am: ሊቁ አባ ሕርያቆስ እና ቅዱስ ሳዊሮስ ዘአንጾኪያ

St. Severus Patriarch of Antioch

am: ክርስቲያን ሆኖ እመቤታችንን የሚወድ ሰው ሁሉ ሊቁን አባ ሕርያቆስን ያውቀዋል:: አባ ሕርያቆስ ተወልዶ ያደገው በምድረ ግብጽ ሲሆን አካባቢው ብህንሳ (ንሒሳ) ይባላል:: ይህቺ ቦታ አቡነ ገብረ መንፈስ ቅዱስን ጨምሮ በርካታ ቅዱሳንን ያፈራች ናት:: አባ ሕርያቆስ የነበረበት ዘመን በ4ኛው ወይም በ5ኛው መቶ ክ/ዘመን እንደ ሆነ ከቤተ ክርስቲያን ትውፊት መረዳት ይቻላል:: ቅዱሱ በዘመኑ የተለየ ማንነት የነበረው ሰው ነው:: ገና ከልጅነቱ እመ ብርሃንን የሚወዳት በመሆኑ ቅን: የዋህና ገራገር ነበረ:: ቀንና ሌሊት ለፍቅሯ የሚተጋ: ማዕበለ ፍቅሯ የሚያማታው ሰው ነበር:: የእመቤታችን ድንግል ማርያምን ስም ሲጠራ ምስጥ ብሎ ልቡናው ይሰወርበት ነበር::

ዘመኑ ዘመነ ሊቃውንት እንደ መሆኑ ሁሉም ለትምሕርት ሲተጉ እርሱ ግን ለጸሎትና ለደግነት ብቻ ነበር የሚተጋው:: ከትምሕርት ወገንም የሰሞን ጉዞዎችን: አንዳንድ ቅዳሴያትንና የዳዊትን መዝሙር ተምሮ ነበር:: በተለይ ግን የዳዊትን መዝሙር እየጣፈጠው መላልሶ ያመሰግንበት ነበር:: ከዳዊት መካከል ደግሞ "ጐሥዐ ልብየ ቃለ ሠናየ-ልቡናዬ መልካም ነገርን አወጣ" የሚለውን መዝሙር 44ን ፈጽሞ ይወዳት ነበር:: የውስጧ ምሥጢር ስለ ድንግል ማርያምና ስለ ክርስቶስ ነውና ቁሞም ተቀምጦም: ተኝቶም ተነስቶም ያለ ማቋረጥ ይላት ነበር:: በወቅቱ የብህንሳ ኤጲስ ቆጶስ በማረፉ ምትክ ሲያፈላልጉ ሕዝቡና ካህናቱ አባ ሕርያቆስን አጩት:: ምንም አለመማሩ ቢያሰጋቸውም "በጸሎቱና በደግነቱ መንጋውን ይጠብቃል" ብለው ኤጲስ ቆጶስ አድርገው ሾሙት::

አንድ ቀን ታዲያ አባ ሕርያቆስ በበረሃ ብቻውን እየተጓዘ "ጐሥዐ ልብየ ቃለ ሠናየ" እያለ እየዘመረ በተመስጦ ሳለ ከመንገዱ ወጥቶ ገደል ውስጥ ወደቀ:: በዚህ ጊዜ ደንግጦ ቢመለከት እጅግ ጥልቅ በሆነ ገደል ውስጥ ራሱን አገኘው፤ ነገር ግን አንድም አካሉ አልተጎዳም ነበር:: የሚገርመው ደግሞ የተቀመጠበት የድንግል ማርያም የቀሚሷ ዘርፍ ነበር:: እመቤታችን አነጋገረችው: ባረከችው:: ፍቅሯን: ምሥጢሯን ገለጸችለት:: በኋላም እመ ብርሃን ከገደሉ አውጥታ ወደ አገሩ መለሰችው::

ከጥቂት ጊዜ በኋላም በብህንሳ ታላቅ ጉባኤ ተዘጋጅቶ ሊቃውንቱ ተሰበሰቡ:: ሊቃውንቱም ለአባ ሕርያቆስ "አንተ ጳጳስ ነህና ቅዳሴ ቀድስልን" አሉት:: እርሱ ግን "እኔ አይቻለኝም: እናንተ ሊቃውንቱ ቀድሱ" አላቸው:: እነርሱ ግን እርሱ የሊቃውንቱን ቅዳሴ አያውቅምና በሰው ፊት እንዲዋረድ በማሰብ ተሳልቀው እርሱኑ አስገቡት:: ወዲያው ግን ድንግል ማርያም ወርዳ ቀጸበችው፤ በዘርፋፋው ቀሚሷ ላይም ረቂቅ የሆነ ቅዳሴን አሳየችው:: አባ ሕርያቆስም በዚያን ጊዜ ከመሬት አንድ ክንድ ያህል ከፍ ብሎ በሰማያዊ ዜማ ዛሬ በቤተ ክርስቲያናችን ያለውን "ቅዳሴ ማርያም" አደረሰ:: መጽሐፈ ቅዳሴው ሙትንም አስነስቷል:: ከዚህች ሰዓት ጀምሮ ታላቅ ሊቅ ሆነ፤ ዐርፎም በክብር ተቀብሯል::

በዚች ዕለት ደግሞ ታላቁ ቅዱስ ሳዊሮስ ዘአንጾኪያ ይታሰባል:: ቅዱስ ሳዊሮስ በ6ኛው መቶ ክ/ዘመን መጀመሪያ አካባቢ በሶርያ አንጾኪያ የተነሳ ታላቅ አባት ነው:: ወቅቱ መለካውያን (ሁለት ባሕርይ ባዮች) የሰለጠኑበትና የኦርቶዶክስ ተዋሕዶ ምእመናን የሚሰደዱበት ጊዜ ነበር:: በዚህ ጊዜ ታላቁ ሊቅ ቅዱስ ሳዊሮስ በሥላሴ ፈቃድ ለቤተ ክርስቲያን ተነሳ፤ ሊቃውንትም በእውነትና በድፍረት በመቆሙ "አንበሳ" ሲሉ ይጠሩታል:: ቅዱሱ የመናፍቃን ጸር በመሆኑ ብዙ ድርሰቶችንና ሃይማኖታዊ መልእክቶችን ጽፏል:: ንጉሡን ዮስጢያኖስን (Justinian) በይፋ ይገሥጸው ነበርና ንጉሡ ሊገድለው ቆረጠ::

ሃይማኖቷ የቀና ንግሥቲቱ ታኦድራ ግን ይህንን ስትሰማ በሌሊት ወደ ሊቁ ሔዳ "እባክህን ሽሽ" አለችው:: እርሱ ግን "ሞት ለእኔ ክብር ነውና አልሔድም" ሲል መለሰላት:: አባቶች ግን "ስለ ቤተ ክርስቲያን ስትል" ብለው ለምነው ወደ ግብጽ ሸኙት:: እርሱ እየሔደ ገዳዮቹ ቢያሳድዱትም በመንገድ ላይ ተሰወረባቸው፤ ለብዙ ቀናትም አብሯቸው እየተጓዘ ሳያዩት ቀሩ:: እነርሱ ተስፋ ቆርጠው ሲመለሱ እርሱ ምድረ ግብጽ ደረሰ:: በምድረ ግብጽም የጵጵስና ልብሱን ትቶ የመነኮሳትን አሮጌ ልብስ ለብሶ በገዳማት ተሰውሮ ሕዝቡንና መነኮሳቱን አስተማረ: አጸና፤ ብዙ ተአምራትንም ሠራ:: ይህቺ ቀን ቅዱስ ሳዊሮስ ወደ ምድረ ግብጽ የፈለሰበት (የተሰደደበት) መታሰቢያ ናት:: የአባቶቻችን በረከት ከሁላችን ጋር ይሁን::
en: Every Christian who cherishes Our Lady the Virgin Mary knows the renowned scholar Abba Heryakos. He was born and reared in the land of Egypt, in the region of Behnesa (Nihisa)—a blessed territory that also nurtured Abuna Gabra Manfas Qeddus and numerous other ascetic luminaries. Church tradition indicates that he flourished in the 4th or 5th century. He was a man of singular spiritual disposition, endowed from his youth with profound love for the Mother of Light, which manifested in genuine humility, simplicity, and gentleness. Day and night he laboured in her love, completely immersed in the ocean of her maternal affection. Whenever he uttered the name of the Virgin Mary, his heart was rapt in heavenly contemplation.

In an era when scholars strove for secular and academic learning, Abba Heryakos concentrated solely on continuous prayer, righteousness, and works of mercy. His scholarly studies were modest, encompassing the daily liturgical hymns, a few liturgies, and the Book of Psalms. He particularly treasured Psalm 44, which begins with the prophetic verse, 'My heart overfloweth with a goodly matter' (Eructavit cor meum verbum bonum). Recognizing that its deep mystical sense speaks of Christ and His Virgin Mother, he recited it unceasingly—whether standing or sitting, sleeping or waking. When the Bishop of Behnesa reposed, the faithful and the clergy chose Abba Heryakos to succeed him. Though some were anxious over his lack of formal scholastic rhetoric, they ordained him bishop, knowing that through his holiness and prayer he would faithfully shepherd the flock.

One day, while walking alone through the desert meditating and singing with deep contrition, 'My heart overfloweth with a goodly matter,' he inadvertently stepped off the path and fell into a precipitous ravine. Terrified, he found himself deep within the abyss, yet entirely uninjured. Most miraculously, he was seated upon the trailing edge of the garment of the Blessed Virgin Mary. Our Lady spoke with him, blessed him, and revealed unto him her divine love and heavenly mysteries, after which she lifted him unharmed from the chasm and returned him safely to his diocese.

Some time later, a great assembly of bishops and learned theologians convened in Behnesa. Wishing to humiliate him because he lacked ornate academic eloquence, the assembly challenged him, saying, 'Since you are the bishop, celebrate the Holy Liturgy for us.' He humbly demurred, saying, 'I am not worthy; let you, the learned fathers, celebrate.' But they insisted and led him to the altar to expose his lack of learning. Immediately, the Virgin Mary descended and touched him, displaying across her vast mystical vesture an ethereal liturgy. In that instant, Abba Heryakos was lifted a cubit above the ground and, chanting with angelic melody, uttered the incomparable Anaphora of Mary (Qeddase Maryam) preserved in our Church to this day. This liturgy was so full of grace that it raised the dead. From that hour, he became celebrated as a supreme doctor of the Church, and having completed his course, he reposed in glory.

On this day also, the Church commemorates St. Severus, Patriarch of Antioch. St. Severus was a stalwart champion of orthodoxy who arose in Syrian Antioch at the beginning of the 6th century. It was a turbulent era when the Chalcedonian party gained imperial ascendancy and faithful Orthodox Christians suffered bitter persecution and exile. In this crucible, the Holy Trinity raised up St. Severus for the defense of the Church; the learned fathers called him 'the Lion' because of his unflinching valor in defending the one incarnate nature of God the Word. As an implacable opponent of heresy, he authored numerous treatises and theological epistles. Because he openly rebuked Emperor Justinian, the emperor decreed his death.

The devout Empress Theodora, learning of the plot, visited the Patriarch at night and urged him, saying, 'Flee for your life!' But he answered, 'Death for Christ is glory to me, and I shall not flee.' Nonetheless, at the fervent entreaties of the clergy who pleaded that his preservation was vital for the Church, he consented to depart for Egypt. While he travelled, imperial assassins pursued him, but by divine protection he was miraculously hidden from their sight; indeed, he walked along the same road beside them for days without being recognized. When his pursuers returned empty-handed, he safely arrived in Egypt. Laying aside his episcopal vestments, he clothed himself in the ragged garb of a humble monk and travelled through the deserts and monasteries, teaching, comforting the Orthodox faithful, and performing countless miracles. This day commemorates the translation and refuge of St. Severus to the land of Egypt. May the blessings of these holy fathers abide with us all.

en.verse: Beloved, while I was very eager to write to you about our common salvation, I was constrained to write to you exhorting you to contend earnestly for the faith which was once for all delivered to the saints.

am.verse: ወዳጆች ሆይ፥ ስለምንካፈለው ስለ መዳናችን ልጽፍላችሁ እጅግ ጓጉቼ ሳለሁ፥ ለቅዱሳን አንድ ጊዜ ፈጽሞ ስለ ተሰጠ ሃይማኖት እንድትጋደሉ እየመከርኋችሁ እጽፍላችሁ ዘንድ ግድ ሆነብኝ።

am: በዓታ ለእግዝእትነ ማርያም ድንግል ወላዲተ አምላክ

ሰማዕቱ ቅዱስ ጊዮርጊስ ሐዲስ (ልብ በሉልኝ ሊቀ ሰማዕታት አይደለም) የተወለደው በምድረ ግብጽ አሕዛብ በሰለጠኑበትና ግብፅንና ሶርያን በያዙበት የመጀመሪያው ዘመን ነበር:: እናቱ የተመሠከረላት ክርስቲያን ብትሆንም አባቱ ግን አሕዛባዊ ነበረ፤ ስሙንም መዛሕዝም አሉት:: የወቅቱ ሕግ ከወላጆቹ አንዱ አሕዛባዊ ከሆነ ክርስትና እንዳይጠመቅ ሰይፍ ስለሚያስከትል ሳይጠመቅ 7 ዓመት ሞላው:: እናቱ ግን ፍቅረ ክርስትናን ታስተምረው: ጸበልና እመነቱን ትቀባው: ደብቃም ቅዳሴ ታሰማው ነበር:: አንድ ቀን ግን ሕጻናት ሲቆርቡ አይቶ "ካልቆረብኩ" ብሎ አለቀሰ:: እናቱም ወደ ውጭ አውጥታ ከአውሎግያ (የሰንበት በረከት) አበላችው:: ልክ በአፉ ሲቀምሳት መዓዛ መንፈስ ቅዱስ አደረበትና ፍጹም ተደሰተ:: ከዚህች ቀን ጀምሮ የሚጠመቅበትን ዘዴ ይፈልግ ጀመር::

አባቱ ሲሞት ወደ ሶርያና እስክንድርያ ሔደ:: በዚያም ገዳማትን እያየ: የደውል ድምጽ እየሰማ: ክርስቲያኖችን በነጻነት ሲያመሰግኑ እየተመለከተ ልቡ በደስታ ተመላ:: ወደ ደብሩ ተጠግቶ አባቶችን "አጥምቃችሁ ስም አውጡልኝ" አላቸው:: አባቶችም ተጠራጥረውት ፈርተው ቢሸሹትም እርሱ ግን አጥብቆ ለመነ፤ መንፈስ ቅዱስም አናግሯቸው አጠመቁትና ስሙን "ጊዮርጊስ" አሉት:: እርሱም ደስ እያለው ልብሰ ክርስትናውን ለብሶ: ማዕተቡን አስሮ በአደባባይ ቆመ::

በዚያ ያሉ አሕዛብ በክርስትና ስም: ልብስና ሞገስ ሲመለከቱት ተበሳጭተው ዕለቱኑ አሠሩት:: ሌሊት እናቱና ሚስቱ ተጨንቀው ወደ እሥር ቤት መጥተው "አንተን ብለን ከሃገር ወጥተናልና ክርስትናህን ካድ" ብለው አለቀሱበት:: ሐዲስ ጊዮርጊስ ግን "እኔ ሕይወቴን ያገኘሁት በክርስቶስ ነውና አልክድም" አላቸው:: ከዚያች ቀን ጀምሮ ለተከታታይ ቀናት ደበደቡት: አካሉን ቆራረጡት: ደሙንም መሬት ላይ አፈሰሱት:: እርሱ ግን በክርስቶስ ፍቅር ጸና:: በመጨረሻም በአደባባይ አንገቱን በሰይፍ ቆረጡት:: ክፋታቸው የጸና ነውና ሥጋውን በእሳት አቃጠለው ወደ ባሕር ጣሉት:: እግዚአብሔር ግን ሥጋውን አከበረለት፤ ሰማዕቱም የክብርን አክሊል ተቀዳጀ::

በዚች ዕለት ደግሞ 42ኛው የእስክንድርያ ሊቀ ጳጳሳት አባ ስምዖን ያረፈበት ነው:: ይህ ቅዱስ አባት ሶርያዊ ሲሆን ከልጅነቱ ገዳም ገብቶ በጾምና በጸሎት ያደገ: በተጋድሎ የጸና ታላቅ ባሕታዊ ነበር:: ሊቀ ጳጳሳት ሆኖ በተሾመ ጊዜም በቅድስናና በትጋት ቤተ ክርስቲያንን ጠበቀ:: ነገር ግን አካላቸው በተጋድሎ የተቀጠቀጠ ስለ ነበር በመንበራቸው ላይ ለብዙ ጊዜ መቆየት አልቻሉም:: እግራቸውን በጠና በመታመማቸው ፈጣሪ ነፍሳቸውን እንዲቀበል ለመኑት፤ እርሱም ሰማቸው:: ሊቀ ጳጳሳት ሆነው በተሾሙ በ165ኛው ቀን (ማለትም በ5 ወር ከ15 ቀናቸው) በክብር ዐርፈው ተቀብረዋል::

በዚችም ዕለት የኢትዮጵያ ቤተ ክርስቲያን ታላቅ የዜማና የድርሰት ሊቅ የሆነው አባ ጊዮርጊስ ዘጋስጫ መታሰቢያ ይከበራል:: ይህ ታላቅ አባት "መጽሐፈ አርጋኖን": "መጽሐፈ ምሥጢር": "መጽሐፈ ሰዓታት" እና ሌሎች በርካታ ድርሰቶችን በመንፈስ ቅዱስ ተቃኝቶ የደረሰ: እመቤታችንን በሰማያዊ ምስጋና ያመሰገነ የቤተ ክርስቲያን ጌጥ ነው:: የአባ ጊዮርጊስ ዘጋስጫ: የቅዱስ ጊዮርጊስ ሐዲስና የአባ ስምዖን ጸሎትና በረከት ከሁላችን ጋር ይሁን::
en: The martyr St. George the New (distinct from St. George the Prince of Martyrs) was born in Egypt during the initial rise and conquest of Egypt and Syria by foreign conquerors. His mother was a faithful and pious Christian, but his father was a non-believer named Mazahim. Under the oppressive laws of the time, any child of a non-believing father was strictly forbidden from Christian baptism upon pain of the sword, so he reached the age of seven without being baptized. Nevertheless, his devout mother taught him the love of Christ, anointed him secretly with holy water and blessed soil, and took him covertly to hear the Holy Liturgy. One day, upon seeing Christian children receiving Holy Communion, he wept bitterly, begging to partake. His mother brought him outside and gave him a portion of the eulogia (the blessed bread of the Sabbath). As soon as he tasted it, the fragrance of the Holy Spirit rested upon him, filling him with sublime joy, and from that day forth he yearned constantly for holy baptism.

Following the death of his father, he journeyed toward Syria and Alexandria. There, beholding monasteries, hearing the solemn tolling of church bells, and watching Christians worshiping freely, his heart leaped with spiritual exultation. Approaching the monastery, he implored the monks to baptize him and give him a Christian name. Fearing an imperial trap, the monks initially withdrew, but moved by his fervent tears and guided by the Holy Spirit, they baptized him and gave him the name George. Clad in his baptismal white robes and bearing the sacred cord (mateb) around his neck, he walked openly into the public squares.

Seeing him publicly professing the Christian faith with dignity and wearing the baptismal vesture, the adversaries were filled with rage and threw him into prison. That night, his mother and wife arrived weeping at the prison doors, pleading, 'We left our home and country for your sake; renounce your baptism so you may live.' But St. George the New answered with steadfast resolve, 'I have found true eternal life in Jesus Christ, and I will never deny Him.' For days they scourged him mercilessly, dismembered his flesh, and poured his blood upon the earth, yet he remained immovable in the love of Christ. Finally, they beheaded him in the public square, and in their hardened malice burned his holy body and cast the ashes into the sea. But God glorified His servant, and the holy martyr received the imperishable crown of martyrdom.

On this day also is commemorated the repose of Abba Simon, the 42nd Patriarch of Alexandria. This holy father was of Syrian heritage, having entered monastic life from childhood and matured in constant fasting, vigils, and deep ascetic solitude. When elevated to the patriarchal throne, he shepherded the flock of Christ with spotless holiness and apostolic zeal. However, his body was utterly worn and frail from decades of rigorous ascetic mortifications. Suffering severe affliction in his feet and limbs, he prayed to God to receive his soul, and the Lord granted his petition. After reigning as patriarch for only 165 days (five months and fifteen days), he reposed in peace and was laid to rest with great honor.

On this day, the Church also commemorates Abba George of Gascha, one of the greatest luminaries, theologians, and liturgical poets of the Ethiopian Orthodox Tewahedo Church. Inspired by the Holy Spirit, Abba George composed the sublime 'Arganona Maryam' (The Harp of Mary), 'Metsihafe Mestir' (The Book of Mystery), 'Metsihafe Sa'atat' (The Book of Horologion/Hours), and numerous other theological hymns praising Our Lady with heavenly eloquence. May the prayers and blessings of Abba George of Gascha, St. George the New, and Patriarch Simon be with us all.

en.verse: Wherefore, my dearly beloved, flee from idolatry. I speak as to wise men; judge ye what I say. The cup of blessing which we bless, is it not the communion of the blood of Christ? The bread which we break, is it not the communion of the body of Christ? For we being many are one bread, and one body: for we are all partakers of that one bread.

am.verse: ስለዚህ፥ ወዳጆቼ ሆይ፥ ጣዖትን ከማምለክ ሽሹ። ልባሞች እንደ መሆናችሁ እላለሁ፤ በምለው ነገር እናንተ ፍረዱ። የምንባርከው የበረከት ጽዋ ከክርስቶስ ደም ጋር ኅብረት ያለው አይደለምን? የምንቆርሰውስ እንጀራ ከክርስቶስ ሥጋ ጋር ኅብረት ያለው አይደለምን? አንድ እንጀራ ስለ ሆነ፥ እኛ ብዙዎች ስንሆን አንድ ሥጋ ነን፤ ሁላችን ያን አንዱን እንጀራ እንካፈላለንና።

title.en: Holy Righteous Kings Abreha and Asbeha, and St. Ananias the Apostle
title.am: ቅዱሳን ነገሥታት አብርሃ ወአጽብሃ እና ቅዱስ ሐናንያ ሐዋርያ

St. John of Heraclia (Martyr)

am: ቅዱሳን ነገሥታት አብርሃ ወአጽብሃ ሞገሶቻችንና ብርሃኖቻችን ናቸውና ደስ እያለን እናከብራቸዋለን:: ቅድስት ሥላሴ ቢመርጧቸው ዛሬ ላለንበት ክርስቲያናዊ ሕይወት መሠረቱን ጥለው አልፈዋልና:: ሁለቱ ቅዱሳን ነገሥታት መንትያዎች ሲሆኑ ወላጆቻቸው ንጉሥ ታዜር (አይዛና / ሠይፈ አርዕድ) እና ንግሥት አሕየዋ (ሶፍያ) ይባላሉ:: ንጉሡና ባለቤቱ ልጅ ቢያጡ ወደ እግዚአብሔር ለመኑ፤ ፈጣሪም በቅዱስ ሚካኤል አብሳሪነት ሁለት ዕንቁዎችን አስረከባቸው:: ንግሥት አሕየዋም ታሕሳስ 29 ቀን ሁለቱን ቅዱሳን ወለደቻቸው:: እነዚህ ሁለት ፍሬዎች በልጅነታቸው ከወቅቱ ሊቀ ካህናት እንበረም ኦሪትን ጠንቅቀው ተምረዋል:: ከእግዚአብሔር የተሰጡ ናቸውና በ12 ዓመታቸው ወደ ቤተ መቅደስ ገብተዋል::

አባታቸው ታዜር በማረፉ ሕዝቡ ሁለቱን ቅዱሳን "ንገሡልን" ቢሏቸውም "እኛ የፈጣሪ አገልጋዮች ነንና አንችልም" በማለታቸው ለተወሰነ ጊዜ እናታቸው አስተዳደረች:: በኋላ ግን ቅዱስ ሚካኤል ለሊቀ ካህናቱ እንበረም "የፈጣሪ ፈቃድ ስለ ሆነ ሁለቱም በአንድ ዙፋን ላይ ይንገሡ: ታላቅ ጸጋ ለሃገሪቱ ይሆናል" አለው:: ሊቀ ካህናቱም በ19 ዓመታቸው ሁለቱንም በአንድ ዙፋን ላይ "ነገሥተ ኢትዮጵያ" ሲል ዘይተ መንግሥት ቀባቸው፤ ስማቸውንም "ኢዛና" እና "ሳይዛና" አላቸው::

ቅዱሳኑ እንደ ነገሡ ቀዳሚ ሥራቸው የቀናችውን ሃይማኖት መፈለግ ሆነ:: በወቅቱ ፍሬምናጦስ (የኋለኛው አቡነ ሰላማ ከሣቴ ብርሃን) በቤተ መንግሥቱ ውስጥ የቅርብ አማካሪ ነበርና ጠርተው "ክርስቶስ ይወርዳል: ይወለዳል ተብሎ የተቆጠረው ሱባኤ አልፏል፤ ምሥጢሩን ንገረን" አሉት:: እርሱም አምላክ ሰው መሆኑንና ዓለምን ማዳኑን አስተማራቸው:: "አጥምቀን" ቢሉት "ክህነት የለኝምና አልችልም" አላቸው:: እነርሱም ከብዙ ስጦታ ጋር ወደ እስክንድርያ ግብጽ ላኩት:: ቅዱስ አትናቴዎስም ፍሬምናጦስን "አቡነ ሰላማ" ብሎ ጵጵስና ሹሞ ከብዙ መጻሕፍት ጋር ላከው::

በመጀመሪያ ኢዛናና ሳይዛና ተጠመቁ፤ ስማቸውም "አብርሃ ወአጽብሃ" ተባለ:: ቀጥሎም ሠራዊቱና ሕዝቡ ተጠመቀ፤ አገራችንም በእነዚህ ቅዱሳን አማካኝነት ከጨለማ ወደ ብርሃን መጣች: የክርስትና ደሴት ሆነች:: ቅዱሳኑ ከ154 በላይ አብያተ ክርስቲያናትን ያነጹ ሲሆን በአክሱም ከተማ ላይ ያነጿትና 12 ቤተ መቅደሶች የነበሯት የጽዮን ቤተ ክርስቲያን የሁሉ መመኪያ ነበረች:: ቅዱስ አብርሃ በተወለደ በ52 ዓመቱ ጥቅምት 4 ቀን ሲያርፍ ወንድሙ ቅዱስ አጽብሃ ለ15 ዓመታት ብቻውን አስተዳድሮ በዚሁ ዕለት ጥቅምት 4 ቀን ዐርፏል::

በዚች ዕለት ደግሞ ቅዱስ ሐናንያ ሐዋርያ ይታሰባል:: ቅዱስ ሐናንያ ቁጥሩ ከ72ቱ አርድእት ሲሆን በመጽሐፍ ቅዱስ ስማቸው ከተመዘገበልን ዋነኞቹ አንዱ ነው:: ለ3 ዓመታት ከጌታ እግር ተምሮ ሀብተ ፈውስ ተሰጥቶት ወንጌልን ሰብኳል:: በሚያስተምርበት ጊዜ የሶርያዋን ደማስቆ ማዕከል አድርጎ ቆይቷል:: ጌታችን ሳውልን (ጳውሎስን) በደማስቆ መንገድ በብርሃን በጠራው ጊዜ ዐይኑ ታውሮ ነበርና "ወደ ሐናንያ ሂድ" አለው::

ሁለቱ እንደተገናኙ ቅዱስ ሐናንያ ሳውልን አስተማረው: ዐይኖቹን ፈወሰው: አጠመቀው: በበጎ መንገድም መራው:: በዚህ ምክንያት ቅዱስ ሐናንያ የብርሃነ ዓለም ቅዱስ ጳውሎስ የንስሐ አባቱ ይሰኛል (ሐዋ. 9:1-19):: ከዚህ በኋላ ቅዱስ ሐናንያ በብዙ አገሮች ወንጌልን አስተምሮ በመጨረሻም በዚህች ቀን ክፉዎች በድንጋይ ወግረው ገድለውታል:: የቅዱሳኑ በረከት ከሁላችን ጋር ይሁን::
en: The holy righteous Kings Abreha and Asbeha are the glory and radiant light of Ethiopia, and we commemorate them with spiritual jubilation. Chosen by the Holy Trinity, they laid the enduring foundations of the Christian faith in our land. These two royal brothers were twins, born to King Tazer (Aizana / Sayfe Ar'ed) and Queen Ahyawa (Sophia). Having long prayed to God for offspring, the Lord answered them through the archangel St. Michael, who bestowed two precious pearls upon them. Queen Sophia gave birth to the royal twins on Tahsas 29, and from their tender youth they were instructed thoroughly in the Old Testament Scriptures by the high priest Enberem. Dedicated to God from birth, they entered service in the sanctuary at twelve years of age.

When their father King Tazer reposed, the people implored the young brothers to ascend the throne, but they declined, saying, 'We are servants of the Creator, and we cannot take secular rule.' Thus their mother governed for a season. Thereafter, the archangel Michael commanded the high priest Enberem, saying, 'It is the divine will; let them both reign together upon a single throne, and great grace shall descend upon the nation.' Consequently, at nineteen years of age, the high priest anointed both brothers upon one throne as Kings of Ethiopia, naming them Ezana and Saizana.

Upon ascending the throne, their primary quest was to find the true and undefiled faith. At that time, Fremnatos (later known as Abuna Salama Kesate Berhan) served as a close counselor in the royal court. The kings summoned him and asked, 'The prophetic weeks foretold that Christ would descend and be born; has this not already passed? Reveal unto us the mystery.' Fremnatos proclaimed unto them that God had indeed become man and redeemed the world three centuries prior. When they asked him to baptize them, he replied, 'I do not possess the priesthood and cannot baptize.' Therefore, the kings dispatched him with magnificent gifts to Alexandria in Egypt. There, the great St. Athanasius the Apostolic ordained Fremnatos as bishop, conferring upon him the name Abuna Salama, and sent him back with holy books and priests.

First, Ezana and Saizana were baptized into Christ, receiving the baptismal names Abreha (He who illuminated) and Asbeha (He who brought the dawn). Subsequently, the royal army and the entire populace were baptized. Through these holy kings, Ethiopia was brought out of pagan darkness into marvelous light, becoming an enduring island of Christianity. The righteous kings constructed over 154 stone-hewn and monolithic sanctuaries across the empire, chief among them the magnificent cathedral of St. Mary of Zion in Aksum, which originally possessed twelve basilican sanctuaries. St. Abreha reposed on Tikimt 4 at the age of fifty-two, and his brother St. Asbeha governed alone for fifteen more years until he too reposed on this exact day, Tikimt 4.

On this day also, the Church commemorates St. Ananias the Apostle, numbered among the Seventy-Two Disciples of Our Lord. Having sat at the feet of Christ during His earthly ministry, he was endowed with the gift of healing and the power of the Holy Spirit. He established his apostolic see in Damascus of Syria. When the Lord appeared in celestial light to Saul of Tarsus on the Damascus road and struck him blind, He directed Saul, saying, 'Go into the city, and it will be told you what you must do; seek out Ananias.'

When they met, St. Ananias laid hands upon Saul, healed his blindness, instructed him, baptized him, and guided him in the true way of righteousness. For this reason, St. Ananias is revered as the spiritual and confession father of St. Paul the Apostle (Acts 9:1-19). Thereafter, St. Ananias preached the Gospel across many regions, enduring immense hardships for the name of Christ, until the adversaries stoned him to death on this day. May the intercession and blessing of these holy saints protect us all.

en.verse: I exhort therefore, that, first of all, supplications, prayers, intercessions, and giving of thanks, be made for all men; For kings, and for all that are in authority; that we may lead a quiet and peaceable life in all godliness and honesty. For this is good and acceptable in the sight of God our Saviour; Who will have all men to be saved, and to come unto the knowledge of the truth.

am.verse: እንግዲህ እግዚአብሔርን በመምሰልና በጭምትነት ሁሉ ጸጥና ዝግ ብለን እንድንኖር፥ ልመናና ጸሎት ምልጃም ምስጋናም ስለ ሰዎች ሁሉ ስለ ነገሥታትና ስለ መኳንንትም ሁሉ እንዲደረጉ ከሁሉ በፊት እመክራለሁ። ሰዎች ሁሉ ሊድኑና እውነቱን ወደ ማወቅ ሊደርሱ በሚወድ በእግዚአብሔር በመድኃኒታችን ፊት መልካምና ደስ የሚያሰኝ ይህ ነው።

title.en: Abuna Gabra Manfas Qeddus and St. Cyriacus (Kirakos) the Elder
title.am: አቡነ ገብረ መንፈስ ቅዱስ እና ቅዱስ ኪራኮስ አረጋዊ

en: Abuna Gabra Manfas Qeddus (Gabra Heywat)
St. Cyriacus (Kirakos) the Elder (Bishop and Martyr)
St. Anne the Martyr (Mother of Cyriacus)
St. James the Son of Alphaeus (Apostle)
Abba Paul the Martyr (Patriarch of Constantinople)
am: አባ ዻውሎስ ሰማዕት (አርዮሳውያን አንቀው የገደሉት አባት)

en: St. Peter the Chief of the Apostles
St. Paul the Light of the World
St. Yohani the Ethiopian
St. Ammonius of Nihisa
St. Eugenia (Martyr and Ascetic)

am: ጻድቁ አባታችን አቡነ ገብረ መንፈስ ቅዱስ (ገብረ ሕይወት) የተወለዱት በምድረ ግብጽ ንሒሳ በሚባል አካባቢ ሲሆን አባታቸው ስምዖን እናታቸው አቅሌስያ ይባላሉ:: አባታችን የጻድቃን አለቃ: የቅዱሳን የበላይ: ተጋድሏቸውና ድንቅ ተአምራታቸው እንደ ሰማይ ከዋክብት የበዛ ቅዱስ ሰው ናቸው:: ለ562 ዓመታት በዚህች ዓለም ሲኖሩ እህል ያልቀመሱ (ምግባቸው ምስጋና ነውና): ልብስ ያልለበሱ (ጠጉር አካላቸውን ይሸፍን ነበርና) ሐዋርያዊ ሆነው ከግብፅ እስከ ኢትዮጵያ ብዙ ነፍሳትን ያዳኑ አባት ናቸው:: በ562 ዓመታት ሕይወታቸው እንደ ሐዋርያት ወንጌልን ሰብከው በሚሊዮን ለሚቆጠሩ ነፍሳት የድኅነት ምክንያት ሆነዋል::

ጻድቁ እንደ ሰማዕታት ከከሃዲዎች ብዙ መከራን ተቀብለዋል፤ እንደ ባሕታውያን ለብዙ መቶ ዓመታት ሰው ሳያዩ በበረሃ ቆይተዋል:: ከእልፍ አእላፍ አጋንንት ጋር ተዋግተው ድል መንሳታቸው ልዩ ተጋድሏቸው ነው:: የንሒሳው ኮከብ ገብረ መንፈስ ቅዱስ ለኢትዮጵያ ልዩ ፍቅር አላቸው:: ስለ አገሪቱና ስለ ሕዝቧ ፍቅር ሲሉ ለ100 ዓመታት በደብረ ዝቋላ መከራን ተቀብለዋል:: ምሕረትን ሲለምኑ ሥጋቸው አልቆ በአጥንታቸው ቆመው ነበርና አገራችን አሥራት ሆና ተሰጠቻቸው:: ስለዚህም ነው በአገሪቱ ውስጥ ከ2,000 በላይ የአቡነ ገብረ መንፈስ ቅዱስ አብያተ ክርስቲያናት ያሉት:: መጋቢት 5 ቀን ሲያርፉ መላእክት አካላቸውን ሠውረዋል:: የጻድቁ በዓል ጥቅምት 5 ቀን የሚከበረው መጋቢት 5 በዐቢይ ጾም ውስጥ ስለሚውል ተውላጥ (ቅያሪ) ሆኖ ነው::

በዚች ዕለት ደግሞ ቅዱስ ኪራኮስ አረጋዊ ይታሰባል:: ይህ ቅዱስ አባት ስም አጠራሩ የከበረ: ሽምግልናውም ያማረ ታላቅ ሰው ነው:: ቅዱስ ኪራኮስ የተወለደው በ3ኛው መቶ ክ/ዘመን ሲሆን እናቱ ቅድስት ሐና ትባላለች:: ምንም በነገዳቸው አይሁድ ቢሆኑም የተባረከች እናቱ ኦሪቱንና ነቢያትን: ቀጥላም ክርስትናን ጠንቅቆ እንዲያውቅ አደረገችው:: ቅዱስ ኪራኮስም ከእናቱ ጋር ሆኖ እግዚአብሔርን እያገለገለ: ክርስቶስን እያመለከ ኖረ::

ቅድስት እሌኒ መስቀሉን ፍለጋ ወደ ኢየሩሳሌም በመጣች ጊዜ ትልቁ ፈተናዋ የተቀበረበትን ቦታ ማወቅ አለመቻሏ ነበር:: አይሁድም አረጋዊው ኪራኮስ የታሪክና የመጻሕፍት ምሑር መሆኑን ነገሯት:: ቅዱስ ኪራኮስም አካባቢውን ያውቀው ነበርና "ደመራ ደምረሽ: በእሳት አቃጥለሽ: ዕጣን ጨምሪበትና የዕጣኑ ጢስ ሰግዶ ያሳየሻል" አላት:: ቅድስት እሌኒም የተባለችውን ፈጽማ የክርስቶስን ቅዱስ መስቀል አገኘች:: ቅድስት እሌኒ ከተመለሰች በኋላም ቅዱስ ኪራኮስ የኢየሩሳሌም ጳጳስ ሆኖ ተሾመ::

በወቅቱ ኤልያኖስ የሚባል ከሃዲ ንጉሥ በቅዱሱ ላይ ተቆጥቶ ወደ እርሱ አስጠርቶ ቅዱስ ቃሉን ይጽፍበት የነበረውን ቀኝ እጁን አስቆረጠው:: ቅዱስ ኪራኮስ ግን እጁ መሬት ላይ ወድቃ ደሙ እየፈሰሰ "አንተ ልብ የሌለህ ንጉሥ! እጄን ቆርጠህ ከክርስቶስ ፍቅር ልትለየኝ አትችልም" አለው:: ንጉሡም በእሳት አልጋ ላይ ጥዶ ቅዱሱን ጠበሰው:: በማግስቱም እናቱን ቅድስት ሐናን አምጥተው እሳት ውስጥ ጣሏትና በጦር ወግተው ገደሏት:: ቅዱስ ኪራኮስንም ለአራዊት ቢሰጡት አራዊቱ ሰገዱለት:: በመጨረሻም በዚህች ቀን አንገቱን ቆርጠው ገደሉትና የሰማዕትነት አክሊልን ተቀዳጀ:: የአባቶቻችን ጸሎት ከሁላችን ጋር ይሁን::
en: Our holy father Abuna Gabra Manfas Qeddus (also called Gabra Heywat) was born in Nihisa in the land of Egypt to devout parents named Simeon and Aklesya. He was a father of supreme holiness, the leader of the righteous, and a celestial man whose miracles and struggles were as numerous as the stars of heaven. He lived upon the earth for 562 years, during which he tasted no earthly bread (for his nourishment was the praise of God) and wore no woven garment (for hair completely covered his body). Living an apostolic life, he journeyed from Egypt to Ethiopia, preaching the Gospel and becoming the instrument of salvation for millions of souls.

Like the martyrs, he endured cruel persecutions from infidels; like the ancient hermits, he dwelt for centuries in trackless deserts without seeing human face. His singular glory was his spiritual warfare against legions of demons, whom he utterly defeated by the power of the Cross. The Star of Nihisa possessed a deep, burning love for Ethiopia. Out of love for the nation and its people, he prayed in the volcanic lake of Mount Zuqualla for one hundred years. Pleading for divine mercy until his flesh withered and he stood only on bone, the Lord gave him Ethiopia as a sacred heritage and tithe. For this reason, more than two thousand churches and monasteries dedicated to Abuna Gabra Manfas Qeddus are found throughout the land. When he reposed on Megabit 5, holy angels shrouded his sacred body and hid it away. Because Megabit 5 almost invariably falls during the Great Fast (Lent), this feast on Tikimt 5 is celebrated as the commemorative festival of his repose.

On this day also, the Church commemorates St. Cyriacus (Kirakos) the Elder. This venerable saint was of noble remembrance and graceful old age. Born in the 3rd century to a devout mother named Anne, though of Jewish lineage, his mother instructed him thoroughly in the Law, the Prophets, and the fullness of the Christian Gospel. St. Cyriacus dwelt with his mother, worshiping Christ and serving God with deep spiritual knowledge.

When Empress St. Helena journeyed to Jerusalem to find the True Cross of Christ, her greatest dilemma was identifying the exact place where the Cross had been buried under mounds of dirt by the adversaries. The local elders identified Cyriacus as a master of sacred history and ancient tradition. St. Cyriacus advised the Empress: 'Erect a woodpile (demera), set it ablaze, cast pure incense upon the fire, and follow where the column of smoke ascends to heaven and bows toward the earth.' Empress Helena performed precisely as instructed, and discovered the Holy Life-Giving Cross of Our Lord. Following Helena's departure, St. Cyriacus was consecrated Bishop of Jerusalem.

Subsequently, an apostate ruler named Julian (Elian) summoned the aged bishop and commanded his right hand—with which he had transcribed the sacred scriptures—to be severed in the public square. But St. Cyriacus, as his hand lay on the ground and his blood flowed, proclaimed boldly: 'O senseless tyrant! You may cut off my hand, but you can never sever me from the love of Jesus Christ!' Enraged, the tyrant roasted the saint upon a red-hot iron bed. The following day, they brought his mother St. Anne, cast her into the flames, and pierced her with spears until she reposed in holiness. When they threw St. Cyriacus to wild beasts, the lions bowed down in reverent submission. Finally, on this day, the tyrant commanded his beheading, and the elderly bishop received the radiant crown of martyrdom. May the prayers of the saints be our shield.

en.verse: But God forbid that I should glory, save in the cross of our Lord Jesus Christ, by whom the world is crucified unto me, and I unto the world.

am.verse: ነገር ግን ዓለም ለእኔ የተሰቀለበት እኔም ለዓለም የተሰቀልሁበት ከጌታችን ከኢየሱስ ክርስቶስ መስቀል በቀር ሌላ ትምክህት ከእኔ ይራቅ።
