am: በዘመነ ሐዋርያት ከነበሩና አስደናቂ ታሪክ ከነበራቸው ቅዱሳን አንዱ ቅዱስ ዲዮናስዮስ ሐዋርያዊ ሊቅ ነው:: ቅዱስ ዲዮናስዮስ በትውልዱ ግሪካዊ ፈላስፋ ሲሆን ከነ አሪስቶትል ሲወርድ የመጣውን ፍልስፍና ጠንቅቆ በማጥናቱ በአቴና (Athens) ርዕሰ ሊቃውንት (የፈላስፎች አለቃ) ተብሎ በአርዮስፋጎስ ታላቅ መሪ ሆኖ ተሹሞ ነበር:: ቅዱስ ዲዮናስዮስ ፈላስፋ ቢሆንም ስለ እውነተኛው አምላክ ይመራመር ነበር:: ነገር ግን አንድ ቀን ዓለም በተፈጠረች በ5,534 ዓመት መጋቢት 27 ቀን በዕለተ ዓርብ በ6 ሰዓት ላይ ምድር ተናወጠች፤ ፀሐይ ጨለመች: ጨረቃ ደም ሆነች: ከዋክብትም ረገፉ:: በዚህ የተደናገጡ የአቴና ጠቢባን "የተፈጠረውን መርምረህ አስረዳን" አሉት::

ዲዮናስዮስም ባለው ጥበብ ፀሐይና ጨረቃን ቢመረምር በቀደመ ቦታቸው አገኛቸው፤ ግራ ተጋብቶ ወደ ቤተ መዛግብቱ ገብቶ መጻሕፍትን ሲያገላብጥ "አርስጣላባ" የሚባል ጥንታዊ መጽሐፍ አግኝቶ ቢገልጠው "እልመክኑን" የሚል ጽሑፍ አገኘ:: ወደ ውጭ ወጥቶ ልብሱን ቀድዶ አለቀሰ፤ ጠቢባኑም "ምን ሆንህ?" ቢሉት "የማይታየው አምላክ ቢወርድ በምቀኝነት ገደሉት የሚል ጽሑፍ አገኘሁ" አላቸው:: "እልመክኑን" ማለት "የማይታይ አምላክ" ማለት ነውና ደቀ መዛሙርቱን (ኡሲፎስና ኡርያኖስን) ጠርቶ "እልመክኑን" የሚለውን ስም "ከቤተ ጣዖቱ በር ላይ ለጥፉት" አላቸው::

ከ14 ዓመታት በኋላ በ48 ዓ/ም ቅዱስ ጳውሎስ ወንጌልን እየሰበከ አቴና ደረሰ:: በጣዖት ቤቱ በር ላይ የተለጠፈውን ጽሑፍ ተመልክቶ ሲያስተምር ጠቢባኑ ሐዋርያውን ይዘው ወደ ዲዮናስዮስ አቀረቡት:: ቅዱስ ጳውሎስም "እኔ አዲስ አምላክን የምሰብክላችሁ አይደለሁም፤ ይልቁኑ እናንተ 'ለማይታወቅ አምላክ' (እልመክኑን) ብላችሁ ሳታውቁት ታመልኩት የነበረውን ፈጣሪ ነው የምሰብከው፤ እርሱም ኢየሱስ ክርስቶስ ነው" አላቸው:: ዲዮናስዮስም "ለምልክት ምን አለህ?" ቢለው "የዛሬ 14 ዓመት መጋቢት 27 ቀን በዕለተ ዓርብ በ6 ሰዓት ላይ ፀሐይ የጨለመችው እርሱ በመስቀል ላይ ስለ ተሰቀለ ነው" አለው:: ዲዮናስዮስም ፈጥኖ አመነ፤ ከአቴና ጠቢባንና ሕዝብ ጋር ተጠመቀ::

ቅዱስ ጳውሎስም ቅዱስ ዲዮናስዮስን የአቴና የመጀመሪያው ጳጳስ አድርጎ ሾመው:: ቅዱሱም ብዙ ድርሰቶችን በመንፈስ ቅዱስ ደረሰ፤ ዛሬ ድረስ በሃይማኖተ አበው ውስጥ የሚገኘው ድርሰቱ ጣዕሙ ልዩ ነው:: በመጨረሻም የአካባቢው አገረ ገዥ አንገቱን አስቆርጦት ሰማዕት ሆነ:: የሚገርመው ሲገድሉት በቦታው ሰው ስላልነበረ ቅዱሱ ተነስቶ ተቆርጣ የወደቀች ራሱን አቅፎ ደቀ መዛሙርቱ ኡሲፎስና ኡርያኖስ እስካሉበት ድረስ ሔዶ በፊታቸው ዘንበል አለ፤ ምእመናንም ከነዚህ አብረው ከተሰየፉት ደቀ መዛሙርቱ ጋር በክብር ቀብረውታል::

በዚች ዕለት ደግሞ ታላቁ ጻድቅና ገዳማዊ አባ ዸንጠሌዎን ዘጾማዕት ይታሰባሉ:: አባ ዸንጠሌዎን ከተስዓቱ (ዘጠኙ) ቅዱሳን አንዱ ሲሆኑ የሮም ቤተ መንግሥት ልዑል ሆነው ሳለ ምድራዊውን ክብር ንቀው ወደ ግብጽ በርሃ ወርደው መነኮሱ:: በኋላም ዘጠኙ ቅዱሳን ተሰብስበው ወደ ኢትዮጵያ በመምጣት በአክሱም ንጉሥ አልዓሜዳ መልካም አቀባበል አደረገላቸው:: አባ ዸንጠሌዎንም ከአክሱም ከተማ በላይ "ጾማዕት" በሚባለው ረዥም ተራራ ላይ ወጥተው ገዳማቸውን መሠረቱ፤ ቦታውም ዛሬ "እንዳባ ዸንጠሌዎን" ይባላል::

በዚያም ድውያንን ፈወሱ: ሙታንን አስነሱ: ብዙ ተአምራትንም አደረጉ:: አንድ ቀን የወይራ ዘንግ በጧት ተክለው በሠርክ ትልቅ ዛፍ ሆኖ አብቧል፤ ያ ዛፍ ዛሬም ድረስ አለ:: በመጨረሻ ዘመናቸው 5 ክንድ ርዝመት ባላት ጠባብ ጾማዕት (በዓት) ውስጥ ገብተው ለ45 ዓመታት ሳይቀመጡና ሳይተኙ በእንባ ቆመው ሲጸልዩ ቅንድባቸው ተላጠ: አካላቸውም በአጥንቱ ብቻ ቀረ:: በዚህች ቀን ጌታችን ተገልጾ ታላቅ ቃል ኪዳን ሰጥቷቸው ነፍሳቸው በክብር ዐረገች:: ታላቁን ንጉሥ አፄ ካሌብንም ያመነኮሱት እርሳቸው ናቸው:: የቅዱሳኑ በረከት ከሁላችን ጋር ይሁን::
en: Among the most extraordinary figures of the apostolic age was St. Dionysius the Areopagite, the apostolic doctor and philosopher. Born an Athenian Greek, he mastered the philosophical traditions descending from Aristotle and was appointed Chief of Philosophers (Archon) and supreme judge in the court of the Areopagus in Athens. Though immersed in philosophy, St. Dionysius constantly contemplated the true Creator, finding no satisfaction among the two hundred and fifty pagan gods worshiped in Greece. In the 5,534th year of the creation of the world, on Friday Megabit 27 at the sixth hour (midday), an unprecedented catastrophe struck: the earth quaked, the sun was darkened, the moon turned to blood, and stars fell from the sky. Terrified, the citizens and philosophers of Athens gathered before Dionysius, imploring, 'Master, search out your wisdom and explain what has happened.'

Employing all his astronomical and mathematical knowledge, Dionysius observed the heavenly bodies and saw they were in their natural orbits. Mystified and unable to sleep, he searched the ancient library and discovered a profound book called 'Aristolaba.' Opening it, he found the word 'El-Meknun' inscribed. Weeping bitterly and tearing his garments, he emerged before the multitude. When they asked the cause of his lamentation, he declared, 'I have found it written: The Invisible God has descended to earth, and through envy they have put Him to death.' ('El-Meknun' signifies 'The Invisible, Hidden God'). Thereupon, he instructed his disciples Onesiphorus and Urianus to carve and post the inscription 'To the Unknown God' (El-Meknun) upon the entrance of the principal pagan temple.

Fourteen years later, in the year 48 AD, St. Paul arrived in Athens preaching the Gospel. Observing the inscription at the temple gates, the Apostle began to teach. The philosophers brought him before Dionysius, demanding an explanation. St. Paul answered, 'I do not proclaim a strange god unto you, but the very Creator whom you worship without knowing under the name El-Meknun (To the Unknown God); this is Jesus Christ.' When Dionysius asked for a confirming sign, St. Paul replied, 'Did not the sun darken and the earth tremble fourteen years ago on Friday Megabit 27 at the sixth hour? It was precisely at that hour that Christ was crucified for our salvation.' Hearing this, Dionysius believed with his whole heart and was baptized alongside his household, his disciples, and many Athenian citizens.

St. Paul consecrated St. Dionysius as the first Bishop of Athens. Inspired by the Holy Spirit, the saint authored sublime theological treatises, whose heavenly fragrance is treasured in the patristic collection Haymanote Abew (Faith of the Fathers). Having labored apostolically for many decades, he was condemned to death by the local governor and beheaded on this day. Miraculously, as no one was present at the execution site, the holy martyr arose, took up his severed head in his hands, and walked to where his faithful disciples Onesiphorus and Urianus were praying. Laying his head before them, he bowed and surrendered his spirit. The disciples, who were likewise crowned with martyrdom, were laid to rest with him by the faithful.

On this day also, the Church commemorates the great monastic luminary Abba Pantaleon of the Cell (Tsom'at). Abba Pantaleon was one of the Nine Saints who came to Ethiopia in the 5th century. Though born of royal lineage in Rome, he renounced all worldly glory, descended to the Egyptian deserts, and was tonsured a monk. Guided by the Holy Spirit, the Nine Saints travelled under Abuna Aregawi's leadership to Aksum, where King Al-Ameda welcomed them with immense reverent honor. Subsequently, Abba Pantaleon climbed the steep mountain peak near Debre Qonatsil known as Tsom'at, establishing the famous sanctuary known today as Enda Abba Pantelewon.

There he performed mighty wonders, healing the sick, expelling demons, and raising the dead. One morning he planted a dried olive staff, which by evening blossomed into a majestic, leafy olive tree that still stands as a witness today. In his final years, he entered a narrow stone cell measuring only five cubits in length; there he stood continuously for forty-five years in tears and prayer, never sitting or sleeping, until his eyebrows wore away and his flesh wasted to bone. On this day, the Savior appeared to him and granted him a magnificent covenant of mercy, whereupon he reposed in glory. It was also Abba Pantaleon who tonsured and clothed Emperor St. Kaleb in the monastic habit. May the intercession of these holy fathers protect us all.

en.verse: Although the fig tree shall not blossom, neither shall fruit be in the vines; the labour of the olive shall fail, and the fields shall yield no meat; the flock shall be cut off from the fold, and there shall be no herd in the stalls: Yet I will rejoice in the LORD, I will joy in the God of my salvation.

am.verse: ምንም እንኳ በለስም ባታፈራ፥ በወይን ሐረግም ፍሬ ባይገኝ፥ የወይራ ሥራ ቢጐድል፥ እርሾችም መብልን ባይሰጡ፥ በጎች ከበረቱ ቢጠፉ፥ ላሞችም በጋጡ ውስጥ ባይገኙ፥ እኔ ግን በእግዚአብሔር ደስ ይለኛል፥ በመድኃኒቴ አምላክ ሐሴት አደርጋለሁ።

title.en: Abba Bawla (Paul) the Hermit and Ascetic
title.am: አባ ባውላ ገዳማዊ መስተጋድል

St. Ignatius Theophorus (Cast to the Lions)

am: ቅዱሱን የመሰሉ አባቶች በግዕዙ "መስተጋድላን" ይባላሉ:: ይህም ለሃይማኖታቸው እስከ ደም ጠብታና እስከ መጨረሻዋ ህቅታ ድረስ መጋደላቸውን የሚያሳይ ነው:: የቅዱሳኑ ተጋድሎ በዋነኝነት ከሁለት አካላት ጋር ሲሆን አንደኛው ፍትወታት እኩያትን ከሚያመጡ አጋንንት ጋር: ሁለተኛው ደግሞ "ሃይማኖታችሁን ካዱ: ለጣዖትም ስገዱ" ከሚሉ ከሃድያን ጋር የሚደረግ ትግል ነው:: ታላቁ አባ ባውላ ገዳማዊ ጻድቅ እንደ መሆኑ ትግሉ ከአጋንንትና ከሥጋ ፈቃድ ጋር ነበር:: የቅዱሳኑ የፍቅራቸውና የትዕግሥታቸው ምሥጢር ጌታችን መድኃኒታችን ኢየሱስ ክርስቶስ "እኔን መከተል የሚወድ ቢኖር ራሱን ይካድ: መስቀሉንም ተሸክሞ ይከተለኝ" (ማቴ. 16:24) ያለውን ቃል በልባቸው ማኖራቸው ነው::

ታላቁ አባ ባውላ የተወለደው በላይኛው ግብጽ አካባቢ ሲሆን የነበረበትም ዘመን በ4ኛው መቶ ክ/ዘመን ነው:: ከክርስቲያን ወላጆቹ መንፈሳዊ ትምህርትን ተምሮ ካደገ በኋላ ምድራዊውን ክብር ትቶ ወደ ገዳም ገባ:: ሥርዓተ ገዳምን: አገልግሎትን: ፍቅርንና ተጋድሎን ከተማረ በኋላም ደቀ መዝሙሩን አባ ሕዝቅኤልን አስከትሎ ወደ በርሃ ወጣ:: አንድ ቀንም እንዲህ ሲል አሰበ:- "ጌታ ሆይ! አንተ ለእኛ ለኃጥአን ኃፍረተ መስቀልን ታግሠህ ሞትን ከሞትክልን እኛ ደግሞ ስለ ንጹሑ አምላክነቱ መከራን መቀበል ይገባናል" አለ::

ይህንን ብሎ ከወትሮው በተለየ መንገድ በጾም: በጸሎትና በስግደት ሊጋደል ጀመረ:: በዚህ እጅግ የጸና ተጋድሎው ምክንያትም 7 ጊዜ ሙቶ 7 ጊዜ ተነስቷል:: አጋንንትም በተለያየ መልክ እየተገለጡ አሰቃዩት፤ እርሱ ግን በእምነቱ ጸና:: ደቀ መዝሙሩ አባ ሕዝቅኤልም የጻድቁን ድንቅ ተጋድሎና ጽናት አይቶ በታላቅ አክብሮት ያገለግለው ነበር:: ጻድቁ አባ ባውላ በጸሎቱ የብዙዎችን ደዌ ፈውሷል፤ ድንቅ ድንቅ ተአምራትንም አድርጓል::

አባ ባውላ ከሰው ክብርና ውዳሴን ፈጽሞ ይሸሽ ነበር:: ሰዎች ሊያዩትና ሊባረኩ ሲመጡ ወደ ሩቅ ዋሻ ይሰወር ነበር:: በመጨረሻም ተጋድሎውን በድል ፈጽሞ በዚህች ቀን በጥቅምት 7 ዐርፏል፤ ቅዱሳን መላእክትም ነፍሱን በዝማሬ ወደ ሰማያዊት መንግሥት አሳረጓት:: የጻድቁ የአባ ባውላና የደቀ መዝሙሩ የአባ ሕዝቅኤል ጸሎትና በረከት ከሁላችን ጋር ይሁን::
en: Fathers such as St. Bawla are designated in Ge'ez as 'Mastegadlan' (Contenders / Ascetic Champions), a title signifying their persevering struggle for the faith to the last drop of blood and their final earthly breath. The holy struggle of the saints is primarily waged on two fronts: first, against the demons who incite disordered passions and temptations; second, against apostates and persecutors who demand denial of Christ and worship of idols. Being an angelic solitary, the glorious Abba Bawla contended ceaselessly against invisible demons and the desires of the flesh. The secret of the saints' divine love and patience was their abiding adherence to the Lord's mandate: 'If any man will come after me, let him deny himself, and take up his cross, and follow me' (Matt. 16:24).

The great Abba Bawla was born in Upper Egypt during the 4th century. Instructed from his youth in sacred learning by devout Christian parents, he renounced the vanity of the world and entered a monastery. Having mastered monastic discipline, humble service, brotherly love, and ascetical combat, he departed into the remote desert, taking with him his faithful disciple Abba Ezekiel. One day, he meditated deeply: 'O Lord, if You endured the shame of the Cross and suffered death for us sinners, how much more ought we to endure all tribulations for the love of Your pure majesty!'

Having made this sacred resolve, he embraced unprecedented levels of fasting, vigils, and thousands of prostrations. Through this terrifyingly severe spiritual combat against legions of demons, he died seven times and was raised up seven times by divine power. Though evil spirits assaulted him in monstrous apparitions, he remained immovable like Mount Zion. His disciple Abba Ezekiel, beholding the sublime struggles and sanctity of his spiritual father, served him with profound veneration. Through his prayers, Abba Bawla healed numerous infirmities and performed astonishing signs.

Abba Bawla fled earthly praise with absolute diligence; whenever pilgrims sought him for blessings, he hid himself in inaccessible mountain caverns. Having gloriously finished his ascetical course, he reposed in the Lord on this day, Tikimt 7, and holy angels escorted his soul with triumphant hymns into the heavenly kingdom. May the prayers and blessings of the righteous Abba Bawla and his disciple Abba Ezekiel abide with us all.

en.verse: Then said Jesus unto his disciples, If any man will come after me, let him deny himself, and take up his cross, and follow me. For whosoever will save his life shall lose it: and whosoever will lose his life for my sake shall find it. For what is a man profited, if he shall gain the whole world, and lose his own soul? or what shall a man give in exchange for his soul?

am.verse: እኔን መከተል የሚወድ ቢኖር ራሱን ይካድ፤ መስቀሉንም ተሸክሞ ይከተለኝ። ነፍሱን ሊያድን የሚወድ ሁሉ ያጠፋታል፤ ስለ እኔ ግን ነፍሱን የሚያጠፋ ሁሉ ያገኛታል። ሰው ዓለሙን ሁሉ ቢያተርፍ ነፍሱንም ቢያጐድል ምን ይጠቅመዋል? ወይስ ሰው ስለ ነፍሱ ቤዛ ምን ይሰጣል?

title.en: Abba Agathon the Hermit and St. Matra the Martyr
title.am: አባ አጋቶን ባሕታዊ እና ቅዱስ መጥራ ሰማዕት

am: አባ አጋቶን ባሕታዊ ታላቅ ጻድቅ: ገዳማዊና የእግዚአብሔር ሰው ሲሆን አንደበቱን ከክፋት ይከለክል ዘንድ ለ30 ዓመታት በአፉ ድንጋይ ጐርሶ የኖረ ድንቅ አባት ነው:: ሊቃውንት ሲገልጹት "ክምረ ክምር ጽድቁ እስከ አስተርአየ-የጽድቁ ክምር እስኪታይ ድረስ ተጋደለ" ይሉታል:: ትዕግሥቱ: ደግነቱ: አርምሞውና ትሩፋቱ ከመነገር በላይ ነው:: በነበረበት በ4ኛው መቶ ክ/ዘመን በገዳመ አስቄጥስ የታላቁ መቃርዮስ መንፈሳዊ ልጅ ሆኖ እንደ ኮከብ ያበራ ታላቅ አባት ነበር:: የቀደሙ አባቶቻችን "ሊሠራ የማይወድ አይብላ" የሚለውን መለኮታዊ ትእዛዝ በመከተል ከተጋድሎ በተረፈቻቸው ሰዓት በእጃቸው ይሠሩ ነበርና አባ አጋቶንም በአንደበቱ ድንጋይ ጐርሶ እንቅቦችን ይሠራ ነበር:: የሠራውንም ሸጦ አንዲት ቂጣ ይገዛና የተረፈውን ገንዘብ ለነዳያን ይመጸውት ነበር::

አንድ ቀን አባ አጋቶን የሠራቸውን 5 እንቅቦች ተሸክሞ ወደ ገበያ ሲሔድ መንገድ ላይ አንድ ነዳይ ወድቆ አገኘ:: ነዳዩም "የምትሰጠኝ ከሌለህ ተሸክመህ ወደ ገበያ ውሰደኝ" አለው:: የነዳዩ አካል እጅግ የቆሳሰለ ቢሆንም ጻድቁ ያለማመንታት አዝሎ ተሸከመው:: ገበያ ሲደርሱም አውርዶ ከጐኑ አስቀመጠው:: ያ ነዳይ አባ አጋቶን አንዷን እንቅብ ሲሸጥ "ስጠኝ" እያለ የ5ቱንም እንቅቦች ዋጋ ወሰደበት:: አባ አጋቶን ግን ቂጣ መግዣ ባይኖረውም በሆነው ነገር አልተከፋም:: ሊሔድ ሲነሳም ነዳዩ "ወደ ቦታዬ ተሸክመህ መልሰኝ" አለው፤ ጻድቁም በፍቅር አዝሎ ተሸከመው:: ቦታው ሲደርሱ ነዳዩ አልወርድም ቢልም ጻድቁ በትዕግሥት ቆመለት::

ትንሽ ቆይቶ ሲመለከት ያ ነዳይ በመሬት ላይ አልነበረም፤ ቀና ሲል ግን በግርማ ክንፎቹን ዘርግቶ በብርሃን ተከቦ የታየው ሊቀ መላእክት ቅዱስ ሚካኤል ነበር:: ቅዱስ ሚካኤልም "ወዳጄ አጋቶን! ትዕግሥትህና ደግነትህ በእግዚአብሔር ፊት ግሩም ነውና ዘወትር ከአንተ ጋር ነኝ" ብሎት ተሰወረ:: ጻድቁም በደስታ ወደ በዓቱ ሔዶ ተረፈ ዘመኑን በአርምሞ ኑሮ በክብር ዐርፏል::

በዚች ዕለት ደግሞ ቅዱስ መጥራ አረጋዊ ሰማዕት ይታሰባል:: ቅዱሱ የ3ኛው መቶ ክ/ዘመን ግብጻዊ ክርስቲያን ሲሆን ከልጅነቱ ጀምሮ እስከ ሽበት ክርስቶስን ሲያመልክ ኖሯል:: ነገሥታቱ "ክርስቶስን ካዱ" እያሉ በዘመነ ሰማዕታት ክርስቲያኖችን ሲያሰቃዩ በሰማ ጊዜ ቅዱሱ አረጋዊ ለሁለት ነገር ሰማዕትነትን ፈለገ:: አንደኛ በክርስቶስ ስም መሞት የክብር ክብርን ስለሚያስገኝ: ሁለተኛው ደግሞ ለወጣቶች የጽናት አብነት (ምሳሌ) ለመሆን ነበር:: ቅዱስ መጥራ እንዳሰበው ወደ መኮንኑ ሔዶ በድፍረት ክርስቶስን ሰበከ:: አሕዛብም ብዙ አሰቃይተው በዚህች ቀን ከተከታዮቹ ጋር ገድለውታል፤ የሰማዕትነት አክሊልንም ተቀዳጅቷል:: የአባቶቻችን ጸሎት ከሁላችን ጋር ይሁን::
en: Abba Agathon the Solitary was a sublime righteous father, ascetic, and man of God, celebrated for placing a small stone inside his mouth for thirty uninterrupted years to safeguard his tongue from idle or hurtful speech. The learned doctors praised him, saying, 'His heap of righteousness shone forth resplendently.' His patience, goodness, holy silence (hesychia), and spiritual virtues were beyond telling. In the 4th century, he shone as a luminous star in the Wilderness of Scetes, having been a spiritual son of St. Macarius the Great. Following the divine apostolic counsel, 'If any would not work, neither should he eat,' the ancient fathers labored with their hands; thus Abba Agathon, with a pebble under his tongue, wove wicker baskets. Selling his handiwork in the market, he purchased a small dry loaf and distributed all remaining funds to the poor.

One day, carrying five woven baskets to the market, he found an afflicted, destitute beggar lying by the roadside. Having no coin, Abba Agathon offered him a basket, but the beggar said, 'If you have no food or money, carry me on your shoulders to the marketplace.' Although the beggar's body was covered in loathsome, festering sores, the holy father hoisted him onto his back without hesitation. Reaching the market, he set him down gently. As Abba Agathon sold each of the five baskets, the beggar demanded the proceeds, saying, 'Give it to me!' The saint willingly surrendered every coin until nothing was left for his own food, yet his heart remained serene and joy-filled. When preparing to depart, the beggar insisted, 'Carry me back to the place where you found me,' and the saint lovingly shouldered him back. Arriving at the spot, the beggar refused to alight, but Abba Agathon waited patiently.

Moments later, the burden suddenly vanished from his shoulders. Looking up, Abba Agathon was awestruck to behold the Archangel St. Michael radiant in celestial light, with outspread wings in heavenly majesty. The Archangel proclaimed, 'Beloved Agathon! Your patience, humility, and love have ascended as a sweet fragrance before God, and I am sent to be with you always,' after which he vanished into heaven. Filled with celestial joy, Abba Agathon returned to his cell, completed his days in holy hesychia, and reposed in great glory.

On this day also is commemorated the holy elderly martyr St. Matra. A devout Egyptian Christian of the 3rd century, he had worshiped Christ faithfully from his youth unto venerable grey hairs. When pagan authorities unleashed fierce persecutions demanding that Christians renounce Christ, the aged Matra sought martyrdom for two noble purposes: first, because laying down one's life for Christ confers the highest heavenly crown; second, to provide an inspiring exemplar of fortitude for Christian youth. Proceeding boldly before the pagan magistrate, St. Matra confessed Christ as true God. After subjecting him to cruel torments, they martyred him alongside his companions on this day. May the intercession of these righteous saints be our refuge.

en.verse: Let my prayer be set forth before thee as incense; and the lifting up of my hands as the evening sacrifice. Set a watch, O LORD, before my mouth; keep the door of my lips. Incline not my heart to any evil thing, to practise wicked works with men that work iniquity: and let me not eat of their dainties. Let the righteous smite me; it shall be a kindness: and let him reprove me.

am.verse: ጸሎቴን በፊትህ እንደ ዕጣን ተቀበልልኝ፥ እጅ መንሣቴም እንደ ሠርክ መሥዋዕት ትሁን። አቤቱ፥ ለአፌ ጠባቂ አኑር፥ የከንፈሮቼንም መዝጊያ ጠብቅ። ልቤን ወደ ክፉ ነገር አትመልሰው፥ ለኃጢአት ምክንያት እንዳልሰጥ፤ ከምርጦቻቸውም ጋር አልተባበር። ጻድቅ በምሕረት ይገሥጸኝ፥ ይዝለፈኝም።

title.en: St. Thomas the Apostle, St. Stephen the Second Martyr, and St. Athanasius Patriarch of Antioch
title.am: ቅዱስ ቶማስ ሐዋርያ፣ ቅዱስ እስጢፋኖስ ካልዕ እና ቅዱስ አትናስዮስ

am: ደጉ ሐዋርያ ቅዱስ ቶማስ ከኢትዮጵያ እስከ ሕንድና ባርቶስ በደረሰች ስብከቱ እጅግ ድንቅ የሆኑ ተአምራትን ሠርቷል:: ቅዱስ ቶማስ ጎና ወደምትባል የሕንድ አውራጃ መግቢያ ፈሊጥ ቢያጣ ጌታችን ወርዶ አበኒስ ለሚባል ነጋዴ እንደ ባሪያ አድርጎ ሸጠው:: በመጀመሪያ በንጉሡ ሠርግ ቤት ውስጥ ተአምራትን አሳይቶ ሕዝቡንና ሙሽሮቹን አሳመነ:: ቀጥሎም ጎንዶፎር ለሚባል ንጉሥ "ቤተ መንግሥት ሥራ" ተብሎ ተላከ:: ሐዋርያውም ንጉሡን "የማንጽበትን ወርቅና ብር ስጠኝ" ብሎ ገንዘቡን ሲቀበል "የምድራዊውን ንጉሥ ለሰማያዊው ንጉሥ እሰጣለሁ" እያለ ለነዳያን መጸወተው:: ንጉሡም በተቆጣ ጊዜ የንጉሡ ወንድም ጋዶን ሞቶ በሰማይ ለንጉሡ የታነጸውን አስደናቂ የወርቅ ቤተ መንግሥት አይቶ ከሞት ተነሥቶ መሰከረ:: ንጉሡና ሠራዊቱም በክርስቶስ አመኑ::

በዚች ዕለት ደግሞ ቅዱስ እስጢፋኖስ ካልዕ (ሁለተኛው) ይታሰባል:: ቅዱሱ በ3ኛው መቶ ክ/ዘመን አጋማሽ በአንጾኪያ ቤተ መንግሥት ውስጥ ከነበሩ ልዑላንና የጦር መሪዎች አንዱ ነበር:: ዘመነ ሰማዕታት በደረሰ ጊዜ ግን ምድራዊ ማዕረጉን: ክብሩንና ሀብቱን ንቆ ስለ ክርስቶስ ፍቅር በድፍረት መሰከረ:: መኮንኑም ብዙ አሰቃይቶ በመጨረሻም አንገቱን አስቆርጦታል፤ የሰማዕትነት አክሊልንም ተቀዳጅቷል::

በዚችም ዕለት የታላቁ የአንጾኪያ ሊቀ ጳጳሳት የቅዱስ አትናስዮስ ብጹዕ መታሰቢያ ይከበራል:: ቅዱስ አትናስዮስ በአንጾኪያ ሊቀ ጳጳሳት ሆኖ ሲመረጥ በወቅቱ ያልነበረው አባ እልመፍርያን የሚባል ጳጳስ "እኔ በሌለሁበት የተሾመው አይሠራም" ብሎ አትናስዮስን አወገዘ:: ቅዱስ አትናስዮስ ግን ለግል ክብሩ ሲል ቤተ ክርስቲያን ስትከፈል ማየትን አልወደደም:: ስለዚህም መንበረ ጵጵስናውን ትቶ የነተበ የበርሃ ልብስ ለብሶ በእግሩ ተጉዞ አባ እልመፍርያን ወዳለበት ገዳም ሔደ:: ወደ እርሱም ገብቶ "ነዳይ ነኝና አስጠጋኝ" ብሎ ሰገደለት::

ቅዱስ አትናስዮስ ፓትርያርክ ሲሆን በዚያ ገዳም ወገቡን ታጥቆ ውሃ ይቀዳል: ዳቦ ይጋግራል: ቤቶችን ይጠርጋል: መጸዳጃ ቤቶችን ያጸዳል: የመነኮሳቱን እግር ያጥባል:: አባቶች ትጋቱን አይተው "ዲቁና ልሹምህ" ቢሉት እያለቀሰ "አባቴ በነውር ተይዞብኝ ነው እንጂ ዲቁናስ አለኝ" አላቸው:: ከዓመት በኋላ ግን ለኤጲስ ቆጶስነት ሊሾሙት ሲሰበሰቡ እያለቀሰ "እኔ እኮ ያ ያወገዛችሁት ፓትርያርክ አትናስዮስ ነኝ" አላቸው::

የሰማውን ነገር ማመን ያቃተው አባ እልመፍርያን ደንግጦ በግንባሩ መሬት ላይ ወድቆ አለቀሰ፤ "ወየው ለእኔ! ጌታዬን አትናስዮስን እንደ አገልጋይ አዘዝኩ" እያለ ምሕረትን ለመነ:: ሊቃውንቱና ምእመናኑም ከቅዱስ አትናስዮስ ታላቅ ትሕትና የተነሣ ፈጽመው አደነቁ፤ በታላቅ ዝማሬም ወደ አንጾኪያ መንበሩ መለሱት:: በዚህ መንገድ ቤተ ክርስቲያንን ከመከፋፈል ታደገ:: ቅዱሱ በብዙ ተጋድሎ ኖሮ በዚህች ቀን ዐርፏል:: የአባቶቻችን በረከት ከሁላችን ጋር ይሁን::
en: The blessed Apostle St. Thomas performed astonishing signs during his preaching from Ethiopia to India and Parthia. Seeking access to the Indian kingdom of Gona, the Lord Jesus appeared and sold Thomas as a slave-architect to a merchant named Abbanes. Arriving in India, Thomas performed miracles at the royal nuptial banquet, bringing the royal household to Christ. Thereafter, King Gondoforus commissioned him to construct a magnificent imperial palace, entrusting him with vast stores of gold and silver. But the Apostle, proclaiming 'I render to the heavenly King what belongs to the earthly king,' distributed every mite to the destitute, widows, and orphans. When the enraged king imprisoned Thomas to execute him, the king's brother Gadon died, saw in heaven the glorious golden palace Thomas had erected for the king through alms, and was sent back to life to testify. Hearing this, the king and his nation believed and were baptized.

On this day also is commemorated St. Stephen the Second (Stephen the Younger). Born in the mid-3rd century into high imperial nobility in Antioch, he was a distinguished military commander. When the great persecution arose, he renounced his rank, titles, and wealth, boldly confessing Jesus Christ before the tribunal. After enduring cruel tortures, he was crowned with martyrdom by the sword.

On this day, the Church honors the memory of St. Athanasius the Blessed, Patriarch of Antioch. When elevated to the patriarchal throne, a prominent bishop named Abba Elmefriyan of Seleucia, who was absent during the synod, angrily rejected the election and pronounced anathema against Athanasius. Learning of this, Patriarch Athanasius refused to allow pride to divide the Church of God. Secretly leaving his throne, he clothed himself in ragged ascetical garments, journeyed on foot to Seleucia, and prostrated before Bishop Elmefriyan, begging: 'I am a poor destitute wanderer; receive me for Christ's sake.'

Though the supreme patriarch, he spent an entire year in that monastery performing the lowest menial services: drawing heavy water pots, kneading and baking bread, scrubbing floors, cleaning latrines, and washing the feet of the brethren with tears. Marveling at his humility, the fathers proposed ordaining him deacon, but he wept, replying, 'I have fallen short through many faults.' A year later, when the bishops assembled to forcibly consecrate him bishop for a vacant diocese, Athanasius wept and revealed: 'Fathers, I am that very Patriarch Athanasius whom you anathematized.'

Stunned and trembling, Bishop Elmefriyan fell face-down upon the earth, weeping bitterly: 'Woe is me, for I have commanded my Lord and Patriarch as a common slave!' The bishops, clergy, and faithful were overwhelmed by the astonishing humility of St. Athanasius. Reconciling in tears of holy love, they escorted him back with glorious hymns to the patriarchal throne of Antioch, thereby preserving the unity of the Holy Church. Having lived in such profound evangelical humility, he reposed on this day. May the prayers of these holy saints be our salvation.

en.verse: Feed the flock of God which is among you, taking the oversight thereof, not by constraint, but willingly; not for filthy lucre, but of a ready mind; Neither as being lords over God's heritage, but being ensamples to the flock. And when the chief Shepherd shall appear, ye shall receive a crown of glory that fadeth not away. Likewise, ye younger, submit yourselves unto the elder. Yea, all of you be subject one to another, and be clothed with humility: for God resisteth the proud, and giveth grace to the humble.

am.verse: በእናንተ ዘንድ ያለውን የእግዚአብሔርን መንጋ ጠብቁ፤ እንደ እግዚአብሔር ፈቃድ በውድ እንጂ በግድ ሳይሆን፥ በበጎ ፈቃድ እንጂ በነውረኛ ረብ ሳይሆን ጐብኙት፤ ለመንጋው ምሳሌ ሁኑ እንጂ ማኅበሮቻችሁን በኃይል አትግዙ፤ የእረኞችም አለቃ በሚገለጥበት ጊዜ የማያልፈውን የክብርን አክሊል ትቀበላላችሁ። እንዲሁም፥ ጐበዞች ሆይ፥ ለሽማግሌዎች ተገዙ፤ ሁላችሁም እርስ በርሳችሁ እየተዋረዳችሁ ትሕትናን እንደ ልብስ ታጠቁ፥ እግዚአብሔር ትዕቢተኞችን ይቃወማልና፥ ለትሑታን ግን ጸጋን ይሰጣል።

am: ሰማዕትነት በክርስትና ለሃይማኖት የሚከፈል የመጨረሻው መስዋዕትነት ነው:: ቅዱስ ኤፍሬም ሶርያዊ "አማን መነኑ ሰማዕት ጣዕማ ለዝ ዓለም: ወተዓገሡ ሞተ መሪረ በእንተ መንግሥተ ሰማያት-ሰማዕታት የእዚህን ዓለም ጣዕም በእውነት ናቁ: ስለ መንግሥተ ሰማያትም መራራውን ሞት ታገሡ" እንዳለው ሰማዕትነት ማለት ስለ ፍቅረ እግዚአብሔር ሲሉ መከራን መታገሥ ነው:: ቅዱሳን ባኮስና ሰርጊስ ከልጅነታቸው ጀምሮ ባልንጀሮች ነበሩ:: በ3ኛው መቶ ክ/ዘመን በሮም ግዛት በሰላሙ ጊዜ ሁለቱ ቅዱሳን ጾምን: ጸሎትንና በጎ ምግባራትን ሁሉ ይከተሉ ነበር:: በመንግሥት ሠራዊት ውስጥም ከፍተኛ የጦር መኮንኖች ሆነው ተሹመው ነበር::

በወቅቱ መክስምያኖስና ዲዮቅልጥያኖስ ሲነግሡ በክርስቲያኖች ላይ ታላቅ ስደት አስነሱ:: ንጉሡም ለጣዖት እንዲሰግዱ ባዘዘ ጊዜ ባኮስና ሰርጊስ "እኛ የሰማይና የምድር ፈጣሪ የሆነውን ክርስቶስን እንጂ ጣዖትን አናመልክም" ብለው በድፍረት መሰከሩ:: ንጉሡም የክብር ልብሳቸውን አስወልቆ የሴት ልብስ አልብሶ በከተማው አደባባዮች አዞራቸው:: ቀጥሎም ወደ ሶርያ አውራጃ ልኮ በጨካኙ መኮንን በአንጾኪያኖስ ፊት እንዲቆሙ አደረገ::

መኮንኑም ሁለቱን ቅዱሳን ለመለየት አስቦ በመጀመሪያ ቅዱስ ባኮስን በጨካኝ ሁኔታ በጅራፍ አስገረፈው፤ በዚያም በደረሰበት ጽኑ ግርፋት ጥቅምት 4 ቀን በሰማዕትነት ዐረፈ:: በሌሊትም ቅዱስ ባኮስ በሰማያዊ ብርሃንና ግርማ ለቅዱስ ሰርጊስ ተገልጦ "ወንድሜ ሆይ! አይዞህ ጽና፤ የክብር አክሊል ተዘጋጅቶልሃልና በክርስቶስ ፍቅር ጨክን" ብሎ አጽናናው::

በማግስቱም መኮንኑ በቅዱስ ሰርጊስ እግር ላይ በውስጡ ረዣዥም ስለታም ሚስማሮች ያሉበትን የብረት ጫማ አስገብቶ በፈረሶች ፊት እንዲሮጥ አደረገው፤ ደሙም እንደ ውኃ ፈሰሰ:: ነገር ግን የእግዚአብሔር መልአክ ወርዶ ፈወሰው:: መኮንኑም ተአምራቱን አይቶ በድንጋጤ ቢዋጥም ልቡ ደንድኖ ነበርና በመጨረሻም ጥቅምት 10 ቀን አንገቱን በሰይፍ አስቆርጦታል፤ ሰማዕቱም የክብርን አክሊል ተቀዳጀ:: የአባቶቻችን በረከት ከሁላችን ጋር ይሁን::
en: Martyrdom is the supreme offering a Christian can make for the holy faith. As St. Ephrem the Syrian proclaimed: 'Truly the martyrs despised the sweet pleasures of this passing world and endured bitter death for the sake of the kingdom of heaven.' Saints Bacchus and Sergius were intimate companions from early childhood. Flourishing in the 3rd century during a temporary era of peace under the Roman Empire, they exercised constant fasting, prayer, and righteousness, while simultaneously serving with highest distinction as decorated senior officers in the imperial military.

When Maximian and Diocletian unleashed horrific persecutions against Christians, the emperor demanded that all military leaders offer sacrifice to Apollo. Saints Bacchus and Sergius openly refused, declaring: 'We worship only the Lord Jesus Christ, Creator of heaven and earth, and we will never offer sacrifice to lifeless idols.' Stripping them of their military insignia and honors, the tyrant clothed them in women's garments and paraded them through the streets to humiliate them. He then exiled them to Syria to be tried by the notorious governor Antiochus.

Hoping to break their resolve, Antiochus separated the two companions and subjected St. Bacchus to ferocious scourgings with raw sinews until his holy flesh was torn and he surrendered his spirit on Tikimt 4. That night, St. Bacchus appeared in celestial glory to St. Sergius, comforting him: 'Fear not, my beloved brother! Be of good courage and endure; a magnificent crown of heavenly glory is prepared for you in Christ.'

On the following day, the governor drove iron shoes studded with sharp, protruding nails into St. Sergius's feet and compelled him to run before galloping horses. While his blood flowed upon the ground, an angel of God descended and miraculously healed his wounds. Terrified by the wonder yet hardened in heart, the tyrant finally commanded that St. Sergius be beheaded on this day, Tikimt 10. Thus the holy martyr triumphed and received his radiant crown. May the intercession of the holy martyrs Sergius and Bacchus protect us all.

en.verse: Who shall separate us from the love of Christ? shall tribulation, or distress, or persecution, or famine, or nakedness, or peril, or sword? As it is written, For thy sake we are killed all the day long; we are accounted as sheep for the slaughter. Nay, in all these things we are more than conquerors through him that loved us.

am.verse: ከክርስቶስ ፍቅር ማን ይለየናል? መከራ፥ ወይስ ጭንቀት፥ ወይስ ስደት፥ ወይስ ራብ፥ ወይስ ራቁትነት፥ ወይስ ፍርሃት፥ ወይስ ሰይፍ ነውን? ስለ አንተ ቀኑን ሁሉ እንገደላለን፥ እንደሚታረዱ በጎች ተቈጠርን ተብሎ እንደ ተጻፈ ነው። በዚህ ሁሉ ግን በወደደን በእርሱ ከአሸናፊዎች እንበልጣለን።

am: "ጳጳስ" ማለት "አባት: መሪ: እረኛ" ማለት ነው:: በቅድስት ቤተ ክርስቲያን አስተምህሮ በሐዲስ ኪዳን የመንፈሳዊ ሥልጣን ደረጃዎች በጥቅሉ ሦስት ናቸው፤ እነሱም ዲቁና: ቅስና: ጵጵስና ናቸው:: አባ ያዕቆብ ስዱድ የተባለው አባት በ6ኛው መቶ ክ/ዘመን የተነሳ ታላቅ የእግዚአብሔር ሰው ሲሆን የአንጾኪያ ሊቀ ጳጳሳት ሆኖ ተሹሟል:: ወቅቱ መለካውያን የተዋሕዶ አማኞችን የሚያሳድዱበት ስለነበር ቅዱስ አባ ያዕቆብ ስለ ቀናች ተዋሕዶ ሃይማኖቱ ከመንበሩ ተሰደደ::
ስለዚህም "ስዱድ" (ስደተኛው) ተባለ:: እርሱ ግን በስደት ሳለ አላረፈም፤ በእግሩ እየተጓዘ በሶርያ: በግብፅና በበርሃዎች ሁሉ የተበተኑትን ምእመናን አጸና: ካህናትን ሾመ: ድውያንን ፈወሰ:: በታላቅ ተጋድሎና ጽናት ቤተ ክርስቲያንን ሲጠብቅ ኖሮ በዚህች ቀን በጥቅምት 11 ዐርፏል::

በዚች ዕለት ደግሞ ታላቋ እናታችን ቅድስት ዺላግያ ገዳማዊት ትታሰባለች:: ቅድስቲቱ በአንጾኪያ ከተማ ትኖር የነበረች እጅግ ውብና በከንቱ የዓለም ቅንጦትና ዘፈን ተጠምዳ የነበረች ሴት ነበረች:: ነገር ግን ጳጳሱ ቅዱስ ኖኖስ በቤተ መቅደስ ስለ ወደፊቱ የፍርድ ቀንና ስለ ንስሐ ሲያስተምር በሰማች ጊዜ ልቧ ተነካ:: ወዲያውም በምሬት አልቅሳ በቅዱስ ኖኖስ እግር ሥር ወደቀች::

ቅድስት ዺላግያ የነበራትን ሀብትና ጌጣጌጥ ሁሉ ለነዳያን ሰጥታ የወንድ መነኩሴ ልብስ ለብሳ ስሟንም "ዺላግዮስ" ብላ ወደ ደብረ ዘይት በዓት ገባች:: በዚያም ለብዙ ዓመታት በጾምና በጸሎት ተጋድላ ሰውነቷ ደረቀ:: ሴት መሆኗ የታወቀው በዚህች ቀን በክብር ባረፈችና ቅዱሳን አባቶች ሊገንዟት በመጡ ጊዜ ነበር:: በንስሐዋ ታላቅ ክብርን አግኝታለች:: የአባቶቻችንና የእናቶቻችን ጸሎት ከሁላችን ጋር ይሁን::
en: 'Bishop' signifies father, guide, and shepherd. In the doctrine of the Holy Church, the spiritual orders of the New Covenant are threefold: the diaconate, the priesthood, and the episcopate. St. Abba James the Exiled was a sublime man of God who flourished in the 6th century and was elevated to the patriarchal throne of Antioch. Because it was an era of fierce persecution by the Chalcedonians against Orthodox believers of the Tewahedo faith, St. James was driven from his throne and exiled for his uncompromising defense of orthodoxy.

For this reason, he was called 'Sdud' (the Exiled). Yet during his exile he never ceased his apostolic labor; travelling on foot throughout Syria, Egypt, and remote deserts, he confirmed scattered Orthodox believers, consecrated faithful bishops and priests, and healed the sick. Having shepherded the flock of Christ with immense ascetic valor and fidelity, he reposed on this day, Tikimt 11.

On this day also, the Church commemorates our holy mother St. Pelagia the Hermit. Originally dwelling in Antioch, she was renowned for her dazzling physical beauty, but was completely immersed in the vanities of theater and worldly revelry. One day, hearing the holy Bishop Nonnus preach with tears concerning the Last Judgment and the beauty of true repentance, her heart was pierced with divine contrition. Weeping bitterly, she threw herself at the bishop's feet, imploring holy baptism.

Distributing all her wealth, jewels, and garments to the destitute, St. Pelagia clothed herself in the coarse tunic of a male monk, took the name 'Pelagios,' and retired to a solitary cave on the Mount of Olives in Jerusalem. There she persevered for many years in rigorous fasting and tearful supplication until her flesh withered. Her true identity as a woman was revealed only upon her repose on this day, when the monastic fathers arrived to prepare her holy body for burial. Through sincere repentance, she attained supreme heavenly honor. May the prayers of these holy fathers and mothers be with us all.

en.verse: And he spake this parable unto them, saying, What man of you, having an hundred sheep, if he lose one of them, doth not leave the ninety and nine in the wilderness, and go after that which is lost, until he find it? And when he hath found it, he layeth it on his shoulders, rejoicing. And when he cometh home, he calleth together his friends and neighbours, saying unto them, Rejoice with me; for I have found my sheep which was lost. I say unto you, that likewise joy shall be in heaven over one sinner that repenteth, more than over ninety and nine just persons, which need no repentance.

am.verse: ይህንም ምሳሌ ነገራቸው እንዲህ ሲል፦ ከእናንተ መቶ በግ ያለው አንዱንም ቢያጠፋ፥ ዘጠና ዘጠኙን በበረሃ ትቶ የጠፋውን እስኪያገኘው ድረስ በኋላው የማይሄድ ማን ነው? ባገኘውም ጊዜ ደስ ብሎት በጫንቃው ይሸከመዋል፤ ወደ ቤትም በመጣ ጊዜ ወዳጆቹንና ጎረቤቶቹን በአንድነት ጠርቶ፦ የጠፋውን በጌን አግኝቼዋለሁና ከእኔ ጋር ደስ ይበላችሁ ይላቸዋል። እላችኋለሁ፥ እንዲሁ ንስሐ ከማያስፈልጋቸው ከዘጠና ዘጠኝ ጻድቃን ይልቅ ንስሐ በሚገባ በአንድ ኃጢአተኛ በሰማይ ደስታ ይሆናል።

am: በዚች ዕለት እግዚአብሔር "እንደ ልቤ የሆነውን የዕሴይን ልጅ ዳዊትን አገኘሁ" ያለለት ቅዱስ ዳዊት በእሥራኤል ላይ የነገሠበት መታሰቢያ ይከበራል:: ቅዱስ ዳዊት በነቢዩ ሳሙኤል እጅ የተቀባ: በመንፈስ ቅዱስ ተቃኝቶ መዝሙረ ዳዊትን የደረሰ: ንጉሥ: ነቢይና የጌታችን የኢየሱስ ክርስቶስ ቅድመ አያት ነው:: ቅዱስ ዳዊት ኃያሉን ጎልያድን ድል የነሣ: በንስሐውና በትሕትናው በእግዚአብሔር ፊት ሞገስን ያገኘ ታላቅ አባት ነው:: በዚች ዕለት የእስራኤል ነገዶች ሁሉ በኬብሮን ተሰብስበው በሙሉ ፈቃዳቸው በሕዝቡ ሁሉ ላይ አነገሡት::

በዚችም ዕለት ቅዱስ ማቴዎስ ሐዋርያና ወንጌላዊ ይታሰባል:: ቅዱስ ማቴዎስ በቀደመ ስሙ ሌዊ ተብሎ ሲጠራ በቀረጥ መሰብሰቢያው ተቀምጦ ሳለ ጌታችን "ተከተለኝ" ባለው ጊዜ ሁሉን ትቶ የተከተለው ከ12ቱ ሐዋርያት አንዱ ነው:: የመጀመሪውን የወንጌል መጽሐፍ በዕብራይስጥ ቋንቋ የጻፈ ሲሆን በምድረ ፍልስጥኤም: በፋርስና በኢትዮጵያ ወንጌልን በታላቅ ተአምራት ሰብኮ ብዙዎችን አሳምኗል::

በዚችም ዕለት 12ኛው የእስክንድርያ ሊቀ ጳጳሳት ቅዱስ ድሜጥሮስ ሊቅ ያረፈበት ነው:: ቅዱስ ድሜጥሮስ ገበሬ ሆኖ ሳለ ድንግልናውን ጠብቆ ከሚስቱ ጋር እንደ ወንድምና እህት ይኖር ነበር:: ፓትርያርኩ ቅዱስ ዮልያኖስ ሊያርፍ ሲል መልአኩ ተገልጾ "ነገ በማለዳ የወይን ዘለላ ይዞ ወደ አንተ የሚመጣውን ሰው በእኔ ፈቃድ ሹመው" አለው፤ በማግስቱም ድሜጥሮስ የወይኑን ዘለላ ይዞ ገባ::

ቅዱስ ድሜጥሮስ ከተሾመ በኋላ ፊደል ያልቆጠረ ገበሬ የነበረ ቢሆንም በመንፈስ ቅዱስ ተገልጦለት በዓላትንና አጽዋማትን የምናወጣበትን "ባሕረ ሐሳብ" (የዘመን አቆጣጠር) ደረሰ:: እንደ ኦሪገን ያሉ መናፍቃንንም አውግዟል:: እስከ 107 ዓመቱ በታላቅ ቅድስናና አገልግሎት ቆይቶ በዚህች ቀን በጥቅምት 12 ዐርፏል:: የቅዱሳኑ ጸሎትና በረከት ከሁላችን ጋር ይሁን::
en: On this day is celebrated the coronation of Prophet King David, concerning whom God testified: 'I have found David the son of Jesse, a man after mine own heart.' Anointed by the prophet Samuel, David was a prophet, king, and the ancestor of Our Lord Jesus Christ according to the flesh, who composed the divine Book of Psalms under the inspiration of the Holy Spirit. Having vanquished the giant Goliath in his youth, he found supreme favor before God through deep repentance, forbearance, and humility. On this day, all the tribes of Israel gathered at Hebron and solemnly crowned him king over all Israel.

On this day also, the Church commemorates St. Matthew the Apostle and Evangelist. Originally named Levi, he sat at the receipt of custom as a tax collector until the Lord Jesus commanded him, 'Follow me.' Instantly renouncing all wealth and secular ambition, he followed the Savior and was numbered among the Twelve Apostles. He authored the first canonical Gospel in the Hebrew language, preaching the Good News with mighty miracles across Judea, Persia, and Ethiopia, bringing multitudes to salvation.

On this day also is commemorated the repose of St. Demetrius the Patriarch, the 12th Patriarch of Alexandria. Originally an illiterate, humble vinedresser, he lived with his wife in immaculate virginity as brother and sister for forty-eight years. When Patriarch Julian was near death, an angel commanded him: 'Consecrate as your successor the man who brings you a cluster of grapes tomorrow morning.' At daybreak, Demetrius arrived bearing early grapes, and Julian consecrated him patriarch.

Though lacking secular scholastic training, the Holy Spirit enlightened Demetrius with divine wisdom, enabling him to calculate and author the 'Bahre Hassab' (Computus), establishing the fixed astronomical rules for calculating Easter and all movable fasts observed by the Church to this day. He also refuted and anathematized heretics such as Origen. Having shepherded the Church in spotless holiness unto the age of 107 years, he reposed in peace on this day, Tikimt 12. May the blessings of these holy saints abide with us.

en.verse: I have found David my servant; with my holy oil have I anointed him: With whom my hand shall be established: mine arm also shall strengthen him. The enemy shall not exact upon him; nor the son of wickedness afflict him. And I will beat down his foes before his face, and plague them that hate him. But my faithfulness and my mercy shall be with him: and in my name shall his horn be exalted.

am.verse: ባሪያዬን ዳዊትን አገኘሁት፥ ቅዱስ ዘይትም ቀባሁት፤ እጄም ትረዳዋለች፥ ክንዴም ታጸናዋለች። ጠላት በእርሱ ላይ አይጠቀምም፥ የዓመፃ ልጅም መከራ አይጨምርበትም። ጠላቶቹን ከፊቱ አጠፋለሁ፥ የሚጠሉትንም አዋርዳቸዋለሁ። እውነቴና ምሕረቴም ከእርሱ ጋር ነው፥ በስሜም ቀንዱ ከፍ ይላል።

am: ለቤተ ክርስቲያን የብርሃን ምሰሶ ስለ ሆነላት ስለ ታላቁ ቅዱስ ዮሐንስ አፈ ወርቅ ዜና ሕይወት ማስተዋል ልዩ በረከትን ያሰጣል:: ቅዱስ ዮሐንስ አፈ ወርቅ ገና በ15 ዓመቱ በመንፈሳዊም በዓለማዊም ትምህርት ወደር የማይገኝለት ሊቅ ሆነ:: በ16 ዓመቱ ሀብቱንና ክብሩን ትቶ ወደ በርሃ ገባ፤ በዚያም በጾምና በጸሎት ሲኖር ቅዱስ ዮሐንስ ወንጌላዊና ቅዱስ ጴጥሮስ ተገልጠው ወንጌሉንና የመንግሥተ ሰማያትን መክፈቻ ሥልጣን ሰጡት:: ከዚያን ጊዜ ጀምሮ ብሉይና ሐዲስን እየመላለሰ ያመሰጠረ: አሥር ሺሕ ድርሳናትንና መልእክታትን የጻፈ ታላቅ የዓለም መምህር ሆነ::

በኋላም የቁስጥንጥንያ ፓትርያርክ ሆኖ ተሾመ:: ጣዕመ ትምህርቱ ከመብዛቱ የተነሣ ምድራዊው ሰው ይቅርና ልዑላን መላእክት ተሰብስበው ያደንቁት ነበር:: እመቤታችንም በሕዝብ መካከል "አፈ ወርቅ! ልሳነ ወርቅ! አፈ በረከት!" ብላ ጠርታዋለች:: ቅዱሱ ለሰው ፊት የማያዳላ እውነተኛ እረኛ ስለ ነበር አንዲት መበለት የተበደለችበትን መሬት አልመልስም ያለችውን ንግሥት አውዶክስያን ገሠጻት፤ እርሷ ግን ከከሃዲዎች ጋር መክራ ሁለት ጊዜ አጋዘችው:: በተሰደደበት አገር ወንጌልን አስተምሮ በ407 ዓ/ም በ60 ዓመቱ በክብር ዐርፏል::

በዚች ዕለት ደግሞ አባ ዘካርያስ ገዳማዊ ይታሰባል:: ይህ ታላቅ ጻድቅ በ7 ዓመቱ አባቱ ወዳለበት ገዳም ገባ:: በገዳም ሳለ ከመልኩ ማማር የተነሣ መነኮሳቱ ሲያደንቁት ሰምቶ "ጌታዬ ሆይ! መልኬ ከአንተ ፍቅር ከሚለየኝ መልኬን አጠፋዋለሁ" ብሎ ከአሲድነት ካለው የጉድጓድ ውኃ ውስጥ ሰጥሞ ለ40 ቀናት ጸለየ:: አካሉ ሁሉ ተለውጦና ቆስሎ ወደ ገዳሙ ተመለሰ፤ ማንነቱን ሳያሳውቅም በትሕትና ለ45 ዓመታት አገለገለ::
በመጨረሻ ግን አባቱ በምልክት ለይቶት አለቀሰ፤ "ልጄ ሆይ! አንተ ለእኔ አባቴ ነህ" ብሎ ሰገደለት:: አበው መነኮሳትም ተሰብስበው እጅ ነሡት:: በ7 ዓመቱ የመነነው አባ ዘካርያስ በ52 ዓመቱ በዚህች ቀን ዐርፎ በክብር ተቀብሯል:: የአባቶቻችን ጸሎትና በረከት ከሁላችን ጋር ይሁን::
en: Contemplating the life of St. John Chrysostom, the radiant pillar of the Church, imparts profound spiritual blessing. By the age of fifteen, he had mastered all sacred and secular rhetoric. At sixteen, despising family nobility and vast fortunes, he retreated into the desert with his companion St. Basil. While contending in ascetic solitude, St. Peter the Apostle and St. John the Evangelist appeared to him, conferring upon him the Holy Gospel and the spiritual keys of the kingdom of heaven. Thenceforth, he illuminated Old and New Testaments with heavenly eloquence, transcribing more than ten thousand theological homilies, commentaries, and epistles.

Subsequently elevated to the patriarchal throne of Constantinople, his sermons were so full of sweetness that not only men but celestial angels gathered invisibly to marvel at his teaching. Our Lady the Virgin Mary audibly addressed him before the congregation as 'Chrysostom' (Golden-Mouthed, Tongue of Gold, Fountain of Blessing). Being an impartial shepherd, he rebuked Empress Eudoxia for unjustly seizing the vineyard of a helpless widow; in retaliation, she conspired with heretics and sent him into exile twice. Having borne his afflictions with apostolic joy, he reposed in exile in 407 AD at sixty years of age.

On this day also, the Church commemorates Abba Zechariah the Hermit. Dedicated to monastic life at seven years of age in the monastery where his father dwelt, he overheard the elder monks marveling at his extraordinary youthful beauty. Fearful lest physical appearance become an impediment to divine love, he prayed, 'O Lord, let my outer beauty perish rather than separate me from Your love,' and immersed himself in a bitter mineral pool for forty days. When he emerged with his skin discolored and scarred like a leper, he returned unrecognizably to the monastery and served the fathers in absolute humility for forty-five years.

Shortly before his death, his elderly father recognized him by a small scar and fell weeping at his feet, exclaiming, 'My son, you have become my spiritual father!' The desert fathers gathered, venerating his supreme mortification and holiness. Having renounced the world at seven, Abba Zechariah reposed at fifty-two on this day and was laid to rest with great honor. May the prayers and blessings of these holy fathers abide with us all.

en.verse: Ye are the salt of the earth: but if the salt have lost his savour, wherewith shall it be salted? it is thenceforth good for nothing, but to be cast out, and to be trodden under foot of men. Ye are the light of the world. A city that is set on an hill cannot be hid. Neither do men light a candle, and put it under a bushel, but on a candlestick; and it giveth light unto all that are in the house. Let your light so shine before men, that they may see your good works, and glorify your Father which is in heaven.

am.verse: እናንተ የምድር ጨው ናችሁ፤ ጨው አልጫ ቢሆን ግን በምን ይጣፍጣል? ወደ ውጭ ተጥሎ በሰው ከመረገጥ በቀር ወደ ፊት ለምንም አይጠቅምም። እናንተ የዓለም ብርሃን ናችሁ፤ በተራራ ላይ ያለች ከተማ ልትሰወር አይቻላትም። መብራትንም አብርተው በመቅረዙ ላይ ያኖሩታል እንጂ በዕንቅብ በታች አይደለም፤ በቤት ላሉት ሁሉም ያበራል። መልካሙን ሥራችሁን አይተው በሰማያት ያለውን አባታችሁን እንዲያከብሩ ብርሃናችሁ እንዲሁ በሰው ፊት ይብራ።

title.en: Abuna Aregawi of Dabra Damo and St. Gabra Krestos the Bridegroom
title.am: አቡነ አረጋዊ ዘደብረ ዳሞ እና ቅዱስ ገብረ ክርስቶስ መርዓዊ

en: Abuna Aregawi (Za-Mikael of Dabra Damo)
St. Philip the Apostle (of the 72 Disciples)
St. Gabra Krestos the Bridegroom (Alexius)
St. Moses the Bridegroom
St. Edna (Mother of Abuna Aregawi)
Abba Matthias (Disciple of Abuna Aregawi)
Abba John the Righteous
Our Holy Mother St. Nesahit (The Penitent)

am: አቡነ አረጋዊ (ዘሚካኤል) በኢትዮጵያ ስም አጠራራቸው ከከበረ ታላላቅ ቅዱሳን አባቶች አንዱ ናቸው:: ጻድቁ በ5ኛው መቶ ክ/ዘመን አጋማሽ በሮም ከንጉሥ ይስሐቅና ከቅድስት እድና ተወለዱ:: ምንም የንጉሥ ልጅ ቢሆኑም ምድራዊውን ክብር ንቀው ወደ ገዳም ገብተው መነኮሱ፤ ስማቸውም በበርሃ "ገብረ አምላክ" ተባለ:: በኋላም በመንፈስ ቅዱስ መሪነት ስምንቱን ቅዱሳን (ተስዓቱ ቅዱሳንን) አስከትለው ወደ ኢትዮጵያ መጡ::

በአክሱም ለጥቂት ጊዜ ከቆዩ በኋላ አቡነ አረጋዊ ወደ ትግራይ ተጉዘው ማንም ሊወጣው የማይችለውን ዳሞ የተባለውን ገደላማ ተራራ አገኙ:: በዚያም ቅዱስ ሚካኤል በታዘዘው ታላቅ ዘንዶ አማካኝነት ጅራቱን ይዘው ወደ ተራራው አናት ወጡ፤ ቦታውም "ደብረ ዳሞ" ተባለ:: በዚያም ታላቅ ገዳም መሥርተው ብዙ ደቀ መዛሙርትን አፈሩ:: በመጨረሻም ጥቅምት 14 ቀን ጌታችን ታላቅ ቃል ኪዳን ሰጥቷቸው በክብር ተሰውረዋል::

በዚችም ዕለት ቅዱስ ገብረ ክርስቶስ መርዓዊ (ሙሽራው) ይታሰባል:: ቅዱሱ የሮም ንጉሥ የቴዎዶስዮስ ልጅ ሲሆን በሠርጉ ዕለት በድንግልና ለእግዚአብሔር ለመኖር ቃል ገብቶ በሌሊት ከቤተ መንግሥት ጠፋ:: ወደ ሩቅ አገር ሔዶ ሀብቱን ለነዳያን አካፍሎ በረሃብና በብርድ ተጋደለ:: ከዓመታት በኋላ ወደ አባቱ ቤተ መንግሥት እንደ ነዳይ ለማኝ ሆኖ ተመልሶ ማንም ሳያውቀው በደጅ ወድቆ ለ15 ዓመታት ከአገልጋዮች የሚወረወርለትን ፍርፋሪ እየበላ በታላቅ ትዕግሥት ኖረ::
በሚያርፍበት ጊዜ ታሪኩን በብራና ላይ ጽፎ በእጁ ይዞ ዐረፈ:: በከተማዋም ታላቅ የደወል ድምፅ ተሰምቶ ንጉሡና ጳጳሱ ወደ እርሱ መጥተው ብራናውን ሲያነቡ የንጉሡ የጠፋው ልጁ መሆኑ ታወቀ:: በዕለቱም ብዙ ድውያን በሥጋው ተፈወሱ:: የቅዱሳኑ በረከት ከሁላችን ጋር ይሁን::
en: Abuna Aregawi (Za-Mikael) is one of the most illustrious and beloved monastic fathers of the Ethiopian Orthodox Tewahedo Church. Born in Rome during the mid-5th century to King Isaac and Queen Edna, he renounced his royal heritage from youth, embraced monasticism, and was given the name 'Gabra Amlak' in the Egyptian desert. Guided by the Holy Spirit, he led the Nine Saints to Ethiopia, where King Al-Ameda welcomed them in Aksum.

Later, Abuna Aregawi journeyed into Tigray until he reached the sheer, towering plateau of Damo, which was utterly inaccessible to human ascent. Commanded by the Archangel St. Michael, a giant serpent lowered its tail, and the saint ascended safely to the summit, establishing the famed monastery of Dabra Damo. There he trained hundreds of holy disciples. On Tikimt 14, after the Lord bestowed upon him a magnificent covenant of mercy, he was miraculously hidden away (translated) in glory.

On this day also is commemorated St. Gabra Krestos the Bridegroom (St. Alexius, Man of God). Son of Emperor Theodosius of Rome, on the very night of his royal wedding he resolved to dedicate his virginity solely to Christ. Leaving his bride and family, he fled in disguise to Edessa, distributed all his possessions to the poor, and lived in severe poverty and prayer for years. Later, returning incognito to Rome, he lived for fifteen years as an unrecognized destitute beggar under the palace stairway of his own father, enduring the insults of servants with angelic patience.

At the hour of his departure, he wrote his life story upon a parchment scroll and held it tightly in his hand. Immediately, supernatural church chimes echoed throughout Rome, leading the Pope and Emperor to the humble beggar under the stairs, where the scroll revealed him as the Emperor's long-lost son. Countless sick were healed through his holy relics. May the intercession of these glorious saints be our shield.

en.verse: He that receiveth a prophet in the name of a prophet shall receive a prophet's reward; and he that receiveth a righteous man in the name of a righteous man shall receive a righteous man's reward. And whosoever shall give to drink unto one of these little ones a cup of cold water only in the name of a disciple, verily I say unto you, he shall in no wise lose his reward.

am.verse: ነቢይን በነቢይ ስም የሚቀበል የነቢይን ዋጋ ይወስዳል፥ ጻድቅንም በጻድቅ ስም የሚቀበል የጻድቁን ዋጋ ይወስዳል። ማንም ከእነዚህ ከታናናሾቹ ለአንዱ ቀዝቃዛ ጽዋ ውኃ ብቻ በደቀ መዝሙር ስም የሚያጠጣ፥ እውነት እላችኋለሁ፥ ዋጋው አይጠፋበትም።

title.en: The Holy Twelve Apostles and St. Bilamon the Martyr
title.am: ቅዱሳን 12ቱ ሐዋርያት እና ቅዱስ ቢላሞን ሰማዕት

en: The Holy Twelve Apostles of Our Lord
St. Bilamon the Martyr
The 158 Companions of St. Bilamon
St. Silas the Apostle
St. Tsometa the Righteous
St. Cyricus (Qirqos) and his Mother St. Julitta
St. Ephrem the Syrian (Fountain of Blessing)
St. Menas of Egypt (the Wonderworker)
St. Marina (Emba Marina)
St. Christina the Martyr

am: በቅድስት ቤተ ክርስቲያን አስተምህሮ ከእመቤታችን ቀጥሎ ከቅዱሳን ሐዋርያት የሚበልጥ አልተነሣም:: "ሐዋርያ" ማለት "የተላከ: የጽድቅ መንገደኛ" ማለት ሲሆን በምሥጢር ግን "ባለሟል" ተብሎ ይተረጎማል:: ጌታችን መድኃኒታችን ኢየሱስ ክርስቶስ አሥራ ሁለቱን ሐዋርያት ጠርቶ በሦስት ዓመታት አገልግሎቱ ምሥጢራተ መንግሥተ ሰማያትን አስተማራቸው፤ በዕለተ ጰራቅሊጦስም መንፈስ ቅዱስን አሳድሮ ዓለምን በወንጌል ብርሃን እንዲቀድሱ ላካቸው::

ሐዋርያት እያንዳንዳቸው በደረሳቸው ዕጣ ፈንታ ወደ ተለያዩ የዓለም አገሮች ሔደው ወንጌልን ሰበኩ: ድውያንን ፈወሱ: ሙታንን አስነሱ: አጋንንትን አባረሩ:: ስለ ክርስቶስ ስምም መከራን: ግርፋትንና ሰማዕትነትን ተቀበሉ:: ጌታችንም "እናንተ የተከተላችሁኝ በዳግመኛ ልደት በአሥራ ሁለቱ የእሥራኤል ነገድ ስትፈርዱ በአሥራ ሁለት ዙፋን ትቀመጣላችሁ" (ማቴ. 19:28) ብሎ ታላቅ ሥልጣንን ሰጥቷቸዋል::

በዚች ዕለት ደግሞ ታላቁ ሰማዕት ቅዱስ ቢላሞንና አብረውት የነበሩት 158ቱ ሰማዕታት ይታሰባሉ:: ቅዱስ ቢላሞን በዘመነ ሰማዕታት ስለ ክርስቶስ ፍቅር ከማኅበሩ ጋር በጽናት በመመስከር ብዙ መከራን ከተቀበለ በኋላ በዚህች ቀን አንገቱን በሰይፍ ተቆርጦ የሰማዕትነት አክሊልን ተቀዳጅቷል:: የቅዱሳኑ ሐዋርያትና የሰማዕቱ የቅዱስ ቢላሞን ጸሎት ከሁላችን ጋር ይሁን::
en: In the sacred tradition of the Holy Church, next to Our Lady the Virgin Mary, no created beings hold greater dignity than the Holy Apostles. 'Apostle' signifies 'one who is sent, a messenger of righteousness,' and mystically 'an intimate confidant of the King.' During His three-year earthly ministry, Our Lord Jesus Christ called the Twelve Apostles, revealed to them the mysteries of the kingdom of heaven, and on the Day of Pentecost endowed them with the Holy Spirit to illuminate the whole world with the Gospel.

Casting lots, the Apostles departed into all nations, preaching the Good News, healing the sick, raising the dead, and casting out demons, enduring persecutions, scourgings, and martyrdom for Christ's name. The Lord bestowed upon them sovereign heavenly authority, declaring: 'Ye which have followed me, in the regeneration when the Son of man shall sit in the throne of his glory, ye also shall sit upon twelve thrones, judging the twelve tribes of Israel' (Matt. 19:28).

On this day also, the Church commemorates St. Bilamon the Martyr and his 158 companions. During the era of persecutions, St. Bilamon and his brotherhood boldly witnessed Christ before pagan authorities, enduring cruel torments with unshakeable fortitude until they were beheaded on this day, receiving the imperishable crown of martyrdom. May the prayers of the Holy Apostles and St. Bilamon protect us all.

en.verse: Then answered Peter and said unto him, Behold, we have forsaken all, and followed thee; what shall we have therefore? And Jesus said unto them, Verily I say unto you, That ye which have followed me, in the regeneration when the Son of man shall sit in the throne of his glory, ye also shall sit upon twelve thrones, judging the twelve tribes of Israel. And every one that hath forsaken houses, or brethren, or sisters, or father, or mother, or wife, or children, or lands, for my name's sake, shall receive an hundredfold, and shall inherit everlasting life.

am.verse: በዚያን ጊዜ ጴጥሮስ መልሶ፦ እነሆ፥ እኛ ሁሉን ትተን ተከተልንህ፤ እንኪያስ ምን እናገኝ ይሆን? አለው። ኢየሱስም እንዲህ አላቸው፦ እውነት እላችኋለሁ፥ እናንተስ የተከተላችሁኝ፥ በዳግመኛ ልደት የሰው ልጅ በክብሩ ዙፋን በሚቀመጥበት ጊዜ፥ እናንተ ደግሞ በአሥራ ሁለቱ የእስራኤል ነገድ ስትፈርዱ በአሥራ ሁለት ዙፋን ትቀመጣላችሁ። ስለ ስሜም ቤቶችን ወይም ወንድሞችን ወይም እኅቶችን ወይም አባትን ወይም እናትን ወይም ሚስትን ወይም ልጆችን ወይም እርሻን የተወ ሁሉ መቶ እጥፍ ይቀበላል የዘላለምንም ሕይወት ይወርሳል።

title.en: Covenant of St. Mary (The Seven Covenants) and Abba Jacob the Patriarch
title.am: ኪዳነ ማርያም (7ቱ ኪዳናት) እና አባ ያዕቆብ ሊቀ ጳጳሳት

en: The Seven Covenants of Our Lady the Virgin Mary
Abba Jacob (Yaqatu) Patriarch of Alexandria
St. Philotheosia
am: ሰባቱ ኪዳናት (እግዚአብሔር ለእመቤታችን የገባላት ቃል ኪዳን)

en: Our Lady the Virgin Mary Covenant of Mercy (Kidane Mehret)
St. Michael the Archangel

am: በዚች ዕለት ቸሩ አምላካችን መድኃኒታችን ኢየሱስ ክርስቶስ ለእናቱ ለድንግል ማርያም የገባላትን 7ቱን ኪዳናት የምናስብበት በዓል ነው:: እግዚአብሔር ለሰው ልጆች ከገባው ቃል ኪዳን ሁሉ የድንግል ማርያም ቃል ኪዳን ይበልጣል፤ እርሷ የድኅነታችን መሠረት ናትና:: በስሟ የተማጸነውን: መታሰቢያዋን ያደረገውን: ለተራበ ያበላውን: ለተጠማ ያጠጣውን: የታረዘውን ያለበሰውን: በስሟ የተማጸነውን ሁሉ ጌታችን እንደሚምርላት ቃል ኪዳን ገብቶላታል::

በዚችም ዕለት 50ኛው የእስክንድርያ ሊቀ ጳጳሳት አባ ያዕቆብ (ያቃቱ) ያረፈበት መታሰቢያ ይከበራል:: ይህ ቅዱስ አባት ከልጅነቱ ጀምሮ በቅድስናና በንጽሕና ያደገ: በገዳመ አስቄጥስ በጾምና በጸሎት የተጋደለ ታላቅ አባት ነበር:: ሊቀ ጳጳሳት ሆኖ በተሾመ ጊዜም ቤተ ክርስቲያንን ከመናፍቃን ተኩላዎች በጽናት ጠብቋል:: ብዙ መከራንና ስደትንም ስለ ቀናች ሃይማኖት ታግሦ አብያተ ክርስቲያናትን አንጿል::

አባ ያዕቆብ በዘመኑ የተነሱትን መናፍቃን ሁሉ በጉባኤ አሳፍሮ አውግዟል፤ መንጋውንም በኦርቶዶክሳዊት ተዋሕዶ ሃይማኖት አጽንቷል:: በዘመኑም ታላቅ ረሃብ በግብፅ ምድር በሆነ ጊዜ በጸሎቱ ዝናም አዝንሞ ምድርን አርክቷል:: ለ30 ዓመታት ቤተ ክርስቲያንን በቅድስናና በትጋት መርቶ በዚህች ቀን በጥቅምት 16 በሰላም ዐርፏል:: የቅድስት ድንግል ማርያም አማላጅነትና የአባ ያዕቆብ ጸሎት ከሁላችን ጋር ይሁን::
en: On this day, the Holy Church celebrates the commemoration of the Seven Covenants which Our Lord and Savior Jesus Christ bestowed upon His Virgin Mother. Above all covenants God made with humanity, the Covenant of the Virgin Mary is supreme, for she is the portal of our salvation. The Lord pledged unto her that whosoever invokes her holy name, commemorates her feast, feeds the hungry, gives drink to the thirsty, or clothes the naked in her memory shall obtain everlasting mercy.

On this day also is commemorated the repose of Abba Jacob (Yaqatu), the 50th Patriarch of Alexandria. Reared from childhood in immaculate purity, he contended in prayer and fasting in the Wilderness of Scetes. When elevated to the patriarchal throne, he guarded the flock of Christ against heretical wolves with apostolic vigilance, enduring exile and persecutions for the defense of the Orthodox faith.

Patriarch Jacob convened synods that refuted and anathematized contemporary heresies, confirming the faithful in the true Tewahedo confession. When a severe drought struck Egypt, his fervent prayers brought torrential rains that healed the parched earth. Having shepherded the Church for thirty fruitful years, he reposed in peace on Tikimt 16. May the intercession of the Virgin Mary and the prayers of Abba Jacob be with us all.

en.verse: Kings' daughters were among thy honourable women: upon thy right hand did stand the queen in gold of Ophir. Hearken, O daughter, and consider, and incline thine ear; forget also thine own people, and thy father's house; So shall the king greatly desire thy beauty: for he is thy Lord; and worship thou him. And the daughter of Tyre shall be there with a gift; even the rich among the people shall intreat thy favour.

am.verse: የነገሥታት ሴት ልጆች ለክብርህ ናቸው፤ በወርቅ ልብስ ተጎናጽፋና ተሸፋፍና ንግሥቲቱ በቀኝህ ትቆማለች። ልጄ ሆይ፥ ስሚ እዪ ጆሮሽንም አዘንብዪ፤ ወገንሽን የአባትሽንም ቤት እርሺ፤ ንጉሥ ውበትሽን ወድዶአልና፥ እርሱ ጌታሽ ነውና ለእርሱም ስገጂ። የጢሮስ ሴቶች ልጆች እጅ መንሻ ይዘው ይሰግዱለታል፥ የአሕዛብ ባለጠጎች በፊትህ ይማለላሉ።

title.en: St. Stephen the Archdeacon and Protomartyr, St. Phileas, and St. Anne the Prophetess
title.am: ቅዱስ እስጢፋኖስ ሊቀ ዲያቆናት፣ ቅዱስ ፊልያስ እና ቅድስት ሐና ነቢይት

am: በሕገ ወንጌል የመጀመሪያው ሊቀ ዲያቆናትና ቀዳሚው ሰማዕት ቅዱስ እስጢፋኖስ ነው:: ቅዱሱ በመጀመሪያው መቶ ክ/ዘመን በኢየሩሳሌም ከታላቁ መምህር ከገማልያል እግር ሥር ኦሪትንና ትንቢትን ተምሮ አደገ:: ሐዋርያት ምእመናንን እንዲያገለግሉ ከሾሟቸው ሰባቱ ዲያቆናት መካከል እስጢፋኖስ አንደኛውና አለቃቸው ነበር:: ጸጋንና ኃይልን ተሞልቶ በሕዝቡ መካከል ድንቅንና ታላቅ ምልክትን ያደርግ ነበር:: ጠቢባኑ ይናገርበት የነበረውን ጥበብና መንፈስ ሊቃወሙ አልቻሉም፤ ፊቱም በሸንጎ ፊት እንደ መልአክ ፊት ያበራ ነበር:: በመጨረሻም በድንጋይ ተወግሮ ሲገደል "ጌታ ሆይ! ይህን ኃጢአት አትቁጠርባቸው" ብሎ በመጸለይ ነፍሱን ሰጠ::

በዚች ዕለት ደግሞ ቅዱስ ፊልያስ ሰማዕት ይታሰባል:: ቅዱሱ በግብፅ የፍሙይስ ሀገረ ስብከት ጳጳስ ሆኖ ሳለ በዲዮቅልጥያኖስ ዘመን ተይዞ ወደ ፍርድ አደባባይ ቀረበ:: መኮንኑ ምድራዊ ሀብቱንና ክብሩን አይቶ "ለጣዖት ሠውተህ ራስህን አድን" ቢለውም ቅዱስ ፊልያስ ግን "እኔ ለሕያው አምላክ ለኢየሱስ ክርስቶስ ምስጋናን እሠዋለሁ እንጂ ለጣዖት አልሰግድም" አለው:: ብዙ አሰቃይተው በዚህች ቀን አንገቱን በሰይፍ ቆርጠው ገደሉት፤ ሰማዕትነቱንም በድል ፈጸመ::

በዚችም ዕለት የነቢዩ የሳሙኤል እናት ቅድስት ሐና ነቢይት መታሰቢያ ይከበራል:: ቅድስት ሐና መካን ሆና ሳለ በቤተ መቅደስ በእንባ ወደ እግዚአብሔር ጸልይታ ታላቁን ነቢይ ሳሙኤልን ወልዳ ለእግዚአብሔር ቤት ሰጠች፤ በመንፈስ ቅዱስም ተሞልታ ድንቅ የሆነውን የምስጋና ጸሎት ጸለየች:: የአባቶቻችንና የእናቶቻችን ጸሎት ከሁላችን ጋር ይሁን::
en: St. Stephen is the glorious Archdeacon and Protomartyr of the New Covenant. Instructed in the Law and Prophets at the feet of the great Gamaliel in Jerusalem, he was chosen first among the Seven Deacons ordained by the Holy Apostles. Full of grace and power, he wrought mighty wonders among the people, and adversaries could not withstand the wisdom and Holy Spirit by which he spoke; indeed, his countenance shone like the face of an angel before the Sanhedrin. When they cast him out and stoned him, he knelt and cried with a loud voice, 'Lord, lay not this sin to their charge,' and surrendered his spirit.

On this day also is commemorated St. Phileas the Martyr, Bishop of Thmuis in Egypt. Arraigned before the prefect Culcianus during the Diocletianic persecution, the magistrate urged him to sacrifice to idols to spare his noble family and vast wealth. St. Phileas replied, 'I offer a sacrifice of praise to the living God Jesus Christ, but I will never bow to lifeless idols.' Enduring horrific tortures, he was crowned with martyrdom by the sword.

On this day also, the Church commemorates St. Anne the Prophetess, mother of the Prophet Samuel. Long barren, she poured out her soul in tearful prayer in the tabernacle at Shiloh. The Lord granted her petition, and she gave birth to Samuel, dedicating him perpetually to divine service and uttering her prophetic hymn of thanksgiving under the Holy Spirit. May the prayers of these holy saints be our salvation.

en.verse: And Stephen, full of faith and power, did great wonders and miracles among the people. ... And they were not able to resist the wisdom and the spirit by which he spake. ... And all that sat in the council, looking stedfastly on him, saw his face as it had been the face of an angel.

am.verse: እስጢፋኖስም ጸጋንና ኃይልን ተሞልቶ በሕዝቡ መካከል ድንቅንና ታላቅ ምልክትን ያደርግ ነበር። ... ይናገርበት የነበረውንም ጥበብና መንፈስ ይቃወሙ ዘንድ አልቻሉም። ... በሸንጎም የተቀመጡት ሁሉ ትኩር ብለው ሲመለከቱት እንደ መልአክ ፊት ሆኖ ፊቱን አዩት።

Abuna Ewostatewos the Righteous (Apostolic Preacher)
St. James of the Hebrews

am: በምድረ ግብጽ ከተነሱና ለቤተ ክርስቲያን አብዝተው ከደከሙ አባቶች አንዱ 23ኛው የእስክንድርያ ሊቀ ጳጳሳት አባ ቴዎፍሎስ ነው:: ቅዱስ ቴዎፍሎስ ገና በልጅነቱ ከባልንጀራው ከቴዎዶስዮስ ጋር ሳለ በሕልም ፀሐይና ጨረቃ በራሳቸው ላይ ሲያበሩ አዩ፤ ይህም ቴዎዶስዮስ የሮም ንጉሥ: ቴዎፍሎስ ደግሞ የእስክንድርያ ፓትርያርክ እንደሚሆኑ የሚያሳይ ነበር:: በዘመኑም የጣዖት ቤቶችን አፍርሶ በርካታ አብያተ ክርስቲያናትን አንጿል:: በተለይም እመቤታችን በስደቷ ወቅት ያረፈችበትን ደብረ ቊስቋምን አንጾ ቀድሷል፤ ድንቅ የሆነውን "ድርሳነ ቊስቋም" የደረሰውም እርሱ ነው::

በዚች ዕለት ደግሞ ታላቁ ሰማዕት ቅዱስ ሮማኖስ ይታሰባል:: ቅዱስ ሮማኖስ በአንጾኪያ ከተማ ዲያቆን ሆኖ ሳለ አረማዊው ንጉሥ ክርስቲያኖች ለጣዖት እንዲሠዉ ባዘዘ ጊዜ በድፍረት ወደ አደባባይ ወጥቶ "ክርስቶስ እውነተኛ አምላክ ነው: ጣዖት ግን ከንቱ ነው" እያለ ሰበከ:: ወታደሮቹም ይዘው አንደበቱን አስቆረጡት፤ እርሱ ግን ያለ አንደበት በተአምራት በግልጽ እግዚአብሔርን አመሰገነ:: በመጨረሻም በእሥር ቤት ውስጥ አንቀው ገደሉትና የሰማዕትነት አክሊልን ተቀዳጀ:: የአባቶቻችን ጸሎት ከሁላችን ጋር ይሁን::
en: St. Theophilus the Theologian, the 23rd Patriarch of Alexandria, laboured immensely for the Holy Church. In childhood, he and his companion Theodosius shared a vision of the sun and moon resting upon their heads, foretelling that Theodosius would become Emperor of Rome and Theophilus Patriarch of Alexandria. During his patriarchate, he demolished pagan temples and constructed splendid sanctuaries, notably consecrating the sanctuary of Mount Qosqwam where the Holy Family found refuge in Egypt, authoring the renowned patristic homily Dirsane Qosqwam.

On this day also is commemorated the valiant martyr St. Romanus. Serving as deacon in Antioch, when the pagan governor ordered Christians to sacrifice to idols, Romanus stood in the public square loudly confessing Christ as true God. The tormentors tore out his tongue, yet by divine miracle he continued to speak clearly, glorifying God and confounding his persecutors. Finally, they martyred him in prison, and he received the radiant crown of martyrdom. May the prayers of these holy fathers protect us all.

en.verse: For if we have been planted together in the likeness of his death, we shall be also in the likeness of his resurrection: Knowing this, that our old man is crucified with him, that the body of sin might be destroyed, that henceforth we should not serve sin. For he that is dead is freed from sin. Now if we be dead with Christ, we believe that we shall also live with him.

am.verse: ሞቱን በሚመስል ሞት ከእርሱ ጋር ከተባበርን፥ ትንሣኤውን በሚመስል ትንሣኤ ደግሞ ከእርሱ ጋር እንተባበራለን፤ ከእንግዲህስ ወዲያ ለኃጢአት እንዳንገዛ የኃጢአት ሥጋ ይሻር ዘንድ አሮጌው ሰዋችን ከእርሱ ጋር እንደ ተሰቀለ እናውቃለን፤ የሞተስ ከኃጢአቱ ጸድቋልና። ነገር ግን ከክርስቶስ ጋር ከሞትን ከእርሱ ጋር ደግሞ በሕይወት እንድንኖር እናምናለን።

title.en: St. Yemrehana Krestos Righteous King of Ethiopia and St. John of Tseylem
title.am: ቅዱስ ይምርሐነ ክርስቶስ ጻድቅ ንጉሠ ኢትዮጵያ እና ቅዱስ ዮሐንስ ዘጸይለም

en: St. Yemrehana Krestos (Righteous King of Ethiopia)
St. John of Tseylem
Abba Simeon the Solitary
Saints Bartholomew and his Wife (Martyrs)
The Holy Bishops who condemned Paul of Samosata
The Righteous Saints of Matra
St. Gabriel the Archangel
St. Isidore the Martyr
Abuna Abiye Egzi the Righteous
Abuna Sene Iyesus
Abuna Joseph the Light of the World

am: የሰው ልጅ "ንጉሥ" ተብሎ "ቅዱስ" መባል ግን ምን ይደንቅ! ይህ ታላቅ ኢትዮጵያዊ መሪ ቅዱስ ይምርሐነ ክርስቶስ ንጉሥ ሲሆን እንደ ደናግል ድንግል: እንደ ባሕታውያን ገዳማዊ: እንደ ካህናት ቀዳሽ: እንደ ሐዋርያት ሰባኪ ሆኖ መገኘቱ እጅግ አስደናቂ ነው:: በዛግዌ ሥርወ መንግሥት ዘመን የነገሠው ጻድቁ ይምርሐነ ክርስቶስ ፍትሕን የጠበቀ: ድሆችንና መበለቶችን የመገበ: በላስታ ምድር በዋሻ ውስጥ እጅግ ድንቅ የሆነውን ቤተ መቅደስ ያነጸ ታላቅ ንጉሥ ነበር:: ቅዳሴ ቀድሶ ሕዝቡን በቅድስና ይመግብ ነበር፤ ዐርፎም ሥጋው ሳይፈርስ ዛሬም ድረስ በክብር በገዳሙ ይገኛል::

በዚች ዕለት ደግሞ ታላቁ ጻድቅ ቅዱስ ዮሐንስ ዘጸይለም ይታሰባል:: ቅዱሱ በሮም ግዛት በገዳም ሳለ አረማውያን ይዘው አሰቃዩት:: መንገድ ላይ ውኃ ጠምቷቸው ሲጨነቁ በጸሎቱ ውኃ አፍልቆ አጠጣቸው፤ እነርሱ ግን ወስደው ጸይለም ለምትባል አገር ለባርነት ሸጡት:: በዚያም ተአምራትን አድርጎ ሕዝቡን በክርስቶስ አሳመነ:: ወደ ጎረቤት አገር ሔዶም አጋንንት ያደሩባቸውን 10,000 ዛፎች በስመ ሥላሴ በመጥረቢያ ሲመታ ዛፎቹ ባንዴ ወደቁ፤ 400,000 ሰዎችም አምነው ተጠመቁ:: በታላቅ ቅድስና ኖሮ በዚህች ቀን ዐርፏል:: የቅዱሳኑ በረከት ከሁላችን ጋር ይሁን::
en: How sublime that an earthly monarch should be crowned a saint of God! St. Yemrehana Krestos was a righteous Ethiopian sovereign of the Zagwe dynasty who united royal majesty with perpetual virginity, solitary asceticism, holy priesthood, and apostolic preaching. Ruling his empire in absolute righteousness, he fed the poor and protected widows. Inside a grand mountain cave in Lasta, he erected the architecturally magnificent church of Yemrehana Krestos. Daily celebrating the Divine Liturgy, he nurtured his flock in holiness, and his incorrupt body rests visibly in his sanctuary to this day.

On this day also is commemorated the righteous father St. John of Tseylem. Captured from his Roman monastery by pagans, he miraculously brought forth water from a rock when his captors were dying of thirst; yet they sold him into slavery in the land of Tseylem. Enduring servitude with patience, he converted the region through miracles. In a neighboring pagan province, he struck down ten thousand idol-trees inhabited by demons through the invocation of the Holy Trinity, bringing four hundred thousand souls to baptism. Having finished his course, he reposed on this day. May the prayers of these righteous saints be with us.

en.verse: The king shall joy in thy strength, O LORD; and in thy salvation how greatly shall he rejoice! Thou hast given him his heart's desire, and hast not withholden the request of his lips. For thou preventest him with the blessings of goodness: thou settest a crown of pure gold on his head. He asked life of thee, and thou gavest it him, even length of days for ever and ever.

am.verse: አቤቱ፥ በኃይልህ ንጉሥ ደስ ይለዋል፤ በማዳንህ እጅግ ሐሴትን ያደርጋል። የልቡን ፈቃድ ሰጠኸው፥ የከንፈሩንም ልመና አልከለከልኸውም። በበጎ በረከት ደርሰህለታልና፥ ከከበረ ዕንቁ የሆነ ዘውድን በራሱ ላይ አኖርህ። ሕይወትን ለመነህ፥ ሰጠኸውም፥ ለረጅም ዘመን ለዘላለም።

title.en: Abba John the Short (Colobos) and St. Elisha the Prophet
title.am: አባ ዮሐንስ ሐጺር እና ቅዱስ ኤልሳዕ ነቢይ

en: St. Abba John the Short (Colobos)
St. Elisha the Prophet
St. Theodore the Martyr
St. John the Short
Abba Amoni the Solitary
Holy Mother Sarah (Matriarch of the Prophets)
St. Theodore the Commander (Martyr)

am: በቤተ ክርስቲያን ያሉ አበው እንደሚሉት ከቅዱሳን በቁመቱ እንደ አባ ዮሐንስ ሐጺር አጭር አልነበረም፤ በዚህም ምክንያት ለዘላለም "ዮሐንስ ሐጺር-አጭሩ አባ ዮሐንስ" ተብሎ ይጠራል:: ቁመቱ አጭር ቢሆንም መንፈሳዊ ተጋድሎውና ትሕትናው ግን ወደ ሰማይ የደረሰ ነበር:: ገዳመ አስቄጥስ ገብቶ ለአረጋዊው ለአባ አሞይ ደቀ መዝሙር ሆነ:: አባ አሞይም ትሕትናውንና ታዛዥነቱን ሊፈትን የደረቀ እንጨት መሬት ላይ ተክሎ "ይህ እንጨት አፍርቶ እስክታይ ድረስ በየቀኑ ውኃ አምጥተህ አጠጣው" አለው፤ ውኃው የሚገኘው ደግሞ የ12 ሰዓት መንገድ ርቆ ነበር::

አባ ዮሐንስ ሐጺር ግን ሳያመነታ ለ3 ዓመታት ውኃ ተሸክሞ ሲያጠጣው ያ የደረቀ እንጨት በ3ኛው ዓመት በቅሎ: አብቦ: ጣፋጭ ፍሬ አፈራ:: አባ አሞይም ፍሬውን ወደ ቤተ መቅደስ ወስዶ ለመነኮሳቱ "የመታዘዝን ፍሬ ቅመሱ" ብሎ አደላቸው:: አባ ዮሐንስ በትሕትናው: በፍቅሩና በጸሎቱ እጅግ የበረታ አባት ሆኖ በክብር ዐርፏል::

በዚች ዕለት ደግሞ ታላቁ ነቢይ ቅዱስ ኤልሳዕ ይታሰባል:: ቅዱስ ኤልሳዕ የታላቁ ነቢይ የቅዱስ ኤልያስ ደቀ መዝሙር ሲሆን ኤልያስ በዕለተ ዕርገቱ እጥፍ መንፈስን አሳድሮበታል:: በጸሎቱ መራራውን ውኃ ያጣፈጠ: ሙታንን ያስነሣ: ደዌያትን የፈወሰ: ከሞተም በኋላ በአጥንቱ ሙት ያስነሣ ድንቅ ነቢይ ነው:: የአባቶቻችን ጸሎት ከሁላችን ጋር ይሁን::
en: Among the desert fathers, none was shorter of stature than Abba John the Short (Colobos), wherefore he is remembered unto all generations as 'John the Short.' Yet though diminutive in body, his spiritual humility and ascetic height reached the highest heavens. Entering the Wilderness of Scetes, he submitted himself in absolute obedience to the elder Abba Amoi. To test his obedience, the elder planted a dry wooden staff in the sand, commanding him: 'Fetch water and water this stick daily until it bears fruit'—though the water source lay a twelve-hour journey away.

Without the slightest hesitation, Abba John carried water under the blazing sun for three continuous years. In the third year, the dry stick blossomed, grew into a fruit-bearing tree, and produced sweet fruit. Abba Amoi brought the fruit into church to the assembly of monks, proclaiming: 'Take, eat the fruit of holy obedience!' Renowned for supreme meekness, love, and continuous prayer, Abba John reposed in holiness.

On this day also, the Church commemorates the great Prophet St. Elisha. Disciple and spiritual son of the Prophet St. Elijah, he received a double portion of his master's spirit when Elijah was taken up to heaven in a chariot of fire. By his prayers, Elisha healed the bitter waters of Jericho, raised the dead, cleansed Naaman the Syrian of leprosy, and even after death his dry bones raised a dead man to life. May the prayers of these holy prophets and fathers be our shield.

en.verse: So likewise ye, when ye shall have done all those things which are commanded you, say, We are unprofitable servants: we have done that which was our duty to do.

am.verse: እንዲሁ እናንተ ደግሞ የታዘዛችሁትን ሁሉ ባደረጋችሁ ጊዜ፦ የማንጠቅም ባሪያዎች ነን፥ ልናደርገው የሚገባንን አድርገናል በሉ።

am: ቅድስት ድንግል እግዝእትነ ማርያም ወላዲተ አምላክ

እመቤታችን ቅድስት ድንግል ማርያም የወልደ እግዚአብሔር እናት: የሰማይና የምድር ንግሥት ናት:: በየወሩ በ21 ቀን የምናከብረው በዓሏ የእመቤታችንን ልዩ ፍቅርና አማላጅነት የምናስብበት ነው:: በዚች ዕለት ደግሞ ጌታችን መድኃኒታችን ኢየሱስ ክርስቶስ በቢታንያ የነበረውን ወዳጁን አልዓዛርን ከሞተ ከአራት ቀን በኋላ ከመቃብር ያስነሣበት ታላቅ ተአምር ይታሰባል::

አልዓዛር በታመመ ጊዜ እህቶቹ ማርያምና ማርታ ወደ ጌታ ልከው ነበር፤ ጌታችንም በደረሰ ጊዜ አልዓዛር ከሞተ አራት ቀን ሆኖት በመቃብር ውስጥ ተኝቶ ነበር:: እህቶቹ ማርያምና ማርታ እያለቀሱ በጌታ እግር ሥር ወደቁ፤ ጌታችንም የሰውን ባሕርይ ገንዘብ አድርጓልና አለቀሰ:: ወዲያውም ወደ መቃብሩ ሔዶ "አልዓዛር ሆይ፥ ወደ ውጭ ና!" ብሎ በሥልጣኑ በጠራው ጊዜ የሞተው አልዓዛር እጆቹና እግሮቹ በመግነዝ እንደ ተገነዙ ወጣ:: በዚህም ጌታችን የትንሣኤና የሕይወት ባለቤት መሆኑን ገለጠ::

አልዓዛር ከትንሣኤው በኋላ በቆጵሮስ ደሴት ጳጳስ ሆኖ ተሹሞ ወንጌልን ሰብኮ ለ30 ዓመታት በቅድስና ኖሮ በክብር ዐርፏል:: በዚችም ዕለት በደጉ አፄ ዳዊት ዘመን ወደ ኢትዮጵያ መጥተው ለግማደ መስቀሉ መምጣት አስተዋጽኦ ያደረጉት አባ ዮሐንስ ዘኢየሩሳሌም ያረፉበት ነው:: የእመቤታችን የድንግል ማርያምና የቅዱስ አልዓዛር ጸሎት ከሁላችን ጋር ይሁን::
en: Our Lady the Virgin Mary is the Mother of God the Word, the Queen of heaven and earth. The monthly commemoration on the 21st day recalls her maternal love and unceasing intercession for humanity. On this day, the Church especially commemorates the glorious miracle wherein Our Lord and Savior Jesus Christ raised His beloved friend St. Lazarus from the dead four days after his burial in Bethany.

When Lazarus fell sick, his sisters Martha and Mary sent word to the Lord. By the time the Savior arrived, Lazarus had already lain in the tomb for four days. Weeping, the sisters fell at Jesus's feet; beholding their sorrow, the Lord in His true human nature wept. Approaching the sepulchre, He commanded: 'Lazarus, come forth!' Instantly, he that was dead came forth, bound hand and foot with graveclothes, revealing Christ as the Resurrection and the Life.

Following his resurrection, St. Lazarus was consecrated Bishop of Kition in Cyprus, where he preached the Gospel for thirty years and reposed in great sanctity. On this day also is commemorated Abba John of Jerusalem, who came to Ethiopia during the reign of Emperor Dawit and contributed to the arrival of the True Fragment of the Holy Cross. May the prayers of the Virgin Mary and St. Lazarus protect us all.

en.verse: Jesus saith unto her, Said I not unto thee, that, if thou wouldest believe, thou shouldest see the glory of God? Then they took away the stone from the place where the dead was laid. And Jesus lifted up his eyes, and said, Father, I thank thee that thou hast heard me. ... And when he thus had spoken, he cried with a loud voice, Lazarus, come forth. And he that was dead came forth, bound hand and foot with graveclothes: and his face was bound about with a napkin. Jesus saith unto them, Loose him, and let him go.

am.verse: ኢየሱስም፦ ብታምኚስ የእግዚአብሔርን ክብር እንድታዪ አልነገርሁሽምን? አላት። ድንጋዩንም አነሱት። ኢየሱስም ዓይኖቹን ወደ ላይ አንስቶ፦ አባት ሆይ፥ ስለ ሰማኸኝ አመሰግንሃለሁ። ... ይህንም ብሎ በታላቅ ድምፅ፦ አልዓዛር ሆይ፥ ወደ ውጭ ና ብሎ ጮኸ። የሞተውም እጆቹና እግሮቹ በመግነዝ እንደ ተገነዙ ወጣ፤ ፊቱም በጨርቅ እንደ ተጠመጠመ ነበረ። ኢየሱስም፦ ፍቱትና ይሂድ ተዉት አላቸው።

am: ቅዱስ ሉቃስ ወንጌላዊ ሐዋርያ: ሐኪም: ሰዓሊ: ጸሐፌ ታሪክና ሰማዕት የሆነ ታላቅ አባት ነው:: በትውልዱ የአንጾኪያ ሰው ሲሆን በ72ቱ አርድእት ውስጥ ተቆጥሯል:: የቅዱስ ሉቃስ ወንጌልንና የሐዋርያት ሥራን በመንፈስ ቅዱስ ተቃኝቶ ጽፏል:: እመቤታችንን በስዕል ለመጀመሪያ ጊዜ የሳላት እርሱ ነው፤ ድንግል ማርያምም ስዕሏን አይታ "በረከቴና የልጄ ጸጋ ከዚህች ስዕል ጋር ይሁን" ብላ ባርካዋለች::
ቅዱስ ሉቃስ ከብርሃነ ዓለም ከቅዱስ ጳውሎስ ጋር በብዙ ስደትና መከራ አብሮ በመጓዝ ወንጌልን ሰብኳል:: በሮም: በግብፅና በግሪክ ብዙዎችን አሳምኗል:: በመጨረሻም በኔሮን ቄሳር ዘመን ተይዞ ወደ ፍርድ አደባባይ ቀረበ፤ ንጉሡም ተቆጥቶ ወንጌልን የጻፈበትን ቀኝ እጁን አስቆረጣት::

ቅዱስ ሉቃስ ግን የእግዚአብሔርን ኃይል ለአሕዛብ ያሳይ ዘንድ ተቆርጣ የወደቀችውን እጁን አንስቶ በክርስቶስ ስም ከትከሻው ጋር አያይዞ ፈወሳት:: በዚያ የነበሩ 477 አሕዛብ ይህንን ድንቅ አይተው በክርስቶስ አምነው ከቅዱሱ ጋር በሰማዕትነት ተሰይፈዋል:: ቅዱስ ሉቃስም ከ36 ዓመታት የስብከት አገልግሎት በኋላ አንገቱን በሰይፍ ተቆርጦ የሰማዕትነት አክሊልን ተቀዳጀ:: የአባቶቻችን በረከት ከሁላችን ጋር ይሁን::
en: St. Luke the Evangelist was an apostle, physician, iconographer, sacred historian, and glorious martyr. A native of Antioch and numbered among the Seventy-Two Disciples, he transcribed the Holy Gospel according to Luke and the Acts of the Apostles under the inspiration of the Holy Spirit. He was the first to paint the sacred icon of Our Lady the Virgin Mary with the Christ Child; beholding the icon, Our Lady blessed it, declaring: 'My blessing and the grace of my Son shall abide with this image.'

St. Luke was the faithful, inseparable companion of St. Paul the Apostle, sharing in all his apostolic tribulations and travels. He preached Christ throughout Rome, Egypt, Dalmatia, and Greece, turning multitudes from idolatry. Arraigned before Emperor Nero, the tyrant ordered St. Luke's right hand—which had transcribed the Holy Gospel—to be severed.

To demonstrate the sovereign power of Christ to the pagans, St. Luke took up his severed hand, joined it back to his arm in the name of Jesus, and it was instantly made whole. Beholding this astonishing miracle, 477 pagans believed in Christ and were martyred on the spot. After more than thirty-six years of apostolic preaching, St. Luke was beheaded on this day, receiving the imperishable crown of martyrdom. May the prayers of the Evangelist Luke be our shield.

en.verse: Forasmuch as many have taken in hand to set forth in order a declaration of those things which are most surely believed among us, Even as they delivered them unto us, which from the beginning were eyewitnesses, and ministers of the word; It seemed good to me also, having had perfect understanding of all things from the very first, to write unto thee in order, most excellent Theophilus, That thou mightest know the certainty of those things, wherein thou hast been instructed.

am.verse: የከበርህ ቴዎፍሎስ ሆይ፥ ከመጀመሪያው በዓይን ያዩትና የቃሉ አገልጋዮች የሆኑት እንዳስተላለፉልን፥ በእኛ ዘንድ ስለ ተፈጸመው ነገር ብዙዎች ታሪክን በየተራው ለማዘጋጀት ስለ ሞከሩ፥ እኔ ደግሞ ስለ ተማርከው ቃል እርግጡን እንድታውቅ፥ በጥንቃቄ ሁሉን ከመጀመሪያው ተከትዬ በየተራው ልጽፍልህ መልካም ሆኖ ታየኝ።

am: በእስክንድርያ ሊቀ ጵጵስናን ከተሾሙና በጎ ሥራን ከሠሩ አባቶች አንዱ 52ኛው ፓትርያርክ አባ ዮሴፍ ነው:: እርሱ በ9ኛው መቶ ክ/ዘመን የነበረ ታላቅ የእግዚአብሔር ሰው ሲሆን ከልጅነቱ ጀምሮ በቅድስና ያደገ: ገዳም ገብቶ በመታዘዝ ያገለገለ አባት ነበር:: ሊቀ ጳጳሳት ሆኖ በተመረጠ ጊዜም በዘመኑ የነበሩ አሕዛብ ገዥዎች በቤተ ክርስቲያን ላይ ብዙ ፈተናዎችን ቢያስነሱም በትዕግሥትና በጸሎት መንጋውን ጠብቋል::

የግብፅ ሱልጣንም አባ ዮሴፍን ሊገድለው ሁለት ጊዜ ሰይፍ ቢመዝበትም በእግዚአብሔር መልአክ ተከልክሎ ሊገድለው አልቻለም:: አባ ዮሴፍ በዘመኑ ተሰዶ የነበረውን የኢትዮጵያ ጳጳስ አባ ዮሐንስንም ከተሰደደበት ወደ መንበሩ መልሶታል:: ቤተ ክርስቲያንን በታላቅ ቅድስናና ጥበብ ሲጠብቅ ኖሮ በ78 ዓመቱ በዚህች ቀን በጥቅምት 23 ዐርፏል:: የአባታችን የአባ ዮሴፍ ጸሎትና በረከት ከሁላችን ጋር ይሁን::
en: St. Joseph the Righteous, the 52nd Patriarch of Alexandria, was a shepherd of exceptional virtue and holiness in the 9th century. From youth he flourished in monastic discipline and humble obedience in the desert of Scetes. When elevated to the patriarchal see, though foreign rulers subjected the Church to intense extortions and afflictions, he preserved the flock through patient endurance, fasting, and fervent prayer.

Twice the local sultan drew his sword to execute Patriarch Joseph, but each time an angel of God visibly deflected the blade, sparing the holy shepherd. In his pastoral care, he also intervened to restore Abba John, the Metropolitan of Ethiopia, who had been unjustly exiled from his see. Having guided the Church with heavenly wisdom, St. Joseph reposed in peace at the age of seventy-eight on Tikimt 23. May his prayers be our protection.

en.verse: For a bishop must be blameless, as the steward of God; not selfwilled, not soon angry, not given to wine, no striker, not given to filthy lucre; But a lover of hospitality, a lover of good men, sober, just, holy, temperate; Holding fast the faithful word as he hath been taught, that he may be able by sound doctrine both to exhort and to convince the gainsayers.

am.verse: ኤጲስ ቆጶስ፥ እንደ እግዚአብሔር መጋቢ፥ የማይነቀፍ ሊሆን ይገባዋልና፤ የማይኮራ፥ የማይቆጣ፥ የማይሰክር፥ የማይጨቃጨቅ፥ ነውረኛ ረብ የማይወድ፥ ነገር ግን እንግዳ ተቀባይ፥ በጎ የሆነውን ነገር የሚወድ፥ ጠንቃቃ፥ ጻድቅ፥ ቅዱስ፥ ራሱን የሚገዛ ይሁን፤ ሕይወት በሚገኝበት ትምህርት ደግሞ ሊመክር ተቃዋሚዎቹንም ሊወቅስ ይችል ዘንድ፥ እንደ ተማረው በታመነ ቃል ይጽና።

title.en: St. Hilarion the Great and St. Tsebela Maryam
title.am: ቅዱስ አብላርዮስ ገዳማዊ እና ቅድስት ጸበለ ማርያም

en: St. Hilarion the Great (Father of Palestinian Monks)
St. Tsebela Maryam
St. Awsya
Abba Paul the Patriarch

St. Agapitus the Righteous Bishop
St. Krestos Samra
St. Thomas of Mar'as
St. Moses the Black (the Ethiopian)
The 24 Heavenly Priests (Seraphim)

am: ቅዱስ አብላርዮስ ታላቁ (Hilarion the Great) የፍልስጥኤም ገዳማውያን አባት በመባል የሚታወቅ ታላቅ ጻድቅ ነው:: የተወለደው በ4ኛው መቶ ክ/ዘመን መጀመሪያ በጋዛ አካባቢ ሲሆን ወላጆቹ አረማውያን ነበሩ:: ወደ እስክንድርያ ሔዶ ሲማር በክርስቶስ አምኖ ተጠመቀ:: በግብፅ በርሃ ታላቁን አባ እንጦኒን አይቶ መንፈሳዊ ሕይወቱን ወደደው፤ የነበረውን ሀብት ሁሉ ለነዳያን ሰጥቶ በ15 ዓመቱ ወደ ጋዛ በርሃ ገባ::

በዚያም በትንሽ ዳስ ውስጥ ለ63 ዓመታት በታላቅ ተጋድሎ ኖረ:: ምግቡ ጥቂት በለስና የዱር ቅጠል ብቻ ነበር:: በጸሎቱ እልፍ አእላፍ አጋንንትን አሳደደ: ድውያንን ፈወሰ: ዝናም አዘነመ:: በሺሕ የሚቆጠሩ ሰዎችን ወደ ክርስትናና ወደ ገዳማዊ ሕይወት መርቷል:: በተወለደ በ80 ዓመቱ በ4ኛው መቶ ክ/ዘመን በዚህች ቀን በጥቅምት 24 በክብር ዐርፏል:: የቅዱስ አብላርዮስ ጸሎትና በረከት ከሁላችን ጋር ይሁን::
en: St. Hilarion the Great is revered as the founding father of Palestinian monasticism. Born near Gaza in the early 4th century to pagan parents, he went to Alexandria to study rhetoric and philosophy, where he encountered Christ and was baptized. Journeying into the Egyptian desert, he met St. Antony the Great and was inflamed with divine love for the ascetical life. Distributing his entire inheritance to the poor, he retired into the desert of Gaza at the tender age of fifteen.

Living in a tiny rush hut, he contended in prayer and fasting for sixty-three continuous years, subsisting on wild herbs and dried figs. Through his prayers, he expelled legions of demons, healed incurable diseases, and caused rain to fall during severe droughts, inspiring thousands to embrace monasticism. Having attained eighty years of age, he reposed in glory on Tikimt 24. May the prayers of St. Hilarion the Great be our shield.

en.verse: For ye see your calling, brethren, how that not many wise men after the flesh, not many mighty, not many noble, are called: But God hath chosen the foolish things of the world to confound the wise; and God hath chosen the weak things of the world to confound the things which are mighty... That no flesh should glory in his presence. But of him are ye in Christ Jesus, who of God is made unto us wisdom, and righteousness, and sanctification, and redemption: That, according as it is written, He that glorieth, let him glory in the Lord.

am.verse: ወንድሞች ሆይ፥ መጠራታችሁን ተመልከቱ፤ እንደ ሰው ጥበብ ጥበበኞች የሆኑ ብዙዎች፥ ኃይለኞች የሆኑ ብዙዎች፥ ባላባቶች የሆኑ ብዙዎች አልተጠሩም። ነገር ግን እግዚአብሔር ጥበበኞችን እንዲያሳፍር የዓለምን ሞኝ ነገር መረጠ... ሥጋን የለበሰ ሁሉ በእግዚአብሔር ፊት እንዳይመካ። ነገር ግን፦ የሚመካ በእግዚአብሔር ይመካ ተብሎ እንደ ተጻፈው ይሁን።

title.en: Abuna Abib (Abba Bula), Abba Ebloy, and St. Julius of Aqfahs

en: Abuna Abib (Abba Bula the Righteous)
Abba Ebloy the Solitary
St. Julius of Aqfahs the Martyr
Saints Abraham and Harik

am: አቡነ አቢብ (አባ ቡላ) በሮም ግዛት የተወለዱና ገድላቸውን በምድረ ግብፅ የፈጸሙ ታላቅ ጻድቅና ሰማዕት ናቸው:: "ቡላ" ማለት "የእግዚአብሔር አገልጋይ" ማለት ነው:: በልጅነታቸው መንነው ወደ ገዳመ አስቄጥስ ገቡ፤ በዚያም ለበርካታ ዓመታት በአክሊል ላይ አክሊል በሚያሰጥ ተጋድሎ ኖሩ:: በጾም: በጸሎትና በስግደት ከመትጋታቸው የተነሣ ሥጋቸው ከአጥንታቸው ጋር ተጣበቀ:: በመጨረሻም በዘመነ ሰማዕታት ብዙ መከራን ከተቀበሉ በኋላ የሰማዕትነት አክሊልን ተቀዳጅተዋል::

በዚች ዕለት ደግሞ ታላቁ ሰማዕት ቅዱስ ዮልዮስ ዘአቅፋህስ ይታሰባል:: ቅዱስ ዮልዮስ በዲዮቅልጥያኖስ ዘመን በግብፅ ቤተ መንግሥት ከፍተኛ ሹም ሆኖ ሳለ የሰማዕታትን ገድልና ታሪክ በብራና ላይ የሚጽፍ: የተቆረጡ ሥጋቸውን ሰብስቦ በክብር የሚቀብር: ለታሠሩትም ምግብና መድኃኒት የሚሰጥ የሰማዕታት ወዳጅ ነበር:: ዘመነ ሰማዕታት ሊፈጸም ሲል እርሱም ለሰማዕትነት ተዘጋጀ፤ ሀብቱን ለነዳያን አካፍሎ በገምኑዲ መኮንን ፊት ክርስቶስን መሰከረ::

መኮንኑም ለጣዖት እንዲሠዋ ባዘዘ ጊዜ ቅዱስ ዮልዮስ በጸሎቱ ጣዖታቱን ከነ ካህናቶቻቸው ምድር ተከፍታ እንድትውጣቸው አደረገ:: በዚህም ተአምር ብዙዎች አምነው ተከተሉት:: በመጨረሻም ቅዱስ ዮልዮስ ከቤተሰቡና ከ1,500 ያህል ተከታዮቹ ጋር አንገቱን በሰይፍ ተቆርጦ የክብርን አክሊል ተቀዳጀ:: የአባቶቻችን ጸሎት ከሁላችን ጋር ይሁን::
en: Abuna Abib (also known as Abba Bula) was a sublime righteous father and martyr born in Rome who completed his holy course in Egypt. 'Bula' signifies 'servant of God.' Renouncing the world in his youth, he entered the desert of Scetes, where he contended in severe fasts, continuous vigils, and prostrations until his flesh cleaved to his bones. During the Diocletianic persecution, he confessed Christ boldly and received the crown of martyrdom.

On this day also is commemorated the great martyr St. Julius of Aqfahs. Holding high civil office in Egypt, he was the renowned chronicler and benefactor of the martyrs, dispatching his scribes to record their trials, redeeming their holy relics for honorable burial, and supplying food to imprisoned confessors. When the era of persecutions was drawing to a close, Christ appeared and permitted him to win the martyr's crown; Julius distributed his vast wealth to the poor and confessed Christ before the governor of Samanoud.

When commanded to sacrifice, St. Julius prayed and the earth opened, swallowing the pagan idols and their priests. Marveling at this wonder, the governor and multitudes believed. Finally, St. Julius was beheaded alongside his family and 1,500 believers on this day, receiving the imperishable crown of martyrdom. May the intercession of these holy martyrs be our protection.

en.verse: Then said Jesus unto his disciples, If any man will come after me, let him deny himself, and take up his cross, and follow me. For whosoever will save his life shall lose it: and whosoever will lose his life for my sake shall find it. For what is a man profited, if he shall gain the whole world, and lose his own soul? or what shall a man give in exchange for his soul?

am.verse: እኔን መከተል የሚወድ ቢኖር ራሱን ይካድ፤ መስቀሉንም ተሸክሞ ይከተለኝ። ነፍሱን ሊያድን የሚወድ ሁሉ ያጠፋታል፤ ስለ እኔ ግን ነፍሱን የሚያጠፋ ሁሉ ያገኛታል። ሰው ዓለሙን ሁሉ ቢያተርፍ ነፍሱንም ቢያጐድል ምን ይጠቅመዋል? ወይስ ሰው ስለ ነፍሱ ቤዛ ምን ይሰጣል?

title.en: St. James the Apostle and St. Timon the Apostle
title.am: ቅዱስ ያዕቆብ ሐዋርያ እና ቅዱስ ጢሞና ሐዋርያ

en: St. James the Apostle (Son of Joseph, Brother of the Lord)
St. Timon the Apostle and Deacon
St. Ignatius
St. Philip
St. Thomas the Apostle
Abuna Habte Maryam the Righteous
Abuna Iyesus Mo'a of Lake Hayq
Holy Martyrs of Najran
St. Abba Salama Kesate Birhan (Enlightener of Ethiopia)

St. James the Apostle holds supreme honor among the holy apostles. His mother was Mary, and he had a sister named Salome. Following the death of his mother Mary, he became an orphan. By divine providence, when the elder Joseph received Our Lady the Virgin Mary from the Temple to care for her and brought her to his home, Mary found young James, immediately fetched an earthen vessel, descended to the spring, brought water, and tenderly washed the child. Our Lady nurtured young James for nine months prior to the Lord's Nativity and for two years following His birth. After the return from exile in Egypt, St. James grew up alongside Our Lord Jesus Christ for twenty-five years, feeling no absence of a mother because the true Spiritual Mother was beside him.

St. James was repeatedly called 'the Brother of the Lord' in the New Testament because they grew up together inseparable for thirty years, because he was the nephew of St. Anna (the maternal grandmother of the Lord in the flesh), because on Joseph's side they shared an ancestral lineage, and because Our Lord out of His infinite humility called His disciples His brethren. Yet St. James himself humbly proclaimed in his epistle: 'James, a servant of God and of the Lord Jesus Christ,' testifying to the infinite distinction between Creator and creation. St. James followed the Savior, was counted among the seventy-two disciples, and studied the Holy Gospel for three years and three months. Alongside the Virgin Mary and St. John, he established the holy fast of the Apostles awaiting the Resurrection of the Lord.

Filled with the Holy Spirit at Pentecost, St. James was ordained the first Bishop of Jerusalem. He presided over the Apostolic Councils in Jerusalem. He performed numerous miracles, raising the dead, healing the sick, opening barren wombs, casting out demons, and bringing multitudes of Jews to faith in Christ. In his final days, non-believing rulers confronted him demanding to know who Jesus of Nazareth was, expecting him to deny His divinity. St. James ascended to the roof of the house and boldly testified: 'Our Lord Jesus Christ is God, Son of God, Son of the Father, and Son of Mary, the Incarnate Word of God! I am His creature and humble servant, not merely His earthly brother.' Enraged, the adversaries cast him down from the terrace, beat his body, and struck his head with a heavy wooden fuller's club until he received the martyr's crown.

Throughout his entire earthly life, St. James never tasted defiling meat or wine, never shaved his head, never bathed luxuriously, nor possessed two garments, living in extreme asceticism. His knees and feet became hardened and swollen like those of a camel from ceaseless prostrations and prayer, which is why the Church fathers revere him as 'the Righteous (Ascetic) Apostle.'

On this day also, the Church commemorates St. Timon the Apostle. He was one of the seventy-two disciples and one of the seven chosen deacons (Acts 6:5). During the Lord's earthly ministry, St. Timon was among those sent two by two who returned rejoicing that even demons were subject to them in Christ's holy name, receiving the Lord's admonition to rejoice rather that their names are written in heaven.

After the descent of the Holy Spirit on Pentecost, St. Timon was chosen alongside St. Stephen to serve the faithful as a deacon with great wisdom and power. Following the martyrdom of St. Stephen, he went forth across distant lands preaching the Gospel of the Kingdom and enduring severe persecution, finally completing his apostolic struggle and receiving the crown of martyrdom on this sacred day.
am: ቅዱስ ያዕቆብ ሐዋርያ በአባቶቻችን ሐዋርያት መካከል ትልቅ ክብር ካላቸው አንዱ ነው:: እናቱ ማርያም ትባላለች:: ሰሎሜ የምትባል እህትም ነበረችው:: እናቱ ማርያም ከሞተች በኋላ ዕጉዋለ ማውታ ሆኖ ነበር:: ነገር ግን በፈቃደ እግዚአብሔር አረጋዊ ዮሴፍ እመቤታችን ቅድስት ድንግል ማርያምን ከቤተ መቅደስ ሊጠብቃት ተቀብሎ ወደ ቤቱ ባመጣት ጊዜ ያዕቆብን አግኝታ ወዲያው ማድጋ አንስታ ወደ ምንጭ ወርዳ ውሃ አምጥታ የሕጻኑን ገላ አጠበችው:: እመቤታችን ጌታ ከመወለዱ በፊት ለ9 ወራት: ከተወለደ በኋላ ደግሞ ለ2 ዓመታት ሕጻኑን ያዕቆብን ተንከባከበችው:: ከስደት መልስም ለ25 ዓመታት ቅዱስ ያዕቆብ ከጌታችን ጋር ሲያድግ ወላጅ እናቱ ትዝ ብላው አታውቅም:: አማናዊቷ እናት ከጎኑ ነበረችና::

ቅዱስ ያዕቆብ 'የጌታ ወንድም' ተብሎ በሐዲስ ኪዳን ተጠርቷል:: ለዚህም ምክንያቱ ለ30 ዓመታት ሳይነጣጠሉ አብረው በማደጋቸው: የጌታችን የሥጋ አያቱ የቅድስት ሐና የእህት ልጅ በመሆኑ: በዮሴፍ በኩልም የአንድ ቅድመ አያት ልጆች በመሆናቸው እና ጌታችን ከትህትናው የተነሳ ደቀ መዛሙርቱን ወንድሞች ይላቸው ስለ ነበር ነው:: ራሱ ቅዱስ ያዕቆብ ግን 'የጌታችን የኢየሱስ ክርስቶስ ባሪያ ነኝ' ብሎ በፈጣሪና በፍጡር መካከል ያለውን ልዩነት ገልጧል:: ቅዱስ ያዕቆብ ጌታችን ሲያስተምር ተከተለው: ከ72ቱ አርድእት ተቆጠረ: 3 ዓመት ከ3 ወር ወንጌልን ተማረ:: ለመጀመሪያ ጊዜ ከድንግል ማርያምና ከቅዱስ ዮሐንስ ጋር ሆኖ 'የጌታን ትንሳኤ ሳላይ እህል አልቀምስም' ብሎ ማክፈልን አስተማረ::

መንፈስ ቅዱስን ከተቀበለ በኋላ የኢየሩሳሌም የመጀመሪያው ሊቀ ጳጳስ ሆኖ አገለገለ:: በሐዋርያት ዘመን የተደረጉትን ሲኖዶሶች በሊቀ መንበርነት መራ:: ሙታንን በማስነሳት: ድውያንን በመፈወስ: አጋንንትን በማውጣት እጅግ ብዙ ተአምራትን ሠርቶ ብዙ አይሁዳውያንን ወደ ክርስትና መለሰ:: በመጨረሻ ዘመኑ ያላመኑ አይሁድ ወደ ቤቱ መጥተው 'የናዝሬቱ ኢየሱስ ማነው?' ብለው በጠየቁት ጊዜ ሐዋርያው ወደ ቤቱ ጣራ ወጥቶ 'ጌታችን ኢየሱስ ክርስቶስ አምላክ ወልደ አምላክ: ወልደ አብ ወልደ ማርያም: ሥግው ቃል እግዚአብሔር ነው፤ እኔም ፍጡሩና ባሪያው ነኝ' ብሎ መሰከረ:: አይሁድም በቁጣ ወደ መሬት ወርውረው ደበደቡት:: አንዱም በእንጨት ገንዳ ራሱን መትቶ ገደለው::
ቅዱስ ያዕቆብ በመላ ዘመኑ የሚያገድፍ ምግብ ሳይቀምስ: ጸጉሩን ሳይላጭ: ገላውን ሳይታጠብና ልብሱን ሳይቀይር በታላቅ ተጋድሎ ኖሯል:: ከጾምና ከጸሎት ብዛትም እግሮቹ እስኪያብጡ ድረስ ቆሞ ይጸልይ ስለ ነበር አበው 'ጻድቁ ሐዋርያ' ይሉታል::
በዚች ዕለት ደግሞ ቅዱስ ጢሞና ሐዋርያ ይታሰባል:: ቅዱሱ ሐዋርያ ቁጥሩ ከ72ቱ አርድእትና ከ7ቱ ዲያቆናት አንዱ ነው:: በጌታችን መዋዕለ ስብከት ሁለት ሁለት ሆነው ከተላኩት ደቀ መዛሙርት አንዱ እርሱ ነበር:: አጋንንት ተገዝተውለት: ድውያን ተፈውሰውለት ተመልሷል:: ጌታችንን እስከ ሕማሙ አገልግሏል::
በበዓለ ሃምሳ መንፈስ ቅዱስን ተቀብሎ ከቅዱስ እስጢፋኖስ ጋር በዲቁና አገልግሎት ተግቷል:: ከቅዱስ እስጢፋኖስ ሰማዕትነት በኋላም በዓለም ዞሮ ወንጌልን በመስበክ ብዙዎችን ካስተማረ በኋላ በዚህች ቀን በሰማዕትነት ዐርፏል::

en.verse: James, a servant of God and of the Lord Jesus Christ, to the twelve tribes which are scattered abroad, greeting. My brethren, count it all joy when ye fall into divers temptations; Knowing this, that the trying of your faith worketh patience. But let patience have her perfect work, that ye may be perfect and entire, wanting nothing.

am.verse: የእግዚአብሔርና የጌታ የኢየሱስ ክርስቶስ ባሪያ ያዕቆብ፤ ለተበተኑ ለአሥራ ሁለቱ ወገኖች፤ ሰላም ለእናንተ ይሁን። ወንድሞቼ ሆይ! የእምነታችሁ መፈተን ትዕግስትን እንዲያደርግላችሁ አውቃችሁ ልዩ ልዩ ፈተና ሲደርስባችሁ እንደ ሙሉ ደስታ ቁጠሩት። ትዕግስትም ምንም የሚጐድላችሁ ሳይኖር ፍጹማንና ምሉዓን ትሆኑ ዘንድ ሥራውን ይፈጽም።

title.en: Christ the Savior of the World, St. Macarius, Abuna Maba'a Tsiyon, and Abba Tsige Dingil
title.am: መድኃኔ ዓለም ክርስቶስ፣ ቅዱስ መቃርስ፣ አቡነ መብዓ ጽዮን እና አባ ጽጌ ድንግል

en: Our Lord Jesus Christ the Savior of the World
St. Macarius the Blessed (Bishop of Qaw)
Abuna Maba'a Tsiyon the Righteous
Abba Tsige Dingil of Weleqa
St. Macarius the Great (Father of Monks)
