St. Raphael the Archangel
St. Askenafer and His Family
The Thirteen Solitary Righteous Hermits (13 Gihusan)
St. Arsenius the Wise
The Ninety-Nine Heavenly Angelic Hosts

Abune Zer'a Buruk: A glorious Ethiopian righteous father born in Shewa, who shone like a celestial beacon. Dedicated to Christ from childhood, he prayed with tears, immersed himself in holy rivers during freezing winter nights, and subdued the flesh through ceaseless fasting. The Lord granted him profound covenants of mercy, assuring forgiveness to all who commemorate his name and call upon his intercession. He fell asleep in great sanctity on this day.

The Seven Holy Youths of Ephesus: Christian youths of noble Roman birth during the Decian persecution in the 3rd century who refused to sacrifice to idols. Fleeing to a cave outside Ephesus, they fell asleep in prayer. The emperor sealed the cave mouth with heavy stones. By divine providence, they slept undisturbed for 372 years, awakening in the reign of the Christian Emperor Theodosius the Younger without their bodies or garments aging, bearing indisputable witness to the bodily resurrection of the dead.
Abba Nekaro and St. Qaros: Holy monastic fathers who preserved rigorous desert solitude, praying ceaselessly for the peace of the Church and entering into celestial delight on this day.
The memory of Abune Zer'a Buruk and the Seven Sleepers strengthens the faith of believers in the eternal power of God over death and time.
am: ጻድቁ አቡነ ዘርዓ ቡሩክ፦ በሸዋ ምድር የተወለዱ: በታላቅ ተጋድሎና ቅድስና ያበሩ ታላቅ ኢትዮጵያዊ ጻድቅ ናቸው:: በበረዶና በውሃ ውስጥ ቆመው ሌሊቱን በሙሉ ሲጸልዩ: ሰውነታቸውን በጾም ሲቀጡ ኖረዋል:: እግዚአብሔር ስማቸውን ለሚጠራና መታሰቢያቸውን ለሚያደርግ ታላቅ የቃል ኪዳን በረከትን ሰጥቷቸዋል:: በዚህች ዕለት በክብር ዐርፈዋል::

ሰባቱ ደቂቅ ቅዱሳን ዘኤፌሶን፦ በ3ኛው መቶ ክፍለ ዘመን በከሀዲው ንጉሥ በዴቅዮስ ዘመን የነበሩ ወጣቶች ናቸው:: ጣዖት እንዳያመልኩ ወደ ዋሻ ሸሽተው ሳሉ ንጉሡ የዋሻውን በር በድንጋይ አስዘጋው:: እግዚአብሔር ድንቅ አድርጎ ለ372 ዓመታት አንቀላፍቷቸው:: በኦርቶዶክሳዊው ንጉሥ በቴዎዶስዮስ ዘመን ሲነቁ ልብሳቸውና መልካቸው ሳይለወጥ ተገኝቶ የሙታን ትንሣኤ እውነት መሆኑን መስክረዋል::
አባ ነካሮ እና ቅዱስ ቃሮስ፦ በበርሃ ተወስነው በጾምና በጸሎት እግዚአብሔርን ደስ ያሰኙ ቅዱሳን ገዳማውያን ናቸው::
የጻድቁ የአቡነ ዘርዓ ቡሩክ እና የሰባቱ ደቂቅ ጸሎት ከሁላችን ጋር ይሁን::

en.verse: Greet one another with a holy kiss. All the saints greet you. The grace of the Lord Jesus Christ, and the love of God, and the communion of the Holy Spirit be with you all. Amen.

am.verse: በተቀደሰ አሳሳም እርስ በርሳችሁ ሰላምታ ተሰጣጡ። ቅዱሳን ሁሉ ሰላምታ ያቀርቡላችኋል። የጌታ የኢየሱስ ክርስቶስ ጸጋ የእግዚአብሔርም ፍቅር የመንፈስ ቅዱስም ኅብረት ከሁላችሁ ጋር ይሁን። አሜን።

title.en: Abba Arkeledis the Hermit, Abune Aregawi, and St. Maximus the Elder
title.am: አባ አርከሌድስ ገዳማዊ፣ አቡነ አረጋዊ እና ቅዱስ መክሲሞስ አረጋዊ

en: Abba Arkeledis the Desert Solitary (Miraculous Hermit of Syria)
Abune Aregawi (Commemoration of His Great Spiritual Feast)
St. Maximus the Righteous Brother (Of Dabra Baramus / Scetis)
St. Cyriacus the Bishop
am: አባ አርከሌድስ ገዳማዊ (በሶርያ በረሃ በታላቅ ተጋድሎ የኖሩ ጻድቅ)
አቡነ አረጋዊ (ታላቁ ገዳማዊ የደብረ ዳሞ አባት)

en: Abba Aregawi the Great (Zemika'el)
St. Gebre Kristos the Bridegroom
St. Philip the Apostle
St. Stephen the Deacon

Abba Arkeledis the Hermit: A noble Roman youth who survived a devastating shipwreck when traveling across the sea. Witnessing human corpses washed up on the shore, he realized the vanity and transience of worldly ambition. Giving up all desires for high government office, he walked to Syria and received the monastic habit at Mount Romanos. Donating two hundred dinars of gold to the monastery, he enclosed himself in strict solitary seclusion, never looking at the face of any mortal, fasting continually, and working extraordinary miracles until his peaceful passing.

St. Maximus of Scetis: The elder son of the Roman Emperor Valentinian who renounced worldly palaces alongside his brother Domatius. Traveling to Syria and then to Scetis in Egypt, they became spiritual children of St. Macarius the Great. On Tir 14, St. Maximus departed peacefully to Christ, escorted by celestial choirs of angels and saints.

Abune Aregawi: The renowned leader of the Nine Saints who came to Axum and founded the famed cliff-top monastery of Debre Damo, climbing the rock with the aid of a divine serpent, remembered for his ascetic brilliance.
The remembrance of these fathers calls believers to detach from worldly vanity and seek eternal treasures in the Kingdom of God.
am: አባ አርከሌድስ ገዳማዊ፦ ከሮም መሳፍንት ወገን የሆነ ቅዱስ ሰው ነው:: ወደ ባሕር ተጉዞ ሳለ መርከቡ በማዕበል ተሰብሮ እርሱ ብቻ በስባሪ ተንጠልጥሎ ዳነ:: በዳርቻ የወደቁትን በድኖች ባየ ጊዜ የዚህን ዓለም ከንቱነት ተረድቶ ሹመት ፍለጋ መሄዱን ተወ:: ወደ ሶርያ ምድረ ገዳም ሄዶ በደብረ ሮማኖስ አመነኮሰ:: ለብዙ ዓመታት ከበዓቱ ሳይወጣ የሰውን ፊት ሳያይ በጾምና በጸሎት ኖረ:: ጥር 14 ቀን በሰላም ዐርፏል::
ቅዱስ መክሲሞስ ጻድቅ፦ የሮም ንጉሥ ልጅ ሲሆን ከወንድሙ ከዱማቴዎስ ጋር የንግሥናን ክብር ንቀው ወደ ግብጽ አስቄጥስ በረሃ ወረዱ:: በታላቁ አባ መቃርስ እጅ መንፈሳዊ ተጋድሎን ተምረው በቅድስና ኖሩ:: ጥር 14 ቀን ቅዱስ መክሲሞስ ሲያርፍ መላእክት በዝማሬ ወደ ሰማይ ወስደውታል::
አቡነ አረጋዊ፦ ከተስዓቱ ቅዱሳን አንዱና መሪያቸው: በደብረ ዳሞ ገዳም በዘንዶ ተጎትተው የወጡ ታላቁ ኢትዮጵያዊ አባት ሲሆኑ መታሰቢያቸው በክብር ይዘከራል::
የቅዱሳኑ በረከትና ረድኤት ከሁላችን ጋር ይሁን::

en.verse: For the Lord loves justice, and does not forsake His saints; they are preserved forever, but the descendants of the wicked shall be cut off.

am.verse: እግዚአብሔር ፍርድን ይወዳልና፥ ቅዱሳኑንም አይጥላቸውምና፤ ለዘላለምም ይጠበቃሉ፤ የኀጥኣን ዘር ግን ይጠፋል።

title.en: St. Cyricus and St. Julitta the Martyrs, and St. Obadiah the Prophet
title.am: ቅዱስ ቂርቆስ ወእሙ ኢየሉጣ እና ቅዱስ አብድዩ ነቢይ

en: St. Cyricus and St. Julitta (The Child Martyr and His Holy Mother)
St. Obadiah the Prophet (One of the Twelve Minor Prophets)
The 11,004 Holy Martyrs who suffered with St. Cyricus
St. Sophia and St. Admira the Righteous
am: ቅዱስ ቂርቆስ ወእሙ ቅድስት ኢየሉጣ (ሕፃኑ ሰማዕትና እናቱ)
ቅዱስ አብድዩ ነቢይ (ከ12ቱ ደቂቀ ነቢያት አንዱ)
11,004 ከቅዱስ ቂርቆስ ጋር የተሰዉ ቅዱሳን ሰማዕታት

en: St. Ephrem the Syrian
St. Minas the Faithful Soldier Martyr
St. Christina the Martyr
St. Enba Marina the Solitary Mother

St. Cyricus and St. Julitta: St. Julitta was a wealthy Christian noblewoman in Iconium. During the Diocletian persecution, she fled to Tarsus holding her three-year-old child Cyricus. When captured by Governor Alexander, Cyricus fearlessly spoke in the wisdom of the Holy Spirit, professing 'I am a Christian!' Alexander threw them into boiling cauldrons of pitch and lead, but the Archangel Gabriel descended and cooled the flames. Together with eleven thousand and four soldiers and witnesses who believed upon seeing the miracle, they were beheaded and inherited celestial crowns.

St. Obadiah the Prophet: A faithful servant of God in the royal court of King Ahab who hid one hundred prophets of the Lord in caves and fed them with bread and water during Jezebel's purge. The Lord granted him prophetic revelation concerning the judgment of Edom and the restoration of Zion, falling asleep in great peace.

The 11,004 Holy Martyrs: Moved by the courage of the child Cyricus and his miraculous deliverance from the flames, thousands openly proclaimed their faith in Jesus Christ, enduring martyrdom on this day.
The intercession of St. Cyricus, Julitta, and Obadiah shields the faithful against all spiritual assaults and physical perils.
am: ቅዱስ ቂርቆስ ወእሙ ቅድስት ኢየሉጣ፦ ቅድስት ኢየሉጣ በኢቆንዮን የምትኖር ባለጠጋና እግዚአብሔርን የምትፈራ ሴት ነበረች:: መከራ በመጣ ጊዜ የሦስት ዓመት ሕፃን ልጇን ቅዱስ ቂርቆስን ይዛ ወደ ጠርሴስ ሸሸች:: ጨካኙ ገዥ እስክንድሮስ ይዞ ክርስቶስን እንዲክዱ ሲያስገድዳቸው ሕፃኑ ቂርቆስ በመንፈስ ቅዱስ ተሞልቶ 'እኔ ክርስቲያን ነኝ' እያለ በድፍረት መሰከረ:: በሚፈላ የጋለ የናስ ጋን ውስጥ ቢጥሏቸውም ቅዱስ ገብርኤል ወርዶ እሳቱን አበረደላቸው:: በመጨረሻም አንገታቸውን በሰይፍ ተቆርጠው የሰማዕትነት አክሊል ተቀብለዋል::
ቅዱስ አብድዩ ነቢይ፦ በንጉሥ አክዓብ ቤት ሳለ ክፉዋ ኤልዛቤል የእግዚአብሔርን ነቢያት በፈጀች ጊዜ መቶ ነቢያትን በዋሻ ውስጥ ሰውሮ እንጀራና ውሃ የመገበ እግዚአብሔርን የሚፈራ ሰው ነበረ:: ስለ ኤዶምያስ ጥፋትና ስለ ጽዮን ድኅነት ትንቢት ተናግሮ በዚህች ዕለት በሰላም ዐርፏል::
11,004 ሰማዕታት፦ የሕፃኑን የቂርቆስን ተአምር አይተው በክርስቶስ ያመኑ አሥራ አንድ ሺህ አራት ሰዎች በአንድነት ሰማዕትነትን ተቀብለዋል::
የቅዱስ ቂርቆስ: የቅድስት ኢየሉጣና የነቢዩ አብድዩ ጸሎት ከሁላችን ጋር ይሁን::

en.verse: The pride of your heart has deceived you, you who dwell in the clefts of the rock, whose habitation is high; you who say in your heart, 'Who will bring me down to the ground?' Though you ascend as high as the eagle, and though you set your nest among the stars, from there I will bring you down, says the Lord.

am.verse: በተሰነጠቀ ዓለት ውስጥ የምትኖር፥ ማደሪያህንም ከፍ ከፍ ያደረግህ፥ በልብህም፦ ወደ ምድር የሚያወርደኝ ማን ነው? የምትል አንተ ሆይ፥ የልብህ ትዕቢት አታልሎሃል። እንደ ንስር ከፍ ብለህ ብትወጣ፥ ጎጆህም በከዋክብት መካከል ቢሆን፥ ከዚያ አወርድሃለሁ፥ ይላል እግዚአብሔር።

title.en: St. Philotheus the Youthful Martyr, Abba Daniel of Scetis, and Abba Palladius
title.am: ቅዱስ ፊላታዎስ ሕፃን ሰማዕት፣ አባ ዳንኤል ዘአስቄጥስ እና አባ ዸላድዮስ

en: St. Philotheus the Youthful Martyr (The Wonderworker who Spoke with the Sun and Defeated Idols)
Abba Daniel of Scetis (The Renowned Elder and Protector of Monks)
Abba Palladius the Ascetic Historian
St. John of Alexandria
am: ቅዱስ ፊላታዎስ ሕፃን ሰማዕት (ፀሐይን ያነጋገረና ጣዖታትን ድል የነሣ)
አባ ዳንኤል ዘአስቄጥስ (ታላቁ ገዳማዊና የባሕታውያን አባት)

en: Kidane Mehret (Our Lady Mary Covenant of Mercy)
The Righteous King Saint Kaleb
St. Elizabeth Mother of John the Baptist
St. Mary Magdalene

St. Philotheus the Youthful Martyr: Born to wealthy pagan parents in Antioch, young Philotheus began seeking the true Creator at the tender age of ten. Looking up at the sun, he asked: 'Are you the God who created me?' The sun answered by divine dispensation: 'I am not God, but a creature created to give light.' An angel appeared and taught Philotheus the Orthodox Christian faith. When persecution broke out, he converted his parents, smashed household idols, healed the sick, and refused Emperor Diocletian's demands. Enduring fire and wheels of torture unharmed, he was beheaded, ascending to Christ with celestial glory.

Abba Daniel of Scetis: The celebrated archimandrite of the desert of Scetis who guided thousands of hermits and redeemed despised sinners. He taught humility through hidden virtues and championed the truth of the Council of Ephesus, departing in great peace.
Abba Palladius: The holy ascetic writer who traversed the deserts of Egypt and Palestine, authoring the Paradise of the Fathers (Lausiac History) and preserving the holy lives of desert saints.
The remembrance of St. Philotheus inspires young and old to seek God with pure sincerity and stand firm for the truth without fear.
am: ቅዱስ ፊላታዎስ ሕፃን ሰማዕት፦ በአንጾኪያ ከአረማውያን ወላጆች የተወለደ ሲሆን በዐሥር ዓመቱ ፈጣሪውን ይመረምር ጀመር:: ፀሐይን 'አንተ ነህን የፈጠርከኝ?' ቢለው 'እኔ ፍጡር ነኝ እንጂ ፈጣሪ አይደለሁም' ሲል መለሰለት:: የእግዚአብሔር መልአክ ተገልጦ የክርስትናን እምነት አስተማረው:: ወላጆቹን ወደ ክርስትና መለሰ:: በዲዮቅልጥያኖስ ፊት በድፍረት ክርስቶስን መስክሮ በእሳትና በስለት ተሰቃይቶ አንገቱን ለሰይፍ ሰጥቶ በሰማዕትነት ዐርፏል::
አባ ዳንኤል ዘአስቄጥስ፦ በግብጽ አስቄጥስ በረሃ በታላቅ ትሕትናና ቅድስና የኖረ: በርካታ ኃጥአንን ወደ ንስሐ የመለሰ ታላቅ ገዳማዊ አባት ሲሆን መታሰቢያው በክብር ይዘከራል::
አባ ዸላድዮስ ገዳማዊ፦ የግብጽና የፍልስጤም ገዳማትን በመዞር የቅዱሳን አባቶችን ገድል የጻፈና በቅድስና ያረፈ አባት ነው::
የቅዱስ ፊላታዎስና የአበው ቅዱሳን ጸሎት ከሁላችን ጋር ይሁን::

en.verse: Assuredly, I say to you, unless you are converted and become as little children, you will by no means enter the kingdom of heaven. Therefore whoever humbles himself as this little child is the greatest in the kingdom of heaven.

am.verse: እውነት እላችኋለሁ፥ ካልተመለሳችሁ እንደ ሕፃናትም ካልሆናችሁ፥ ወደ መንግሥተ ሰማያት ከቶ አትገቡም። እንግዲህ እንደዚህ ሕፃን ራሱን የሚያዋርድ ሁሉ፥ በመንግሥተ ሰማያት የሚበልጥ እርሱ ነው።

title.en: Sts. Maximus and Domatius of Scetis, and St. James Bishop of Nisibis
title.am: ቅዱሳን መክሲሞስ ወዱማቴዎስ (ዘደብረ ብርስም) እና ቅዱስ ያዕቆብ ዘንሲቢን

en: Sts. Maximus and Domatius the Roman Princes and Ascetics (Founders of Deir al-Baramus)
St. James Bishop of Nisibis (The Great Wonderworker and Father of Nicaea)
St. Joseph the Scribe and Confessor
am: ቅዱሳን መክሲሞስ ወዱማቴዎስ (ልዑላነ ሮም: የደብረ ብርስም መሥራቾች)
ቅዱስ ያዕቆብ ዘንሲቢን ኤጲስ ቆጶስ (ባለታላቅ ተአምርና የኒቂያ አባት)

en: St. Stephen Archdeacon and Protomartyr
St. James the Apostle Brother of John
St. Epiphanius Bishop of Cyprus
Abba Gerima of the Nine Saints
am: ቅዱስ እስጢፋኖስ ሊቀ ዲያቆናት ወቀዳሜ ሰማዕት

en: Sts. Maximus and Domatius: The two sons of Emperor Valentinian of Rome who renounced royal succession to follow Christ into the desert. Guided by divine providence to Syria, they trained under Abba Agabius. After his death, they journeyed to Scetis in Egypt and sought out St. Macarius the Great. Macarius marveled at their royal gentleness and built them a small cell. Living in silence, weaving palm leaves, and praying without ceasing, they attained sublime sanctity. St. Maximus departed on Tir 14 and his younger brother Domatius on Tir 17. Macarius dedicated their cell as the famous Monastery of Baramus (the Mountain of the Roman Children).

St. James Bishop of Nisibis: A renowned ascetic bishop from Mesopotamia who attended the First Ecumenical Council of Nicaea in 325 A.D. Blessed with extraordinary miraculous powers, he prayed for the protection of Nisibis against Persian sieges, caused swarms of gnats to disperse enemy armies, and guided his flock in steadfast Orthodoxy.
The peaceful departure of Maximus and Domatius reminds every Christian that love for Christ surpasses all earthly kingdoms, crowns, and riches.
am: ቅዱሳን መክሲሞስ ወዱማቴዎስ፦ የሮም ንጉሥ የቫለንቲንያን ልጆች ሲሆኑ የዚህን ዓለም የንግሥና ክብር ንቀው ወደ ምድረ ሶርያ ገዳም ሄዱ:: በአባ አጋብዮስ እጅ መንፈሳዊ ትሩፋትን ከተማሩ በኋላ ወደ ግብጽ አስቄጥስ ወርደው በታላቁ አባ መቃርስ በዓት ሥር ተቀመጡ:: በአርምሞ: በጾምና በጸሎት ለዓመታት ተጋድለው በቅድስና ኖሩ:: ጥር 14 ቀን ቅዱስ መክሲሞስ: ጥር 17 ቀን ደግሞ ቅዱስ ዱማቴዎስ በሰላም ዐርፈዋል:: አባ መቃርስ በዓታቸውን 'ደብረ ብርስም (የሮማ ልጆች ደብር)' ብሎ ሠርቶላቸዋል::
ቅዱስ ያዕቆብ ዘንሲቢን፦ በኒቂያ ጉባኤ የተገኘ: ታላላቅ ተአምራትን ያደረገ ታላቅ የሶርያ ኤጲስ ቆጶስ ሲሆን በጸሎቱ የፋርስን ሠራዊት ድል ነሥቷል:: በዚህች ዕለት በክብር ይታሰባል::
የቅዱሳን መክሲሞስና ዱማቴዎስ: የቅዱስ ያዕቆብም ጸሎት ከሁላችን ጋር ይሁን::

en.verse: For a day in Your courts is better than a thousand. I would rather be a doorkeeper in the house of my God than dwell in the tents of wickedness.

am.verse: ከሺህ ዓመት ይልቅ በአደባባዮችህ አንዲት ቀን ትሻላለች፤ በኀጥኣን ድንኳኖች ከመቀመጥ ይልቅ፥ በእግዚአብሔር ቤት እጣል ዘንድ መረጥሁ።

title.en: St. George the Megalomartyr of Lydda, St. Bacchus the Martyr, and Holy Virgins Mary and Martha
title.am: ሊቀ ሰማዕታት ቅዱስ ጊዮርጊስ ዘልዳ፣ ቅዱስ ባኮስ ሰማዕት እና ቅዱሳት ማርያ ወማርታ

en: St. George the Megalomartyr of Lydda (Commemoration of His Sufferings and Divine Consolations)
St. Bacchus the Illustrious Martyr (Companion of St. Sergius)
St. James the Apostle (Son of Alphaeus)
Holy Virgins Mary and Martha of Bethany (Sisters of Lazarus)
am: ሊቀ ሰማዕታት ቅዱስ ጊዮርጊስ ዘልዳ (የተጋድሎውና የጽናቱ መታሰቢያ)
ቅዱስ ባኮስ ክቡር ሰማዕት (የቅዱስ ሰርጊስ ባልንጀራ)
ቅዱሳት ደናግል ማርያ ወማርታ ዘቢታንያ (አኃቲሁ ለአልዓዛር)

en: St. Philip the Apostle
St. Titus the Apostle
Abba Eustathius the Ethiopian
St. Justin the Martyr

St. George the Megalomartyr of Lydda: The Commander of Martyrs who endured seven continuous years of unimaginable tortures under seventy pagan kings. Driven by intense love for Christ, he refused royal honors, gave away his inherited wealth to the destitute, and confessed Jesus Christ with fearless courage. Three times he died of torture and three times the Lord raised him to life, until he finally received the crown of martyrdom in Lydda, becoming the swift protector and deliverer of all who call upon his name.

St. Bacchus the Martyr: A noble Roman officer who refused to sacrifice to idols alongside St. Sergius. Stripped of his military belt, clad in women's garb to mock him, and beaten severely with raw thongs, he yielded his soul to God and received an incorruptible celestial crown.

Holy Sisters Mary and Martha: Blessed sisters of Lazarus in Bethany who welcomed Christ into their home. Mary sat at Jesus' feet listening to His sacred words, chose the good part which shall not be taken away, and anointed His feet with costly spikenard before His burial.
The celebration of St. George, St. Bacchus, Mary, and Martha reminds the faithful that enduring love for Christ overcomes all persecutions and crowns the soul with everlasting life.
am: ሊቀ ሰማዕታት ቅዱስ ጊዮርጊስ ዘልዳ፦ የሰማዕታት አለቃና ሞገሳቸው የሆነው ቅዱስ ጊዮርጊስ ለ7 ዓመታት በ70 ከሀድያን ነገሥታት ፊት መከራን የተቀበለ ታላቅ ሰማዕት ነው:: ሦስት ጊዜ በሰማዕትነት ቢሞትም ጌታችን ከሞት እያስነሳው ለክርስቶስ ስም መሰከረ:: ክብሩንና ሀብቱን ለድሆች በትኖ በመጨረሻ አንገቱን ለሰይፍ ሰጥቶ የማይጠፋውን አክሊል ተቀብሏል::
ቅዱስ ባኮስ ሰማዕት፦ ከቅዱስ ሰርጊስ ጋር በሮም ሠራዊት ውስጥ በክብር ያገለገለ: ጣዖት እንዳያመልክ እምነቱን ጠብቆ በጽኑ ግርፋት ሰማዕትነቱን የፈጸመ ክቡር ሰማዕት ነው::
ቅዱሳት ማርያ ወማርታ፦ ጌታችንን በቤታቸው ያስተናገዱ የአልዓዛር እህቶች ናቸው:: ማርያም በጌታችን እግር ሥር ተቀምጣ ቃሉን ስትሰማ መልካሙን ዕድል መረጠች:: ጌታችን ከመሰቀሉ አስቀድሞ ዋጋው እጅግ ውድ የሆነውን የናርዶስ ሽቱ በእግሩ ላይ ያፈሰሰች እርሷ ናት::
የሊቀ ሰማዕታት የቅዱስ ጊዮርጊስ: የቅዱስ ባኮስና የቅዱሳት ማርያ ወማርታ ጸሎት ከሁላችን ጋር ይሁን::

en.verse: Then Mary took a pound of very costly oil of spikenard, anointed the feet of Jesus, and wiped His feet with her hair. And the house was filled with the fragrance of the oil.

am.verse: ማርያምም ዋጋው እጅግ የከበረ የንጹሕ ናርዶስ ሽቱ ንጥር ወስዳ የኢየሱስን እግር ቀባች፥ በጠጉርዋም እግሩን አበሰች፤ ቤቱም ከሽቱው መዓዛ ሞላ።

title.en: Abune Yafqerene Egzi'e the Righteous of Guguben
title.am: ጻድቁ አቡነ ያፍቅረነ እግዚእ ዘጉጉቤን

en: Abune Yafqerene Egzi'e the Ethiopian Righteous Father (Founder of Guguben Monastery)
St. Timothy the Monk
St. Thecla the Martyr
am: ጻድቁ አቡነ ያፍቅረነ እግዚእ ዘጉጉቤን (የጉጉቤን ገዳም መሥራች)

en: St. Gabriel the Archangel
St. John of Burullus (Bishop)
Abune Sine Eyesus the Righteous

Abune Yafqerene Egzi'e: An illustrious Ethiopian ascetic father who flourished in the 14th century, establishing the holy monastery of Guguben in Gojjam / Begemder. From his youth, he lived in intense spiritual warfare, praying throughout freezing nights immersed in cold streams, and subsisting on herbs and seeds. The Lord bestowed upon him abundant gifts of prophecy and divine healing, casting out unclean spirits and raising the sick through his prayers. After a long life crowned with virtuous deeds, he departed peacefully to Christ on Tir 19.
St. Timothy and St. Thecla: Holy monastic and martyr witnesses who dedicated their lives wholeheartedly to Christ, crowned with everlasting remembrance on this day.
The holy memory of Abune Yafqerene Egzi'e stands as an enduring inspiration for perseverance in ascetic disciplines, prayer, and trust in divine mercy.
am: ጻድቁ አቡነ ያፍቅረነ እግዚእ ዘጉጉቤን፦ በ14ኛው መቶ ክፍለ ዘመን በኢትዮጵያ ምድር ያበሩ: ታላቁን የጉጉቤን ገዳም የመሠረቱ ታላቅ ጻድቅ አባት ናቸው:: ገና በወጣትነታቸው ዓለምን ንቀው በጾምና በጸሎት ተወስነዋል:: በውሃ ውስጥ ቆመው በመጸለይ: ሥጋቸውን በረኃብና በጥም በመቅጣት ለእግዚአብሔር ተገዝተዋል:: እግዚአብሔርም የፈውስና የትንቢት ጸጋ ሰጥቷቸው በርካታ ድንቆችን አድርገው ጥር 19 ቀን በክብር ዐርፈዋል::
ቅዱስ ጢሞቴዎስ እና ቅድስት ቴክላ፦ ስለ ክርስቶስ ስም ቅድስናን ጠብቀው በጽናት የኖሩ ቅዱሳን ናቸው::
የጻድቁ የአቡነ ያፍቅረነ እግዚእ ጸሎትና በረከት ከሁላችን ጋር ይሁን::

en.verse: The righteous shall flourish like a palm tree, he shall grow like a cedar in Lebanon. Those who are planted in the house of the Lord shall flourish in the courts of our God. They shall still bear fruit in old age; they shall be fresh and flourishing.

am.verse: ጻድቅ እንደ ዘንባባ ያፈራል፥ እንደ ሊባኖስ ዝግባም ያድጋል። በእግዚአብሔር ቤት ውስጥ ተተክለዋል፥ በአምላካችንም አደባባይ ውስጥ ይበቅላሉ። ያን ጊዜ በለመለመ ሽምግልና ያፈራሉ፥ ደልበውም ይኖራሉ።

title.en: St. John of the Golden Gospel (Yochanan Wangelu Zeworq) and St. Aclog the Priest
title.am: ቅዱስ ዮሐንስ ወንጌሉ ዘወርቅ እና ቅዱሳን አክሎግ ቀሲስ ወመርምሕናም

en: St. John of the Golden Gospel (The Ascetic Roman Prince who Dwelt as a Beggar at His Father's Gate)
St. Aclog the Priest and Martyr
St. Marmhenam the Martyr
am: ቅዱስ ዮሐንስ ወንጌሉ ዘወርቅ (የወርቅ ወንጌል ባለቤት: በአባቱ ደጅ በድህነት የኖረ ልዑል)

en: Holy Theotokos (Hennaze Maryam - Building of the First Church of the Virgin)
St. John Chrysostom
St. Thaddaeus the Apostle

St. John of the Golden Gospel: Born of wealthy Roman nobility, his father gifted him a magnificent handwritten Gospel decorated with gold. Moved by Christ's call to perfection, he secretly left his home and boarded a ship to a monastery. Desiring perfect detachment from self, he returned years later clothed in rags as an unrecognized beggar, dwelling in a tiny hut outside his father's palace gate for seven years, receiving crumbs from his parents' table without ever revealing his identity. When his death drew near, he sent his Golden Gospel to his mother, who wept with joy and awe at his extraordinary humility. He rested in the Lord on Tir 20.
St. Aclog the Priest and St. Marmhenam: Valiant martyrs who bore witness to the Lord Jesus Christ during Persian and Roman persecutions, joyfully accepting martyrdom for the eternal Kingdom.
The sublime life of St. John teaches total renunciation of worldly pride, supreme humility, and radiant spiritual victory through Christ.
am: ቅዱስ ዮሐንስ ወንጌሉ ዘወርቅ፦ በሮም ከተማ ከባለጸጎች የተወለደ: አባቱ በወርቅ የተጻፈ ውድ ወንጌል የሸለመው ቅዱስ ሰው ነበረ:: ዓለምን ንቆ ወደ ገዳም ገባ:: ፍጹም ትሕትናን ሊያሳይ ፈልጎ ከዓመታት በኋላ እንደ ለማኝ ሆኖ ተመልሶ በአባቱ ደጅ ላይ በትንሽ ጎጆ ውስጥ ለ7 ዓመታት ተቀመጠ:: እናትና አባቱ እርሱ መሆኑን ሳያውቁ ከማዕዳቸው ፍርፋሪ ይሰጡት ነበር:: የዕረፍቱ ጊዜ ሲደርስ የወርቅ ወንጌሉን ለእናቱ ልኮ እርሱ መሆኑን አሳወቀ:: በታላቅ ቅድስና ጥር 20 ቀን ዐርፏል::
ቅዱሳን አክሎግ ቀሲስና መርምሕናም፦ ስለ ክርስቶስ ስም ደማቸውን ያፈሰሱ: ሃይማኖታቸውን በጽናት የጠበቁ ክቡራን ሰማዕታት ናቸው::
የቅዱስ ዮሐንስ ወንጌሉ ዘወርቅ እና የቅዱሳኑ ሁሉ ጸሎት ከሁላችን ጋር ይሁን::

en.verse: And everyone who has left houses or brothers or sisters or father or mother or wife or children or lands, for My name's sake, shall receive a hundredfold, and inherit eternal life.

am.verse: ስለ ስሜም ቤቶችን ወይም ወንድሞችን ወይም እኅቶችን ወይም አባትን ወይም እናትን ወይም ሚስትን ወይም ልጆችን ወይም እርሻን የተወ ሁሉ መቶ እጥፍ ይቀበላል የዘላለምንም ሕይወት ይወርሳል።

title.en: Aster'eyo Maryam (Dormition / Departure of our Lady the Virgin Mary) and St. Hilaria
title.am: አስተርእዮ ማርያም (ዕረፍተ እግዝእትነ ማርያም ድንግል ወላዲተ አምላክ) እና ቅድስት ኢላርያ

en: Aster'eyo Maryam (The Falling Asleep / Dormition of our Holy Lady Mary the Mother of God)
St. Hilaria the Solitary Ascetic (Daughter of Emperor Zeno who lived in Scetis as 'Father Hilarion')
St. Gregory the Bishop
St. Paul the Syrian
am: አስተርእዮ ማርያም (ዕረፍተ እመቤታችን ቅድስት ድንግል ማርያም ወላዲተ አምላክ)
ቅድስት ኢላርያ ገዳማዊት (የንጉሥ ዜኖን ልጅ: በወንድ አምሳል በአስቄጥስ የተጋደለች)

en: Our Lady Mary the Holy Theotokos
St. Cyprian the Martyr
St. Justa the Righteous
The Twelve Apostles

Aster'eyo Maryam (The Dormition of the Mother of God): On this sacred day, at sixty-four years of age, our spotless Lady Mary, the Mother of God, completed her earthly pilgrimage. The Holy Apostles were gathered miraculously upon clouds from the ends of the earth to Jerusalem. The Lord Jesus Christ descended with thousands of angels, receiving her pure soul into His divine hands amidst sweet celestial hymns. Her sacred body was carried by the Apostles toward Gethsemane, protected by divine clouds from Jewish adversaries, preparing for her subsequent glorious Assumption (Filseta).

St. Hilaria the Ascetic: Eldest daughter of Byzantine Emperor Zeno who abandoned the royal court, cut her hair, wore men's monastic attire, and entered the desert of Scetis under Abba Bamun. For many years she struggled as 'Abba Hilarion,' practicing silence, prayer, and austere fasting, her royal identity revealed only upon her holy death on Tir 21.
St. Gregory and St. Paul: Venerated shepherds and ascetics who guarded Orthodox dogma and monastic excellence.
The festival of Aster'eyo Maryam brings transcendent joy and profound comfort to the Church, glorifying the Ark of the New Covenant who stands eternally at the King's right hand.
am: አስተርእዮ ማርያም (ዕረፍተ እመቤታችን)፦ እመቤታችን ቅድስት ድንግል ማርያም በ64 ዓመቷ በዚህች ዕለት በክብር ዐረፈች:: ቅዱሳን ሐዋርያት ከየአህጉሩ በደመና ተጭነው በኢየሩሳሌም ተሰበሰቡ:: ጌታችን መድኃኒታችን ኢየሱስ ክርስቶስ ከአእላፋት መላእክት ጋር ወርዶ ንጽሕት ነፍሷን በእጁ ተቀበለ:: ቅዱሳን ሐዋርያት ሥጋዋን ሊቀብሩ ወደ ጌቴሴማኒ ሲወስዱ አይሁድ ሊያቃጥሉ ቢሞክሩም እግዚአብሔር በደመና ሰውሯታል::
ቅድስት ኢላርያ ገዳማዊት፦ የንጉሥ ዜኖን ልጅ ስትሆን የዓለምን ክብር ንቃ በወንድ አምሳል 'አባ ሂላሪዮን' ተብላ በአስቄጥስ በረሃ በታላቅ ተጋድሎ ኖረች:: ማንነቷ ሳይታወቅ በጾምና በጸሎት ኖራ ጥር 21 ቀን በክብር ዐርፋለች::
ቅዱስ ጐርጐርዮስ እና ቅዱስ ዻውሎስ፦ ቤተ ክርስቲያንን በቅንነት ያገለገሉ ቅዱሳን አባቶች ናቸው::
የእመቤታችን የቅድስት ድንግል ማርያም አማላጅነትና በረከት ከሁላችን ጋር ይሁን::

en.verse: Let us go into His tabernacle; let us worship at His footstool. Arise, O Lord, to Your resting place, You and the ark of Your strength.

am.verse: ወደ ማደሪያዎቹ እንገባለን፥ በእግሮቹ መረገጫ እንሰግዳለን። አቤቱ፥ ወደ ዕረፍትህ ተነሥ፥ አንተና የመቅደስህ ታቦት።

title.en: St. Anthony the Great (Star of the Desert) and St. Uriel the Archangel
title.am: ኮከበ ገዳም አባ እንጦንስ እና ቅዱስ ዑራኤል ሊቀ መላእክት

en: St. Anthony the Great (The Father of Christian Monasticism, Star of the Desert)
St. Uriel the Archangel (Feast of His Guidance of the Holy Family in Ethiopia)
St. Timothy the Hermit
Abba Paul of Thebes
am: ታላቁ ኮከበ ገዳም አባ እንጦንስ (አበ መነኮሳት: የገዳማዊ ሕይወት መሥራች)
ቅዱስ ዑራኤል ሊቀ መላእክት (እመቤታችንን በስደቷ ወደ ኢትዮጵያ የመራት)

en: St. Uriel the Archangel
St. Luke the Evangelist
St. George the Martyr
Abba Anthony the Great

St. Anthony the Great: Born in Upper Egypt, Anthony entered church one day and heard the Gospel verse: 'If you want to be perfect, go, sell what you have and give to the poor, and you will have treasure in heaven; and come, follow Me.' Giving all his possessions to the poor, he entered the deep desert and inaugurated Christian monasticism. He endured decades of severe demonic warfare, overcoming spiritual enemies through prayer, the Sign of the Cross, and unwavering faith. Emperors sought his counsel and thousands flocked to his wisdom. At 105 years of age, he departed in peace on Tir 22.

St. Uriel the Archangel: The radiant angel who guided our Lady Mary and the infant Christ during their holy exile into Ethiopia, carrying them across the land and establishing Ethiopian holy sites as divine inheritance.
St. Timothy and Abba Paul: Blessed anchorites who dedicated their solitary lives to unceasing prayer in desert caves.
The memory of St. Anthony and St. Uriel inspires every Christian to spiritual vigilance, fervent prayer, and total surrender to the will of God.
am: ታላቁ ኮከበ ገዳም አባ እንጦንስ፦ በግብጽ ምድር የተወለደ: የገዳማዊ ሕይወት መሥራችና አባት ነው:: በወጣትነቱ በቤተ መቅደስ 'ፍጹም ልትሆን ብትወድ ያለህን ሁሉ ሸጠህ ለድሆች ስጥ: በሰማይም መዝገብ ታገኛለህ: መጥተህም ተከተለኝ' የሚለውን የወንጌል ቃል ሰምቶ ሀብቱን ለድሆች አካፍሎ ወደ በረሃ ወጣ:: ከአጋንንት ጋር ለዓመታት ተጋድሎ ድል ነሣ:: በ105 ዓመቱ ጥር 22 ቀን በሰላም ዐርፏል::
ቅዱስ ዑራኤል ሊቀ መላእክት፦ እመቤታችን ቅድስት ድንግል ማርያም ከልጇ ጋር በተሰደደች ጊዜ በክንፉ ተሸክሞ ወደ ኢትዮጵያ ምድር የመራትና አሥራት እንድትቀበል ያደረገ ታላቅ መልአክ ነው::
ቅዱስ ጢሞቴዎስ እና አባ ዻውሊ፦ በበርሃ ተወስነው በጾምና በጸሎት ያበሩ ቅዱሳን አባቶች ናቸው::
የአባ እንጦንስና የቅዱስ ዑራኤል ጸሎትና ረድኤት ከሁላችን ጋር ይሁን::

en.verse: Then Jesus said to His disciples, 'If anyone desires to come after Me, let him deny himself, and take up his cross, and follow Me.'

am.verse: በዚያን ጊዜ ኢየሱስ ለደቀ መዛሙርቱ እንዲህ አለ፦ እኔን መከተል የሚወድ ቢኖር፥ ራሱን ይካድ መስቀሉንም ተሸክሞ ይከተለኝ።

title.en: St. Timothy the Apostle (Bishop of Ephesus) and the Righteous Emperor Theodosius
title.am: ቅዱስ ጢሞቴዎስ ሐዋርያ (ኤጲስ ቆጶስ ዘኤፌሶን) እና ጻድቁ ንጉሥ ቴዎዶስዮስ

en: St. Timothy the Apostle and Bishop of Ephesus (Beloved Spiritual Son of St. Paul)
St. Theodosius the Righteous Emperor (Defender of the Orthodox Faith)
St. Philip the Martyr
am: ቅዱስ ጢሞቴዎስ ሐዋርያ (ኤጲስ ቆጶስ ዘኤፌሶን: የቅዱስ ጳውሎስ መንፈሳዊ ልጅ)

en: St. George the Megalomartyr
Abba Longinus the Hermit
St. Marina the Martyr

St. Timothy the Apostle: Born in Lystra to a Greek father and Jewish mother Eunice, Timothy embraced Christ from youth. St. Paul chose him as his beloved traveling companion, fellow laborer, and first Bishop of Ephesus, writing two canonical pastoral epistles to him. Timothy shepherded the Church in Ephesus with apostolic zeal. When pagan idolaters staged an immoral festival, Timothy courageously denounced their abominations; they dragged him through the streets and beat him with clubs until he received the martyr's crown.

Theodosius the Righteous Emperor: The devout Christian ruler who convened the Second Ecumenical Council of Constantinople in 381 A.D., confirming the divinity of the Holy Spirit and suppressing pagan temples across the empire. He ruled with justice, humility, and fear of God, falling asleep in holiness on this day.
St. Philip the Martyr: Remembered for his unwavering confession of Christ before pagan governors, accepting death rather than apostasy.
The commemoration of St. Timothy and Emperor Theodosius calls the faithful to hold fast to the sound doctrine handed down by the apostles and to lead a life of steadfast integrity.
am: ቅዱስ ጢሞቴዎስ ሐዋርያ፦ በልስጥራ ከተማ የተወለደ: የቅዱስ ጳውሎስ የልብ ወዳጅና መንፈሳዊ ልጁ የነበረ ታላቅ ሐዋርያ ነው:: ቅዱስ ጳውሎስ ሁለት መልእክታትን የጻፈለት እርሱ ሲሆን በኤፌሶን የመጀመሪያው ኤጲስ ቆጶስ ሆኖ ተሹሟል:: አረማውያን በጣዖት በዓላቸው ሲዘፍኑ በድፍረት ገሥጾአቸው በዱላና በድንጋይ ደብድበው ሰማዕትነቱን ፈጽሟል::
ጻድቁ ንጉሥ ቴዎዶስዮስ፦ በ381 ዓ/ም 150ው ሊቃውንት የተሰበሰቡበትን ሁለተኛውን የቁስጥንጥንያ ጉባኤ የጠራ: የቀናች ሃይማኖትን ያጸና እግዚአብሔርን የሚፈራ ንጉሥ ሲሆን በዚህች ዕለት በሰላም ዐርፏል::
ቅዱስ ፊልጶስ ሰማዕት፦ ስለ ክርስቶስ ስም መከራን የተቀበለ ክቡር ሰማዕት ነው::
የቅዱስ ጢሞቴዎስና የጻድቁ ንጉሥ የቴዎዶስዮስ ጸሎት ከሁላችን ጋር ይሁን::

en.verse: Paul, an apostle of Jesus Christ, by the commandment of God our Savior and the Lord Jesus Christ, our hope, to Timothy, a true son in the faith: Grace, mercy, and peace from God our Father and Jesus Christ our Lord.

am.verse: የመድኃኒታችን የእግዚአብሔርና የተስፋችን የጌታ የኢየሱስ ክርስቶስ ትእዛዝ እንደ ተሰጠው ሐዋርያ እንደ ጳውሎስ፥ በእምነት እውነተኛ ልጄ ለሆነ ለጢሞቴዎስ፤ ከእግዚአብሔር ከአባታችን ከክርስቶስ ኢየሱስም ከጌታችን ጸጋና ምሕረት ሰላምም ይሁን።

title.en: Abune Tekle Haymanot the Righteous and St. Bifu the Martyr
title.am: አቡነ ተክለ ሃይማኖት ጻድቅ እና ቅዱስ ቢፉ ሰማዕት

en: Abune Tekle Haymanot (Commemoration of His Birth, Consecration, and Miracles)
St. Bifu the Martyr
Abba Abraham the Abbot
am: አቡነ ተክለ ሃይማኖት ጻድቅ (የተፀነሱበት: የተወለዱበትና የተአምራቸው በዓል)

en: Abune Tekle Haymanot (Sun of Shoa, Pillar of Debre Libanos)
St. Thomas the Apostle
St. John the Baptist

Abune Tekle Haymanot: The peerless Ethiopian ascetic, reformer, and apostle who was born in Zorare (Bulga, Shewa) to Tsaga Ze'ab and Sarah. Endowed with the Holy Spirit from the womb, he destroyed pagan groves, brought thousands of non-believers to baptism across Damot and Amhara, and established the illustrious monastic see of Debre Libanos. He stood in intense prayer on one leg for twenty-two years until his leg broke off, receiving six wings of light from the Holy Trinity and a magnificent covenant for all who honor his holy name. Today his feast is commemorated with sublime jubilation across Ethiopia.
St. Bifu the Martyr: A courageous witness who stood before persecutors, confessing Christ without fear and receiving the martyr's crown.
Abba Abraham the Abbot: A wise and pastoral superior who governed his monastic brotherhood with gentleness, prayer, and fidelity to apostolic tradition.
The prayers of Abune Tekle Haymanot and St. Bifu bring peace, healing, and spiritual joy to the whole nation.
am: አቡነ ተክለ ሃይማኖት ጻድቅ፦ በሸዋ ምድር በዞራሬ ከጸጋ ዘአብና ከእግዚእ ኃረያ የተወለዱ: ገና በሕፃንነታቸው በመንፈስ ቅዱስ የተሞሉ ታላቅ ሐዋርያ ናቸው:: ጣዖታትን አፍርሰው በዳሞት: በወላይታ: በሸዋና በአማራ አህጉር በርካቶችን አጥምቀዋል:: ታላቁን የደብረ ሊባኖስ ገዳም መሥርተዋል:: በአንድ እግራቸው ለ22 ዓመታት ቆመው ሲጸልዩ እግራቸው ተሰብሮ ወድቆ ስድስት የብርሃን ክንፍ ተሰጥቷቸዋል:: በዚህች ዕለት በዓላቸው በታላቅ ድምቀት ይከበራል::
ቅዱስ ቢፉ ሰማዕት፦ ስለ እውነተኛይቱ ሃይማኖት ደሙን ያፈሰሰ ክቡር ሰማዕት ነው::
አባ አብርሃም መጋቢ፦ ገዳማውያንን በፍቅርና በትሕትና የመራ ቅዱስ አባት ነው::
የአባታችን የአቡነ ተክለ ሃይማኖት ምልጃና በረከት ከሁላችን ጋር ይሁን::

en.verse: I have found My servant David; with My holy oil I have anointed him, with whom My hand shall be established; also My arm shall strengthen him. But My faithfulness and My mercy shall be with him, and in My name his horn shall be exalted.

am.verse: ባሪያዬን ዳዊትን አገኘሁት፥ በቅዱስ ዘይቴም ቀባሁት። እጄም ትረዳዋለች፥ ክንዴም ታጸናዋለች። እውነቴና ምሕረቴም ከእርሱ ጋር ናቸው፥ በስሜም ቀንዱ ከፍ ከፍ ይላል።

title.en: St. Mercurius the Two-Sworded Martyr (Philopater) and St. John the Monk
title.am: ቅዱስ መርቆሬዎስ ፒሉፓዴር (ባለ ሁለት ሰይፍ) እና ቅዱስ ዮሐንስ ገዳማዊ

en: St. Mercurius (Philopater - Commemoration of His Miraculous Victory and Apparition)
St. John the Ascetic of the Egyptian Desert
St. Peter the Deacon
am: ቅዱስ መርቆሬዎስ ፒሉፓዴር (ባለ ሁለት ሰይፍ: የተአምሩና የድሉ መታሰቢያ)

en: St. Mercurius the Martyr
St. James the Apostle
St. Abanob the Child Martyr

St. Mercurius (Philopater): Born in Rome to Christian parents, Mercurius rose to become a formidable military commander. During a desperate battle against barbarian invaders, the Archangel Michael appeared to him, handing him a luminous sword of heavenly fire. Victorious over all foes, Mercurius confessed Christ before the pagan emperor Decius, casting down his military belt. He endured relentless beatings, fire, and scourging before being crowned with martyrdom in Cappadocia. Later, through miraculous apparition, he pierced Julian the Apostate on the battlefield, saving the Church from pagan suppression.
St. John the Ascetic: A humble solitary monk who lived decades in deep contemplation, prayer, and silence in the desert, entering into eternal glory.
St. Peter the Deacon: A devout minister of the sanctuary who faithfully served Christ's altar and entered into heavenly rest.
The glorious commemoration of St. Mercurius provides great courage, hope, and divine protection to all believers facing persecution and adversity.
am: ቅዱስ መርቆሬዎስ ፒሉፓዴር፦ በሮም የተወለደ: በጦር ሜዳ ጀግና የነበረ ክቡር ሰማዕት ነው:: ከጠላቶች ጋር ሲዋጋ ቅዱስ ሚካኤል ተገልጦ ከሰማይ የተላከ የብርሃን ሰይፍ ሰጠው:: ጠላቶቹን ድል ነሥቶ በክርስቶስ ስም በድፍረት መሰከረ:: ከሀዲው ዴቅዮስ ጣዖት እንዲያመልክ ቢያስገድደው የጦር መሣሪያውንና የክብር ቀበቶውን በፊቱ ጣለ:: በጽኑ መከራ አልፎ አንገቱን ለሰይፍ ሰጥቷል:: በኋላም ከሀዲው ዑልያኖስ ክርስቲያኖችን ሊያጠፋ ሲነሳ በጦር ሜዳ ወግቶ ገድሎታል::
ቅዱስ ዮሐንስ ገዳማዊ፦ በግብጽ በረሃ በታላቅ ተጋድሎና ጸሎት የኖረ ጻድቅ አባት ነው::
ቅዱስ ጴጥሮስ ዲያቆን፦ መቅደሱን በቅድስና ያገለገለ ቅዱስ ዲያቆን ነው::
የቅዱስ መርቆሬዎስ ጸሎትና ረድኤት ከሁላችን ጋር ይሁን::

en.verse: Others were tortured, not accepting deliverance, that they might obtain a better resurrection. Still others had trial of mockings and scourgings, yes, and of chains and imprisonment. They were stoned, they were sawn in two, were tempted, were slain with the sword.

am.verse: ሌሎችም መዳንን ሳይቀበሉ የሚበልጠውን ትንሣኤ እንዲያገኙ እስከ ሞት ድረስ ተደበደቡ፤ ሌሎችም መዘበቻ በመሆንና በመገረፍ፥ ከዚህም በላይ በእስራትና በወኅኒ ተፈተኑ፤ በድንጋይ ተወግረው ሞቱ፥ ተፈተኑ፥ በመጋዝ ተሰነጠቁ፥ በሰይፍ ተገድለው ሞቱ።

title.en: The Forty-Nine Holy Martyrs of Scetis and St. Thomas the Hermit
title.am: አርባ ዘጠኙ አረጋውያን ሰማዕታት ዘአስቄጥስ እና ቅዱስ ቶማስ ገዳማዊ

en: The Forty-Nine Holy Elders and Martyrs of Scetis (Slain by Berbers for Refusing to Flee)
St. Thomas the Desert Solitary
St. Luke the Confessor
am: አርባ ዘጠኙ አረጋውያን ሰማዕታት ዘአስቄጥስ (በበርበር አረማውያን የተሰዉ ገዳማውያን)

en: St. Thomas the Apostle
St. Timothy the Apostle
Abba Bishoy the Ascetic

The Forty-Nine Holy Elders of Scetis: In the 5th century, a violent raid of desert Berber barbarians descended upon the holy monastery of Scetis. The abbot, St. John Hegumen of Scetis, stood before the brethren and said: 'Behold, the barbarians come! Whoever wishes to be saved, let him flee.' The forty-eight elder monks replied: 'We will not flee, but will die with you for Christ's name.' When the raiders breached the gate, they found the holy fathers praying peacefully in the sanctuary and slaughtered all forty-nine of them with swords. An imperial courier hidden in a tower saw forty-nine crowns of light descending, stepped forward, and joined them in martyrdom.
St. Thomas the Hermit: A faithful anchorite who attained spiritual perfection in desert caves through prayer, entering into eternal joy.
St. Luke the Confessor: Commemorated on this day for his unwavering preservation of the Orthodox Christian faith.
The sacrifice of the Forty-Nine Elders teaches Christians fearless devotion to Christ, fidelity to holy monastic life, and readiness to yield life for the eternal Kingdom.
am: አርባ ዘጠኙ አረጋውያን ሰማዕታት ዘአስቄጥስ፦ በ5ኛው መቶ ክፍለ ዘመን አረማውያን የበርበር ወራሪዎች ወደ አስቄጥስ ገዳም በመጡ ጊዜ የአስቄጥስ መሪ አባ ዮሐንስ መነኮሳቱን ጠርቶ 'ማምለጥ የሚፈልግ ይሽሽ' አላቸው:: አርባ ስምንቱ አረጋውያን ግን 'ከአንተ ጋር ስለ ክርስቶስ ስም እንሞታለን እንጂ አንሸሽም' ብለው በመቅደስ ቆመው ጸለዩ:: ወራሪዎቹ መጥተው 49ኙንም አረጋውያን በሰይፍ ጨፈጨፏቸው:: በዛፍ ላይ ተደብቆ የነበረ አንድ የንጉሥ መልእክተኛ 49 የብርሃን አክሊላት ሲወርዱ አይቶ እርሱም ወጥቶ ከእነርሱ ጋር ሰማዕት ሆነ::
ቅዱስ ቶማስ ገዳማዊ፦ በበርሃ ተወስኖ በቅድስና ያረፈ አባት ነው::
ቅዱስ ሉቃስ ምእመን፦ ሃይማኖቱን በጽናት የጠበቀ ቅዱስ አባት ነው::
የአርባ ዘጠኙ አረጋውያን ሰማዕታት ጸሎት ከሁላችን ጋር ይሁን::

en.verse: Who shall separate us from the love of Christ? Shall tribulation, or distress, or persecution, or famine, or nakedness, or peril, or sword? Yet in all these things we are more than conquerors through Him who loved us.

am.verse: ከክርስቶስ ፍቅር ማን ይለየናል? መከራ ነውን? ወይስ ጭንቀት፥ ወይስ ስደት፥ ወይስ ራብ፥ ወይስ ራቁትነት፥ ወይስ ፍርሃት፥ ወይስ ሰይፍ ነውን? ነገር ግን በዚህ ሁሉ በወደደን በእርሱ ከአሸናፊዎች እንበልጣለን።

title.en: St. Suriel the Archangel, St. Enoch the Prophet, and St. Timothy the Apostle
title.am: ቅዱስ ሱርያል ሊቀ መላእክት፣ ቅዱስ ኄኖክ ነቢይ እና ቅዱስ ጢሞቴዎስ ሐዋርያ

en: St. Suriel the Archangel (Angel of Repentance and Trumpet of Judgment)
St. Enoch the Prophet (The Seventh from Adam who Walked with God and Was Translated)
St. Timothy the Apostle (Commemoration of His Sufferings and Apostolic Mission)
am: ቅዱስ ሱርያል ሊቀ መላእክት (መልአከ ንስሐና የትንሣኤ መለከት አብሳሪ)
ቅዱስ ኄኖክ ነቢይ (ከአዳም በሰባተኛ ትውልድ የተነሳና አካሔዱን ከእግዚአብሔር ጋር ያደረገ)
ቅዱስ ጢሞቴዎስ ሐዋርያ (የሐዋርያዊ ተልዕኮውና የጽናቱ መታሰቢያ)

en: St. Suriel the Archangel
Medhane Alem (Savior of the World)
St. Victor the Martyr

St. Suriel the Archangel: Counted among the exalted archangels standing before the throne of God. St. Suriel is revered as the angel of divine repentance, who revealed heavenly mysteries and the calendar of the stars to the Prophet Enoch, interceding day and night for the salvation of sinners.

St. Enoch the Prophet: The seventh generation from Adam, Enoch walked with God in absolute righteousness and purity. The Lord translated him bodily without seeing death, revealing to him the courses of heavenly lights, the judgment of fallen angels, and the coming of the Messiah. He dwells in the Garden of Eden until the end of time.
St. Timothy the Apostle: Disciple and fellow-apostle of St. Paul, commemorated on this day for his tireless evangelistic journeys across Asia Minor, strengthening newly planted churches.
The celebration of St. Suriel and Enoch reminds the faithful that walking with God brings victory over death and eternal communion with the angels.
am: ቅዱስ ሱርያል ሊቀ መላእክት፦ በእግዚአብሔር ዙፋን ፊት ከሚቆሙት ከዋነኞቹ ሊቃነ መላእክት አንዱ ነው:: የንስሐ መልአክ በመባል የሚታወቅ ሲሆን ለነቢዩ ኄኖክ የሰማይን ምሥጢር: የከዋክብትን ሥርዓትና የትንሣኤን ቀን የገለጠለት እርሱ ነው::
ቅዱስ ኄኖክ ነቢይ፦ ከአዳም በሰባተኛ ትውልድ የተነሳ: አካሔዱን ከእግዚአብሔር ጋር በማድረጉ ሞትን ሳያይ ወደ ሰማይ የተወሰደ ጻድቅ ነቢይ ነው:: የዓለምን ፍጻሜ: የጌታችንን መምጣትና የፍርድን ነገር ተመልክቷል::
ቅዱስ ጢሞቴዎስ ሐዋርያ፦ አብያተ ክርስቲያናትን በማጽናት ወንጌልን የሰበከ ታላቅ ሐዋርያ ሲሆን መታሰቢያው በክብር ይዘከራል::
የቅዱስ ሱርያል: የነቢዩ ኄኖክና የቅዱስ ጢሞቴዎስ ጸሎት ከሁላችን ጋር ይሁን::

en.verse: For to this you were called, because Christ also suffered for us, leaving us an example, that you should follow His steps: 'Who committed no sin, nor was deceit found in His mouth.'

am.verse: የተጠራችሁለት ለዚህ ነውና፤ ክርስቶስ ደግሞ ፍለጋውን እንድትከተሉ ምሳሌ ትቶላችሁ ስለ እናንተ መከራን ተቀብሏልና። እርሱም ኃጢአት አላደረገም፥ ተንኰልም በአፉ አልተገኘበትም።

title.en: The Miracles of Emmanuel Christ and St. Clement Martyr Bishop of Rome
title.am: ተአምረ አማኑኤል ክርስቶስ እና ቅዱስ ቀሌምንጦስ ሰማዕት ሊቀ ጳጳሳት ዘሮሜ

en: Annual Feast of the Miracles of Emmanuel Christ (God with Us)
St. Clement the Martyr and Bishop of Rome (Apostolic Disciple of St. Peter)
St. Ka'oma the Ascetic
am: ዓመታዊ የተአምረ አማኑኤል በዓል (እግዚአብሔር ከእኛ ጋር)
ቅዱስ ቀሌምንጦስ ሰማዕት ሊቀ ጳጳሳት ዘሮሜ (የቅዱስ ጴጥሮስ ደቀ መዝሙር)

en: Feast of Emmanuel (God with Us)
St. Clement the Martyr
St. Abraham the Patriarch

The Miracles of Emmanuel Christ: On this day, Holy Church commemorates the boundless manifestations of Christ's miraculous power. The Gospel records how our Lord healed the sick, gave sight to the blind, opened the ears of the deaf, made the lame walk, cleansed lepers, and multiplied loaves of bread for thousands in the wilderness. His sacred Name 'Emmanuel' guarantees that God is intimately with His people through all tribulations, bringing peace, healing, and redemption.

St. Clement Bishop of Rome: The third successor of St. Peter who labored alongside St. Paul. Exiled to the marble quarries of Crimea for his bold Christian confession, he brought forth fresh water from rock to comfort prisoners and converted thousands. Emperor Trajan ordered an iron anchor tied to his neck and had him cast into the Black Sea, where the Lord miraculously revealed his relics on the sea floor.
St. Ka'oma: A pious maiden who spent her days in prayer and ascetic solitude, entering into eternal joy.
Commemorating Emmanuel Christ and St. Clement fills believers with joyous assurance that the Almighty Savior watches over His Church through all storms.
am: ተአምረ አማኑኤል ክርስቶስ፦ ቅድስት ቤተ ክርስቲያን የጌታችንን የበዛ ተአምራቱን ታስባለች:: መድኃኒታችን በወንጌል እንደተገለጠው ድውያንን ፈወሰ: ዕውሮችን አበራ: ለምጻሞችን አነጻ: ሙታንን አስነሣ:: በምድረ በዳ የተራቡትን በትንሽ እንጀራ አጠገበ:: ስሙ 'አማኑኤል' የተባለው አምላካችን ሁልጊዜ ከሕዝቡ ጋር በመሆን ድኅነትንና ሰላምን ይሰጣል::

ቅዱስ ቀሌምንጦስ ሊቀ ጳጳሳት ዘሮሜ፦ ከቅዱስ ጴጥሮስና ከቅዱስ ጳውሎስ ጋር ወንጌልን የሰበከ ሦስተኛው የሮም ሊቀ ጳጳሳት ነው:: ወደ ባሕር ተግዞ ድንጋይ በሚፈልጡ እስረኞች መካከል ወንጌልን አስተምሮ ብዙዎችን አሳመነ:: ከሀዲው ንጉሥ በብረት መልሕቅ አስሮ ወደ ባሕር ጠልቆ በሰማዕትነት እንዲሞት አደረገው:: እግዚአብሔርም በባሕሩ ውስጥ ታላቅ ተአምር አድርጓል::
ቅድስት ካዖማ ገዳማዊት፦ በቅድስና ኑራ ያረፈች ንጽሕት እናት ናት::
የአማኑኤል አምላካችን ቸርነትና የቅዱስ ቀሌምንጦስ ጸሎት ከሁላችን ጋር ይሁን::

en.verse: Now Jesus called His disciples to Himself and said, 'I have compassion on the multitude, because they have now continued with Me three days and have nothing to eat. And I do not want to send them away hungry, lest they faint on the way.'

am.verse: ኢየሱስም ደቀ መዛሙርቱን ወደ እርሱ ጠርቶ፦ ሕዝቡ ከእኔ ጋር እስካሁን ሦስት ቀን ውለዋልና የሚበሉት ስለ ሌላቸው አዝንላቸዋለሁ፤ በመንገድም እንዳይዝሉ በጾማቸው ላሰናብታቸው አልወድም አላቸው።

title.en: The Righteous Fathers of Dege (Tsadqane Dege) and St. Xenia the Ascetic Maiden
title.am: ቅዱሳን ጻድቃነ ዴጌ እና ቅድስት ክሴንያ ገዳማዊት

en: The Holy Righteous Fathers of Dege (Ethiopian Desert Fathers of Gheralta, Tigray)
St. Xenia the Righteous Maiden (The Stranger for Christ who fled Rome)
St. Serapion the Bishop and Martyr
am: ቅዱሳን ጻድቃነ ዴጌ (በትግራይ ገርዓልታ በዓት የኖሩ ኢትዮጵያውያን ጻድቃን)
ቅድስት ክሴንያ ገዳማዊት (ስለ ክርስቶስ ስደተኛ ሆና የኖረች የሮም ልዑል)

en: Ba'ale Wold (Feast of the Son of God, Holy Incarnation)
Birth of our Lord Jesus Christ
St. Peter the Apostle

The Holy Righteous Fathers of Dege: An assembly of ascetic Ethiopian fathers who withdrew into the majestic rock-hewn cliffs of Dege in Gheralta, Tigray. Dedicated entirely to contemplation, relentless psalmody, and fasting, they attained supreme holiness. The local rock sanctuaries preserve their sacred memories and uncorrupted relics, working manifold miracles of healing and spiritual comfort for pilgrims.

St. Xenia the Ascetic Maiden: Sole daughter of a prominent Roman senator who fled an arranged worldly marriage alongside two faithful handmaidens. Boarding a ship to Alexandria, she concealed her name, called herself 'Xenia' (meaning stranger/foreigner), and lived in humble solitary prayer in Milas (Caria), establishing a convent for holy virgins and working wondrous signs before her holy death on Tir 29.
St. Serapion the Bishop: A holy martyr who suffered boldly for Orthodox dogma, crowned with martyrdom.
The remembrance of the Fathers of Dege and St. Xenia reminds the faithful that pilgrimage on earth is temporary, and the true homeland of the soul is the Kingdom of Heaven.
am: ቅዱሳን ጻድቃነ ዴጌ፦ በትግራይ ገርዓልታ በዴጌ ተራራ በታላቅ ገዳማዊ ተጋድሎ የኖሩ ኢትዮጵያውያን ቅዱሳን አባቶች ናቸው:: ሌሊትና ቀን ሳይተኙ በጾምና በጸሎት ተወስነዋል:: በዓታቸውና ያረፉበት ቅዱስ ዋሻ እስከ ዛሬ ድረስ ታላላቅ ተአምራትን የሚያደርግ የበረከት ስፍራ ነው:: በዚህች ዕለት በክብር ይታሰባሉ::
ቅድስት ክሴንያ ገዳማዊት፦ የሮም ባለጸጋ ሴናተር ልጅ ስትሆን የዓለምን ክብርና ጋብቻ ንቃ ከሁለት አገልጋዮቿ ጋር ወደ እስክንድርያ ሸሸች:: ማንነቷ እንዳይታወቅ ስሟን 'ክሴንያ' (ስደተኛ) ብላ ጠርታ በታላቅ ተጋድሎ ኖረች:: ለደናግል ገዳምን አንጻ በጾምና በጸሎት ኖራ ጥር 29 ቀን በሰላም ዐርፋለች::
ቅዱስ ሴራፒዮን ኤጲስ ቆጶስ፦ ስለ ቀናች እምነቱ መከራን የተቀበለ ሰማዕት ነው::
የጻድቃነ ዴጌ እና የቅድስት ክሴንያ ጸሎት ከሁላችን ጋር ይሁን::

en.verse: The righteous shall inherit the land, and dwell in it forever.

am.verse: ጻድቃን ምድርን ይወርሳሉ፥ በእርስዋም ለዘላለም ይኖራሉ።

title.en: St. Sophia and Her Daughters, and St. Gregory the Theologian
title.am: ቅድስት ሶፍያ ወአዋልዲሃ እና ቅዱስ ጐርጐርዮስ ነባቤ መለኮት

en: St. Sophia and Her Three Daughters (Faith, Hope, and Love - Pistis, Elpis, Agape)
St. Gregory the Theologian (Patriarch of Constantinople, Divine Theologian)
St. Orni and Her Companions the Martyrs
am: ቅድስት ሶፍያ ወአዋልዲሃ (ሦስቱ ልጆቿ፦ ጲስጢስ: አላጲስ: አጋጲስ)
ቅዱስ ጐርጐርዮስ ነባቤ መለኮት (ሊቀ ጳጳሳት ዘቁስጥንጥንያ: የነገረ መለኮት አባት)

en: St. Mark the Apostle and Evangelist
St. John the Baptist
St. Theodore the General

St. Sophia and Her Three Daughters: Sophia, a devout Christian widow in Rome, raised her daughters Pistis (Faith, age 12), Elpis (Hope, age 10), and Agape (Love, age 9) in profound love for Christ. Brought before Emperor Hadrian, Sophia exhorted her children to stand firm in the Lord. Each young daughter endured horrific tortures with serene courage and was beheaded. Sophia buried their bodies on a hill outside Rome and prayed with tears of thanksgiving at their graves until she peacefully yielded her spirit to God three days later, reuniting with them in glory.

St. Gregory the Theologian: The brilliant Cappadocian father and Archbishop of Constantinople who presided over the Second Ecumenical Council in 381 A.D. His profound theological orations articulated the eternal co-equality and consubstantiality of the Holy Trinity against all heresies, earning him the rare title 'The Theologian' (Neba'abe Melekot).
St. Orni and Her Companions: Steadfast female martyrs who suffered in Egypt for the name of Christ, receiving incorruptible celestial crowns.
On this closing day of Tir, Holy Church renders glory to the Holy Trinity for guiding the faithful through the sacred commemorations of this blessed month.
am: ቅድስት ሶፍያ ወአዋልዲሃ፦ በሮም ከተማ የምትኖር እግዚአብሔርን የምትፈራ ሴት ስትሆን ሦስት ልጆቿን ጲስጢስን (እምነት: የ12 ዓመት): አላጲስን (ተስፋ: የ10 ዓመት): እና አጋጲስን (ፍቅር: የ9 ዓመት) በቅድስና አሳደገች:: ከሀዲው ንጉሥ ሃድሪያን ጣዖት እንዲያመልኩ ሲያስገድዳቸው ሕፃናቱ በድፍረት ክርስቶስን መሰከሩ:: በፊቷ እያንዳንዳቸው በሰይፍ ተሰውተው ሰማዕትነታቸውን ሲፈጽሙ እናታቸው በመቃብራቸው ላይ በጸሎት ቆማ ነፍሷን ለእግዚአብሔር ሰጠች::
ቅዱስ ጐርጐርዮስ ነባቤ መለኮት፦ የቁስጥንጥንያ ሊቀ ጳጳሳት: በ381 ዓ/ም የቁስጥንጥንያን ጉባኤ የመራ: የሥላሴን አንድነትና ሦስትነት በጠለቀ ምሥጢር ያስተማረ ታላቅ የቤተ ክርስቲያን ሊቅ ነው::
ቅድስት ኦርኒ ወማኅበራኒሃ፦ በክርስቶስ ስም ሰማዕትነትን የተቀበሉ ቅዱሳት ደናግል ናቸው::
በዚህች በጥር ወር የመጨረሻ ዕለት ቅድስት ቤተ ክርስቲያን ያሳለፈንን እግዚአብሔርን እያመሰገነች የቅዱሳኑን በረከት ትቀበላለች::

en.verse: Do not let your adornment be merely outward—arranging the hair, wearing gold, or putting on fine apparel—rather let it be the hidden person of the heart, with the incorruptible beauty of a gentle and quiet spirit, which is very precious in the sight of God.

am.verse: ለእናንተም ጠጉርን በመሸረብና ወርቅን በማንጠልጠል ወይም ልብስን በመጎናጸፍ የሚሆን የውጭ ጌጥ አይሁንላችሁ፥ ነገር ግን በእግዚአብሔር ፊት ዋጋው እጅግ የከበረ የዋህና ዝግተኛ መንፈስ ያለውን የማይጠፋውን ጌጥ ለብሶ የተሰወረ የልብ ሰው ይሁንላችሁ።

title.en: St. Peter the Seal of Martyrs (Patriarch of Alexandria) and the 150 Fathers of Constantinople
title.am: ተፍጻሜተ ሰማዕት ቅዱስ ዼጥሮስ (ሊቀ ጳጳሳት ዘእስክንድርያ) እና 150ው ሊቃውንተ ቁስጥንጥንያ

en: St. Peter the Seal of Martyrs (17th Patriarch of Alexandria, who ended the Era of Martyrs)
The 150 Holy Fathers of the Second Ecumenical Council of Constantinople (381 A.D.)
Consecration of the Church of St. Peter in Alexandria
am: ተፍጻሜተ ሰማዕት ቅዱስ ዼጥሮስ (17ኛው ሊቀ ጳጳሳት ዘእስክንድርያ: ዘመነ ሰማዕታትን የዘጋ)
150ው ሊቃውንተ ቁስጥንጥንያ (በ381 ዓ/ም መንፈስ ቅዱስ እግዚአብሔር መሆኑን ያጸኑ)

en: St. Bartholomew the Apostle
St. Raguel the Archangel
Righteous Job the Patient
St. Elias (Elijah) the Prophet

St. Peter the Seal of Martyrs: Succeeded St. Theonas as the 17th Patriarch of Alexandria. During the brutal persecution under Maximian, he shepherded his flock fearlessly. Seeing Arius' heretical denial of Christ's divinity, Christ appeared to Peter in a torn garment, saying 'Arius has rent My robe.' When sentenced to death, Peter secretly prayed outside prison asking God that his blood be the final martyrdom of the era, and offered his neck to the sword. After his death, imperial persecutions ceased, earning him the glorious title 'Seal of Martyrs.'

The 150 Holy Fathers of Constantinople: Convened by Emperor Theodosius in 381 A.D., these holy hierarchs, led by St. Gregory the Theologian, condemned Macedonius and formulated the article of the Nicene-Constantinopolitan Creed affirming: 'And in the Holy Spirit, the Lord, the Giver of Life, who proceedeth from the Father, who with the Father and the Son together is worshiped and glorified.'
Consecration of St. Peter's Sanctuary: Celebrated in Alexandria where miracles of healing and remission of sins were bestowed upon the faithful.
On this opening day of Yekatit, Holy Church praises the Holy Trinity for the victory of the martyrs and the unshakeable foundation of Orthodox dogma.
am: ተፍጻሜተ ሰማዕት ቅዱስ ዼጥሮስ፦ ከአባ ቴዎናስ ቀጥሎ 17ኛው የእስክንድርያ ፓትርያርክ ሆኖ የተመረጠ ታላቅ አባት ነው:: በአርዮስ ክህደት ጊዜ ጌታችን ልብሱ ተቀዶ ተገልጦለት 'አርዮስ ልብሴን ቀደደው: እንዳትቀበለው' ብሎ አዘዘው:: መክሲሚያኖስ ሊያስገድለው በወኅኒ ባሰረው ጊዜ ቅዱስ ጴጥሮስ 'ደሜ የሰማዕታት መጨረሻ ይሁን' ብሎ ጸልዮ አንገቱን ለሰይፍ ሰጠ:: ከእርሱ በኋላ የክርስቲያኖች ደም መፍሰስ አበቃ:: በዚህም ምክንያት 'ተፍጻሜተ ሰማዕት (የሰማዕታት ፍጻሜ)' ተብሏል::

150ው ሊቃውንተ ቁስጥንጥንያ፦ በ381 ዓ/ም በንጉሥ ቴዎዶስዮስ ዘመን የተሰበሰቡ ሲሆን በመንፈስ ቅዱስ አምላክነት ላይ የተነሳውን የመቅዶንዮስን ክህደት አውግዘው 'በመንፈስ ቅዱስም እናምናለን: እርሱም ጌታ ሕይወትን የሚሰጥ ከአብ የሠረጸ: ከአብና ከወልድ ጋር በአንድነት የሚሰገድለትና የሚመሰገን' የሚለውን የሃይማኖት ጸሎት አጽንተዋል::
ቅዳሴ ቤቱ ለቅዱስ ዼጥሮስ፦ በእስክንድርያ የታነጸው ቅዱስ መቅደስ የከበረበት ዕለት ሲሆን በእርሱ ጸሎት በርካታ ድንቆች ተከናውነዋል::
በዚህች በየካቲት የመጀመርያ ዕለት ቅድስት ቤተ ክርስቲያን የሰማዕታትንና የሊቃውንቱን መታሰቢያ በታላቅ ክብር ታከብራለች::

en.verse: And I also say to you that you are Peter, and on this rock I will build My church, and the gates of Hades shall not prevail against it.

am.verse: እኔም እልሃለሁ፥ አንተ ጴጥሮስ ነህ፥ በዚችም ዓለት ላይ ቤተ ክርስቲያኔን እሠራለሁ፥ የገሃነም ደጆችም አይችሉአትም።

title.en: Abba Paul the First Hermit (Father of Anchorites) and Abba Longinus the Abbot
title.am: ታላቁ ገዳማዊ አባ ጳውሊ (ቀዳሜ ባሕታውያን) እና ጻድቁ አባ ለንጊኖስ

en: Abba Paul of Thebes (The First Hermit of Christianity who dwelt in the Desert for 90 Years)
Abba Longinus the Righteous Abbot of the Monastery of the Glass (Deir az-Zujaj)
St. Paphnutius the Ascetic
am: አባ ጳውሊ ዘቴቤስ (የመጀመሪያው ገዳማዊ: በበረሃ ለ90 ዓመታት የተጋደለ ታላቅ አባት)
ጻድቁ አባ ለንጊኖስ (ዘደብረ ዙጃጅ: የመነኮሳት አለቃ)

en: St. Thaddaeus the Apostle
Righteous Job the Patient
Abba Paul the Great Hermit
St. John the Baptist

Abba Paul of Thebes (The First Hermit): Fleeing Decian persecutions at age sixteen, Paul withdrew into the deep Egyptian desert near the Red Sea. For ninety uninterrupted years, he dwelt in a mountain cave, clothed in woven palm leaves, fed daily by a raven that brought him half a loaf of bread. When he reached 113 years of age, God revealed him to St. Anthony the Great. When Anthony arrived, the raven brought a whole loaf. After praying together in tears, Abba Paul passed away in prayer; two lions came and dug his grave with their paws, and Anthony buried him reverently on Yekatit 2.
Abba Longinus: An exemplary Cilician monastic father who governed the renowned Monastery of the Glass in Egypt with profound humility, refusing worldly honors and healing many through his prayers.
St. Paphnutius: A blessed elder who witnessed the glory of desert hermits and preserved their holy legacies.
The holy memory of Abba Paul inspires believers to seek divine contemplation, silence, and absolute reliance on God's heavenly providence.
am: ታላቁ ገዳማዊ አባ ጳውሊ፦ በ16 ዓመቱ ከስደት ሸሽቶ ወደ ግብጽ በርሃ የገባ: ለ90 ዓመታት የሰውን ፊት ሳያይ በብሕትውና የኖረ የመጀመሪያው ገዳማዊ አባት ነው:: የዘንባባ ቅጠል ለብሶ: ቁራ በየዕለቱ ግማሽ ኅብስት እያመጣለት በጸሎት ኖረ:: ዕድሜው 113 ዓመት ሲሆን እግዚአብሔር ለአባ እንጦንስ ገለጠለት:: አባ እንጦንስ ሊጎበኘው ሲመጣ ቁራው ሙሉ ኅብስት አመጣ:: በአንድነት ከጸለዩ በኋላ አባ ጳውሊ ሲያርፍ ሁለት አንበሶች መጥተው በመዳፋቸው መቃብር ቆፍረው አባ እንጦንስ ቀብሮታል::
ጻድቁ አባ ለንጊኖስ፦ በግብጽ ደብረ ዙጃጅ ገዳም መነኮሳትን በትሕትና የመራ: ድውያንን የፈወሰ ታላቅ ገዳማዊ አባት ሲሆን በዚህች ዕለት በሰላም ዐርፏል::
ቅዱስ ጳፍኑቲዎስ ገዳማዊ፦ የቅዱሳን አባቶችን ገድል የመሰከረ ንጹሕ አባት ነው::
የአባ ጳውሊና የአባ ለንጊኖስ በረከትና ጸሎት ከሁላችን ጋር ይሁን::

en.verse: The righteous shall flourish like a palm tree, he shall grow like a cedar in Lebanon. Those who are planted in the house of the Lord shall flourish in the courts of our God.

am.verse: ጻድቅ እንደ ዘንባባ ያፈራል፥ እንደ ሊባኖስ ዝግባም ያድጋል። በእግዚአብሔር ቤት ውስጥ ተተክለዋል፥ በአምላካችንም አደባባይ ውስጥ ይበቅላሉ።

title.en: St. James the Ascetic and Wonderworker, and St. Abba Hor
title.am: ቅዱስ ያዕቆብ ገዳማዊ ባለታላቅ ተአምር እና ቅዱስ አባ ሖር

en: St. James the Ascetic (The Penitent Hermit who Overcame Demonic Temptation through Repentance)
St. Abba Hor the Martyr
St. Thomas the Confessor
am: ቅዱስ ያዕቆብ ገዳማዊ (በንስሐ ተጋድሎ ድል የነሣ ታላቅ ባሕታዊ)

en: Ba'ata Le-Egzi'etne Mariam (Entrance of the Theotokos into the Temple)
Sts. Joachim and Anna
Abune Zena Marqos the Righteous

St. James the Ascetic: A devout Palestinian hermit who lived in a cave for fifteen years, healing the sick and driving out demons. The devil, envious of his virtue, severely tempted him through a possessed girl whom he healed. Falling into temptation and despair, he initially fled, but an elder monk exhorted him to repent. Locking himself in an ancient tomb for ten years, weeping bitterly and begging for divine forgiveness, the Lord accepted his repentance, returned to him the gift of miracles, and granted rain upon the parched land at his prayer. He rested in peace on Yekatit 3.
St. Abba Hor: A courageous martyr who gave his life in steadfast confession of the Orthodox Christian faith.
St. Thomas the Confessor: Commemorated for his steadfast defense of holy dogma during imperial trials.
The life of St. James proves that no fall is beyond the boundless ocean of God's forgiving mercy when met with genuine, tearful repentance.
am: ቅዱስ ያዕቆብ ገዳማዊ፦ በፍልስጤም በረሃ ለ15 ዓመታት በታላቅ ተጋድሎ የኖረ: ድውያንን የሚፈውስ አባት ነበረ:: ሰይጣን ቀንቶበት በፈተና ቢጥለውም ተስፋ ሳይቆርጥ ወደ ንስሐ ገባ:: በመቃብር ውስጥ ለ10 ዓመታት ተዘግቶ በእንባና በዋይታ እግዚአብሔርን ይቅርታ ለመነ:: እግዚአብሔርም ፍጹም ንስሐውን ተቀብሎ የተአምራት ጸጋውን መለሰለት:: በጸሎቱም ለደረቀችው ምድር ዝናብ አዘነበ:: ጥር 3 ቀን በሰላም ዐርፏል::
ቅዱስ አባ ሖር ሰማዕት፦ ስለ ክርስቶስ ስም ደሙን ያፈሰሰ ክቡር ሰማዕት ነው::
ቅዱስ ቶማስ ምእመን፦ ሃይማኖቱን በጽናት የጠበቀ ቅዱስ አባት ነው::
የቅዱስ ያዕቆብና የቅዱሳኑ ጸሎት ከሁላችን ጋር ይሁን::

en.verse: Confess your trespasses to one another, and pray for one another, that you may be healed. The effective, fervent prayer of a righteous man avails much.

am.verse: እርስ በርሳችሁ በኃጢአታችሁ ተናዘዙ፤ ትፈወሱም ዘንድ አንዱ ስለ አንዱ ይጸልይ፤ የጻድቅ ሰው ጸሎት በሥራዋ እጅግ ኃይል ታደርጋለች።

title.en: St. Agabus the Apostle and Prophet (From the Seventy Disciples)
title.am: ቅዱስ አጋቦስ ሐዋርያ ወነቢይ (ከ72ቱ አርድእት አንዱ)

en: St. Agabus the Apostle and Prophet (Who Prophesied the Great Famine and St. Paul's Bonds)
St. Zacharias the Ascetic
St. John the Martyr
am: ቅዱስ አጋቦስ ሐዋርያ ወነቢይ (ታላቁን ራብና የቅዱስ ጳውሎስን እስራት የተነበየ)

en: St. John the Evangelist
St. Andrew the Apostle
St. Sophia the Martyr

St. Agabus the Apostle and Prophet: Numbered among the seventy-two disciples sent out by our Lord Jesus Christ, he was endowed with the sublime gift of prophecy. As recorded in the Book of Acts, he arrived in Antioch from Jerusalem and prophesied by the Holy Spirit that a great famine would spread throughout the Roman world, which occurred in the days of Claudius Caesar. Later at Caesarea, he took Paul's belt, bound his own hands and feet, and declared: 'Thus says the Holy Spirit: So shall the Jews at Jerusalem bind the man who owns this belt.' He preached the Gospel in Antioch and Judea, suffering many afflictions before falling asleep in the Lord.
St. Zacharias the Ascetic: A solitary elder who lived in continuous prayer and tears in the wilderness, resting in peace on this day.
St. John the Martyr: Commemorated for his fearless confession of faith before pagan magistrates.
The prophetic life of St. Agabus inspires believers to heed the voice of the Holy Spirit and remain faithful in trials.
am: ቅዱስ አጋቦስ ሐዋርያ ወነቢይ፦ ጌታችን ከመረጣቸው ከ72ቱ አርድእት አንዱ ሲሆን የታላቅ ትንቢት ጸጋ የተሰጠው አባት ነው:: በሐዋርያት ሥራ እንደተጻፈው ከኢየሩሳሌም ወደ አንጾኪያ ወርዶ በመላው ዓለም ታላቅ ራብ እንደሚሆን በመንፈስ ቅዱስ ተናገረ:: ደግሞም በቂሣርያ የቅዱስ ጳውሎስን መታጠቃያ ወስዶ እጁንና እግሩን አስሮ 'ይህን መታጠቃያ ያለውን ሰው አይሁድ በኢየሩሳሌም እንዲህ ያስሩታል' ብሎ ትንቢት ተናገረ:: ወንጌልን በታማኝነት ሰብኮ ጥር 4 ቀን በክብር ዐርፏል::
ቅዱስ ዘካርያስ ገዳማዊ፦ በበርሃ ተወስኖ በጾምና በጸሎት ያበራ አባት ነው::
ቅዱስ ዮሐንስ ሰማዕት፦ ስለ ክርስቶስ ስም ሰማዕትነትን የተቀበለ ቅዱስ ነው::
የቅዱስ አጋቦስ ሐዋርያ ጸሎትና በረከት ከሁላችን ጋር ይሁን::

en.verse: Then one of them, named Agabus, stood up and showed by the Spirit that there was going to be a great famine throughout all the world, which also happened in the days of Claudius Caesar.

am.verse: ከእነርሱም አጋቦስ የሚሉት አንድ ሰው ተነሥቶ በዓለም ሁሉ ታላቅ ራብ ሊሆን እንዳለው በመንፈስ አመለከተ፤ ይህም በቀላውዴዎስ ቄሣር ዘመን ሆነ።

title.en: St. Agrippinus Patriarch of Alexandria and St. Hippolytus Pope of Rome
title.am: ቅዱስ አግሪጳ ሊቀ ጳጳሳት ዘእስክንድርያ እና ቅዱስ አቡሊዲስ ሊቀ ጳጳሳት ዘሮሜ

en: St. Agrippinus the 10th Patriarch of Alexandria (The Apostolic Confessor)
St. Hippolytus (Abulidis) Pope and Martyr of Rome
St. Anianus the Bishop
am: ቅዱስ አግሪጳ 10ኛው ሊቀ ጳጳሳት ዘእስክንድርያ (ሐዋርያዊው አባት)
ቅዱስ አቡሊዲስ ሊቀ ጳጳሳት ዘሮሜ ሰማዕት

en: St. Peter Head of the Apostles
St. Paul Light of the World
Abune Gebre Menfes Qiddus

St. Agrippinus, Patriarch of Alexandria: Succeeded St. Celadion as the 10th Patriarch of Alexandria in the 2nd century. He preserved the apostolic traditions received from the Evangelist Mark with holy meekness, poverty, and love, instructing his clergy and guiding the faithful through turbulent times without compromising the faith, departing peacefully on Yekatit 5.

St. Hippolytus (Abulidis) of Rome: A profound theologian, author of early Church canons, and courageous martyr. When pagan Roman authorities ordered him to sacrifice to idols, he confessed Christ boldly. Tied to wild horses and dragged across stony crags, he surrendered his soul to the Lord, receiving the martyr's crown.
St. Anianus: A faithful bishop who shepherded the flock of Christ with wisdom and gentleness, entering into eternal glory.
The remembrance of Agrippinus and Hippolytus reminds the faithful of the courage required to preserve apostolic truth in all ages.
am: ቅዱስ አግሪጳ ሊቀ ጳጳሳት ዘእስክንድርያ፦ 10ኛው የእስክንድርያ ፓትርያርክ ሲሆን ከወንጌላዊው ማርቆስ የተረከበውን ሐዋርያዊ ትውፊት በቅድስናና በትሕትና ጠብቋል:: መንጋውን ከክህደት ተኩላዎች እየጠበቀ ለ12 ዓመታት በመልካም እረኝነት ካገለገለ በኋላ ጥር 5 ቀን በሰላም ዐርፏል::
ቅዱስ አቡሊዲስ ሊቀ ጳጳሳት ዘሮሜ፦ ታላቅ የቤተ ክርስቲያን ሊቅና የሥርዓት መምህር ሲሆን ስለ ቀናች ሃይማኖቱ በከሀዲው ንጉሥ ፊት ክርስቶስን መሰከረ:: በዱር ፈረሶች ታስሮ በድንጋይ ላይ እንዲጎተት ተደርጎ በሰማዕትነት ዐርፏል::
ቅዱስ አንያኖስ ኤጲስ ቆጶስ፦ ምእመናንን በፍቅርና በትምህርት ያጸና ቅዱስ አባት ነው::
የቅዱስ አግሪጳና የቅዱስ አቡሊዲስ ጸሎት ከሁላችን ጋር ይሁን::

en.verse: I have fought the good fight, I have finished the race, I have kept the faith. Finally, there is laid up for me the crown of righteousness, which the Lord, the righteous Judge, will give to me on that Day, and not to me only but also to all who have loved His appearing.

am.verse: መልካሙን ገድል ተጋድያለሁ፥ ሩጫውን ጨርሻለሁ፥ ሃይማኖትን ጠብቄአለሁ፤ ወደ ፊት የጽድቅ አክሊል ተዘጋጅቶልኛል፥ ይህንም ጻድቅ ፈራጅ የሆነው ጌታ በዚያ ቀን ለእኔ ያስረክባል፥ ደግሞም መገለጡን ለሚወዱት ሁሉ እንጂ ለእኔ ብቻ አይደለም።

title.en: St. Abadir and St. Irai His Sister, and the Forty Martyrs of Sebaste
title.am: ቅዱስ አባዲርና ቅድስት ኢራኢ እህቱ እና አርባው የሰባስቲያ ሰማዕታት

en: St. Abadir and St. Irai (Irani) His Sister (Noble Roman Martyrs who Slew the Persecutor's Idols)
The Forty Holy Martyrs of Sebaste (Frozen in the Icy Lake for Christ)
St. Joseph the Monk
am: ቅዱስ አባዲርና ቅድስት ኢራኢ እህቱ (የሮም መሳፍንት: ስለ ክርስቶስ የተሰዉ ሰማዕታት)
አርባው የሰባስቲያ ሰማዕታት (በበረዶ ሐይቅ ውስጥ ስለ ክርስቶስ የጸኑ)

en: St. Peter Head of the Apostles
St. Paul Light of the World
St. Arsema the Virgin Martyr

St. Abadir and St. Irai: Children of Basilides, prime minister of Antioch. When Diocletian began his persecution, Abadir, a high-ranking military commander, distributed his wealth to the poor. Together with his virgin sister Irai, they disguised themselves as peasants and journeyed to Upper Egypt. Confessing Christ before Governor Arianus of Ansena, they endured horrific tortures: iron combs, boiling cauldrons, and the wheel. Archangel Michael comforted them until they were beheaded on Yekatit 6, receiving glorious celestial crowns.

The Forty Martyrs of Sebaste: Roman soldiers in Armenia who confessed Christ. Stripped of their clothes on a freezing winter night and forced into an icy lake, they prayed steadfastly. In the morning, radiant crowns descended from heaven upon them, and they entered into eternal joy.
St. Joseph the Monk: A humble desert father who lived in continuous prayer and peace, resting in holiness.
The courage of Abadir and Irai teaches believers to abandon worldly vanity and love Christ above earthly kinship and honors.
am: ቅዱስ አባዲርና ቅድስት ኢራኢ እህቱ፦ የአንጾኪያ የጦር መሪ የነበረው ቅዱስ አባዲር ከድንግል እህቱ ከኢራኢ ጋር የዓለምን ክብር ንቀው ወደ ግብጽ ወረዱ:: በከሀዲው አርያኖስ ፊት በድፍረት ክርስቶስን መሰከሩ:: በብረት አልጋ: በሚፈላ ዘይትና በስለት ተሰቃይተው በመጨረሻ አንገታቸውን በሰይፍ ተቆርጠው የሰማዕትነት አክሊል ተቀብለዋል::
አርባው የሰባስቲያ ሰማዕታት፦ በብርድ ሌሊት ልብሳቸውን ተገፈው በበረዶ ሐይቅ ውስጥ ቢጣሉም በጸሎት ጸንተው አርባ የብርሃን አክሊላት ከሰማይ ወርዶላቸው ሰማዕትነታቸውን ፈጽመዋል::
ቅዱስ ዮሴፍ ገዳማዊ፦ በቅድስና ኑሮ ያረፈ አባት ነው::
የቅዱስ አባዲር: የቅድስት ኢራኢና የአርባው ሰማዕታት ጸሎት ከሁላችን ጋር ይሁን::

en.verse: For I am persuaded that neither death nor life, nor angels nor principalities nor powers, nor things present nor things to come, nor height nor depth, nor any other created thing, shall be able to separate us from the love of God which is in Christ Jesus our Lord.

am.verse: ሞት ቢሆን፥ ሕይወትም ቢሆን፥ መላእክትም ቢሆኑ፥ ግዛትም ቢሆን፥ ያለውም ቢሆን፥ የሚመጣውም ቢሆን፥ ኃይላትም ቢሆኑ፥ ከፍታም ቢሆን፥ ዝቅታም ቢሆን፥ ልዩ ፍጥረትም ቢሆን በክርስቶስ ኢየሱስ በጌታችን ካለ ከእግዚአብሔር ፍቅር ሊለየን እንዳይችል ተረድቼአለሁ።

title.en: Abba Abdulmawos the Ascetic and St. Alexander the Bishop
title.am: ጻድቁ አባ አብዱልማዎስ ገዳማዊ እና ቅዱስ እስክንድሮስ ኤጲስ ቆጶስ

en: Abba Abdulmawos the Righteous Ascetic (Who excelled in nocturnal vigils and solitude)
St. Alexander the Holy Bishop
St. Theophilus the Confessor
am: ጻድቁ አባ አብዱልማዎስ ገዳማዊ (በሌሊት ጸሎትና በብሕትውና ያበራ አባት)

en: Holy Trinity (Selassie)
Abba Giyorgis of Gascha
Abba Shenouda the Archimandrite

Abba Abdulmawos the Ascetic: A revered desert father who dedicated his whole life to rigorous monastic solitude. Standing in continuous prayer throughout freezing winter nights, his body became dried like parchment, while his spirit shone like an angel. The Lord granted him profound wisdom and discernment, and many monks traveled across the desert to receive his holy blessings. He passed away peacefully on Yekatit 7.
St. Alexander the Bishop: A vigilant shepherd who defended his flock from heretical teachings and maintained pristine apostolic communion.
St. Theophilus: Commemorated for his steadfast defense of holy dogma during severe trials.
The solitary struggle of Abba Abdulmawos demonstrates the power of constant communion with God away from worldly distractions.
am: ጻድቁ አባ አብዱልማዎስ ገዳማዊ፦ በበረሃ ተወስኖ በጾምና በጸሎት ያበራ: ሰውነቱን በገድል የቀጣ ታላቅ አባት ነው:: ሌሊቱን በሙሉ ሳይተኛ በጸሎት ቆሞ ሲያነጋ አጋንንትን ድል ነሥቷል:: በርካታ ገዳማውያን ከመንፈሳዊ ጥበቡ ለመካፈል ወደ በዓቱ ይመጡ ነበር:: ጥር 7 ቀን በሰላም ዐርፏል::
ቅዱስ እስክንድሮስ ኤጲስ ቆጶስ፦ መንጋውን በርትዕት ሃይማኖት የመራ ቅዱስ እረኛ ነው::
ቅዱስ ቴዎፍሎስ ምእመን፦ ሃይማኖቱን የጠበቀ ቅዱስ ሰው ነው::
የአባ አብዱልማዎስና የቅዱሳኑ ጸሎት ከሁላችን ጋር ይሁን::

en.verse: For the Lord loves justice, and does not forsake His saints; they are preserved forever, but the descendants of the wicked shall be cut off.

am.verse: እግዚአብሔር ፍርድን ይወዳልና፥ ቅዱሳኑንም አይጥላቸውምና፤ ለዘላለምም ይጠበቃሉ፤ የኀጥኣን ዘር ግን ይጠፋል።

title.en: Abba Barsuma the Syrian (Father of Syrian Monks) and St. Theodore the Roman
title.am: አባ በርሱማ ሶርያዊ (የሶርያ መነኮሳት አባት) እና ቅዱስ ቴዎድሮስ ሮማዊ

en: Abba Barsuma the Syrian (Great Ascetic who Stood in Prayer for 54 Years)
St. Theodore the Roman the Martyr
St. Juliana the Virgin Martyr
am: አባ በርሱማ ሶርያዊ (ለ54 ዓመታት በጸሎት የቆመ ታላቅ ባሕታዊ)

en: St. Moses Head of the Prophets
The Four Living Creatures (Cherubim)
Abba Kiros the Hermit

Abba Barsuma the Syrian: Known as the Father of Syrian Monks and a champion of the Council of Ephesus. From youth, he gave himself to severe ascetic discipline, wearing heavy iron chains under his garment and standing upright in continuous prayer day and night for fifty-four years without leaning or sitting down. The Lord performed countless signs through his hands: driving out snakes, healing paralytics, and upholding the Orthodox faith against the Nestorian heresy. He rested in peace on Yekatit 8.
St. Theodore the Roman: A valiant soldier of Christ who suffered torments under Emperor Maximian, crowned with martyrdom.
St. Juliana: A steadfast virgin who rejected pagan suitors and suffered martyrdom for Christ.
The unbending prayer of Abba Barsuma reminds the faithful of the spiritual endurance required to triumph over temptation.
am: አባ በርሱማ ሶርያዊ፦ ለሶርያ መነኮሳት አባት የሆነ: በኤፌሶን ጉባኤ የቀናች ሃይማኖትን የደገፈ ታላቅ አባት ነው:: በሰውነቱ ላይ የብረት ሰንሰለት ታጥቆ ለ54 ዓመታት ሳይቀመጥና ሳይደገፍ ቆሞ ሲጸልይ ኖሯል:: እግዚአብሔር በርካታ ድንቆችን በእጁ አድርጓል:: ጥር 8 ቀን በክብር ዐርፏል::
ቅዱስ ቴዎድሮስ ሮማዊ፦ ስለ ክርስቶስ ስም ደሙን ያፈሰሰ ክቡር ሰማዕት ነው::
ቅድስት ዩልያና ድንግል፦ ጣዖታትን አቃላ በክርስቶስ ስም ሰማዕትነትን የተቀበለች ቅድስት ናት::
የአባ በርሱማና የቅዱሳኑ ጸሎት ከሁላችን ጋር ይሁን::

en.verse: He who receives a prophet in the name of a prophet shall receive a prophet's reward. And he who receives a righteous man in the name of a righteous man shall receive a righteous man's reward.

am.verse: ነቢይን በነቢይ ስም የሚቀበል የነቢይን ዋጋ ይወስዳል፥ ጻድቅንም በጻድቅ ስም የሚቀበል የጻድቁን ዋጋ ይወስዳል።

title.en: Abba Barsanuphius the Great Recluse and St. Paul the Confessor
title.am: አባ በርሰኑፋ ታላቁ ባሕታዊ እና ቅዱስ ዻውሎስ ምእመን

en: Abba Barsanuphius the Great Recluse of Gaza (The Seer of Mysteries who Spoke through Letters)
St. Paul the Confessor
St. Andrew the Monk
am: አባ በርሰኑፋ ታላቁ ባሕታዊ ዘጋዛ (ምሥጢራትን ያየ: በመልእክታቱ ያስተማረ)

en: The 318 Holy Fathers of Nicaea
Abba Barsuma the Syrian
Abba Melchizedek of Mida

Abba Barsanuphius the Great Recluse: Flourished near Gaza in the 6th century. For over fifty years, he enclosed himself completely within a tiny sealed cell, communicating with disciples and patriarchs only through written letters written under the inspiration of the Holy Spirit. His answers to spiritual questions guided thousands of souls in humility, discernment, and prayer of the heart, departing peacefully to the Lord.
St. Paul the Confessor: A noble confessor who endured persecution for the Orthodox faith with unwavering patience.
St. Andrew the Monk: A devout anchorite commemorated for his prayer and ascetic life in the desert.
The letters of Abba Barsanuphius continue to illumine monks and laypeople alike in the discernment of divine thoughts and holy humility.
am: አባ በርሰኑፋ ታላቁ ባሕታዊ፦ በጋዛ አካባቢ በአንድ ትንሽ በዓት ተዘግቶ ለ50 ዓመታት የሰውን ፊት ሳያይ በብሕትውና የኖረ ታላቅ አባት ነው:: ከመንፈሳዊ ጥበቡና ከዕውቀቱ የተነሳ ጳጳሳትና መነኮሳት በመልእክት ይጠይቁት እርሱም በመንፈስ ቅዱስ እየጻፈ ይመልስላቸው ነበር:: ጥር 9 ቀን በሰላም ዐርፏል::
ቅዱስ ዻውሎስ ምእመን፦ ስለ ቀናች ሃይማኖት መከራን የታገሰ ቅዱስ አባት ነው::
ቅዱስ እንድርያስ ገዳማዊ፦ በጾምና በጸሎት ያበራ አባት ነው::
የአባ በርሰኑፋ ጸሎትና ረድኤት ከሁላችን ጋር ይሁን::

en.verse: But God forbid that I should boast except in the cross of our Lord Jesus Christ, by whom the world has been crucified to me, and I to the world.

am.verse: ነገር ግን ዓለም ለእኔ የተሰቀለበት እኔም ለዓለም የተሰቀልሁበት ከጌታችን ከኢየሱስ ክርስቶስ መስቀል በቀር ሌላ ትምክህት ከእኔ ይራቅ።

title.en: St. James the Apostle (Son of Alphaeus) and St. Justus the Bishop
title.am: ቅዱስ ያዕቆብ ሐዋርያ ወልደ እልፍዮስ እና ቅዱስ ዮስጦስ ኤጲስ ቆጶስ

en: St. James the Apostle Son of Alphaeus (One of the Twelve Apostles of Christ)
St. Justus the Holy Bishop
St. Isidore the Martyr
am: ቅዱስ ያዕቆብ ሐዋርያ ወልደ እልፍዮስ (ከ12ቱ ሐዋርያት አንዱ)

en: Holy Cross of our Lord Jesus Christ
144,000 Holy Innocents of Bethlehem
The Righteous King Saint Kaleb

St. James the Apostle Son of Alphaeus: Chosen by our Lord as one of the Twelve Holy Apostles. After Pentecost, he preached the Gospel in Southern Judea, Gaza, and Egypt, working mighty signs and converting many idolaters. He suffered severe persecutions and was stoned and beaten with a fuller's club by pagan adversaries, receiving the glorious crown of apostolic martyrdom.
St. Justus the Bishop: A holy hierarch who guided his diocese with great zeal, preserving Orthodox dogma and caring for the impoverished.
St. Isidore: A faithful martyr who confessed Christ before tyrannical rulers, entering into celestial glory.
The apostolic foundation laid by St. James strengthens the Church in eternal truth and sacrificial love for the Gospel.
am: ቅዱስ ያዕቆብ ሐዋርያ ወልደ እልፍዮስ፦ ጌታችን ከመረጣቸው ከዐሥራ ሁለቱ ሐዋርያት አንዱ ሲሆን በመንፈስ ቅዱስ ተሞልቶ በይሁዳ: በጋዛና በግብጽ ወንጌልን ሰብኳል:: ጣዖታትን አፍርሶ በርካቶችን አሳምኗል:: በመጨረሻም አረማውያን በድንጋይ ወግረው በሰማዕትነት ገድለውታል:: ጥር 10 ቀን የሰማዕትነት አክሊል ተቀብሏል::
ቅዱስ ዮስጦስ ኤጲስ ቆጶስ፦ መንጋውን በቅንነትና በፍቅር የመራ ቅዱስ እረኛ ነው::
ቅዱስ አሲዶሮስ ሰማዕት፦ ስለ ክርስቶስ ስም ደሙን ያፈሰሰ ሰማዕት ነው::
የሐዋርያው የቅዱስ ያዕቆብና የቅዱሳኑ ጸሎት ከሁላችን ጋር ይሁን::

en.verse: And when He had called His twelve disciples to Him, He gave them power over unclean spirits, to cast them out, and to heal all kinds of sickness and all kinds of disease. Now the names of the twelve apostles are these... James the son of Alphaeus...

am.verse: አሥራ ሁለቱን ደቀ መዛሙርቱን ወደ እርሱ ጠርቶ፥ እንዲያወጡአቸው በርኩሳን መናፍስት ላይ ደዌንና ሕማምንም ሁሉ እንዲፈውሱ ሥልጣን ሰጣቸው። የአሥራ ሁለቱም ሐዋርያት ስም ይህ ነው፤ ... የእልፍዮስ ልጅ ያዕቆብም...

title.en: St. Fabianus Pope of Rome and St. Blaise Bishop of Sebaste
title.am: ቅዱስ ፋቢአኖስ ሊቀ ጳጳሳት ዘሮሜ እና ቅዱስ ብላስዮስ ኤጲስ ቆጶስ ዘሰባስቲያ

en: St. Fabianus Pope and Martyr of Rome (Upon whom a Dove Landed at His Election)
St. Blaise the Wonderworker Bishop of Sebaste
St. Theodore the Monk
am: ቅዱስ ፋቢአኖስ ሊቀ ጳጳሳት ዘሮሜ ሰማዕት (በምርጫው ጊዜ ርግብ የወረደችበት)
ቅዱስ ብላስዮስ ባለታላቅ ተአምር ኤጲስ ቆጶስ ዘሰባስቲያ

en: St. Claudius the Martyr
St. Fasilides the Great Martyr
Abba Samuel of Waldebba

St. Fabianus Pope of Rome: Elected bishop of Rome in 236 A.D. by extraordinary divine signs: while the clergy debated candidates, a white dove miraculously flew in and alighted upon Fabianus' head. Recognized as God's chosen shepherd, he organized church administrative districts, collected the acts of martyrs, and strengthened the flock during the Decian persecution until he was crowned with martyrdom.

St. Blaise Bishop of Sebaste: A renowned physician and bishop who lived in wilderness caves, taming wild animals by prayer. He healed throat diseases and comforted tortured martyrs before being beheaded under Licinius.
St. Theodore the Monk: A peaceful anchorite who spent his years in quiet contemplation and monastic discipline.
The pastoral courage of Fabianus and Blaise inspires all Christians to serve God's flock with sacrificial dedication.
am: ቅዱስ ፋቢአኖስ ሊቀ ጳጳሳት ዘሮሜ፦ በ236 ዓ/ም የሮም ሊቀ ጳጳሳት ሆኖ የተመረጠ ታላቅ አባት ነው:: በምርጫው ወቅት ነጭ ርግብ ከሰማይ ወርዳ በራሱ ላይ በማረፏ የእግዚአብሔር ምርጫ መሆኑ ታወቀ:: የሰማዕታትን ገድል በማሰባሰብና ምእመናንን በማጽናት አገልግሏል:: በዴቅዮስ ዘመን በሰማዕትነት ዐርፏል::
ቅዱስ ብላስዮስ ኤጲስ ቆጶስ ዘሰባስቲያ፦ ሐኪምና ጳጳስ የነበረ: የዱር አራዊትን በጸሎቱ ያገረሰ: በክርስቶስ ስም በርካታ ድንቆችን ካደረገ በኋላ በሰማዕትነት ያረፈ አባት ነው::
ቅዱስ ቴዎድሮስ ገዳማዊ፦ በበርሃ ተወስኖ በቅድስና ያረፈ አባት ነው::
የቅዱስ ፋቢአኖስና የቅዱስ ብላስዮስ ጸሎት ከሁላችን ጋር ይሁን::

en.verse: I am the good shepherd. The good shepherd gives His life for the sheep. I am the good shepherd; and I know My sheep, and am known by My own.

am.verse: መልካም እረኛ እኔ ነኝ። መልካም እረኛ ነፍሱን ስለ በጎቹ ያኖራል። መልካም እረኛ እኔ ነኝ፥ አብም እንደሚያውቀኝ እኔም አብን እንደማውቀው የራሴን በጎች አውቃለሁ የራሴም በጎች ያውቁኛል።

title.en: Feast of St. Michael the Archangel and St. Gelasius the Martyr
title.am: በዓለ ቅዱስ ሚካኤል ሊቀ መላእክት እና ቅዱስ ገላስዮስ ሰማዕት

en: St. Michael the Archangel (Monthly Memorial of Deliverance and Heavenly Intercession)
St. Gelasius the Actor and Martyr (Who Confessed Christ upon Stage)
St. Demetrius the Monk
am: ቅዱስ ሚካኤል ሊቀ መላእክት (የወርኀዊ መታሰቢያውና የድኅነቱ በዓል)
ቅዱስ ገላስዮስ ሰማዕት (በመድረክ ላይ ክርስቲያኖችን ሲያፌዝ አምኖ የተሰዋ)

en: St. Michael the Archangel
St. Lalibela the Righteous King
Abba Samuel of Waldebba

St. Michael the Archangel: Holy Church observes the monthly memorial of the Archangel Michael with deep thanksgiving. As the leader of the heavenly army who defends believers, Michael carries the prayers of the saints to the throne of God, delivering the distressed and standing as a merciful advocate for mankind.

St. Gelasius the Actor: A pagan stage actor who was performing a mockery of Christian holy baptism before a crowd of pagan spectators in Heliopolis. When he was immersed into the water to mock the sacred mystery, divine grace touched his heart. Stepping out of the pool, he proclaimed boldly to the emperor and audience: 'I am a Christian! I saw celestial angels surrounding the water!' Refusing to recant his newfound faith, he was immediately beheaded, baptized in his own blood.
St. Demetrius: A peaceful monk who lived in desert solitude and continuous prayer.
The remembrance of Archangel Michael and Gelasius illustrates how divine grace transforms hearts in an instant and provides angelic protection to all who believe.
am: ቅዱስ ሚካኤል ሊቀ መላእክት፦ ቅድስት ቤተ ክርስቲያን የወርኀዊ መታሰቢያውን በታላቅ ምስጋና ታከብራለች:: ቅዱስ ሚካኤል የቅዱሳንን ጸሎት ወደ እግዚአብሔር የሚያሳርግ: ምእመናንን ከመከራ የሚያድን ታላቅ መልአክ ነው::
ቅዱስ ገላስዮስ ሰማዕት፦ በአረማውያን መድረክ ላይ የክርስትናን ጥምቀት እያፌዘ ሲተውከን በድንገት የእግዚአብሔር ጸጋ በልቡ አደረ:: ከውሃው ሲወጣ 'እኔ ክርስቲያን ነኝ! መላእክት በውሃው ላይ ሲያበሩ አየሁ' ብሎ በንጉሡ ፊት መሰከረ:: ወዲያውኑ አንገቱን በሰይፍ ተቆርጦ የሰማዕትነት አክሊል ተቀብሏል::
ቅዱስ ድሜጥሮስ ገዳማዊ፦ በበርሃ ተወስኖ በጾምና በጸሎት ያበራ አባት ነው::
የቅዱስ ሚካኤልና የቅዱስ ገላስዮስ ጸሎት ከሁላችን ጋር ይሁን::

en.verse: Bless the Lord, you His angels, who excel in strength, who do His word, heeding the voice of His word. Bless the Lord, all you His hosts, you ministers of His who do His pleasure.

am.verse: ቃሉን የምትፈጽሙ፥ የቃሉንም ድምፅ የምትሰሙ፥ ብርቱዎችና ኃያላን፥ መላእክቱ ሁሉ፥ እግዚአብሔርን አመስግኑ። ፈቃዱን የምታደርጉ አገልጋዮቹ፥ ሠራዊቱ ሁሉ፥ እግዚአብሔርን አመስግኑ።

title.en: St. Sergius the Megalomartyr and St. Timothy the Patriarch of Alexandria
title.am: ቅዱስ ሰርጊስ ሊቀ ሰማዕታት እና ቅዱስ ጢሞቴዎስ ሊቀ ጳጳሳት ዘእስክንድርያ

en: St. Sergius the Megalomartyr (Companion of St. Bacchus, Commander of Roman Forces)
St. Timothy the 22nd Patriarch of Alexandria
St. Victor the Soldier Martyr
am: ቅዱስ ሰርጊስ ሊቀ ሰማዕታት (የቅዱስ ባኮስ ባልንጀራ: የሮም ሠራዊት አለቃ)

en: Feast of God the Father
St. Raphael the Archangel
The Thirteen Solitary Righteous Hermits (13 Gihusan)

St. Sergius the Megalomartyr: A distinguished Roman officer in Syria alongside St. Bacchus. When emperor Maximian discovered their Christian faith, he ordered them stripped and marched through streets in women's clothing. After Bacchus was beaten to death, Sergius was made to run in iron shoes with upright nails driven into his soles. Enduring horrific tortures with angelic courage, he was beheaded in Resafa (Syria), where his relics worked miracles throughout the Christian East.

St. Timothy Patriarch of Alexandria: Succeeded his brother Peter II as the 22nd Patriarch. He took part in the Second Ecumenical Council in Constantinople (381 A.D.), authoring canonical responses and shepherding the flock with profound pastoral wisdom.
St. Victor: A faithful warrior martyr who confessed Christ fearlessly, receiving an immortal crown.
The steadfast endurance of St. Sergius reminds Christians that love for Christ overcomes every pain of the flesh.
am: ቅዱስ ሰርጊስ ሊቀ ሰማዕታት፦ በሶርያ የሮም ሠራዊት አለቃ የነበረ ሲሆን ከቅዱስ ባኮስ ጋር ክርስቶስን መሰከረ:: ቅዱስ ባኮስ በግርፋት ካረፈ በኋላ ቅዱስ ሰርጊስ በውስጡ ሚስማር በተተከለበት የብረት ጫማ እንዲሮጥ ተደረገ:: በጽናት ታግሦ አንገቱን ለሰይፍ ሰጥቶ ሰማዕትነቱን ፈጽሟል::
ቅዱስ ጢሞቴዎስ ሊቀ ጳጳሳት ዘእስክንድርያ፦ 22ኛው የእስክንድርያ ፓትርያርክ ሲሆን በ381 ዓ/ም በቁስጥንጥንያ ጉባኤ ተገኝቶ የቀናች ሃይማኖትን ያጸና ታላቅ አባት ነው::
ቅዱስ ፊቅጦር ሰማዕት፦ ስለ እውነተኛይቱ ሃይማኖት ደሙን ያፈሰሰ ሰማዕት ነው::
የቅዱስ ሰርጊስና የቅዱስ ጢሞቴዎስ ጸሎት ከሁላችን ጋር ይሁን::

en.verse: You therefore must endure hardship as a good soldier of Jesus Christ. No one engaged in warfare entangles himself with the affairs of this life, that he may please him who enlisted him as a soldier. And also if anyone competes in athletics, he is not crowned unless he competes according to the rules.

am.verse: እንደ ኢየሱስ ክርስቶስ በጎ ወታደር ሆነህ፥ አብረኸኝ መከራ ተቀበል። የሚዋጋው ሁሉ ደስ ያሰኘው ዘንድ ለጦር ያስከተተውን ከዚህ ዓለም ኑሮ ጋር እንዳይጠላለፍ ያደርጋል። ደግሞም በስፖርት የሚወዳደር ማንም ቢሆን፥ እንደ ሕጉ ካልተወዳደረ አክሊልን አያገኝም።

title.en: St. Severus Patriarch of Antioch (Crown of the Syriac Church and Defender of Orthodoxy)
title.am: ቅዱስ ሳዊሮስ ሊቀ ጳጳሳት ዘአንጾኪያ (ዘውደ ሶርያ ወዓምደ ሃይማኖት)

en: St. Severus Patriarch of Antioch (The Great Doctor who Defended Miaphysite Christology and Suffered Exile)
St. James of Serug (The Flute of the Holy Spirit)
St. Sergius the Monk
am: ቅዱስ ሳዊሮስ ሊቀ ጳጳሳት ዘአንጾኪያ (የኦርቶዶክስ ተዋሕዶ ሃይማኖት ዓምድ: የስደተኛው አባት ዕረፍት)
ቅዱስ ያዕቆብ ዘሥሩግ (እምነተ ተዋሕዶን በቅኔ ያስተማረ ሊቅ)

en: Abba Aregawi the Great (Zemika'el)
St. Gebre Kristos the Bridegroom
St. Philip the Apostle

St. Severus Patriarch of Antioch: Born in Sozopolis (Pisidia) around 465 A.D., Severus studied rhetoric and law in Alexandria and Beirut before being baptized and embracing the monastic habit. Consecrated Patriarch of Antioch in 512 A.D., he was a towering doctor of the Church who defended the Orthodox Cyrillian formula 'One Incarnate Nature of God the Word' against Chalcedonian dualism. When Emperor Justin I sought to arrest him, Severus escaped to Egypt, where he lived in exile for twenty years, strengthening the Coptic and Syriac faithful through his prolific theological writings and treatises until his blessed repose on Yekatit 14, 538 A.D.
St. James of Serug: A beloved Syriac hymnographer whose metrical homilies praised the mysteries of the Holy Trinity, the Incarnation, and the Mother of God with poetic sweetness.
St. Sergius: A devoted desert solitary who served St. Severus during his Egyptian exile.
The feast of St. Severus stands as a cornerstone of Oriental Orthodox unity and doctrinal purity.
am: ቅዱስ ሳዊሮስ ሊቀ ጳጳሳት ዘአንጾኪያ፦ በ512 ዓ/ም የአንጾኪያ ፓትርያርክ ሆኖ የተመረጠ: የቀናች የተዋሕዶ ሃይማኖት ታላቁ ዓምድ ነው:: የቄርሎስን 'አንዲት ባሕርይ' ትምህርት በጽናት በመከላከል የኬልቄዶንን ክህደት አጋልጧል:: ከሀዲው ንጉሥ ዮስጢኖስ ሊያስገድለው በፈለገ ጊዜ ወደ ግብጽ ተሰደደ:: በስደት ለ20 ዓመታት እየኖረ ምእመናንን በመጻሕፍቱና በድርሳናቱ አጽንቷል:: ጥር 14 ቀን ዐርፎ በታላቅ ክብር ተቀብሯል::
ቅዱስ ያዕቆብ ዘሥሩግ፦ የተዋሕዶን ምሥጢር በጣፋጭ ቅኔና ድርሳን ያስተማረ ታላቅ የሶርያ ሊቅ ነው::
ቅዱስ ሰርጊስ ገዳማዊ፦ ቅዱስ ሳዊሮስን በስደት ያገለገለ ቅዱስ አባት ነው::
የቅዱስ ሳዊሮስና የቅዱስ ያዕቆብ ጸሎት ከሁላችን ጋር ይሁን::

en.verse: Holding fast the faithful word as he has been taught, that he may be able, by sound doctrine, both to exhort and convict those who contradict.

am.verse: ሕያው በሚሆን ትምህርት ሊመክር የሚቃወሙትንም ሊወቅስ ይችል ዘንድ፥ እንደ ተማረው በታመነ ቃል ይጽና።

title.en: St. Zechariah the Prophet (Son of Berechiah) and St. Paphnutius the Hermit
title.am: ቅዱስ ዘካርያስ ነቢይ (ወልደ በረክዩ) እና ቅዱስ ጳፍኑቲዎስ ገዳማዊ

en: St. Zechariah the Prophet (Son of Berechiah, Who Prophesied Christ's Triumphal Entry on a Donkey)
St. Paphnutius the Desert Solitary
St. George the Ascetic
am: ቅዱስ ዘካርያስ ነቢይ (ወልደ በረክዩ: የጌታችንን በውርንጫይቱ ላይ ሆኖ መግባትን የተነበየ)

en: St. Cyricus and St. Julitta
St. Ephrem the Syrian
St. Minas the Martyr

St. Zechariah the Prophet: The son of Berechiah, the son of Iddo, one of the twelve Minor Prophets who returned from the Babylonian captivity. He prophesied the rebuilding of the Temple in Jerusalem and uttered profound Messianic prophecies: 'Rejoice greatly, O daughter of Zion! Behold, your King is coming to you; He is just and having salvation, lowly and riding on a donkey, a colt, the foal of a donkey.' He also prophesied the thirty pieces of silver paid for Christ. He completed his prophetic course in deep righteousness, entering into peace on Yekatit 15.
St. Paphnutius the Hermit: A blessed anchorite who lived in the Egyptian desert in ceaseless prayer, fasting, and contemplation.
St. George the Ascetic: A solitary monk commemorated for his humility and spiritual vigilance.
The prophecies of Zechariah remind the faithful that God's promises of salvation through Christ the King are fulfilled with exactitude.
am: ቅዱስ ዘካርያስ ነቢይ፦ ከባቢሎን ምርኮ ከተመለሱት ከ12ቱ ደቂቀ ነቢያት አንዱ ሲሆን የኢየሩሳሌምን መቅደስ መታነጽና የመሲሑን መምጣት ተንብዮአል:: 'አንቺ የጽዮን ልጅ ሆይ: እጅግ ደስ ይበልሽ! እነሆ ንጉሥሽ ጻድቅና አዳኝ ነው: ትሑትም ሆኖ በአህያይቱና በውርንጫይቱ ላይ ተቀምጦ ወደ አንቺ ይመጣል' ብሎ የሆሳዕናን ምሥጢር የተነበየ እርሱ ነው:: በ30 ብር መሸጡንም ተናግሯል:: በቅድስና ኑሮ ጥር 15 ቀን ዐርፏል::
ቅዱስ ጳፍኑቲዎስ ባሕታዊ፦ በበረሃ ተወስኖ በጾምና በጸሎት ያበራ አባት ነው::
ቅዱስ ጊዮርጊስ ገዳማዊ፦ በቅድስና ኑሮ ያረፈ ቅዱስ ሰው ነው::
የነቢዩ የቅዱስ ዘካርያስና የቅዱሳኑ ጸሎት ከሁላችን ጋር ይሁን::

en.verse: Rejoice greatly, O daughter of Zion! Shout, O daughter of Jerusalem! Behold, your King is coming to you; He is just and having salvation, lowly and riding on a donkey, a colt, the foal of a donkey.

am.verse: አንቺ የጽዮን ልጅ ሆይ፥ እጅግ ደስ ይበልሽ፤ አንቺ የኢየሩሳሌም ልጅ ሆይ፥ እልል በዪ፤ እነሆ፥ ንጉሥሽ ጻድቅና አዳኝ ነው፤ ትሑትም ሆኖ በአህያም፥ በአህያይቱም ግልገል በውርንጫይቱ ላይ ተቀምጦ ወደ አንቺ ይመጣል።

title.en: Kidane Mehret (The Great Feast of the Covenant of Mercy of Our Lady the Virgin Mary)
title.am: ታላቁ በዓለ ኪዳነ ምሕረት (እመቤታችን ከልጇ የይቅርታ ቃል ኪዳን የተቀበለችበት በዓል)

en: Kidane Mehret (Feast of the Covenant of Mercy Given by Christ to His Holy Mother at Golgotha)
St. Elizabeth Mother of St. John the Baptist
The Translation of the Relics of St. George
St. Menas the Monk
am: ኪዳነ ምሕረት (እመቤታችን በጎልጎታ ከልጇ የተቀበለችው ታላቁ የምሕረት ቃል ኪዳን)

en: Kidane Mehret (Covenant of Mercy)
The Righteous King Saint Kaleb
St. Mary Magdalene

Kidane Mehret (The Covenant of Mercy): On this glorious day, our Lord, God, and Savior Jesus Christ gave the solemn Covenant of Mercy (Kidane Mehret) to His Blessed Mother at Golgotha. Standing on the sacred place where He was crucified, our Lord appeared to her amidst celestial hosts and swore by His own Divinity: 'Whoever commemorates your name, feeds the hungry, clothes the naked, builds a church in your honor, or prays in your name with faith, I will forgive their sins and grant them the Kingdom of Heaven.' This feast is celebrated with unbounded spiritual ecstasy across the Ethiopian Church.

St. Elizabeth Mother of the Baptist: A righteous and blameless woman from the daughters of Aaron who, having lived in barrenness to old age, conceived by divine miracle the great Prophet John the Forerunner, resting peacefully on this day.
Translation of the Relics of St. George: The miraculous translation of the holy remains of the Megalomartyr George to his glorious sanctuary in Lydda.
The Covenant of Mercy fills the Church with eternal hope, assuring every repentant soul that the Mother of God stands as a tireless intercessor before her Son's throne.
am: ኪዳነ ምሕረት፦ እመቤታችን ቅድስት ድንግል ማርያም በጎልጎታ በልጇ መቃብር ላይ ቆማ ስትጸልይ ጌታችን ከመላእክቱ ጋር ተገልጦ 'የማይጠፋውን የምሕረት ቃል ኪዳን ሰጠሁሽ:: ስምሽን የጠራውን: መታሰቢያሽን ያደረገውን: በስምሽ የታረዘውን ያለበሰውን: የተራበውን ያበላውን: በስምሽ የተማጸነውን ሁሉ እምርልሻለሁ: መንግሥተ ሰማያትንም አወርሰዋለሁ' ብሎ በማይፈርስ መለኮታዊ ቃሉ ማለላት:: ይህ በዓል በኢትዮጵያ በታላቅ ደስታ ይከበራል::
ቅድስት ኤልሳቤጥ እመ መጥምቅ፦ ከካህናት ወገን የሆነች: ያለ ነቀፋ በእግዚአብሔር ፊት የኖረችና በስተእርጅናዋ መጥምቁ ዮሐንስን የወለደች ንጽሕት እናት ናት::
ፍልሠተ ሥጋሁ ለቅዱስ ጊዮርጊስ፦ የሊቀ ሰማዕታት የቅዱስ ጊዮርጊስ ቅዱስ ሥጋው ወደ ልዳ መቅደስ የፈለሰበት ታላቅ ዕለት ነው::
የእመቤታችን የኪዳነ ምሕረት አማላጅነት: የቅድስት ኤልሳቤጥና የቅዱስ ጊዮርጊስ ጸሎት ከሁላችን ጋር ይሁን::

en.verse: For He has regarded the lowly state of His maidservant; for behold, henceforth all generations will call me blessed. For He who is mighty has done great things for me, and holy is His name.

am.verse: የባሪያይቱን ውርደት ተመልክቶአልና። እነሆም፥ ከዛሬ ጀምሮ ትውልድ ሁሉ ብፅዕት ይሉኛል፤ ብርቱ የሆነ እርሱ በእኔ ታላቅ ሥራ አድርጎአልና፤ ስሙም ቅዱስ ነው።

title.en: St. Moses Head of the Prophets (The Lawgiver) and St. Menas the Martyr
title.am: ቅዱስ ሙሴ ሊቀ ነቢያት (ቀዳሜ ነቢያት) እና ቅዱስ ሚናስ ሰማዕት

en: St. Moses Head of the Prophets (Who Spoke with God Face to Face at Mount Sinai)
St. Menas the Soldier Martyr
St. Apollonia the Virgin Martyr
am: ቅዱስ ሙሴ ሊቀ ነቢያት (በደብረ ሲና ከእግዚአብሔር ጋር ፊት ለፊት የተነጋገረ)

en: St. Stephen Archdeacon and Protomartyr
St. James the Apostle Brother of John
St. Epiphanius Bishop of Cyprus
am: ቅዱስ እስጢፋኖስ ሊቀ ዲያቆናት ወቀዳሜ ሰማዕት

en: St. Moses Head of the Prophets: Born in Egypt during the Pharaoh's decree to slay Hebrew male infants, his mother hid him in an ark of bulrushes on the Nile, where Pharaoh's daughter found him.
