At eighty years of age, God called him from the burning bush on Mount Horeb. With the Rod of God, Moses led Israel out of Egypt, parting the Red Sea and drowning Pharaoh's army. At Sinai, he received the Tablets of the Ten Commandments written by the finger of God and spoke with the Lord face to face as a man speaks to his friend. At 120 years of age, having seen the Promised Land from Mount Nebo, he fell asleep, and God Himself buried his body in an undisclosed tomb.
St. Menas the Martyr: A noble Roman soldier who witnessed to Christ and was crowned with martyrdom.
St. Apollonia: A holy deaconess who gave her life in Alexandria during pagan persecution, keeping her virginity and faith unto death.
The divine intimacy of Moses reminds every believer to approach God with humble fear and holy reverence.
am: ቅዱስ ሙሴ ሊቀ ነቢያት፦ በግብጽ ባርነት ሳሉ የተወለደ: በፈርዖን ቤት በልዕልና ያደገ: ነገር ግን ከፈርዖን ልጅ መባል ይልቅ ከእግዚአብሔር ሕዝብ ጋር መከራን የመረጠ ታላቅ ነቢይ ነው:: በኮሬብ ተራራ ከእሳቱ ቁጥቋጦ እግዚአብሔር ጠርቶት ባሕረ ኤርትራን ከፍሎ እስራኤልን ከግብጽ አወጣ:: በደብረ ሲና ከእግዚአብሔር ጋር ፊት ለፊት ተነጋግሮ ዐሥርቱ ቃላትን ተቀበለ:: በ120 ዓመቱ በናባው ተራራ ላይ ሳለ በክብር ዐርፎ እግዚአብሔር ራሱ በምስጢር ቀብሮታል::
ቅዱስ ሚናስ ሰማዕት፦ ስለ ክርስቶስ ስም የተሰዋ ክቡር ወታደር ሰማዕት ነው::
ቅድስት አጶሎንያ ድንግል፦ በእስክንድርያ ስለ ክርስቶስ ስም መከራን ታግሣ በሰማዕትነት ያረፈች ንጽሕት ናት::
የሊቀ ነቢያት የቅዱስ ሙሴና የቅዱሳኑ ጸሎት ከሁላችን ጋር ይሁን::

en.verse: But since then there has not arisen in Israel a prophet like Moses, whom the Lord knew face to face, in all the signs and wonders which the Lord sent him to do in the land of Egypt, before Pharaoh, before all his servants, and in all his land.

am.verse: እግዚአብሔር ፊት ለፊት እንዳወቀው እንደ ሙሴ ያለ ነቢይ ከዚያ ወዲህ በእስራኤል ዘንድ አልተነሣም፤ በግብጽ ምድር በፈርዖንና በባሪያዎቹ ሁሉ በምድሩም ሁሉ ላይ ያደርገው ዘንድ እግዚአብሔር በላከው ምልክትና ድንቅ ሁሉ።

title.en: St. Melanius Patriarch of Antioch and St. Peter the Monk
title.am: ቅዱስ መላንዮስ ሊቀ ጳጳሳት ዘአንጾኪያ እና ቅዱስ ጴጥሮስ ገዳማዊ

en: St. Melanius Patriarch of Antioch (The Confessor who was Exiled Three Times for Orthodoxy)
St. Peter the Desert Father
St. Abraham the Ascetic
am: ቅዱስ መላንዮስ ሊቀ ጳጳሳት ዘአንጾኪያ (ስለ ቀናች ሃይማኖቱ ሦስት ጊዜ በስደት የተጋደለ)

en: St. Philip the Apostle
St. Titus the Apostle
Abba Eustathius the Ethiopian

St. Melanius Patriarch of Antioch: Consecrated Patriarch of Antioch in 361 A.D. A steadfast defender of the Council of Nicaea, he opposed Arian emperors who exiled him from his see three separate times. He presided over the early sessions of the Second Ecumenical Council in Constantinople in 381 A.D., where St. Gregory of Nyssa delivered his funeral oration, calling him 'a father, an apostle, and a champion of truth.' He fell asleep in Christ with celestial honors on Yekatit 18.
St. Peter the Monk: An Egyptian ascetic who conquered the passions through continuous prayer, silence, and fasting in the desert of Scetis.
St. Abraham: A devout monk commemorated for his humility and loving pastoral care of young ascetics.
The life of St. Melanius demonstrates that earthly exile and imperial persecution cannot extinguish the light of Orthodox truth.
am: ቅዱስ መላንዮስ ሊቀ ጳጳሳት ዘአንጾኪያ፦ በ361 ዓ/ም የአንጾኪያ ሊቀ ጳጳሳት ሆኖ የተሾመ: የኒቂያን ሃይማኖት በመደገፉ በአርዮሳውያን ነገሥታት ምክንያት ሦስት ጊዜ የተሰደደ ታላቅ አባት ነው:: በ381 ዓ/ም ሁለተኛውን የቁስጥንጥንያ ጉባኤ በሊቀ መንበርነት የመራ እርሱ ሲሆን በዚያው ጉባኤ ሳለ ጥር 18 ቀን በሰላም ዐርፏል:: ሊቃውንቱ ሁሉ በታላቅ ክብር ቀብረውታል::
ቅዱስ ጴጥሮስ ገዳማዊ፦ በአስቄጥስ በረሃ በጾምና በጸሎት የተጋደለ ቅዱስ አባት ነው::
ቅዱስ አብርሃም ባሕታዊ፦ በብሕትውና ያበራ ንጹሕ አባት ነው::
የቅዱስ መላንዮስና የቅዱሳኑ ጸሎት ከሁላችን ጋር ይሁን::

en.verse: I charge you therefore before God and the Lord Jesus Christ, who will judge the living and the dead at His appearing and His kingdom: Preach the word! Be ready in season and out of season. Convince, rebuke, exhort, with all longsuffering and teaching.

am.verse: በእግዚአብሔር ፊት በሕያዋንና በሙታንም ሊፈርድ ባለው በጌታ በኢየሱስ ክርስቶስ ፊት፥ በመገለጡና በመንግሥቱም እመሰክርብሃለሁ፤ ቃሉን ስበክ፥ በጊዜውም አለጊዜውም ጽና፥ ፈጽመህ እየታገሥህና እያስተማርህ፥ ዝለፍና ገሥጽ ምከርም።

title.en: Feast of St. Gabriel the Archangel and St. Maruta Bishop of Maypherqat
title.am: በዓለ ቅዱስ ገብርኤል ሊቀ መላእክት እና ቅዱስ ማሩታ ኤጲስ ቆጶስ ዘመይፈሪቃት

en: St. Gabriel the Archangel (Monthly Memorial of Good Tidings and Deliverance from Fire)
St. Maruta Bishop of Maypherqat (The Great Physician who Collected Relics of Persian Martyrs)
St. Joseph the Monk
am: ቅዱስ ገብርኤል ሊቀ መላእክት (የብሥራቱና ከእሳት የመታደጉ ወርኀዊ መታሰቢያ)
ቅዱስ ማሩታ ኤጲስ ቆጶስ ዘመይፈሪቃት (የፋርስ ሰማዕታትን አፅም የሰበሰበ ባለፈውስ)

en: St. Gabriel the Archangel
St. John of Burullus
Abune Sine Eyesus the Righteous

St. Gabriel the Archangel: Holy Church observes the monthly memorial of Archangel Gabriel, the Angel of Joy, who announced the glad tidings of Christ's Incarnation to the Holy Virgin Mary and delivered the Three Youths from the fiery furnace in Babylon. His prayers bring comfort, peace, and spiritual protection to the faithful.

St. Maruta Bishop of Maypherqat: A skilled physician and bishop from Mesopotamia. Sent as an ambassador to Persia, he healed the daughter of the Persian King Yazdegerd by prayer, winning religious tolerance for Persian Christians. He painstakingly searched out and gathered the scattered holy relics of thousands of Persian martyrs, building a magnificent martyrium city named Martyropolis (Maypherqat), falling asleep in peace.
St. Joseph the Monk: A devout desert father who struggled in quiet prayer and obedience.
The remembrance of Archangel Gabriel and St. Maruta inspires the Church to offer mercy, heal the afflicted, and honor the sacred relics of the martyrs.
am: ቅዱስ ገብርኤል ሊቀ መላእክት፦ ለድንግል ማርያም የምሥራች ያበሰረ: ሠለስቱ ደቂቅን ከሚነደው የእሳት እቶን ያዳነ ታላቅ መልአክ ሲሆን ቅድስት ቤተ ክርስቲያን ወርኀዊ መታሰቢያውን በታላቅ ደስታ ታከብራለች::
ቅዱስ ማሩታ ኤጲስ ቆጶስ ዘመይፈሪቃት፦ ሐኪምና ጳጳስ የነበረ: የፋርስን ንጉሥ ልጅ በጸሎቱ የፈወሰ አባት ነው:: በፋርስ የተሰዉትን የብዙ ሺህ ሰማዕታት አፅም ሰብስቦ 'መይፈሪቃት (የሰማዕታት ከተማ)' በምትባል ታላቅ ከተማ አሳርፏል:: ጥር 19 ቀን በሰላም ዐርፏል::
ቅዱስ ዮሴፍ ገዳማዊ፦ በበርሃ ተወስኖ በቅድስና የኖረ አባት ነው::
የቅዱስ ገብርኤልና የቅዱስ ማሩታ ጸሎት ከሁላችን ጋር ይሁን::

en.verse: And the angel answered and said to him, 'I am Gabriel, who stands in the presence of God, and was sent to speak to you and bring you these glad tidings.'

am.verse: መልአኩም መልሶ፦ እኔ በእግዚአብሔር ፊት የምቆመው ገብርኤል ነኝ፥ እንድናገርህም ይህችንም የምሥራች እንድሰብክልህ ተልኬ ነበር፤

title.en: St. Peter Patriarch of Alexandria and St. Basilides the Martyr
title.am: ቅዱስ ጴጥሮስ ሊቀ ጳጳሳት ዘእስክንድርያ እና ቅዱስ ፋሲለደስ ሰማዕት

en: St. Peter II the 21st Patriarch of Alexandria (Disciple of St. Athanasius)
St. Basilides the Martyr (Father of Holy Roman Martyrs)
St. Thecla the Nun
am: ቅዱስ ጴጥሮስ 21ኛው ሊቀ ጳጳሳት ዘእስክንድርያ (የቅዱስ አትናቴዎስ ደቀ መዝሙር)

en: Hennaze Maryam (Dedication of the Virgin's Church)
St. John Chrysostom
St. Thaddaeus the Apostle

St. Peter II Patriarch of Alexandria: Chosen by St. Athanasius the Apostolic as his successor to the throne of St. Mark in 373 A.D. Soon after his consecration, the Arian prefect ousted him, driving him into exile in Rome. While in Rome, Peter strengthened the communion between the Alexandrian and Roman sees in defense of the Nicene faith. Following the death of the Arian Emperor Valens, Peter returned triumphantly to Alexandria and guided his church with pastoral holiness until his peaceful departure on Yekatit 20.
St. Basilides: The father of numerous martyrs, an exalted nobleman who surrendered his rank to witness to Christ, martyred under Diocletian.
St. Thecla: A pious virgin who struggled in ascetic prayer, entering into eternal joy.
The pastoral resilience of St. Peter II reminds the Church that righteous shepherds stand firm against imperial oppression to protect their spiritual sheep.
am: ቅዱስ ጴጥሮስ ሊቀ ጳጳሳት ዘእስክንድርያ፦ ሐዋርያዊው ቅዱስ አትናቴዎስ ካረፈ በኋላ በእስክንድርያ 21ኛ ፓትርያርክ ሆኖ የተመረጠ ታላቅ አባት ነው:: አርዮሳውያን ከመንበሩ አባርረውት ወደ ሮም ተሰደደ:: በዚያም የቀናችውን ሃይማኖት ካጸና በኋላ ወደ መንበሩ ተመልሶ ምእመናንን በፍቅርና በትምህርት መርቷል:: ጥር 20 ቀን በሰላም ዐርፏል::
ቅዱስ ፋሲለደስ ሰማዕት፦ በርካታ የሰማዕታት ልጆች አባት: የክርስቶስን ስም በድፍረት የመሰከረ ክቡር ሰማዕት ነው::
ቅድስት ቴክላ ገዳማዊት፦ በጾምና በጸሎት ያበራች ንጽሕት እናት ናት::
የቅዱስ ጴጥሮስና የቅዱሳኑ ጸሎት ከሁላችን ጋር ይሁን::

en.verse: Shepherd the flock of God which is among you, serving as overseers, not by compulsion but willingly, not for dishonest gain but eagerly; and when the Chief Shepherd appears, you will receive the crown of glory that does not fade away.

am.verse: በእናንተ ዘንድ ያለውን የእግዚአብሔርን መንጋ ጠብቁ፤ በውድ እንጂ በግድ ሳይሆን፥ በበጎ ፈቃድ እንጂ መጥፎውን ረብ በመመኘት ሳይሆን ጎብኙት፤ የእረኞችም አለቃ በሚገለጥበት ጊዜ የማያልፈውን የክብርን አክሊል ትቀበላላችሁ።

title.en: Feast of our Lady Mary the Holy Theotokos and St. Onesimus the Apostle
title.am: በዓለ እግዝእትነ ማርያም ድንግል ወላዲተ አምላክ እና ቅዱስ አናሲሞስ ሐዋርያ

en: Monthly Commemoration of our Lady Mary the Holy Theotokos
St. Onesimus the Apostle (Spiritual Son of St. Paul and Bishop of Ephesus)
St. Gabriel the Martyr
am: ወርኀዊ መታሰቢያ ለእግዝእትነ ማርያም ድንግል ወላዲተ አምላክ
ቅዱስ አናሲሞስ ሐዋርያ (የቅዱስ ጳውሎስ መንፈሳዊ ልጅ: ኤጲስ ቆጶስ ዘኤፌሶን)

en: Our Lady Mary the Holy Theotokos
The Twelve Apostles
St. Cyprian the Martyr

Monthly Feast of the Holy Theotokos: Holy Church commemorates the boundless grace, purity, and maternal mediation of the Holy Virgin Mary. Through her free assent at the Annunciation, salvation entered the world. Believers invoke her name across all Ethiopian sanctuaries, chanting Weddase Maryam and seeking her maternal blessing.

St. Onesimus the Apostle: Formerly a runaway slave of Philemon in Colossae, Onesimus met St. Paul while the apostle was imprisoned in Rome. Converted and baptized, Paul called him 'my son Onesimus, whom I have begotten while in my chains.' Paul sent him back to Philemon 'no longer as a slave, but more than a slave—a beloved brother.' Later consecrated bishop, he succeeded Timothy in Ephesus, preaching Christ until he was martyred by stoning in Rome.
St. Gabriel the Martyr: A devout Christian who endured cruel tortures for Christ, crowned on this day.
The life of Onesimus illustrates the radical transforming power of Christ, elevating a runaway servant into an apostolic hierarch and holy martyr.
am: ወርኀዊ መታሰቢያ ለእግዝእትነ ማርያም፦ ቅድስት ቤተ ክርስቲያን የእመቤታችንን ንጽሕና: ቅድስናና አማላጅነት በታላቅ ደስታ ታስባለች:: ድንግል ማርያም የድኅነታችን መጀመሪያና የሰው ልጆች ሁሉ እናት ናት::
ቅዱስ አናሲሞስ ሐዋርያ፦ የቀሌሞና ባሪያ የነበረ ሲሆን ሸሽቶ ወደ ሮም ሄደ:: በዚያም በወኅኒ ሳለ ከቅዱስ ጳውሎስ ጋር ተገናኝቶ አመነ:: ቅዱስ ጳውሎስ 'በእስራቴ የወለድሁት ልጄ' ብሎ ጠርቶታል:: በኋላም ኤጲስ ቆጶስ ሆኖ ተሹሞ ወንጌልን በታማኝነት ከሰበከ በኋላ በሮም በድንጋይ ተወግሮ ሰማዕትነቱን ፈጽሟል::
ቅዱስ ገብርኤል ሰማዕት፦ ስለ ክርስቶስ ስም መከራን ታግሦ ያረፈ ሰማዕት ነው::
የእመቤታችን የድንግል ማርያምና የቅዱስ አናሲሞስ ጸሎት ከሁላችን ጋር ይሁን::

en.verse: I appeal to you for my son Onesimus, whom I have begotten while in my chains, who once was unprofitable to you, but now is profitable to you and to me... no longer as a slave but more than a slave—a beloved brother.

am.verse: በእስራቴ የወለድሁትን ልጄን አናሲሞስን እለምንሃለሁ፤ ቀድሞ ያልጠቀመህን፥ አሁን ግን ለእኔም ለአንተም የሚጠቅመውን... ከእንግዲህ ወዲህ እንደ ባሪያ ሳይሆን፥ ከባሪያ የሚሻል የተወደደ ወንድም ነው።

title.en: St. Marutha the Ascetic and St. Matthew the Hermit
title.am: ቅዱስ ማርታ ገዳማዊ እና ቅዱስ ማቴዎስ ባሕታዊ

en: St. Marutha the Syrian Solitary (The Anchorite of Mount Lebanon)
St. Matthew the Hermit of Upper Egypt
St. Luke the Deacon
am: ቅዱስ ማርታ ሶርያዊ ባሕታዊ (በሊባኖስ ተራራ የተጋደለ)

en: St. Uriel the Archangel
Abba Anthony the Great
St. Luke the Evangelist

St. Marutha the Syrian: A holy anchorite who fled human praise and settled in the rugged mountains of Lebanon. Clothed in coarse haircloth, he spent decades in tears and continuous contemplation of the Passion of our Lord. He subsisted on wild herbs, taming wild beasts by the Sign of the Cross and healing all who came to him with afflictions, departing peacefully on Yekatit 22.
St. Matthew the Hermit: An Egyptian solitary of Upper Egypt who practiced extraordinary vigilance, fasting for days at a time and working wonders through prayer before his holy departure.
St. Luke the Deacon: A devout server at the altar commemorated for his fidelity and prayer.
The austere striving of Marutha and Matthew reminds Christians to cultivate interior silence and pure prayer amid worldly turbulence.
am: ቅዱስ ማርታ ሶርያዊ፦ በሊባኖስ ተራራ ብቻውን በብሕትውና የኖረ: ሌሊትና ቀን ሳይተኛ በጸሎት ያበራ ታላቅ አባት ነው:: የዱር አራዊትን በመስቀል ምልክት እያረጋጋ: ለብዙ ዓመታት በጾምና በጸሎት ተወስኖ ጥር 22 ቀን በሰላም ዐርፏል::
ቅዱስ ማቴዎስ ገዳማዊ፦ በላይኛው ግብጽ በረሃ በታላቅ ተጋድሎ የኖረ ጻድቅ አባት ነው::
ቅዱስ ሉቃስ ዲያቆን፦ መቅደሱን በቅድስና ያገለገለ ቅዱስ ሰው ነው::
የቅዱስ ማርታና የቅዱስ ማቴዎስ ጸሎት ከሁላችን ጋር ይሁን::

en.verse: They wandered about in sheepskins and goatskins, being destitute, afflicted, tormented—of whom the world was not worthy. They wandered in deserts and mountains, in dens and caves of the earth.

am.verse: የበግና የፍየል ሌጦ ለብሰው ዞሩ፤ ተጨነቁ፥ መከራን ተቀበሉ፥ በጭንቀትም ኖሩ፤ ዓለም አልተገባቸውምና በምድረ በዳና በተራራ፥ በዋሻና በምድር ጉድጓድ ተቅበዘበዙ።

title.en: St. Eusebius the Roman Martyr and St. Peter the Hermit
title.am: ቅዱስ አውሳብዮስ ሰማዕት ዘሮሜ እና ቅዱስ ጴጥሮስ ባሕታዊ

en: St. Eusebius the Roman Martyr (Son of Basilides the Prime Minister)
St. Peter the Desert Father
St. Mary the Virgin Martyr
am: ቅዱስ አውሳብዮስ ሰማዕት ዘሮሜ (የመልአከ ሮም የፋሲለደስ ልጅ)

en: St. George the Megalomartyr
Abba Longinus the Hermit
St. Marina the Martyr

St. Eusebius the Roman Martyr: The son of Basilides, minister of Rome. When Diocletian apostatized and demanded Christian soldiers sacrifice to idols, Eusebius refused, declaring his sole allegiance to Jesus Christ. Banished to Upper Egypt, he was subjected to excruciating torments: torn with iron rakes, cast into blazing ovens, and pierced with javelins, but the Archangel Michael preserved him. Finally beheaded on Yekatit 23, he received the victor's crown of martyrdom.
St. Peter the Hermit: A holy solitary who dwelt in caves, spending decades in tearful repentance and continuous prayer for the world.
St. Mary the Martyr: Commemorated for her pure virginity and courageous confession under pagan persecution.
The martyrdom of St. Eusebius inspires all believers to remain steadfast soldiers of Christ, valuing eternal life far above earthly status and royal honors.
am: ቅዱስ አውሳብዮስ ሰማዕት ዘሮሜ፦ የሮም መኳንንት አለቃ የነበረው የፋሲለደስ ልጅ ሲሆን በዲዮቅልጥያኖስ ፊት በድፍረት ክርስቶስን መሰከረ:: ወደ ላይኛው ግብጽ ተግዞ በሚነድድ እቶንና በስለት ተሰቃይቶ በመጨረሻ አንገቱን ለሰይፍ ሰጥቶ ሰማዕትነቱን ፈጽሟል::
ቅዱስ ጴጥሮስ ባሕታዊ፦ በበረሃ ተወስኖ በጾምና በጸሎት ያበራ አባት ነው::
ቅድስት ማርያም ሰማዕት፦ ስለ ክርስቶስ ስም ሰማዕትነትን የተቀበለች ንጽሕት ናት::
የቅዱስ አውሳብዮስና የቅዱሳኑ ጸሎት ከሁላችን ጋር ይሁን::

en.verse: And do not fear those who kill the body but cannot kill the soul. But rather fear Him who is able to destroy both soul and body in hell.

am.verse: ሥጋንም የሚገድሉትን ነፍስን ግን መግደል የማይቻላቸውን አትፍሩ፤ ይልቁንም ነፍስንም ሥጋንም በገሃነም ሊያጠፋ የሚቻለውን ፍሩ።

title.en: St. Agapitus the Wonderworking Bishop and St. Matthew the Ascetic
title.am: ቅዱስ አጋፒቶስ ኤጲስ ቆጶስ ባለታላቅ ተአምር እና ቅዱስ ማቴዎስ ገዳማዊ

en: St. Agapitus the Bishop and Wonderworker (Who Raised the Dead and Tamed Wild Beasts)
St. Matthew the Ascetic
St. Timothy the Confessor
am: ቅዱስ አጋፒቶስ ኤጲስ ቆጶስ ባለታላቅ ተአምር (ሙታንን ያስነሳ: አራዊትን ያገረሰ)

en: Abune Tekle Haymanot (Sun of Shoa)
St. Thomas the Apostle
St. John the Baptist

St. Agapitus the Wonderworking Bishop: Born in Phrygia to pious Christian parents, he entered monastic life in his youth. When Licinius launched persecution, Agapitus was arrested and subjected to torture, surviving unharmed by divine power. Under Emperor Constantine the Great, he was consecrated Bishop of Synnada. God granted him extraordinary gifts: he raised the dead, opened the eyes of the blind, caused springs of fresh water to gush forth, and tamed savage lions and bears with the Sign of the Cross, falling asleep peacefully in Christ on Yekatit 24.
St. Matthew the Ascetic: A desert father who spent fifty years in monastic solitude and fervent prayer.
St. Timothy the Confessor: Commemorated for his steadfast endurance in defending the true Orthodox faith.
The life of St. Agapitus testifies to the supernatural grace given by Christ to those who preserve purity of heart and unwavering faith.
am: ቅዱስ አጋፒቶስ ኤጲስ ቆጶስ ባለታላቅ ተአምር፦ በትንሽ እስያ በፍርግያ የተወለደ: ገና በወጣትነቱ አመንኩሶ በታላቅ ተጋድሎ የኖረ አባት ነው:: በሰማዕትነት ዘመን ብዙ መከራን ታግሦ ድል ነሣ:: የሲናዳ ኤጲስ ቆጶስ ሆኖ ከተሾመ በኋላ እግዚአብሔር ታላቅ የተአምራት ጸጋ ሰጠው:: ሙታንን አስነስቷል: ዕውሮችን አብርቷል: አራዊትን በመስቀል ምልክት አገርስቷል:: ጥር 24 ቀን በሰላም ዐርፏል::
ቅዱስ ማቴዎስ ገዳማዊ፦ ለ50 ዓመታት በበረሃ በብሕትውና የኖረ ጻድቅ አባት ነው::
ቅዱስ ጢሞቴዎስ ምእመን፦ ሃይማኖቱን በጽናት የጠበቀ ቅዱስ ሰው ነው::
የቅዱስ አጋፒቶስና የቅዱሳኑ ጸሎት ከሁላችን ጋር ይሁን::

en.verse: Heal the sick, cleanse the lepers, raise the dead, cast out demons. Freely you have received, freely give.

am.verse: ድውዮችን ፈውሱ፤ ሙታንን አስነሡ፤ ለምጻሞችን አንጹ፤ አጋንንትን አውጡ፤ በከንቱ ተቀበላችሁ፥ በከንቱ ስጡ።

title.en: St. Onesiphorus the Apostle and Martyr and St. Porphyry the Ascetic
title.am: ቅዱስ አናሲፎሮስ ሐዋርያ ወሰማዕት እና ቅዱስ ፎርፊርዮስ ገዳማዊ

en: St. Onesiphorus the Apostle and Martyr (Beloved Companion of St. Paul who Refreshed Him in Prison)
St. Porphyry the Ascetic of Gaza
St. Titus the Deacon
am: ቅዱስ አናሲፎሮስ ሐዋርያ ወሰማዕት (ቅዱስ ጳውሎስን በወኅኒ ያጽናና ታማኝ ደቀ መዝሙር)

en: St. Mercurius the Martyr
St. James the Apostle
St. Abanob the Child Martyr

St. Onesiphorus the Apostle and Martyr: Numbered among the seventy-two disciples sent by Christ. When the Apostle Paul was imprisoned in chains in Rome, when others deserted him, Onesiphorus searched diligently for Paul until he found him, refreshing him and not being ashamed of his chains. Paul prayed for him in his Epistle: 'The Lord grant mercy to the household of Onesiphorus, for he often refreshed me.' Later, Onesiphorus was consecrated Bishop of Colophon, boldly proclaiming the Gospel until he was tied to wild horses by pagan persecutors and crowned with martyrdom on Yekatit 25.
St. Porphyry the Ascetic: A holy elder who spent years in desert prayer before becoming a shepherd of souls in Gaza.
St. Titus the Deacon: Remembered for his faithful service at the holy altar.
The loyal devotion of Onesiphorus teaches Christians to visit and comfort the sick, imprisoned, and persecuted with fearless brotherly love.
am: ቅዱስ አናሲፎሮስ ሐዋርያ ወሰማዕት፦ ከ72ቱ አርድእት አንዱ ሲሆን ቅዱስ ጳውሎስ በሮም በወኅኒ ታስሮ ሳለ ሁሉም ሲሸሹ እርሱ ግን ፈልጎ አግኝቶት አጽናንቶታል:: ቅዱስ ጳውሎስ በመልእክቱ 'ጌታ ለአናሲፎሮስ ቤተ ሰዎች ምሕረትን ይስጥ: ብዙ ጊዜ አሳርፎኛልና: በሰንሰለቴም አላፈረበትምና' ብሎ ጸልዮለታል:: በኋላም በቆሎፎን ኤጲስ ቆጶስ ሆኖ ሲያስተምር አረማውያን በዱር ፈረሶች አስረው ጎትተውት በሰማዕትነት ዐርፏል::
ቅዱስ ፎርፊርዮስ ገዳማዊ ዘጋዛ፦ በበርሃ ተወስኖ በጾምና በጸሎት ያበራ አባት ነው::
ቅዱስ ቲቶ ዲያቆን፦ መቅደሱን በታማኝነት ያገለገለ ቅዱስ ሰው ነው::
የቅዱስ አናሲፎሮስና የቅዱሳኑ ጸሎት ከሁላችን ጋር ይሁን::

en.verse: The Lord grant mercy to the household of Onesiphorus, for he often refreshed me, and was not ashamed of my chain... The Lord grant to him that he may find mercy from the Lord in that Day.

am.verse: ጌታ ለአናሲፎሮስ ቤተ ሰዎች ምሕረትን ይስጥ፥ ብዙ ጊዜ አሳርፎኛልና፥ በሰንሰለቴም አላፈረበትም፤ ... ጌታ በዚያ ቀን ከጌታ ዘንድ ምሕረትን እንዲያገኝ ይስጠው።

title.en: St. Hosea the Prophet and St. Sadok with the 128 Martyrs of Persia
title.am: ቅዱስ ሆሴዕ ነቢይ እና ቅዱስ ሳዶቅ ወ128 ሰማዕታት ዘፋርስ

en: St. Hosea the Prophet (Son of Beeri, who Prophesied Christ's Third-Day Resurrection)
St. Sadok Metropolitan of Persia and the 128 Holy Martyrs (Beheaded by Shapur II)
St. Justus the Ascetic
am: ቅዱስ ሆሴዕ ነቢይ (ወልደ ብኤሪ: የጌታችንን የሦስተኛ ቀን ትንሣኤ የተነበየ)
ቅዱስ ሳዶቅ ሊቀ ጳጳሳት ዘፋርስ እና 128ቱ ሰማዕታት (በንጉሥ ሳፖር የተሰዉ)

en: St. Thomas the Apostle
St. Timothy the Apostle
Abba Bishoy the Ascetic

St. Hosea the Prophet: Son of Beeri, of the tribe of Issachar, who prophesied in Israel for more than sixty years. By divine command, his marriage mirrored God's steadfast, unmerited love for unfaithful humanity. He prophesied the Resurrection of Christ on the third day: 'After two days He will revive us; on the third day He will raise us up, that we may live in His sight.' He entered into eternal rest on Yekatit 26.

St. Sadok and the 128 Martyrs of Persia: Bishop Sadok succeeded St. Simeon bar Sabba'e in Persia. When King Shapur II launched a brutal persecution against Christians, Sadok and one hundred and twenty-eight priests, deacons, and virgins were arrested. Offered freedom if they worshipped the sun, they replied: 'We worship Christ, the Creator of the sun.' They were beheaded together, receiving eternal celestial crowns.
St. Justus: A devout hermit who dedicated his life to fasting and prayer in the desert.
The prophecy of Hosea and the courage of Sadok call all believers to steadfast repentance and fearless love for Christ.
am: ቅዱስ ሆሴዕ ነቢይ፦ ከ12ቱ ደቂቀ ነቢያት አንዱ ሲሆን ከ60 ዓመታት በላይ ትንቢት ተናግሯል:: የእግዚአብሔርን ታላቅ ምሕረትና ፍቅር የሰበከ ሲሆን የጌታችንን የሦስተኛ ቀን ትንሣኤ 'ከሁለት ቀን በኋላ ያድነናል: በሦስተኛውም ቀን ያስነሣናል: በፊቱም በሕይወት እንኖራለን' ብሎ ትንቢት ተናግሯል:: በቅድስና ኑሮ ጥር 26 ቀን ዐርፏል::

ቅዱስ ሳዶቅ ወ128 ሰማዕታት ዘፋርስ፦ በፋርስ ምድር የክርስቲያኖች መሪ የነበረ ሲሆን የፋርስ ንጉሥ ፀሐይን እንዲያመልኩ ቢያስገድዳቸው 'እኛ ፀሐይን የፈጠረውን ክርስቶስን እናመልካለን' ብለው መሰከሩ:: 128ቱ ካህናትና ዲያቆናት ከአባታቸው ከሳዶቅ ጋር አንገታቸውን በሰይፍ ተቆርጠው የሰማዕትነት አክሊል ተቀብለዋል::
ቅዱስ ዮስጦስ ገዳማዊ፦ በበርሃ ተወስኖ በጾምና በጸሎት ያበራ አባት ነው::
የነቢዩ የቅዱስ ሆሴዕ: የቅዱስ ሳዶቅና የሰማዕታቱ ጸሎት ከሁላችን ጋር ይሁን::

en.verse: Come, and let us return to the Lord; for He has torn, but He will heal us; He has stricken, but He will bind us up. After two days He will revive us; on the third day He will raise us up, that we may live in His sight.

am.verse: ኑ፥ ወደ እግዚአብሔር እንመለስ፤ እርሱ ሰብሮናልና፥ እርሱም ይፈውሰናል፤ እርሱ መትቶናል፥ እርሱም ይጠግነናል። ከሁለት ቀን በኋላ ያድነናል፤ በሦስተኛውም ቀን ያስነሣናል፥ በፊቱም በሕይወት እንኖራለን።

title.en: St. Eustathius Patriarch of Antioch (Champion of Nicaea) and St. John the Monk
title.am: ቅዱስ ኤዎስጣቴዎስ ሊቀ ጳጳሳት ዘአንጾኪያ (የኒቂያ ኃያል አባት) እና ቅዱስ ዮሐንስ ገዳማዊ

en: St. Eustathius Patriarch of Antioch (One of the Leaders of the Council of Nicaea, Exiled by Arians)
St. John the Solitary Desert Father
St. Martha the Righteous Maiden
am: ቅዱስ ኤዎስጣቴዎስ ሊቀ ጳጳሳት ዘአንጾኪያ (በኒቂያ ጉባኤ ከአርዮስ ጋር የተከራከረ ታላቅ ሊቅ)

en: St. Suriel the Archangel
Medhane Alem (Savior of the World)
St. Victor the Martyr

St. Eustathius Patriarch of Antioch: Consecrated Bishop of Beroea and later Patriarch of Antioch in 324 A.D. At the First Ecumenical Council of Nicaea (325 A.D.), he played a preeminent role alongside St. Athanasius in refuting Arius and defining the consubstantiality (Homoousios) of the Son with the Father. The Arians fabricated false moral accusations against him and had him exiled to Thrace, where he continued writing treatises strengthening the faithful until his holy departure on Yekatit 27.
St. John the Solitary: A dedicated desert hermit who attained perfection in prayer, silence, and obedience.
St. Martha: A pious woman commemorated for her charitable deeds and devotion to Christ.
The life of St. Eustathius demonstrates the glory of suffering for Orthodox dogma, proving that truth outlives every slanderous falsehood.
am: ቅዱስ ኤዎስጣቴዎስ ሊቀ ጳጳሳት ዘአንጾኪያ፦ በ325 ዓ/ም በኒቂያ ጉባኤ ከቅዱስ አትናቴዎስ ጋር በመሆን አርዮስን በክርክር ያሳፈረ: ወልድ ከአብ ጋር በመለኮት አንድ መሆኑን የመሰከረ ታላቅ አባት ነው:: አርዮሳውያን በሐሰት ከሰው ወደ ትሬስ አሰደዱት:: በስደት ሳለ በርካታ ድርሳናትን እየጻፈ ምእመናንን አጽንቶ ጥር 27 ቀን በሰላም ዐርፏል::
ቅዱስ ዮሐንስ ባሕታዊ፦ በበረሃ ተወስኖ በጸሎት ያበራ ጻድቅ አባት ነው::
ቅድስት ማርታ ጻድቅ፦ በበጎ ምግባር ያጌጠች ንጽሕት እናት ናት::
የቅዱስ ኤዎስጣቴዎስና የቅዱሳኑ ጸሎት ከሁላችን ጋር ይሁን::

en.verse: Beloved, while I was very diligent to write to you concerning our common salvation, I found it necessary to write to you exhorting you to contend earnestly for the faith which was once for all delivered to the saints.

am.verse: ወዳጆች ሆይ፥ ስለምንካፈለው ስለ መዳናችን ልጽፍላችሁ እጅግ ተግቼ ሳለሁ፥ ለቅዱሳን አንድ ጊዜ ፈጽሞ ስለ ተሰጠ ሃይማኖት እንድትጋደሉ እየመከርኋችሁ እጽፍላችሁ ዘንድ ግድ ሆነብኝ።

title.en: St. Theodore the Roman Martyr and St. Alexander Bishop of Alexandria
title.am: ቅዱስ ቴዎድሮስ ሮማዊ ሰማዕት እና ቅዱስ እስክንድሮስ ሊቀ ጳጳሳት ዘእስክንድርያ

en: St. Theodore the Roman Martyr (Commander who Stood Against Maximian)
St. Alexander the 19th Patriarch of Alexandria (Who Excommunicated Arius)
St. George the Monk
am: ቅዱስ ቴዎድሮስ ሮማዊ ሰማዕት (በመክሲሚያኖስ ፊት በድፍረት የቆመ የጦር አለቃ)
ቅዱስ እስክንድሮስ 19ኛው ሊቀ ጳጳሳት ዘእስክንድርያ (አርዮስን ያወገዘ አባት)

en: Feast of Emmanuel (God with Us)
St. Clement the Martyr
St. Abraham the Patriarch

St. Theodore the Roman Martyr: A distinguished general in the Roman army during the reign of Maximian. When commanded to burn incense to idols, Theodore boldly proclaimed his faith in Jesus Christ, the King of kings. Handed over to harsh torturers, he was hung on a post, scraped with iron hooks, and plunged into fire, but divine power shielded him. He was finally beheaded on Yekatit 28, receiving the incorruptible crown of martyrdom.

St. Alexander Patriarch of Alexandria: The 19th Patriarch of Alexandria who originally detected and condemned the heresy of Arius, bringing St. Athanasius to the Council of Nicaea (325 A.D.) and defending the co-equality of the Son.
St. George the Monk: A humble elder who lived in desert fasting and prayer, resting in peace.
The steadfast confession of Theodore and Alexander inspires the faithful to defend the faith without fear of temporal punishment.
am: ቅዱስ ቴዎድሮስ ሮማዊ ሰማዕት፦ በመክሲሚያኖስ ዘመን የነበረ ታላቅ የሮም ጦር መሪ ሲሆን ክርስቶስን በድፍረት በመመስከሩ ጣዖት እንዲያመልክ ታዘዘ:: እምቢ በማለቱ በብረት መቧጠጫ ተቦጭቆ: በእሳት ውስጥ ተጥሎ በመጨረሻ አንገቱን ለሰይፍ ሰጥቶ የሰማዕትነት አክሊል ተቀብሏል::
ቅዱስ እስክንድሮስ ሊቀ ጳጳሳት ዘእስክንድርያ፦ 19ኛው የእስክንድርያ ፓትርያርክ ሲሆን አርዮስን ያወገዘ: ቅዱስ አትናቴዎስን ለኒቂያ ጉባኤ ያዘጋጀ ታላቅ የቤተ ክርስቲያን አባት ነው::
ቅዱስ ጊዮርጊስ ገዳማዊ፦ በበርሃ ተወስኖ በቅድስና ያረፈ አባት ነው::
የቅዱስ ቴዎድሮስና የቅዱስ እስክንድሮስ ጸሎት ከሁላችን ጋር ይሁን::

en.verse: I beseech you therefore, brethren, by the mercies of God, that you present your bodies a living sacrifice, holy, acceptable to God, which is your reasonable service.

am.verse: እንግዲህ፥ ወንድሞች ሆይ፥ ሰውነታችሁን እግዚአብሔርን ደስ የሚያሰኝና ሕያው ቅዱስም መሥዋዕት አድርጋችሁ ታቀርቡ ዘንድ በእግዚአብሔር ርኅራኄ እለምናችኋለሁ፥ እርሱም ለአእምሮ የሚመች አገልግሎታችሁ ነው።

title.en: St. Polycarp Bishop of Smyrna (Apostolic Father) and St. Feqerte Kristos the Ethiopian Righteous Mother
title.am: ቅዱስ ፖሊካርፐስ ኤጲስ ቆጶስ ዘሰሚርና እና ቅድስት ፍቅርተ ክርስቶስ ኢትዮጵያዊት ጻድቅ

en: St. Polycarp Bishop of Smyrna (Disciple of St. John the Apostle, Burnt at the Stake)
St. Feqerte Kristos the Ethiopian Righteous Mother (Great Ascetic of Lake Tana)
St. Peter the Martyr
am: ቅዱስ ፖሊካርፐስ ኤጲስ ቆጶስ ዘሰሚርና (የወንጌላዊው ቅዱስ ዮሐንስ ደቀ መዝሙር: በእሳት የተሰዋ ሰማዕት)
ቅድስት ፍቅርተ ክርስቶስ ኢትዮጵያዊት ጻድቅ (በጣና ሐይቅ በታላቅ ተጋድሎ የኖረች እናት)

en: Ba'ale Wold (Feast of the Son of God, Holy Incarnation)
Birth of our Lord Jesus Christ
St. Peter the Apostle

St. Polycarp Bishop of Smyrna: Consecrated Bishop of Smyrna by the Apostle John himself. When arrested at age eighty-six during Roman persecution, the proconsul urged him to revile Christ and save his life. Polycarp answered with famous courage: 'Eighty-six years have I served Him, and He never did me any wrong; how then can I blaspheme my King and Savior?' When cast into the flames, the fire arched around his body like a ship's sail without burning him; a soldier then stabbed him with a dagger, his blood extinguishing the blaze as his soul entered heavenly triumph.

St. Feqerte Kristos: A glorious Ethiopian righteous mother who lived near Lake Tana. Dedicated to continuous fasting, prayer, and contemplation of the Crucified Lord, she attained sublime heights of sanctity and performed numerous miracles before her peaceful falling asleep on Yekatit 29.
St. Peter the Martyr: A faithful Christian who yielded his life rather than worship idols.
The glorious confession of St. Polycarp and St. Feqerte Kristos inspires all generations to love Christ unto death.
am: ቅዱስ ፖሊካርፐስ ኤጲስ ቆጶስ ዘሰሚርና፦ በወንጌላዊው ዮሐንስ እጅ ኤጲስ ቆጶስነት የተሾመ: ሐዋርያዊ አባት ነው:: በ86 ዓመቱ አረማውያን ይዘውት ክርስቶስን እንዲሰድብ ሲጠይቁት 'ለ86 ዓመታት አገለገልሁት: እርሱ አንዳች አልበደለኝም፤ ታዲያ እንዴት ንጉሤንና መድኃኒቴን እሳደባለሁ?' ሲል መለሰ:: በእሳት ውስጥ ቢጥሉትም እሳቱ እንደ መርከብ ሸራ ከቦት ሳይቃጠል ቀረ:: በመጨረሻም በሰይፍ ወግተው ገደሉት:: ጥር 29 ቀን የሰማዕትነት አክሊል ተቀብሏል::
ቅድስት ፍቅርተ ክርስቶስ ኢትዮጵያዊት ጻድቅ፦ በጣና ሐይቅ አካባቢ በታላቅ ተጋድሎ: በጾምና በጸሎት የኖረች: እግዚአብሔር በርካታ ድንቆችን በእጇ የፈጸመላት ታላቅ እናት ስትሆን በዚህች ዕለት በሰላም ዐርፋለች::
ቅዱስ ጴጥሮስ ሰማዕት፦ ስለ እውነተኛይቱ ሃይማኖት ደሙን ያፈሰሰ ሰማዕት ነው::
የቅዱስ ፖሊካርፐስና የእናታችን የቅድስት ፍቅርተ ክርስቶስ ጸሎት ከሁላችን ጋር ይሁን::

en.verse: Do not fear any of those things which you are about to suffer. Indeed, the devil is about to throw some of you into prison, that you may be tested... Be faithful until death, and I will give you the crown of life.

am.verse: ልትቀበለው ያለህን መከራ አትፍራ። እነሆ፥ እንድትፈተኑ ዲያብሎስ ከእናንተ አንዳንዶቹን በወኅኒ ሊጥላችሁ አለው፤ ... እስከ ሞት ድረስ የታመንህ ሁን የሕይወትንም አክሊል እሰጥሃለሁ።

title.en: The Discovery of the Sacred Head of St. John the Baptist (Rekbete Re'esu)
title.am: ረክበተ ርእሱ ለቅዱስ ዮሐንስ መጥምቀ መለኮት (የከበረ ራሱ የተገኘበት በዓል)

en: The Finding of the Sacred Head of St. John the Baptist and Forerunner (Rekbete Re'esu)
St. George the Monk
St. Nicholas the Confessor
am: ረክበተ ርእሱ ለቅዱስ ዮሐንስ መጥምቀ መለኮት (በኤሜሳ ምድር የከበረ ራሱ በድንቅ የተገኘበት በዓል)

en: St. Mark the Apostle and Evangelist
St. John the Baptist
St. Theodore the General

The Finding of the Sacred Head of St. John the Baptist: After Herod Antipas ordered the beheading of the great Prophet and Forerunner John, Herodias hid his sacred head in a secret vessel near Herod's palace. Years later, two pious monks who traveled to Jerusalem were revealed the location of the holy relic in a divine vision. Excavating the site, they discovered the sacred head enclosed in a jar, emitting heavenly fragrance and working countless miraculous healings. The precious relic was brought to Emesa and enshrined with great reverence. The feast of Rekbete Re'esu is celebrated with high praise on Yekatit 30.
St. George the Monk: An ascetic father who lived in desert solitude and continuous prayer, entering into eternal rest.
St. Nicholas the Confessor: A faithful confessor of Christ commemorated for his virtue and defense of the truth.
On this closing day of Yekatit, Holy Church gives thanks to God for the glorious lives and intercessions of all the saints who adorned this month.
am: ረክበተ ርእሱ ለቅዱስ ዮሐንስ መጥምቅ፦ ሄሮድስ የታላቁን ነቢይ የቅዱስ ዮሐንስን ራስ ባስቆረጠ ጊዜ ሄሮድያዳ ራሱን በድብቅ በሸክላ ዕቃ አድርጋ በቤተ መንግሥት አቅራቢያ ቀበረችው:: ከዓመታት በኋላ ሁለት መነኮሳት ወደ ኢየሩሳሌም ሲሄዱ በራእይ ተገልጦላቸው ራሱ የተቀበረበትን ቦታ አገኙ:: የከበረው ራስ እጅግ ጣፋጭ መዓዛን እያወጣ በርካታ ድውያንን ፈወሰ:: ወደ ኤሜሳ ከተማ ተወስዶ በታላቅ ክብር ተቀምጧል:: ይህ በዓል 'ረክበተ ርእስ' ተብሎ በየካቲት 30 በደስታ ይከበራል::
ቅዱስ ጊዮርጊስ ገዳማዊ፦ በበርሃ ተወስኖ በቅድስና ያረፈ አባት ነው::
ቅዱስ ኒቆላዎስ ምእመን፦ ሃይማኖቱን የጠበቀ ቅዱስ ሰው ነው::
በዚህች በየካቲት ወር የመጨረሻ ዕለት ቅድስት ቤተ ክርስቲያን የመጥምቁ ዮሐንስንና የቅዱሳኑን ሁሉ በረከት ትቀበላለች::

en.verse: Assuredly, I say to you, among those born of women there has not risen one greater than John the Baptist; but he who is least in the kingdom of heaven is greater than he.

am.verse: እውነት እላችኋለሁ፥ ከሴቶች ከተወለዱት መካከል ከመጥምቁ ዮሐንስ የሚበልጥ አልተነሣም፤ በመንግሥተ ሰማያት ግን ከሁሉ የሚያንሰው ይበልጠዋል።

title.en: Beginning of the Second Half of the Year, St. Barkisios the Bishop, and the 44 Holy Martyrs
title.am: መባቻ ዘመንፈቀ ዓመት (የሁለተኛው መንፈቀ ዘመን መጀመሪያ)፣ ቅዱስ በርክስዮስ እና አርባ አራቱ ሰማዕታት

en: Beginning of the Seventh Month and Second Half of the Ecclesiastical Year
St. Barkisios the Holy Bishop and Confessor
The Forty-Four Holy Martyrs who Suffered in Rome
am: መባቻ ዘመጋቢትና የሁለተኛው መንፈቀ ዘመን የመጀመሪያ ዕለት
በሮም የተሰዉ አርባ አራቱ ቅዱሳን ሰማዕታት

en: St. Bartholomew the Apostle
St. Raguel the Archangel
Righteous Job the Patient
St. Elias (Elijah) the Prophet

Beginning of the Second Half of the Year: On this sacred day, Holy Church marks the opening of the blessed seventh month Megabit, the turning point of the ecclesiastical calendar where daylight and night reach perfect equality (equinox). The Church praises the Creator who sustains seasons, times, and harvests according to His divine wisdom.
St. Barkisios the Bishop: A devoted shepherd who guided his flock through persecution, preserving Orthodox doctrine and giving all his goods to feed the destitute.

The Forty-Four Martyrs of Rome: Faithful soldiers and civilians who refused to bow to pagan idols during imperial persecutions, choosing sword and fire rather than denying the Lord Jesus Christ, receiving immortal celestial crowns.
On this opening day of Megabit, believers pray for divine renewal, spiritual growth, and peaceful completion of the holy season.
am: መባቻ ዘመንፈቀ ዓመት፦ ቅድስት ቤተ ክርስቲያን የሰባተኛውን ወር የመጋቢትን መባቻና የሁለተኛውን መንፈቀ ዘመን መጀመሪያ ታስባለች:: ቀንና ሌሊት እኩል 12 ሰዓት የሚሆኑበት ይህ የተባረከ ወር የፍጥረታት መታደስ ምልክት ነው:: ዓመታትንና ወራትን በቸርነቱ ለሚመግብ ፈጣሪ ክብርና ምስጋና ይገባል::
ቅዱስ በርክስዮስ ኤጲስ ቆጶስ፦ መንጋውን በርትዕት ሃይማኖት የመራ: ድሆችን የመገበ ታላቅ አባት ነው::
አርባ አራቱ ሰማዕታት ዘሮሜ፦ በሮም ከተማ ስለ ክርስቶስ ስም የተሰዉ: ጣዖታትን አቃለው አንገታቸውን ለሰይፍ የሰጡ ክቡራን ሰማዕታት ናቸው::
በዚህች በመጋቢት የመጀመሪያ ዕለት እግዚአብሔር ዘመኑን የተባረከ ያድርግልን::

en.verse: Therefore, if anyone is in Christ, he is a new creation; old things have passed away; behold, all things have become new.

am.verse: ስለዚህ ማንም በክርስቶስ ቢሆን አዲስ ፍጥረት ነው፤ አሮጌው ነገር አልፎአል፤ እነሆ፥ ሁሉም አዲስ ሆኖአል።

title.en: St. Gregory the Illuminator of Armenia (Re'aye Hebu'at) and St. Hellanicus
title.am: ቅዱስ ጐርጐርዮስ ረዓዬ ኅቡዓት (ብርሃነ አርማንያ) እና ቅዱስ አላኒቆስ

en: St. Gregory the Illuminator of Armenia (Who Spent 15 Years in a Pit of Snakes and Converted King Tiridates)
St. Hellanicus the Bishop
St. Eudoxia the Martyr
am: ቅዱስ ጐርጐርዮስ ረዓዬ ኅቡዓት (በእባቦች ጉድጓድ ለ15 ዓመታት የተጋደለ: አርማንያን ያበራ)

en: St. Thaddaeus the Apostle
Righteous Job the Patient
Abba Paul the Great Hermit
St. John the Baptist

St. Gregory the Illuminator: The Apostle of Armenia, born of noble lineage. Refusing to worship pagan idols, King Tiridates III threw him into a deep, dark subterranean pit filled with venomous serpents (Khor Virap). By divine power, Gregory remained unharmed in the pit for fifteen continuous years, sustained by a pious Christian widow who lowered bread daily. When King Tiridates was struck with madness like Nebuchadnezzar, his sister was commanded in a vision to release Gregory. Gregory prayed over the king, healed him, baptized the royal court and the entire Armenian nation in 301 A.D., making Armenia the first Christian kingdom. He fell asleep in deep peace, receiving the title 'The Illuminator.'
St. Hellanicus the Bishop: A holy shepherd who preserved the Orthodox faith and nurtured his flock with Gospel truth.
St. Eudoxia the Martyr: A holy maiden who surrendered her life for Christ rather than commit idolatry.
The wondrous endurance of St. Gregory reminds Christians that God's light shines brightest in the deepest darkness.
am: ቅዱስ ጐርጐርዮስ ረዓዬ ኅቡዓት፦ የአርማንያ ሐዋርያና ብርሃን የሆነው ቅዱስ ጎርጎርዮስ ጣዖት ባለማምለኩ ንጉሥ ድርጣድስ መርዛማ እባቦች ወደሞሉበት ጥልቅ ጉድጓድ (ሖር ቪራፕ) ጣለው:: እግዚአብሔር ድንቅ አድርጎ ለ15 ዓመታት ሳይጎዳ ጠበቀው:: አንዲት ምእመን በየዕለቱ ኅብስት ታወርድለት ነበር:: ንጉሡ አብዶ እንደ አውሬ በሆነ ጊዜ ቅዱስ ጎርጎርዮስ በጸሎቱ ፈወሰው:: ንጉሡና መላው የአርማንያ ሕዝብ አምነው በ301 ዓ/ም ተጠመቁ:: አርማንያ የመጀመሪያዋ ክርስቲያን አገር ሆነች::
ቅዱስ አላኒቆስ ኤጲስ ቆጶስ፦ መንጋውን በቅንነት የመራ ቅዱስ እረኛ ነው::
ቅድስት አውዶክስያ ሰማዕት፦ ስለ ክርስቶስ ስም ሰማዕትነትን የተቀበለች ቅድስት ናት::
የቅዱስ ጐርጐርዮስ ረዓዬ ኅቡዓት ጸሎትና በረከት ከሁላችን ጋር ይሁን::

en.verse: You are the light of the world. A city that is set on a hill cannot be hidden... Let your light so shine before men, that they may see your good works and glorify your Father in heaven.

am.verse: እናንተ የዓለም ብርሃን ናችሁ። በተራራ ላይ ያለች ከተማ ልትሰወር አይቻላትም... መልካሙን ሥራችሁን አይተው በሰማያት ያለውን አባታችሁን እንዲያከብሩ ብርሃናችሁ እንዲሁ በሰው ፊት ይብራ።

title.en: St. Cosmas Patriarch of Alexandria and St. Porphyry the Bishop
title.am: ቅዱስ ቆዝሞስ ሊቀ ጳጳሳት ዘእስክንድርያ እና ቅዱስ ፎርፊርዮስ ኤጲስ ቆጶስ

en: St. Cosmas the 44th Patriarch of Alexandria (Apostolic Father of Peace and Charity)
St. Porphyry Bishop of Gaza
St. George the Martyr
am: ቅዱስ ቆዝሞስ 44ኛው ሊቀ ጳጳሳት ዘእስክንድርያ (የሰላምና የበጎ አድራጎት አባት)

en: Ba'ata Le-Egzi'etne Mariam (Entrance of the Theotokos into the Temple)
Sts. Joachim and Anna
Abune Zena Marqos the Righteous

St. Cosmas Patriarch of Alexandria: An austere monk from the Monastery of St. Macarius in Scetis, chosen to become the 44th Patriarch of Alexandria. He served with profound humility, selling his own garments to feed famine victims, rebuilding destroyed sanctuaries, and reconciling estranged brethren in Christ. His days were filled with tears of prayer and pastoral vigil, departing peacefully to the Lord on Megabit 3.
St. Porphyry Bishop of Gaza: The courageous hierarch who uprooted pagan temples in Gaza, establishing churches and protecting his flock by ceaseless prayer and miracles.
St. George the Martyr: Commemorated for his steadfast endurance and love for Christ.
The gentle holiness of St. Cosmas reminds all hierarchs and believers to shepherd others with active charity and genuine humility.
am: ቅዱስ ቆዝሞስ ሊቀ ጳጳሳት ዘእስክንድርያ፦ ከአስቄጥስ ገዳም የተመረጠ 44ኛው የእስክንድርያ ፓትርያርክ ነው:: በታላቅ ትሕትናና ፍቅር ያገለገለ ሲሆን በራብ ጊዜ ልብሱን ሳይቀር እየሸጠ ድሆችን መግቧል:: የተጣሉትን አስታርቆ: አብያተ ክርስቲያናትን አንጾ ጥር 3 ቀን በሰላም ዐርፏል::
ቅዱስ ፎርፊርዮስ ኤጲስ ቆጶስ ዘጋዛ፦ በጋዛ ከተማ ጣዖታትን አፍርሶ አብያተ ክርስቲያናትን ያነጸ ታላቅ አባት ነው::
ቅዱስ ጊዮርጊስ ሰማዕት፦ ስለ ክርስቶስ ስም መከራን የታገሰ ሰማዕት ነው::
የቅዱስ ቆዝሞስና የቅዱሳኑ ጸሎት ከሁላችን ጋር ይሁን::

en.verse: Remember those who rule over you, who have spoken the word of God to you, whose faith follow, considering the outcome of their conduct. Jesus Christ is the same yesterday, today, and forever.

am.verse: የእግዚአብሔርን ቃል የነገሩአችሁን መሪዎቻችሁን አስቡ፥ የኑሮአቸውንም ፍሬ እየተመለከታችሁ በእምነት ምሰሉአቸው። ኢየሱስ ክርስቶስ ትናንትና ዛሬ እስከ ዘላለምም ያው ነው።

title.en: The Apparition of the Holy Cross in Jerusalem and St. Hananya the Martyr
title.am: አስተርእዮተ መስቀል በኢየሩሳሌም (ድርሳነ መስቀል) እና ቅዱስ ሐናንያ ሰማዕት

en: The Miraculous Apparition of the Holy Cross of Light in the Skies of Jerusalem (351 A.D.)
St. Hananya (Ananias) the Martyr
St. Thomas the Ascetic
am: አስተርእዮተ መስቀል (በ351 ዓ/ም በኢየሩሳሌም ሰማይ ላይ የታየው የብርሃን መስቀል ተአምር)

en: St. John the Evangelist
St. Andrew the Apostle
St. Sophia the Martyr

Apparition of the Holy Cross in Jerusalem: In 351 A.D., during the reign of Emperor Constantius and the episcopate of St. Cyril of Jerusalem, a luminous Cross appeared in the heavens over Jerusalem. Stretching from Golgotha to the Mount of Olives, it shone brighter than the midday sun for several continuous hours. Entire populations of Jews, pagans, and Christians rushed to the churches in tears, glorifying Jesus Christ. St. Cyril wrote an official pastoral letter to the emperor documenting this celestial manifestation, commemorated on Megabit 4 with the reading of Dirsane Mesqel.
St. Hananya the Martyr: A faithful Christian who confessed Christ before tyrannical rulers, crowned with martyrdom.
St. Thomas the Ascetic: A solitary monk commemorated for his holy life in the wilderness.
The glorious sign of the Cross reminds believers that the Cross of Christ is the eternal weapon of peace, victory, and salvation.
am: አስተርእዮተ መስቀል በኢየሩሳሌም፦ በ351 ዓ/ም በንጉሥ ቆስጠንጥኖስ ልጅ ዘመንና በቅዱስ ቄርሎስ ዘኢየሩሳሌም ዘመነ ጵጵስና በኢየሩሳሌም ሰማይ ላይ ከጎልጎታ እስከ ደብረ ዘይት ድረስ የተዘረጋ እጅግ የሚያበራ የብርሃን መስቀል ተገለጠ:: ብርሃኑ ከፀሐይ እጅግ በልጦ ለብዙ ሰዓታት ታየ:: አይሁድና አረማውያን ሳይቀሩ በድንጋጤና በእንባ ወደ ቤተ ክርስቲያን ሮጠው በክርስቶስ አመኑ:: ይህ ዕለት 'ድርሳነ መስቀል' እየተነበበ በታላቅ በረከት ይከበራል::
ቅዱስ ሐናንያ ሰማዕት፦ ስለ ክርስቶስ ስም ደሙን ያፈሰሰ ሰማዕት ነው::
ቅዱስ ቶማስ ገዳማዊ፦ በበርሃ ተወስኖ በጸሎት ያበራ አባት ነው::
የክቡር መስቀሉ ኃይልና ረድኤት ከሁላችን ጋር ይሁን::

en.verse: For the message of the cross is foolishness to those who are perishing, but to us who are being saved it is the power of God.

am.verse: የመስቀሉ ቃል ለሚጠፉት ሞኝነት፥ ለእኛ ለምንድን ግን የእግዚአብሔር ኃይል ነውና።

title.en: Abune Gebre Menfes Qiddus the Star of the Desert and St. Sarabamon the Bishop
title.am: አቡነ ገብረ መንፈስ ቅዱስ (ኮከበ ገዳም) እና ቅዱስ ሳርባሞን ኤጲስ ቆጶስ

en: Abune Gebre Menfes Qiddus (Abo - Annual Feast of the Repose of the Ethiopian Wonderworker)
St. Sarabamon the Martyr Bishop of Niku
St. Eudoxia the Ascetic Mother
am: አቡነ ገብረ መንፈስ ቅዱስ (አቦ - ዓመታዊ የዕረፍታቸው በዓል: የዝቋላና የምድር ከዋክብት)
ቅዱስ ሳርባሞን ሰማዕት ኤጲስ ቆጶስ ዘኒቁ

en: Abune Gebre Menfes Qiddus
St. Peter Head of the Apostles
St. Paul Light of the World

Abune Gebre Menfes Qiddus: Born in Nehis (Egypt) to Simeon and Aklesia after thirty years of prayer. An angel presented the newborn directly before the Holy Trinity. For five hundred and sixty-two years, he lived an extraordinary ascetic life without eating bread or drinking water, clothed only in his hair. Coming to Ethiopia, he dwelt on the volcanic peak of Mount Zuqualla and in Medre Kebd, accompanied by sixty lions and sixty leopards that bowed before him. He stood in prayer for one hundred years in the crater lake of Zuqualla, pleading for Ethiopia until the Lord granted him an eternal covenant that whoever commemorates his name shall be forgiven. He fell asleep in Christ on Megabit 5.
St. Sarabamon Bishop of Niku: A courageous Egyptian bishop who defended the flock during the Diocletian persecution, enduring cruel tortures before being beheaded for Christ.
St. Eudoxia: A penitent mother who renounced worldly riches, lived in austere desert prayer, and rested in holiness.
The annual feast of Abune Gebre Menfes Qiddus (Abo) is celebrated with transcendent jubilation and gratitude throughout Ethiopia.
am: አቡነ ገብረ መንፈስ ቅዱስ፦ በግብጽ ንሂሳ ከስምዖንና ከአቅሌስያ በጸሎት የተወለዱ: ገና በተወለዱበት ቀን 'ስብሐት ለአብ: ስብሐት ለወልድ: ስብሐት ለመንፈስ ቅዱስ' ብለው ፈጣሪን ያመሰገኑ ታላቅ አባት ናቸው:: ለ562 ዓመታት እህል ሳይበሉና ውሃ ሳይጠጡ በፀጉራቸው ተሸፍነው በብሕትውና ኖረዋል:: ወደ ኢትዮጵያ መጥተው በዝቋላ ተራራና በምድረ ከብድ ሲጋደሉ 60 አንበሶችና 60 ነብሮች ያጅቧቸው ነበር:: በዝቋላ ባሕር ውስጥ ለ100 ዓመታት ቆመው ስለ ኢትዮጵያ ምሕረትን ለምነዋል:: ጥር 5 ቀን በክብር ዐርፈዋል::
ቅዱስ ሳርባሞን ኤጲስ ቆጶስ፦ በዲዮቅልጥያኖስ ዘመን ስለ ቀናች ሃይማኖት አንገቱን ለሰይፍ የሰጠ ክቡር ሰማዕት ነው::
ቅድስት አውዶክስያ ገዳማዊት፦ በንስሐ ተጋድሎ ያበራች ንጽሕት እናት ናት::
የአባታችን የአቡነ ገብረ መንፈስ ቅዱስ ጸሎትና በረከት ከሁላችን ጋር ይሁን::

en.verse: Then Peter answered and said to Him, 'See, we have left all and followed You. Therefore what shall we have?' And everyone who has left houses or brothers or sisters or father or mother or wife or children or lands, for My name's sake, shall receive a hundredfold, and inherit eternal life.

am.verse: በዚያን ጊዜ ጴጥሮስ መልሶ፦ እነሆ፥ እኛ ሁሉን ትተን ተከተልንህ፤ እንኪያስ ምን እናገኝ ይሆን? አለው። ... ስለ ስሜም ቤቶችን ወይም ወንድሞችን ወይም እኅቶችን ወይም አባትን ወይም እናትን ወይም ሚስትን ወይም ልጆችን ወይም እርሻን የተወ ሁሉ መቶ እጥፍ ይቀበላል የዘላለምንም ሕይወት ይወርሳል።

title.en: St. Theophilus Bishop of Caesarea and St. Dioscorus the Martyr
title.am: ቅዱስ ቴዎፍሎስ ኤጲስ ቆጶስ ዘቂሣርያ እና ቅዱስ ዲዮስቆሮስ ሰማዕት

en: St. Theophilus Bishop of Caesarea (Who Championed the Calculation of Pascha)
St. Dioscorus the Youthful Martyr
St. Mary the Ascetic
am: ቅዱስ ቴዎፍሎስ ኤጲስ ቆጶስ ዘቂሣርያ (የበዓለ ፋሲካን ቀመር ያስተማረ ሊቅ)

en: St. Peter Head of the Apostles
St. Paul Light of the World
St. Arsema the Virgin Martyr

St. Theophilus Bishop of Caesarea: A wise and holy shepherd of Palestine who presided over local councils establishing the universal Christian observance of the Resurrection of Christ on Sunday. He guided his diocese with great purity, resisting pagan oppression and leaving theological writings before resting in Christ.

St. Dioscorus the Youth: A courageous young Christian who was dragged before pagan judges and commanded to deny Christ. Despite being subjected to horrific beatings, he stood firm, professing 'I am a Christian,' until he was crowned with martyrdom.
St. Mary the Ascetic: A solitary nun who dedicated her life to continuous tears, prayer, and silence in the desert.
The remembrance of Theophilus and Dioscorus strengthens the Church to hold fast to the resurrection faith and apostolic order.
am: ቅዱስ ቴዎፍሎስ ኤጲስ ቆጶስ ዘቂሣርያ፦ በፍልስጤም የቂሣርያ ሊቀ ጳጳሳት የነበረ: የበዓለ ፋሲካ በዓል በእሑድ ቀን እንዲከበር ያጸና ታላቅ ሊቅ ነው:: መንጋውን በቅድስና ጠብቆ ጥር 6 ቀን በሰላም ዐርፏል::
ቅዱስ ዲዮስቆሮስ ሰማዕት፦ ገና በወጣትነቱ በከሀዲያን ፊት ክርስቶስን በድፍረት የመሰከረ: በግርፋትና በሰይፍ ሰማዕትነቱን የፈጸመ ክቡር ወጣት ነው::
ቅድስት ማርያም ገዳማዊት፦ በበርሃ ተወስና በጾምና በጸሎት ያበራች ንጽሕት እናት ናት::
የቅዱስ ቴዎፍሎስና የቅዱስ ዲዮስቆሮስ ጸሎት ከሁላችን ጋር ይሁን::

en.verse: I charge you therefore before God and the Lord Jesus Christ, who will judge the living and the dead at His appearing and His kingdom: Preach the word! Be ready in season and out of season. Convince, rebuke, exhort, with all longsuffering and teaching.

am.verse: በእግዚአብሔር ፊት በሕያዋንና በሙታንም ሊፈርድ ባለው በጌታ በኢየሱስ ክርስቶስ ፊት፥ በመገለጡና በመንግሥቱም እመሰክርብሃለሁ፤ ቃሉን ስበክ፥ በጊዜውም አለጊዜውም ጽና፥ ፈጽመህ እየታገሥህና እያስተማርህ፥ ዝለፍና ገሥጽ ምከርም።

title.en: St. Philemon the Actor and St. Apollonius the Reader (Martyrs of Antinoe)
title.am: ቅዱስ ፊልሞና ተወናይ እና ቅዱስ አጶሎንዮስ አናጉንስጢስ (ሰማዕታተ አንሲና)

en: St. Philemon the Actor (Pagan Musician who Embraced Christ and Was Beheaded)
St. Apollonius the Reader (Deacon who Slew Idolatry through True Repentance)
St. Arianus the Governor (Who Converted and Became a Martyr)
am: ቅዱስ ፊልሞና ተወናይ (የክርስቶስን እምነት በድፍረት የመሰከረ አረማዊ ሙዚቀኛ)
ቅዱስ አጶሎንዮስ አናጉንስጢስ (በንስሐ ተመልሶ ሰማዕትነትን የተቀበለ ዲያቆን)

en: Holy Trinity (Selassie)
Abba Giyorgis of Gascha
Abba Shenouda the Archimandrite

St. Philemon the Actor and St. Apollonius: In Antinoe during the Diocletian persecution, Apollonius, a Christian reader, trembled before torture and hired Philemon, a famous pagan piper and actor, to put on his clothes and sacrifice to idols in his place. When Philemon stood before Governor Arianus disguised as Apollonius, divine light flooded his heart. Refusing to sacrifice, he cried: 'I am a Christian!' Apollonius was deeply struck with remorse, stepped forward, and confessed Christ alongside him. Both were subjected to cruel tortures and cast into the sea in sacks, receiving immortal crowns.

Governor Arianus: Stricken by blindness during their execution, Arianus rubbed dust from Philemon's grave on his eyes and was miraculously healed. Converted to Christ, he and four bodyguards confessed the faith and were also martyred.
The glorious repentance of Philemon and Apollonius proves that the foolishness of God is wiser than men, and God uses the weak to shame the strong.
am: ቅዱስ ፊልሞና ተወናይ እና ቅዱስ አጶሎንዮስ፦ በአንሲና ከተማ አጶሎንዮስ የተባለ ዲያቆን መከራን ፈርቶ ፊልሞና የተባለውን አረማዊ ዘፋኝ ልብሱን አልብሶ በስሙ ጣዖት እንዲሠዋ ላከው:: ፊልሞና በአርያኖስ ፊት በቆመ ጊዜ ግን የእግዚአብሔር ጸጋ በልቡ አድሮ 'እኔ ክርስቲያን ነኝ!' ብሎ መሰከረ:: አጶሎንዮስም በጸጸት ተመልሶ ከእርሱ ጋር ቆመ:: ሁለቱም በጽኑ ተሰቃይተው ወደ ባሕር ተጥለው ሰማዕትነታቸውን ፈጸሙ:: ገዥው አርያኖስም ዕውር ሆኖ በፊልሞና አፈር ዓይኑ በዳነ ጊዜ አምኖ እርሱም ሰማዕት ሆነ::
ቅዱስ ዮሴፍ ገዳማዊ፦ በበርሃ ተወስኖ በጾምና በጸሎት ያበራ አባት ነው::
የቅዱስ ፊልሞና: የቅዱስ አጶሎንዮስና የሰማዕታቱ ጸሎት ከሁላችን ጋር ይሁን::

en.verse: But God has chosen the foolish things of the world to put to shame the wise, and God has chosen the weak things of the world to put to shame the things which are mighty; and the base things of the world and the things which are despised God has chosen.

am.verse: ነገር ግን እግዚአብሔር ጠቢባንን እንዲያሳፍር የዓለምን ሞኝ ነገር መረጠ፤ ብርቱንም ነገር እንዲያሳፍር እግዚአብሔር የዓለምን ደካማ ነገር መረጠ፤ እግዚአብሔርም የሆነውን ነገር ከንቱ እንዲያደርግ የዓለምን ምናምንቴ ነገር የተናቀውንም ነገር ያልሆነውንም ነገር መረጠ።

title.en: Martyrdom of St. Matthias the Apostle (Chosen to Complete the Twelve)
title.am: ሰማዕትነቱ ለቅዱስ ማትያስ ሐዋርያ (በይሁዳ ፈንታ የተመረጠ)

en: Martyrdom of St. Matthias the Apostle (Chosen by Lot to Fill the Place of Judas)
St. Julian the Martyr
St. Sophia the Ascetic
am: ሰማዕትነቱ ለቅዱስ ማትያስ ሐዋርያ (ከዐሥራ ሁለቱ ሐዋርያት አንዱ: በይሁዳ ፈንታ የተተካ)

en: St. Moses Head of the Prophets
The Four Living Creatures (Cherubim)
Abba Kiros the Hermit

St. Matthias the Apostle: Chosen by the holy Apostles through prayer and lots after the Ascension of Christ to take the place of Judas Iscariot. Having accompanied our Lord from the baptism of John until the Ascension, he received the Holy Spirit at Pentecost. Matthias preached the Gospel in Judea, Damascus, and Ethiopia, destroying idols, giving sight to the blind, and casting out demons. In the city of cannibals, he was cast into prison, but the Lord delivered him. Eventually, he was stoned and beheaded for Christ's name, receiving the glorious apostolic crown of martyrdom on Megabit 8.
St. Julian the Martyr: A brave confessor who suffered torments rather than renounce Christ.
St. Sophia: A holy ascetic who lived in prayer and solitude, entering into eternal life.
The apostolic witness of St. Matthias inspires the faithful to fulfill their holy calling with unshakeable fidelity.
am: ሰማዕትነቱ ለቅዱስ ማትያስ ሐዋርያ፦ ጌታችን ካረገ በኋላ ቅዱሳን ሐዋርያት በጸሎትና በዕጣ በይሁዳ ፈንታ ከመረጧቸው ከዐሥራ ሁለቱ ሐዋርያት አንዱ ነው:: በበዓለ ኀምሳ መንፈስ ቅዱስን ተቀብሎ በይሁዳ: በደማስቆና በኢትዮጵያ ወንጌልን ሰብኳል:: በርካታ ድንቆችን አድርጎ: ሙታንን አስነስቶ በመጨረሻ በድንጋይ ተወግሮና በሰይፍ ተሰይፎ ሰማዕትነቱን ጥር 8 ቀን ፈጽሟል::
ቅዱስ ዩልያኖስ ሰማዕት፦ ስለ ክርስቶስ ስም ደሙን ያፈሰሰ ሰማዕት ነው::
ቅድስት ሶፍያ ገዳማዊት፦ በጾምና በጸሎት ያበራች ንጽሕት እናት ናት::
የሐዋርያው የቅዱስ ማትያስና የቅዱሳኑ ጸሎት ከሁላችን ጋር ይሁን::

en.verse: And they prayed and said, 'You, O Lord, who know the hearts of all, show which of these two You have chosen.' And they cast their lots, and the lot fell on Matthias. And he was numbered with the eleven apostles.

am.verse: ሲጸልዩም፦ የሁሉን ልብ የምታውቅ አንተ ጌታ ሆይ፥ ... ከእነዚህ ከሁለቱ አንዱን እንድትመርጥ ሹመው አሉ። ዕጣም ተጣጣሉላቸው፥ ዕጣውም ለማትያስ ወደቀና ከአሥራ አንዱ ሐዋርያት ጋር ተቈጠረ።

title.en: Annual Feast of the Forty Holy Martyrs of Sebaste and St. Conan the Wonderworker
title.am: ዓመታዊ በዓለ አርባው የሰባስቲያ ሰማዕታት እና ቅዱስ ቆናን ባለታላቅ ተአምር

en: The Forty Holy Martyrs of Sebaste (Annual Commemoration of Their Victory over the Icy Lake)
St. Conan the Wonderworker (Who Subdued Demons to Labor for the Church)
St. Gregory the Hermit
am: አርባው የሰባስቲያ ሰማዕታት (ዓመታዊ የበረዶ ሐይቅ የድል በዓላቸው)
ቅዱስ ቆናን ባለታላቅ ተአምር (አጋንንትን በጸሎቱ አስሮ ያገለገለ)

en: The 318 Holy Fathers of Nicaea
Abba Barsuma the Syrian
Abba Melchizedek of Mida

The Forty Holy Martyrs of Sebaste: Soldiers in the Roman Twelfth Legion who confessed Christ in Sebaste (Armenia) under Emperor Licinius. The pagan governor ordered them stripped naked and forced to stand all night on a frozen lake during a bitter winter gale, while a warm bathhouse was heated nearby to tempt them. One soldier weakened and ran to the bathhouse, dying immediately from the shock. The Roman guard, seeing thirty-nine radiant crowns descending from heaven, threw off his armor, shouted 'I am a Christian!' and joined them on the ice, completing the holy forty. In the morning, their legs were broken, and their souls ascended in triumph on Megabit 9.

St. Conan the Wonderworker: A holy elder from Isauria who possessed such great authority from Christ that unclean spirits submitted to his word, carrying stones and wood to build a sanctuary for the Lord.
St. Gregory the Hermit: A solitary desert father who prayed continuously in wilderness caverns.
The heroic endurance of the Forty Martyrs reminds Christians to endure temporal hardships with patience for the unfading crown of eternal life.
am: አርባው የሰባስቲያ ሰማዕታት፦ በአርማንያ ሰባስቲያ በበረዶ ሐይቅ ውስጥ ልብሳቸውን ተገፈው ስለ ክርስቶስ ስም የታገሱ 40 ወታደሮች ናቸው:: በአጠገባቸው ሙቅ ቤት ተዘጋጅቶ ሳለ አንዱ ፈርቶ ሲሮጥ ወዲያው ሞተ:: ጠባቂያቸው ግን 39 የብርሃን አክሊላት ከሰማይ ሲወርዱ አይቶ ልብሱን ጥሎ 'እኔም ክርስቲያን ነኝ!' ብሎ ከእነርሱ ጋር ተቀላቀለ:: አርባውም በክብር ሰማዕትነታቸውን ፈጽመው ወደ ዘለዓለም ክብር ገብተዋል::
ቅዱስ ቆናን ባለታላቅ ተአምር፦ በአጋንንት ላይ ታላቅ ሥልጣን የተሰጠው: አጋንንት ለቤተ መቅደስ ሥራ ድንጋይ እንዲያመጡ ያዘዘ ታላቅ አባት ነው::
ቅዱስ ጐርጐርዮስ ገዳማዊ፦ በበርሃ ተወስኖ በጾምና በጸሎት ያበራ አባት ነው::
የአርባው የሰባስቲያ ሰማዕታትና የቅዱስ ቆናን ጸሎት ከሁላችን ጋር ይሁን::

en.verse: Who shall separate us from the love of Christ? Shall tribulation, or distress, or persecution, or famine, or nakedness, or peril, or sword? Yet in all these things we are more than conquerors through Him who loved us.

am.verse: ከክርስቶስ ፍቅር ማን ይለየናል? መከራ ነውን? ወይስ ጭንቀት፥ ወይስ ስደት፥ ወይስ ራብ፥ ወይስ ራቁትነት፥ ወይስ ፍርሃት፥ ወይስ ሰይፍ ነውን? ነገር ግን በዚህ ሁሉ በወደደን በእርሱ ከአሸናፊዎች እንበልጣለን።

title.en: The Great Feast of the Finding of the Holy Cross of Christ by Empress Helena
title.am: ታላቁ በዓለ መስቀል (ዕፀ መስቀሉ በንግሥት ዕሌኒ የተገኘበት ታላቅ በዓል)

en: The Finding of the Life-Giving Cross of our Lord Jesus Christ by Empress Helena in Golgotha (326 A.D.)
St. Helena the Righteous Empress (Mother of St. Constantine)
The Miracle of the True Cross Raising the Dead Man
am: የክቡር መስቀሉ መገኘት በንግሥት ዕሌኒ (በጎልጎታ ከቆሻሻ ጉድጓድ የወጣበት ታላቅ በዓል)
የክርስቶስ መስቀል ሙት በማስነሳት የተለየበት ተአምር

en: Holy Cross of our Lord Jesus Christ
144,000 Holy Innocents of Bethlehem
The Righteous King Saint Kaleb

The Finding of the Holy Cross by Empress Helena: For almost three centuries following Christ's Crucifixion, Jewish authorities covered Golgotha with city refuse and pagan temples were erected above it. In 326 A.D., Queen Helena, mother of Emperor Constantine, journeyed to Jerusalem. Guided by elderly Kirakos who indicated the garbage mound, she lit incense and prayed; the smoke turned and pointed directly down to the site. Excavating deep, they found three crosses. To identify the True Cross, they placed them sequentially upon a corpse being carried to the tomb: upon touching the Cross of Christ, the dead man immediately sat up alive. The Empress embraced the Cross with tears, celebrating with the faithful on Megabit 10.
Queen Helena the Righteous: Renowned for building the Church of the Holy Sepulchre (Resurrection) in Jerusalem, the Church of the Nativity in Bethlehem, and numerous holy shrines.
The Glorious Cross of Christ: The instrument of our salvation, the standard of victory over death and demons, celebrated with joyous liturgical songs (Meqdese Mesqel).
The feast of the Finding of the Cross brings celestial joy, renewal, and divine protection to all believers.
am: የክቡር መስቀሉ መገኘት በንግሥት ዕሌኒ፦ አይሁድ የመስቀሉን ተአምራት አይተው እንዳይመለከቱት በጎልጎታ ላይ የቆሻሻ መጣያ አድርገውት ለ300 ዓመታት ተቀብሮ ቆየ:: በ326 ዓ/ም ንግሥት ዕሌኒ ወደ ኢየሩሳሌም ሄዳ ኪራኮስ በተባለ አረጋዊ መሪነት ዕጣን አጥና ስትጸልይ የዕጣኑ ጢስ ወደ ቆሻሻው ተራራ ሰገደ:: ስታስቆፍር ሦስት መስቀሎች ተገኙ:: የትኛው የክርስቶስ እንደሆነ ለማወቅ በሞተ ሰው ላይ ባኖሩት ጊዜ በጌታችን መስቀል ላይ ሲደርስ ሙቱ ወዲያው ተነስቶ ቆመ:: ንግሥቲቱና ሕዝቡ ሁሉ በታላቅ እልልታና እንባ ሰገዱለት:: ይህ በዓል በመጋቢት 10 በታላቅ ክብር ይከበራል::
ቅድስት ዕሌኒ ንግሥት፦ በኢየሩሳሌም የትንሣኤን ቤተ መቅደስና በቤተ ልሔም የልደትን ቤተ ክርስቲያን ያነጸች ቡርክት እናት ናት::
የክርስቶስ መስቀል ዲያብሎስን ድል የነሣንበት: የድኅነታችን ምልክትና የሕይወት ዛፍ ነው::
የክቡር መስቀሉ በረከትና የንግሥት ዕሌኒ ጸሎት ከሁላችን ጋር ይሁን::

en.verse: But God forbid that I should boast except in the cross of our Lord Jesus Christ, by whom the world has been crucified to me, and I to the world.

am.verse: ነገር ግን ዓለም ለእኔ የተሰቀለበት እኔም ለዓለም የተሰቀልሁበት ከጌታችን ከኢየሱስ ክርስቶስ መስቀል በቀር ሌላ ትምክህት ከእኔ ይራቅ።

title.en: St. Basilides the Elder and Martyr (Prime Minister of Rome)
title.am: ቅዱስ ፋሲለደስ አረጋዊ ሰማዕት (የሮም መኳንንት መሪ)

en: St. Basilides the Elder (Father of Holy Roman Martyrs who Was Exiled and Beheaded in Egypt)
St. Theoclia the Martyr (Wife of St. Justus)
St. Sophia the Martyr
am: ቅዱስ ፋሲለደስ አረጋዊ ሰማዕት (የሮም መሳፍንት አባት: በግብጽ የተሰዋ)

en: St. Claudius the Martyr
St. Fasilides the Great Martyr
Abba Samuel of Waldebba

St. Basilides the Elder: The venerable prime minister and general of the Roman Empire under Numerian and Diocletian. When Diocletian demanded sacrifice to idols, Basilides and his noble sons (Eusebius, Macarius) and daughters boldly cast off their golden belts and confessed Christ. Sent into exile in Upper Egypt, Basilides endured cruel beatings, iron hooks, and fire with supernatural fortitude, praying for his persecutors before being beheaded, ascending with heavenly crowns on Megabit 11.
St. Theoclia: The devout wife of St. Justus who suffered horrific tortures and gave her life in martyrdom for the love of Christ.
St. Sophia: A steadfast maiden who rejected idols, crowned on this day.
The noble sacrifice of Basilides and his family proves that devotion to Christ surpasses all earthly crowns and worldly honor.
am: ቅዱስ ፋሲለደስ አረጋዊ ሰማዕት፦ በሮም መንግሥት ታላቅ የጦርና የምክር መሪ የነበረ: የበርካታ ሰማዕታት አባት ነው:: ዲዮቅልጥያኖስ ጣዖት እንዲያመልክ ባዘዘ ጊዜ ክብሩን ንቆ ክርስቶስን መሰከረ:: ወደ ላይኛው ግብጽ ተግዞ በብዙ መከራ አልፎ በመጨረሻ አንገቱን ለሰይፍ ሰጥቶ የሰማዕትነት አክሊል ተቀብሏል::
ቅድስት ቴዎክሊያ ሰማዕት፦ የቅዱስ ዮስጦስ ሚስት: ስለ ክርስቶስ ስም መከራን ታግሣ በሰማዕትነት ያረፈች ንጽሕት እናት ናት::
ቅድስት ሶፍያ ሰማዕት፦ ሃይማኖቷን በጽናት የጠበቀች ሰማዕት ናት::
የቅዱስ ፋሲለደስና የቅዱሳኑ ጸሎት ከሁላችን ጋር ይሁን::

en.verse: I have fought the good fight, I have finished the race, I have kept the faith. Finally, there is laid up for me the crown of righteousness, which the Lord, the righteous Judge, will give to me on that Day.

am.verse: መልካሙን ገድል ተጋድያለሁ፥ ሩጫውን ጨርሻለሁ፥ ሃይማኖትን ጠብቄአለሁ፤ ወደ ፊት የጽድቅ አክሊል ተዘጋጅቶልኛል፥ ይህንም ጻድቅ ፈራጅ የሆነው ጌታ በዚያ ቀን ለእኔ ያስረክባል።

title.en: Feast of St. Michael the Archangel and St. Demetrius Patriarch of Alexandria
title.am: በዓለ ቅዱስ ሚካኤል ሊቀ መላእክት እና ቅዱስ ድሜጥሮስ ሊቀ ጳጳሳት ዘእስክንድርያ

en: St. Michael the Archangel (Monthly Memorial of the Heavenly Commander)
St. Demetrius the 12th Patriarch of Alexandria (The Vine-Dresser who Established the Computus / Bahre Hasab)
St. Joseph the Monk
am: ቅዱስ ሚካኤል ሊቀ መላእክት (የወርኀዊ መታሰቢያውና የረድኤቱ በዓል)
ቅዱስ ድሜጥሮስ 12ኛው ሊቀ ጳጳሳት ዘእስክንድርያ (ባሕረ ሐሳብን ያዘጋጀ የወይን አትክልተኛ)

en: St. Michael the Archangel
St. Lalibela the Righteous King
Abba Samuel of Waldebba

St. Michael the Archangel: Holy Church observes the monthly memorial of Archangel Michael with deep thanksgiving. The defender of the people of God, Michael stands before the Holy Trinity pleading for divine mercy upon the earth and delivering the faithful from visible and invisible perils.

St. Demetrius Patriarch of Alexandria: An illiterate married vine-dresser who lived with his wife in strict virginity like brother and sister for forty-seven years. Revealed by an angel to Patriarch Julian before his death, Demetrius was consecrated the 12th Patriarch of Alexandria. God bestowed upon him miraculous wisdom, enabling him to calculate the Alexandrian Paschal Calendar (Bahre Hasab / Computus) regulating Fast of Nineveh, Great Lent, and Easter across Christendom. He proved his virginity publicly by holding glowing red coals in his vestments without burning. He shepherded the flock for thirty-two years, falling asleep on Megabit 12 at 105 years of age.
St. Joseph the Monk: A peaceful solitary who lived in prayer and humility.
The life of St. Demetrius demonstrates how pure virginity and humble prayer unlock celestial wisdom.
am: ቅዱስ ሚካኤል ሊቀ መላእክት፦ ቅድስት ቤተ ክርስቲያን የወርኀዊ መታሰቢያውን በታላቅ ክብር ታከብራለች:: ቅዱስ ሚካኤል የቅዱሳንን ጸሎት የሚያሳርግ: ምእመናንን ከመከራ የሚያድን ታላቅ መልአክ ነው::

ቅዱስ ድሜጥሮስ ሊቀ ጳጳሳት ዘእስክንድርያ፦ 12ኛው የእስክንድርያ ፓትርያርክ ሲሆን ከሚስቱ ጋር ለ47 ዓመታት በድንግልና የኖረ የወይን አትክልተኛ ነበረ:: መልአክ ለአባ ዩልያኖስ ገልጦለት ፓትርያርክ ሆነ:: እግዚአብሔር ታላቅ ጥበብ ሰጥቶት የበዓላትና የአጽዋማትን መውጫ የሚያሰላውን 'ባሕረ ሐሳብ' አዘጋጀ:: ድንግልናውን ለሕዝቡ ለማሳየት የሚነድድ ፍም በእጁ ይዞ ልብሱ ሳይቃጠል አሳይቷል:: በ105 ዓመቱ መጋቢት 12 ቀን በሰላም ዐርፏል::
ቅዱስ ዮሴፍ ገዳማዊ፦ በበርሃ ተወስኖ በቅድስና ያረፈ አባት ነው::
የቅዱስ ሚካኤልና የቅዱስ ድሜጥሮስ ጸሎት ከሁላችን ጋር ይሁን::

en.verse: Bless the Lord, you His angels, who excel in strength, who do His word, heeding the voice of His word.

am.verse: ቃሉን የምትፈጽሙ፥ የቃሉንም ድምፅ የምትሰሙ፥ ብርቱዎችና ኃያላን፥ መላእክቱ ሁሉ፥ እግዚአብሔርን አመስግኑ።

title.en: St. Dionysius Patriarch of Alexandria and St. Theodora the Martyr
title.am: ቅዱስ ዲዮናስዮስ ሊቀ ጳጳሳት ዘእስክንድርያ እና ቅድስት ቴዎድራ ሰማዕት

en: St. Dionysius the 14th Patriarch of Alexandria (The Great Teacher and Confessor)
St. Theodora the Holy Martyr
St. Paul the Ascetic
am: ቅዱስ ዲዮናስዮስ 14ኛው ሊቀ ጳጳሳት ዘእስክንድርያ (ታላቁ ሊቅና ምእመን)

en: Feast of God the Father
St. Raphael the Archangel
The Thirteen Solitary Righteous Hermits

St. Dionysius Patriarch of Alexandria: Succeeded Heraclas as the 14th Patriarch in 248 A.D. A profound disciple of Origen, he headed the Catechetical School of Alexandria. During Decian and Valerian persecutions, he was arrested and exiled to Libya, guiding his flock through pastoral epistles. He tended the plague-stricken with heroic charity and combated Sabellian and Millenarian heresies with sharp theological treatises, falling asleep in Christ on Megabit 13 after seventeen years of fruitful episcopate.
St. Theodora the Martyr: A holy maiden who stood fearlessly before pagan judges and accepted martyrdom for Christ.
St. Paul the Ascetic: A solitary desert monk who spent his days in unceasing prayer.
The pastoral courage of St. Dionysius reminds the Church of the triumph of Gospel wisdom over imperial tyranny.
am: ቅዱስ ዲዮናስዮስ ሊቀ ጳጳሳት ዘእስክንድርያ፦ 14ኛው የእስክንድርያ ፓትርያርክ ሲሆን የታላቁ የእስክንድርያ ትምህርት ቤት መሪ ነበረ:: በዴቅዮስና በቫሌሪያኖስ ዘመን ወደ ሊቢያ ተሰዶ ሳለ ምእመናንን በመልእክታቱ አጽንቷል:: በቸነፈር ጊዜ የታመሙትን በገዛ እጁ አገልግሏል:: የተሳሳቱ ትምህርቶችን በመጻሕፍቱ አጋልጦ ለ17 ዓመታት ቤተ ክርስቲያንን ከመራ በኋላ መጋቢት 13 ቀን በሰላም ዐርፏል::
ቅድስት ቴዎድራ ሰማዕት፦ ስለ ክርስቶስ ስም ደሟን ያፈሰሰች ክቡር ሰማዕት ናት::
ቅዱስ ዻውሎስ ገዳማዊ፦ በበርሃ ተወስኖ በጾምና በጸሎት ያበራ አባት ነው::
የቅዱስ ዲዮናስዮስና የቅዱሳኑ ጸሎት ከሁላችን ጋር ይሁን::

en.verse: Therefore take heed to yourselves and to all the flock, among which the Holy Spirit has made you overseers, to shepherd the church of God which He purchased with His own blood.

am.verse: በገዛ ደሙ የዋጃትን የእግዚአብሔርን ቤተ ክርስቲያን ትጠብቁአት ዘንድ መንፈስ ቅዱስ እናንተን ጳጳሳት አድርጎ ለሾመባት ለመንጋው ሁሉና ለራሳችሁ ተጠንቀቁ።

title.en: Abba Sinoda the Archimandrite and St. Eugenius the Ascetic
title.am: አባ ሲኖዳ ሊቀ ባሕታውያን እና ቅዱስ አውጋንዮስ ገዳማዊ

en: Abba Sinoda the Archimandrite (Leader of Thousands of Egyptian Monks and Defender of Ephesus)
St. Eugenius (Abba Awgan) the Father of Mesopotamian Monasticism
St. Thomas the Confessor
am: አባ ሲኖዳ ሊቀ ባሕታውያን (የአእላፋት መነኮሳት መሪና የኤፌሶን ጉባኤ ኃያል አባት)
ቅዱስ አውጋንዮስ (አባ አውጋን: የሜሶጶጣሚያ ገዳማዊ ሕይወት መሥራች)

en: Abba Aregawi the Great (Zemika'el)
St. Gebre Kristos the Bridegroom
St. Philip the Apostle

Abba Sinoda the Archimandrite: Abbot of the White Monastery in Upper Egypt, guiding over two thousand monks and eighteen hundred nuns. He accompanied St. Cyril of Alexandria to the Third Ecumenical Council of Ephesus in 431 A.D., where he boldly confronted the heretic Nestorius. He was a champion of the poor, shelterer of famine refugees, and severe ascetic who conversed with Christ in the sanctuary, departing in peace at an advanced age.

St. Eugenius (Abba Awgan): An Egyptian pearl diver who became a monk under St. Pachomius and later introduced monasticism into Mesopotamia, establishing a monastery on Mount Izla with seventy disciples.
St. Thomas the Confessor: Commemorated for his preservation of Orthodox dogma.
The powerful witness of Abba Sinoda and Abba Eugenius inspires monks and laypeople alike to hold fast to the Orthodox faith and active Christian charity.
am: አባ ሲኖዳ ሊቀ ባሕታውያን፦ በግብጽ ነጭ ገዳም ከሁለት ሺህ በላይ መነኮሳትን የመራ ታላቅ አባት ነው:: በ431 ዓ/ም ከቅዱስ ቄርሎስ ጋር ወደ ኤፌሶን ጉባኤ ሄዶ ንስጥሮስን በድፍረት አሳፍሮታል:: ድሆችን በመመገብ: ለስደተኞች መጠለያ በመሆን ያገለገለ ሲሆን ጌታችን በመቅደስ ውስጥ ይገለጥለት ነበር:: በታላቅ ቅድስና ኖሮ መጋቢት 14 ቀን ዐርፏል::
ቅዱስ አውጋንዮስ ገዳማዊ፦ በሜሶጶጣሚያ የገዳማዊ ሕይወት መሥራች የሆነ: ከ70 ደቀ መዛሙርቱ ጋር በኢዝላ ተራራ ያበራ ታላቅ አባት ነው::
ቅዱስ ቶማስ ምእመን፦ ሃይማኖቱን በጽናት የጠበቀ ቅዱስ ሰው ነው::
የአባ ሲኖዳና የቅዱስ አውጋንዮስ ጸሎት ከሁላችን ጋር ይሁን::

en.verse: Come to Me, all you who labor and are heavy laden, and I will give you rest. Take My yoke upon you and learn from Me, for I am gentle and lowly in heart, and you will find rest for your souls.

am.verse: እናንተ ደካሞች ሸክማችሁ የከበደ ሁሉ፥ ወደ እኔ ኑ፥ እኔም አሳርፋችኋለሁ። ቀንበሬን በላያችሁ ተሸከሙ ከእኔም ተማሩ፥ እኔ የዋህ በልቤም ትሑት ነኝና፥ ለነፍሳችሁም ዕረፍት ታገኛላችሁ።

title.en: St. Sarah the Nun (Desert Mother) and St. Elias the Hermit
title.am: ቅድስት ሣራ ገዳማዊት (እመ ምናኔ) እና ቅዱስ ኤልያስ ባሕታዊ

en: St. Sarah the Nun (Desert Mother who Stood in Prayer by the Nile for 60 Years)
St. Elias the Hermit of the Upper Thebaid
St. George the Martyr
am: ቅድስት ሣራ ገዳማዊት (በአባይ ወንዝ ዳርቻ ለ60 ዓመታት የተጋደለች እናት)

en: St. Cyricus and St. Julitta
St. Ephrem the Syrian
St. Minas the Martyr

St. Sarah the Desert Mother: One of the exalted Desert Mothers (Ammas) of Egypt who dwelt in a small cell above the River Nile. For sixty continuous years, she waged spiritual warfare against the demons of lust and pride, never looking down at the river waters from her window so as not to be distracted. Renowned for her spiritual sayings recorded in the Apophthegmata Patrum, she declared: 'I put my foot on the ladder to go up to heaven every single day.' She fell asleep peacefully on Megabit 15.
St. Elias the Hermit: A venerable solitary who lived in a cave in the Upper Thebaid, eating only bread and water and interceding unceasingly for all creation.
St. George the Martyr: Commemorated for his steadfast endurance in the confession of Christ.
The life of Mother Sarah inspires women and men alike to maintain unwavering spiritual focus and vigilance over the senses.
am: ቅድስት ሣራ ገዳማዊት፦ በግብጽ በአባይ ወንዝ ዳርቻ በአንዲት በዓት ተወስና ለ60 ዓመታት የሰውን ፊት ሳታይ በታላቅ ተጋድሎ የኖረች ታላቅ እናት ናት:: ልቧ እንዳይበታተን ከመስኮቷ ወርዳ የአባይን ውሃ አይታ አታውቅም ነበር:: 'በየዕለቱ እግሬን ወደ ሰማይ በሚያወጣው መሰላል ላይ አኖራለሁ' እያለች አጋንንትን ድል ነሥታ በቅድስና ኖራ መጋቢት 15 ቀን ዐርፋለች::
ቅዱስ ኤልያስ ባሕታዊ፦ በላይኛው ቴቤስ በጾምና በጸሎት ያበራ ጻድቅ አባት ነው::
ቅዱስ ጊዮርጊስ ሰማዕት፦ ስለ ክርስቶስ ስም ደሙን ያፈሰሰ ሰማዕት ነው::
የቅድስት ሣራና የቅዱሳኑ ጸሎት ከሁላችን ጋር ይሁን::

en.verse: The unmarried woman cares about the things of the Lord, that she may be holy both in body and in spirit. But she who is married cares about the things of the world—how she may please her husband.

am.verse: ያላገባች ሴትና ድንግል በሥጋም በነፍስም ቅዱሳን እንዲሆኑ የጌታን ነገር ያስባሉ፤ ያገባች ግን ባልዋን እንዴት ደስ እንደምታሰኘው የዓለምን ነገር ታስባለች።

title.en: Feast of St. Michael the Archangel and St. Zechariah the Ascetic
title.am: በዓለ ቅዱስ ሚካኤል ሊቀ መላእክት እና ቅዱስ ዘካርያስ ገዳማዊ

en: St. Michael the Archangel (Feast of Deliverance and Heavenly Victory)
St. Zechariah the Desert Father of Scetis
St. Theodora the Confessor
am: ቅዱስ ሚካኤል ሊቀ መላእክት (የድኅነቱና የድሉ በዓል)

en: Kidane Mehret (Covenant of Mercy)
The Righteous King Saint Kaleb
St. Mary Magdalene

St. Michael the Archangel: Commemorated on this day for the innumerable manifestations of divine mercy and deliverance granted to believers who cry out in distress. The Archangel Michael swiftly protects the weak, shields travelers, and guides souls toward salvation.

St. Zechariah of Scetis: Son of Abba Carion, he entered the monastery of Scetis as a young boy. Growing in profound silence and contemplation, his father once saw him praying surrounded by celestial fire. Asked on his deathbed what was the greatest virtue in the monastic life, Zechariah looked at his hands and replied: 'To remain silent and to count oneself as nothing.' He departed to Christ in radiant holiness.
St. Theodora: A pious confessor who endured persecutions with patience and faith.
The angelic defense of Michael and the holy humility of Zechariah show that silence of heart and divine protection lead directly to the Kingdom of Heaven.
am: ቅዱስ ሚካኤል ሊቀ መላእክት፦ ምእመናንን ከመከራና ከፈተና የሚታደግ: ወደ እግዚአብሔር ዙፋን ምልጃን የሚያሳርግ ታላቅ መልአክ ሲሆን መታሰቢያው በታላቅ ምስጋና ይታሰባል::

ቅዱስ ዘካርያስ ገዳማዊ ዘአስቄጥስ፦ የአባ ካርዮን ልጅ ሲሆን ገና በልጅነቱ ወደ ገዳም ገብቶ በአርምሞና በጸሎት ያደገ አባት ነው:: አባቱ ሲጸልይ በእሳት ተከቦ አይቶታል:: በዕረፍቱ ጊዜ 'በገዳማዊ ሕይወት ከሁሉ የሚበልጠው ምንድር ነው?' ቢሉት 'ዝምታና ራስን እንደ ከንቱ መቁጠር' ሲል መለሰ:: መጋቢት 16 ቀን በሰላም ዐርፏል::
ቅድስት ቴዎድራ ምእመን፦ ሃይማኖቷን በጽናት የጠበቀች ቅድስት ናት::
የቅዱስ ሚካኤልና የቅዱስ ዘካርያስ ጸሎት ከሁላችን ጋር ይሁን::

en.verse: Take heed that you do not despise one of these little ones, for I say to you that in heaven their angels always see the face of My Father who is in heaven.

am.verse: ከእነዚህ ከታናናሾቹ አንዱን እንዳትንቁ ተጠንቀቁ፤ መላእክቶቻቸው በሰማያት ሁልጊዜ በሰማያት ያለውን የአባቴን ፊት ያያሉ እላችኋለሁና።

title.en: St. Theodora the Empress and St. Lazarus the Friend of Christ
title.am: ቅድስት ቴዎድራ ንግሥት እና ቅዱስ አልዓዛር ወዳጁ ለእግዚእ

en: St. Theodora the Pious Empress (Who Championed the Restoration of Holy Icons)
St. Lazarus the Four-Days-Dead Friend of Christ (Bishop of Kition, Cyprus)
St. Joseph the Monk
am: ቅድስት ቴዎድራ ንግሥት (የተቀደሱ ሥዕላትን ክብር የመለሰች ደግ ንግሥት)
ቅዱስ አልዓዛር ወዳጁ ለእግዚእ (አራት ቀን በሞት ቆይቶ የተነሣ: ኤጲስ ቆጶስ ዘቆጵሮስ)

en: St. Stephen Archdeacon and Protomartyr
St. James the Apostle Brother of John
St. Epiphanius Bishop of Cyprus
am: ቅዱስ እስጢፋኖስ ሊቀ ዲያቆናት ወቀዳሜ ሰማዕት

en: St. Theodora the Pious Empress: Consort of Emperor Theophilus. Throughout the iconoclastic persecution, she secretly venerated the holy icons of Christ and the Theotokos in her bedchamber. Following her husband's death, she restored the veneration of holy icons across the Empire in 843 A.D., inaugurating the Triumph of Orthodoxy, before spending her final years in prayer and monastic seclusion.

St. Lazarus of Bethany: The beloved friend of our Lord who was raised from the tomb on the fourth day after death. Following Pentecost, he journeyed to Cyprus where he was consecrated Bishop of Kition, serving for thirty years in sober holiness, tasting joy only in the Hope of the Resurrection.
St. Joseph the Monk: A peaceful anchorite commemorated for his prayer and ascetic life.
The raising of Lazarus and the devotion of Queen Theodora testify that Christ is the Victorious Resurrection who glorifies His saints.
am: ቅድስት ቴዎድራ ንግሥት፦ በቤተ መንግሥት ሳለች የተቀደሱ አዶዎችንና ሥዕላትን በክብር የጠበቀች: ባለቤቷ ካረፈ በኋላ በ843 ዓ/ም የሥዕላትን ክብር በይፋ የመለሰችና የቀናች ሃይማኖትን ያጸናች ንግሥት ናት:: በስተመጨረሻ መንኩሳ በሰላም ዐርፋለች::
ቅዱስ አልዓዛር ወዳጁ ለእግዚእ፦ በቢታንያ በአራተኛው ቀን ከመቃብር በጌታችን ሥልጣን የተነሳ: በኋላም ወደ ቆጵሮስ ሄዶ ለ30 ዓመታት ኤጲስ ቆጶስ ሆኖ ያገለገለ ታላቅ አባት ነው::
ቅዱስ ዮሴፍ ገዳማዊ፦ በበርሃ ተወስኖ በጾምና በጸሎት ያበራ አባት ነው::
የቅድስት ቴዎድራና የቅዱስ አልዓዛር ጸሎት ከሁላችን ጋር ይሁን::

en.verse: Jesus said to her, 'I am the resurrection and the life. He who believes in Me, though he may die, he shall live. And whoever lives and believes in Me shall never die. Do you believe this?'

am.verse: ኢየሱስም፦ ትንሣኤና ሕይወት እኔ ነኝ፤ የሚያምንብኝ ቢሞት እንኳ ሕያው ይሆናል፤ ሕያው የሆነም የሚያምንብኝም ሁሉ ለዘላለም አይሞትም፤ ይህን ታምኛለሽን? አላት።

title.en: St. Alexander Bishop of Jerusalem and St. James the Confessor
title.am: ቅዱስ እስክንድሮስ ኤጲስ ቆጶስ ዘኢየሩሳሌም እና ቅዱስ ያዕቆብ ምእመን

en: St. Alexander Bishop of Jerusalem (Founder of the Famous Theological Library of Jerusalem)
St. James the Confessor (Who Suffered under Iconoclasts)
St. Mark the Ascetic
am: ቅዱስ እስክንድሮስ ኤጲስ ቆጶስ ዘኢየሩሳሌም (የኢየሩሳሌምን ታላቅ የመጻሕፍት ግምጃ ቤት የመሠረተ)

en: St. Philip the Apostle
St. Titus the Apostle
Abba Eustathius the Ethiopian

St. Alexander Bishop of Jerusalem: Originally Bishop of Cappadocia, Alexander traveled to Jerusalem on pilgrimage. The Christians of Jerusalem, commanded by a heavenly vision, chose him to assist the aged Bishop Narcissus. Alexander established the renowned theological library of Jerusalem, where Origen studied. Under Emperor Decius, Alexander was imprisoned and suffered severe tortures for his confession of Christ, departing peacefully in chains to receive the martyr's crown on Megabit 18.
St. James the Confessor: A brave defender of Orthodox dogma who suffered exile and imprisonment for defending the veneration of holy icons.
St. Mark the Ascetic: A solitary elder who lived in desert fasting, tears, and prayer.
The life of St. Alexander reminds the Church that scholarly knowledge and sacrificial martyrdom together glorify God.
am: ቅዱስ እስክንድሮስ ኤጲስ ቆጶስ ዘኢየሩሳሌም፦ በመጀመሪያ የካፓዶቂያ ጳጳስ የነበረ: ወደ ኢየሩሳሌም ለጉብኝት በመጣ ጊዜ በራእይ ትእዛዝ የኢየሩሳሌም ኤጲስ ቆጶስ ሆኖ የተመረጠ ታላቅ አባት ነው:: በኢየሩሳሌም ታላቁን የመጻሕፍት ግምጃ ቤት አቋቁሟል:: በዴቅዮስ ዘመን በወኅኒ ታስሮ በሰንሰለት ሳለ መጋቢት 18 ቀን በሰማዕትነት ዐርፏል::
ቅዱስ ያዕቆብ ምእመን፦ ስለ ቀናች ሃይማኖት መከራን የታገሰ ቅዱስ ሰው ነው::
ቅዱስ ማርቆስ ገዳማዊ፦ በበርሃ ተወስኖ በጾምና በጸሎት ያበራ አባት ነው::
የቅዱስ እስክንድሮስና የቅዱሳኑ ጸሎት ከሁላችን ጋር ይሁን::

en.verse: I have fought the good fight, I have finished the race, I have kept the faith. Finally, there is laid up for me the crown of righteousness, which the Lord, the righteous Judge, will give to me on that Day.

am.verse: መልካሙን ገድል ተጋድያለሁ፥ ሩጫውን ጨርሻለሁ፥ ሃይማኖትን ጠብቄአለሁ፤ ወደ ፊት የጽድቅ አክሊል ተዘጋጅቶልኛል፥ ይህንም ጻድቅ ፈራጅ የሆነው ጌታ በዚያ ቀን ለእኔ ያስረክባል።

title.en: St. Aristobulus the Apostle (Bishop of Britain) and St. Gabriel the Martyr
title.am: ቅዱስ አርስጦቡሎስ ሐዋርያ (ኤጲስ ቆጶስ ዘብሪታንያ) እና ቅዱስ ገብርኤል ሰማዕት

en: St. Aristobulus the Apostle (Brother of St. Barnabas, First Apostle of Britain)
St. Gabriel the Youthful Martyr
St. Martha the Nun
am: ቅዱስ አርስጦቡሎስ ሐዋርያ (የቅዱስ በርናባስ ወንድም: የመጀመሪያው የብሪታንያ ሐዋርያ)

en: St. Gabriel the Archangel
St. John of Burullus
Abune Sine Eyesus the Righteous

St. Aristobulus the Apostle: Numbered among the seventy-two disciples, he was the brother of the Apostle Barnabas. Traveling with the Apostle Paul, he is greeted in Romans 16:10. Sent to preach the Gospel in the British Isles, he faced ferocious barbarian pagans who repeatedly beat and stoned him. Through divine patience, miracles, and the power of the Cross, he converted thousands, built churches, ordained priests and deacons, and fell asleep peacefully in Christ, revered as the Apostle of Britain.
St. Gabriel the Martyr: A noble young Christian who stood fearlessly before pagan persecutors, crowned with martyrdom.
St. Martha: A pious virgin who spent her days in desert prayer and charity.
The apostolic journeys of Aristobulus inspire the Church to carry the Gospel of salvation to the ends of the earth without fear.
am: ቅዱስ አርስጦቡሎስ ሐዋርያ፦ ከ72ቱ አርድእት አንዱና የቅዱስ በርናባስ ወንድም ሲሆን ከቅዱስ ጳውሎስ ጋር ወንጌልን ሰብኳል:: ወደ ብሪታንያ (እንግሊዝ) ደሴት ተልኮ በአረማውያን መካከል ብዙ መከራን ታግሦ ድንቆችን እያደረገ በርካቶችን አጥምቋል:: አብያተ ክርስቲያናትን አንጾ: ካህናትን ሾሞ መጋቢት 19 ቀን በሰላም ዐርፏል::
ቅዱስ ገብርኤል ሰማዕት፦ ስለ ክርስቶስ ስም ደሙን ያፈሰሰ ክቡር ሰማዕት ነው::
ቅድስት ማርታ ገዳማዊት፦ በጾምና በጸሎት ያበራች ንጽሕት እናት ናት::
የቅዱስ አርስጦቡሎስና የቅዱሳኑ ጸሎት ከሁላችን ጋር ይሁን::

en.verse: Greet Apelles, approved in Christ. Greet those who are of the household of Aristobulus.

am.verse: በክርስቶስ መመረጡ ለታወቀው ለአጵሌስ ሰላምታ አቅርቡልኝ። ከአርስጦቡሎስ ቤተ ሰዎች ላሉት ሰላምታ አቅርቡልኝ።

title.en: St. Thecla the Martyr and St. Michael the Solitary Monk
title.am: ቅድስት ቴክላ ሰማዕት እና ቅዱስ ሚካኤል ባሕታዊ

en: St. Thecla the Martyr of Rome (Beheaded under Diocletian)
St. Michael the Solitary Desert Father
St. Isaac the Confessor
am: ቅድስት ቴክላ ሰማዕት ዘሮሜ (በዲዮቅልጥያኖስ ዘመን የተሰዋች)

en: Hennaze Maryam (Dedication of the Virgin's Church)
St. John Chrysostom
St. Thaddaeus the Apostle

St. Thecla the Martyr: A devout Roman maiden who dedicated her virginity to Christ. During the Diocletian persecution, she refused pagan marriage and pagan sacrifice, declaring herself the bride of Christ. She was subjected to the rack, scraped with iron claws, and cast into the fire, but remained unharmed by divine power before being beheaded, ascending to the celestial bridal chamber.
St. Michael the Solitary: An Egyptian anchorite who spent sixty years in the deep desert in absolute silence and prayer, overcoming demonic assaults through the Sign of the Cross.
St. Isaac the Confessor: Commemorated for his steadfast defense of holy dogma during imperial trials.
The courageous virginity of St. Thecla reminds all Christians to preserve holiness of body and spirit for the eternal Bridegroom.
am: ቅድስት ቴክላ ሰማዕት፦ በሮም ከተማ የተወለደች: ድንግልናዋን ለክርስቶስ የሰጠች ንጽሕት ናት:: በዲዮቅልጥያኖስ ፊት በድፍረት ክርስቶስን በመመስከሯ በስለትና በእሳት ቢፈትኗትም እግዚአብሔር አድኗታል:: በመጨረሻም አንገቷን ለሰይፍ ሰጥታ የሰማዕትነት አክሊል ተቀብላለች::
ቅዱስ ሚካኤል ባሕታዊ፦ ለ60 ዓመታት በበረሃ በብሕትውና የኖረ ጻድቅ አባት ነው::
ቅዱስ ይስሐቅ ምእመን፦ ሃይማኖቱን የጠበቀ ቅዱስ ሰው ነው::
የቅድስት ቴክላና የቅዱሳኑ ጸሎት ከሁላችን ጋር ይሁን::

en.verse: And he who does not take his cross and follow after Me is not worthy of Me. He who finds his life will lose it, and he who loses his life for My sake will find it.

am.verse: መስቀሉንም የማይዝ በኋላዬም የማይከተለኝ ለእኔ ሊሆን አይገባውም። ነፍሱን የሚያገኝ ያጠፋታል፥ ነፍሱንም ስለ እኔ የሚያጠፋ ያገኛታል።

title.en: Monthly Feast of the Holy Theotokos and St. Theodore the Roman Martyr
title.am: ወርኀዊ በዓለ እግዝእትነ ማርያም ድንግል ወላዲተ አምላክ እና ቅዱስ ቴዎድሮስ ሮማዊ ሰማዕት

en: Monthly Commemoration of our Lady Mary the Holy Mother of God
St. Theodore the Roman Martyr (Commander of Roman Forces)
St. Luke the Monk
am: ወርኀዊ መታሰቢያ ለእግዝእትነ ማርያም ድንግል ወላዲተ አምላክ
ቅዱስ ቴዎድሮስ ሮማዊ ሰማዕት (የሮም ሠራዊት አለቃ)

en: Our Lady Mary the Holy Theotokos
The Twelve Apostles
St. Cyprian the Martyr

Monthly Feast of the Holy Theotokos: Holy Church renders glorious thanksgiving to our Lady Mary, the Mother of God, through whom the Light of the World shone upon those who sat in darkness. Ethiopian sanctuaries resound with hymns of praise honoring her intercession, which is swift and boundless for all who call upon her holy name.

St. Theodore the Roman Martyr: A distinguished general in the Roman legions who stood boldly before pagan magistrates, confessing Christ and throwing his military insignia to the ground. After enduring excruciating tortures, he was beheaded, ascending to glory.
St. Luke the Monk: A peaceful solitary who lived in continuous prayer and fasting.
The love of the Virgin Mary shields the Church against all adversity, guiding believers to eternal life with her Son.
am: ወርኀዊ መታሰቢያ ለእግዝእትነ ማርያም፦ ቅድስት ቤተ ክርስቲያን የእመቤታችንን ንጽሕና: ቅድስናና አማላጅነት በታላቅ ምስጋና ታስባለች:: ድንግል ማርያም የብርሃን እናት: የዓለም ሁሉ መታመኛ ናት::
ቅዱስ ቴዎድሮስ ሮማዊ ሰማዕት፦ ስለ ክርስቶስ ስም በድፍረት የመሰከረ: መከራን ታግሦ አንገቱን ለሰይፍ የሰጠ ታላቅ ሰማዕት ነው::
ቅዱስ ሉቃስ ገዳማዊ፦ በበርሃ ተወስኖ በጾምና በጸሎት ያበራ አባት ነው::
የእመቤታችን የድንግል ማርያምና የቅዱስ ቴዎድሮስ ጸሎት ከሁላችን ጋር ይሁን::

en.verse: And Mary said: 'My soul magnifies the Lord, and my spirit has rejoiced in God my Savior. For He has regarded the lowly state of His maidservant; for behold, henceforth all generations will call me blessed.'

am.verse: ማርያምም እንዲህ አለች፦ ነፍሴ ጌታን ታከብረዋለች፥ መንፈሴም በአምላኬ በመድኃኒቴ ሐሴት ታደርጋለች፤ የባሪያይቱን ውርደት ተመልክቶአልና። እነሆም፥ ከዛሬ ጀምሮ ትውልድ ሁሉ ብፅዕት ይሉኛል።

title.en: St. Cyril Patriarch of Jerusalem (Doctor of the Catechism) and St. Michael the Martyr
title.am: ቅዱስ ቄርሎስ ሊቀ ጳጳሳት ዘኢየሩሳሌም (ባለታላቅ ትምህርት) እና ቅዱስ ሚካኤል ሰማዕት

en: St. Cyril Patriarch of Jerusalem (Author of the Mystagogic Catecheses, Exiled Three Times by Arians)
St. Michael the Martyr
St. Paul the Hermit
am: ቅዱስ ቄርሎስ ሊቀ ጳጳሳት ዘኢየሩሳሌም (የኦርቶዶክስ ትምህርት አባት: በአርዮሳውያን ሦስት ጊዜ የተሰደደ)

en: St. Uriel the Archangel
Abba Anthony the Great
St. Luke the Evangelist

St. Cyril Patriarch of Jerusalem: Consecrated Bishop of Jerusalem around 350 A.D. During his episcopate, the miraculous Cross of Light appeared over Golgotha. Renowned for his twenty-four sublime Catechetical Lectures instructing catechumens in the Orthodox faith, baptism, and the Holy Mysteries. The Arians fabricated accusations and exiled him from Jerusalem three times. He returned triumphantly, participated in the Second Ecumenical Council in Constantinople (381 A.D.), and fell asleep peacefully on Megabit 22.
St. Michael the Martyr: A brave confessor who gave his life for Christ under pagan persecutors.
St. Paul the Hermit: An ascetic who struggled in continuous desert prayer and silence.
The profound catechetical instruction of St. Cyril remains a guiding beacon of sacramental theology and Orthodox devotion.
am: ቅዱስ ቄርሎስ ሊቀ ጳጳሳት ዘኢየሩሳሌም፦ በ350 ዓ/ም የኢየሩሳሌም ሊቀ ጳጳሳት ሆኖ የተሾመ ታላቅ አባት ነው:: በዘመኑ በኢየሩሳሌም ሰማይ ላይ የብርሃን መስቀል ተገልጧል:: ምእመናንን ስለ ጥምቀት: ስለ ቅዱስ ቁርባንና ስለ ቀናች ሃይማኖት ያስተማረባቸው 24ቱ ድርሳናቱ በቤተ ክርስቲያን እጅግ የታወቁ ናቸው:: በአርዮሳውያን ምክንያት ሦስት ጊዜ ተሰዶ በመጨረሻ በ381 ዓ/ም በቁስጥንጥንያ ጉባኤ ተገኝቶ መጋቢት 22 ቀን በሰላም ዐርፏል::
ቅዱስ ሚካኤል ሰማዕት፦ ስለ ክርስቶስ ስም ሰማዕትነትን የተቀበለ ቅዱስ ነው::
ቅዱስ ዻውሎስ ባሕታዊ፦ በበረሃ ተወስኖ በጾምና በጸሎት ያበራ አባት ነው::
የቅዱስ ቄርሎስ ዘኢየሩሳሌም ጸሎትና በረከት ከሁላችን ጋር ይሁን::

en.verse: All Scripture is given by inspiration of God, and is profitable for doctrine, for reproof, for correction, for instruction in righteousness, that the man of God may be complete, thoroughly equipped for every good work.

am.verse: የእግዚአብሔር ሰው ፍጹምና ለበጎ ሥራ ሁሉ የተዘጋጀ ይሆን ዘንድ፥ የእግዚአብሔር መንፈስ ያለበት መጽሐፍ ሁሉ ለትምህርትና ለተግሣጽ ልብንም ለማቅናት በጽድቅም ላለው ምክር ደግሞ ይጠቅማል።

title.en: St. Daniel the Great Prophet and St. Macarius the Martyr
title.am: ታላቁ ነቢይ ቅዱስ ዳንኤል (ተወዳጁ ነቢይ) እና ቅዱስ መቃርስ ሰማዕት

en: St. Daniel the Great Prophet (Who Interpreted Nebuchadnezzar's Dream and Was Preserved in the Lions' Den)
St. Macarius the Martyr
St. John the Ascetic
am: ታላቁ ነቢይ ቅዱስ ዳንኤል (የናቡከደነፆርን ሕልም የፈታ: በአንበሶች ጉድጓድ ያልተጎዳ)

en: St. George the Megalomartyr
Abba Longinus the Hermit
St. Marina the Martyr

St. Daniel the Great Prophet: Carried captive from Jerusalem to Babylon as a youth, Daniel preserved dietary and spiritual purity, refusing the king's delicacies. God gave him understanding of all visions and dreams. He interpreted Nebuchadnezzar's dream of the great statue crushed by the uncut stone (Christ), saw the Ancient of Days and the Son of Man coming on clouds, and prophesied the exact timeline of the Messiah's coming. Cast into a den of ravenous lions under Darius, the angel of the Lord shut the lions' mouths. He lived in righteousness to an advanced age, resting on Megabit 23.
St. Macarius the Martyr: A noble Christian who endured cruel tortures and was beheaded for Christ.
St. John the Ascetic: A solitary desert father who prayed continuously in wilderness caves.
The steadfast purity and prophetic visions of Daniel assure believers that God preserves His faithful through all perils.
am: ታላቁ ነቢይ ቅዱስ ዳንኤል፦ በባቢሎን ምርኮ ሳለ የንጉሡን ምግብ ሳይበላ በእህልና በውሃ የጾመ: እግዚአብሔር ታላቅ የጥበብና የራእይ ጸጋ የሰጠው ነቢይ ነው:: የናቡከደነፆርን ሕልም ፈታ:: የአምላክን መወለድና የዓለማትን ፍጻሜ ተመልክቷል:: በንጉሥ ዳርዮስ ዘመን በጸሎቱ ምክንያት ወደ ተራቡ አንበሶች ጉድጓድ ቢጣለም የእግዚአብሔር መልአክ መጥቶ የአንበሶቹን አፍ ዘጋለት:: በታላቅ ቅድስና ኖሮ መጋቢት 23 ቀን ዐርፏል::
ቅዱስ መቃርስ ሰማዕት፦ ስለ ክርስቶስ ስም ደሙን ያፈሰሰ ሰማዕት ነው::
ቅዱስ ዮሐንስ ገዳማዊ፦ በበርሃ ተወስኖ በጾምና በጸሎት ያበራ አባት ነው::
የነቢዩ የቅዱስ ዳንኤልና የቅዱሳኑ ጸሎት ከሁላችን ጋር ይሁን::

en.verse: My God sent His angel and shut the lions' mouths, so that they have not hurt me, because I was found innocent before Him; and also, O king, I have done no wrong before you.

am.verse: አምላኬ መልአኩን ልኮ የአንበሶቹን አፍ ዘጋ፥ በእርሱ ፊት ንጹሕ ሆኜ ተገኝቼአለሁና አልጎዱኝም፤ ደግሞም፥ ንጉሥ ሆይ፥ በፊትህ አልበደልሁም።

title.en: Abba Macarius the Great (Father of the Monks of Scetis) and St. Theodore the Martyr
title.am: አባ መቃርስ ሊቀ ጳጳሳት (አበ መነኮሳት ዘአስቄጥስ) እና ቅዱስ ቴዎድሮስ ሰማዕት

en: Abba Macarius the Great (Founder of Scetis Monasticism and Patriarch)
St. Theodore the Soldier Martyr
St. Sarah the Ascetic
am: አባ መቃርስ ሊቀ ጳጳሳት (የአስቄጥስ መነኮሳት አባት: ባለታላቅ ትሩፋት)

en: Abune Tekle Haymanot
St. Thomas the Apostle
St. John the Baptist

Abba Macarius the Great: The founder of monastic life in the desert of Scetis, disciple of St. Anthony the Great. Known as an 'earthly god' for his radiant humility, he covered the faults of his brethren as God covers the sins of the world. Once falsely accused of fathering a child, he accepted the slander in silence, weaving double palm baskets to support the mother until God vindicated his innocence. He raised the dead, received angelic visions, and guided thousands of hermits until his peaceful repose on Megabit 24 at ninety years of age.
St. Theodore the Martyr: A faithful soldier who refused to sacrifice to idols, enduring cruel tortures before receiving the martyr's crown.
St. Sarah the Ascetic: A devout nun commemorated for her life of prayer and silence.
The sublime humility of Abba Macarius teaches the Church that covering the faults of others and deep humility conquer every demonic snare.
am: አባ መቃርስ ሊቀ ጳጳሳት፦ የአስቄጥስ በረሃ ገዳማዊ ሕይወት መሥራች: የታላቁ አባ እንጦንስ ደቀ መዝሙር ነው:: በትሕትናው የተነሳ 'ምድራዊ አምላክ' ይሉት ነበር:: በሐሰት ሲከሰስ አርምሞን መርጦ ለዓመታት በእርጋታ ተጋድሏል:: እግዚአብሔር ንጽሕናውን ገልጦ በርካታ ድንቆችን በእጁ አድርጓል:: ሙታንን ያስነሳ: በሺህ የሚቆጠሩ መነኮሳትን የመራ ታላቅ አባት ሲሆን በ90 ዓመቱ መጋቢት 24 ቀን በሰላም ዐርፏል::
ቅዱስ ቴዎድሮስ ሰማዕት፦ ስለ ክርስቶስ ስም ደሙን ያፈሰሰ ሰማዕት ነው::
ቅድስት ሣራ ገዳማዊት፦ በጾምና በጸሎት ያበራች ንጽሕት እናት ናት::
የአባ መቃርስና የቅዱሳኑ ጸሎት ከሁላችን ጋር ይሁን::

en.verse: Blessed are the pure in heart, for they shall see God.

am.verse: ልበ ንጹሖች ብፁዓን ናቸው፥ እግዚአብሔርን ያዩታልና።

title.en: St. Onesiphorus the Apostle and St. Gabriel the Martyr
title.am: ቅዱስ አናሲፎሮስ ሐዋርያ እና ቅዱስ ገብርኤል ሰማዕት

en: St. Onesiphorus the Apostle (Memorial of His Apostolic Labors)
St. Gabriel the Martyr of Rome
St. Sophia the Nun
St. Mercurius the Martyr
St. James the Apostle
St. Abanob the Child Martyr

St. Onesiphorus the Apostle: Numbered among the seventy disciples, commemorated on this day for his tireless evangelistic mission, traveling across Asia Minor and Europe, confirming newly planted churches in the truth of the Holy Trinity.
